contributorNote: Borana / Oromo (Afaan Borana / Orma / Kigalla) vocabulary compiled from Rev. J. L. Krapf & Rev. C. W. Isenberg (1840 "An Imperfect Outline of the Elements of the Galla Language", 1842 "Vocabulary of the Galla Language", 1850 "Vocabulary of Six East-African Languages"), Karl & Lawrence Tutschek (1844–1845), R. N. Cust (1883), E. C. Foot (1913), Prof. Alice Werner (1915), BFBS (1921), and Catherine Griefenow-Mewis (1996). Expanded and cross-verified with Commercially Permissive Datasets (Google Research SMOL/GATITOS Oromo/Borana (en_orm, CC-BY-4.0), Kaikki.org Oromo Machine-Readable Dictionary (1,245 headwords, CC-BY-SA-4.0), CLDF ASJP v20 BORANA_OROMO & WAATA (CC-BY-4.0), OLDI FLORES+ & SIB-200 (CC-BY-SA-4.0)).

entries.english: Your skin is your largest organ, and it's important to take care of it both inside and out. Here are some tips for healthy skin:
entries.translation: Gogaan qaama keessan isa guddaadha, kanaafuu keessoo fi ala isaaf kunuunsa gochuun barbaachisaadha. Fayyummaa gogaatiif gorsoonni muraasni kunooti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Drink plenty of water: Water is essential for healthy skin, as it helps to keep your skin hydrated and soft. Aim to drink eight glasses of water per day.
entries.translation: * Bishaan hedduu dhuguu: Bishaan akka gogaan keenya hin gogne waan taasisuuf, fayyumma gogaatiif barbaachisaadha. Kanaafuubishaan hanga burcuqqoo saddeetii dhuguuf yaalaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Eat a healthy diet: Eating a healthy diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains can help to improve your skin's appearance.
entries.translation: * Soorata fayyaaleyyii soorachuu: Soorata fayyaaleyyii kanneen akka muduraalee, kuduraalee, akkasumas midhaan dheedhii soorachuun bareedina gogaa keessanii dabala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Get enough sleep: When you don't get enough sleep, your body produces more of the stress hormone cortisol, which can lead to inflammation and skin problems. Aim for 7-8 hours of sleep per night.
entries.translation: * Hirriba gahaa argachuu: Yoo hirriba gahaa hin arganne, qaamni keessan hormonii mukaa'uu koortisool jedhamu maddisiisa, kun immoo dhukkubbii fi gubachuu gogaa fida. halkan tokkotti sa'atii 7-8 rafuu yaalaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Protect your skin from the sun: The sun's UV rays can damage your skin and lead to premature aging, wrinkles, and skin cancer.
entries.translation: * Gogaa keessan aduu irraa eegaa: Xiyyoonni UV aduu gogaa keessan miidhuun dulluma yeroo malee akkasumas kaanserii gogaf isin saaxila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But in 1974, a military junta known as the Derg seized power and began a brutal campaign of repression.
entries.translation: Garuu bara 1974 keessa, juuntaan waraanaa Dargii jedhamu aangoo qabachuun hacuuccaa gara jabinaa eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Derg's policies led to widespread famine and poverty, and millions of Ethiopians were forced to flee their homes.
entries.translation: Imaammatoonni Dargii gara beelaa fi hiyyuma bal'aatti biyyattii geesse, akkasumas Itoophiyaanonni miiliyoonotaan lakka'aman biyyatti dheessanii akka deeman taasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1991, a coalition of rebel groups known as the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF) overthrew the Derg.
entries.translation: Bara 1991 keessa, wal ta'iinsi garee finciltootaa Adda Dimokiraatawaa Warraaqsa Uummatoota Itoophiyaa (ADWUI) jedhamu Dargii aangoo irraa kuffiise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The EPRDF established a new government and promised to restore peace and prosperity to Ethiopia.
entries.translation: ADWUI n mootummaa haaraya hundeessuun nagaa fi badhaadhina Itoophiyaa bakkatti deebisuuf waadaa seene.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the EPRDF's rule has been plagued by human rights abuses, corruption, and political repression.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, bulchiinsi ADWUI sarbama mirgoota namoomaa, malaammaltumaa, fi hacuuccaa siyaasaan kan dabaalamedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2018, Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed took office and pledged to reform the country.
entries.translation: Bara 2018 keessa, Muummichi Ministeerotaa Abiy Ahimed aangoo qabachuun biyyattii keessatti haaromsa fiduuf waadaa seenan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He released political prisoners, lifted restrictions on the media, and began peace talks with the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), the former ruling party of Tigray.
entries.translation: Hidhamtoota siyaasaa hidhaa irraa gadhiise, qoqqobbiiwwan miidiyaa irra turan kaase, akkasumas Adda Bilisa baasaa Uummata Tigiraay (ABUT), paartii duraan Tigiraay bulchaa ture waliin marii nagaa taasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the peace talks broke down in June 2020, and the TPLF launched an offensive against the Ethiopian military.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, mariin nagaa kun Waxabajji 2020 adda cabe, ABUT raayyaa ittisa biyyaa Itoophiyaa irratti tarkaanfii haleellaa fudhate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ensuing conflict has been devastating.

entries.english: The fighting has displaced millions of people, and the humanitarian situation is dire.

entries.english: They can influence our beliefs about everything from love and romance to war and violence.

entries.english: And they have a particularly strong influence on our ideas about gender roles.

entries.english: For decades, Hollywood has perpetuated the stereotype of the ideal wife as a beautiful, submissive, and domestic woman who puts her husband and children first.
entries.translation: Saddeeta muraasaaf, Hooliiwuud haadha manaa akka dubartii bareedduu, ajajamtuu, fi mana keessaa hin baane, kan abbaa manaa fi ijoollee isheef dursa kennituu gochuun bocaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This image is often reinforced by the way that female characters are portrayed in movies.
entries.translation: Suuraan sunis taatoowwan dubartii fiilmicha keessatti taasisaniin deggeramaa ture.

entries.english: The majority of female characters were portrayed as either romantic interests or mothers.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This narrow representation of women in film sends a powerful message to viewers about what it means to be a woman.
entries.translation: Bakka bu'ummaan dubartootaa dhiphaan fiilmii keessa jiru kunis maalummaa dubartootaa ilaalchisee daawwattoota bira ergaa jabaa geessisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It suggests that women's primary role is to be attractive and nurturing, and that their success is measured by their relationships with men and children.
entries.translation: Gaheen dubartootaa inni hangafni hawwattuu fi bareedduu ta'uu, akkasumas milkaa'inni isaanii walitti dhufeenya isaan dhiiraa fi ijoollee isaanii waliin madaalama ergaa jedhu calaqqisiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This idealized image of the wife can be harmful to women in several ways.

entries.english: Patient: Doctor, I've been having this terrible stomach pain for the past few days.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Dookter, Guyyoota muraasaaf dhukkubbii garaa hamaa kanaanin rakkachaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's so bad that I can't eat or sleep.
entries.translation: Hammaachuu isaa irraa kan ka'e nyaachuu fi rafuu hin danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a sharp, stabbing pain that comes and goes.
entries.translation: Dhukkubbii qara ta'ee fi kan nama waraanu amma dhufee amma badudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Can you tell me more about the pain? Where is it located?
entries.translation: Dookterii: Waa'ee dukkubbii kanaa dabalataan natti himuu dandeessaa? Essa kee dhukkuba?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's mostly in my lower abdomen, right around my belly button, but it sometimes radiates to my back.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Irra jireessaan garaa koo gara gadiiti, naannoo handhuura kootii, yeroo tokko tokko immoo gara dugda koottis natti dhagahama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does anything make the pain worse?
entries.translation: Dookterii: Waanti dhukkubbicha sitti hammeessu ni jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Eating seems to make it worse, especially fatty or greasy foods.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Nyaata kaa, keessumaa nyaatota cooma qaban ykn dibata qaban yoon nyaadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: And does anything make it better.?
entries.translation: Dooktera: Waanti sitti fooyyessu hoo ni jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Lying down seems to help a little.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Yoon ciise xiqqoo natti fura.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does the pain come and go, or is it constant?
entries.translation: Dookterii: Dhukkubbichi kan dhufee badu moo, walitti fufiinsa qaba?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's constant. It's just a dull ache, but it's really uncomfortable.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Dhaabbataa dha. dhukkubbii nuffisiisaadha, garuu dhugumatti namatti hin tolu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Have you had any other symptoms? Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea?
entries.translation: Dookterii: Mallattoowwan kan biroo ni qabdaa? Ol ol nama jechuu, balaqqama, garaa kaasaa?

entries.english: Doctor: I see. Well, it sounds like you're having a case of gastritis.
entries.translation: Dookterii: Naaf gale. Tole, egaa mallattoolee dhukkuba garaachaan si irratti argaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gastritis is inflammation of the stomach lining.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be caused by a number of things, including eating spicy or fatty foods, drinking alcohol, or taking certain medications.
entries.translation: Sababoota hedduudhaan uumamuu danda'u, kunis nyaatawwan guban ykn cooma hedduu qaban nyaachuu, alkoolii dhuguu, ykn qorichoota tokko tokko fudhachuu fa'a dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It can be, but in most cases it's not.
entries.translation: Dookterii: Ta'uu danda'a, garuu haala hedduu keessatti akkas hin ta'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to prescribe you some medication to help relieve the pain and inflammation.
entries.translation: Amma egaa gubaa fi dhukkubbiin kun akka sitti furuuf qorichoota muraasan siif ajaja.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid eating spicy or fatty foods, and drink plenty of fluids.
entries.translation: Nyaata gubaa fi cooma hedduu qabu nyaachuu dhiisuu qabda, dhangala'aa baay'ee immoo dhugi.

entries.english: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan.
entries.translation: 1. Dursanii oovaanii hanga digirii F 350 (digirii C 175)tti ho'isuu. eelee keekii iinchii 8 bal'atu dibata dibuun daakuu xiqqoo itti firfirsuun siilessuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flours, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
entries.translation: 2. Sa'anii giddu galeessatti, daakuu, sukkaara daakamaa, sukkaara boora, daakuu daabboo, soodaa daabboo, fi ashaboo waliin rukkutuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and egg until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg yolk and almond extract.
entries.translation: 3. Sa'anii guddaa keessatti, hanga inni sirriitti wal makutti dhadhaa fi buphaa waliin rukkutuu. Keessoo buuphaa fi cuunfaa almoondii itti rukkutuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk. Mix until just combined.
entries.translation: 4. Suuta suuta qabiyyeewwan gogaa sana qabiyyeewwan jiidhaatti dabaluu, aannanis itti gochuu. Hanga wal nyaatutti sirriitti walitti makuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Fold in the almond flour until evenly distributed.
entries.translation: 5. Hanga inni wal qixaatee wal ga'utti daakuu almoondii itti firfirsuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a hot summer day in July when I finally turned 16 years old.
entries.translation: Yeroo ani waggaa 16 guutu Adoolessi ganna ho'aa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had been eagerly anticipating this day for as long as I could remember, and now that it was finally here, I couldn't wait to get started on my road to freedom.
entries.translation: Guyyaa kana hangan yaadadhutti yeroo dheeraafin hawwaa ture, dhuma irratti kunoo amma ni gahe, daandii bilisummaa koo eegaluuf jarjareen ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first step was to take the written test.
entries.translation: Tarkaanfiin jalqabaa qorumsa barreeffamaa fudhachuu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I studied hard for weeks, and I was confident that I would pass.
entries.translation: Torbanootaaf jabaadhee qo'achaan ture, akkan darbu ofitti amanamummaan qaban ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the day of the test, I arrived at the DMV early and took my seat in the waiting room.
entries.translation: Guyyaa qorumsaa, durseen DMV qaqqabe sana booda kutaa eegumsaa keessaan bakka qabadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, my name was called, and I was ushered into a small room with a computer.
entries.translation: Sa'atiiwwan muraasa booda, maqaan kiyya ni waamame, gara kutaa xiqqoo kompiyuutera qabdu tokkoottin seensifame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The test was surprisingly easy, and I finished it in no time.
entries.translation: Qorumsichi haala nama ajaa'ibuun baay'ee salphaa waan tureef dafeen xumure.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few days later, I received a letter in the mail informing me that I had passed the written test.
entries.translation: Guyyoota muraasa booda, Xalayaa qorumsa barreeffamaa darbuu kiyya ibsutu ana qaqqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next step was to schedule a driving test.
entries.translation: Tarkaanfiin itti aanu qorumsa konkolaachisummaaf beellama qabachuu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I called the DMV and made an appointment for the following week.
entries.translation: DMV f bilbileen toorban itti aanuuf beellama qabsiifadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The day of my driving test arrived, and I was more nervous than I had ever been in my life.
entries.translation: Guyyaan qorumsa konkolaachisummaa koo ni gahe, jireenya koo keessatti akka guyyaa sanaa sodaadhee hin beeku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I drove to the DMV with my mom, who would be accompanying me on the test.
entries.translation: Harmee kiyya, kan qorumsicha irratti miiltoo koo taate faanan gara DMV deeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Heartbreak," sighed the poet, "is the cruelest of afflictions.
entries.translation: "Cabni laphee," jedhee hafuura baafate walaloo barreessaan, "rakkina keessaa isa gara jabeessadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a pain that pierces the soul and leaves us feeling empty and alone.
entries.translation: Dhukkuba lubbuu namaa dhiigsuu fi mirri duwwuumaa akkasumas kophummaan akka nutti dhagahaamuu kan godhu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a fire that burns from within, consuming us with its flames.
entries.translation: Innis ibidda keessaa keenyaa nu gubuu yoo ta'u, labooba isaatiin immoo kan nu nyaatu dha. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a storm that tears us apart, leaving us broken and scarred.
entries.translation: Bubbee adda adda nu cicciruu yoo ta'u, cacabsuniifii fi madeessudhaan kan nu dhiisudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even in the midst of our heartbreak, there is hope.
entries.translation: Gaddi keenya cimaa ta'ullee gidduu kanatti garuu abdiin jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For even as our hearts are broken, they are also made new.
entries.translation: Gaddi garaa keenyaa jiraatus dandeettii haaromuus nii qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are given the opportunity to learn from our mistakes and to grow stronger.
entries.translation: Dogoggora keenya irraa barannee akka cimnuuf carraan nuuf kennamee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are given the chance to find love again, even if it is different than the love we have lost.
entries.translation: Jaalala dhabne irraa adda ta'ullee, deebinee jaalala argachuuf carraan nuuf kenname jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So let us not despair in our heartbreak.
entries.translation: Kanaafuu gadda ciimaan nurra gaheen abdii kutachu hin qabnu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us instead embrace it as a part of life.
entries.translation: Kana mannaa akkuma qaama jireenyaatti haa fudhannu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us learn from it and grow from it.
entries.translation: Irraa haa barannuu irraas haa guddannu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And let us never give up on the hope of finding love again"
entries.translation: Akkasumas irra deebinee jaalala argachuu irrattis abdii hin kutachuu hin qabnu"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Judaism and Kosher Kosher is a set of dietary laws in Judaism.
entries.translation: Juudaayizimii fi Kooshar Koosharin tuuta seera nyaataa amantii Yihudootaa keessatti kan argamu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These laws define which foods are permissible to eat and which are not.
entries.translation: Seerotni kunnen nyaata kam nyaachuun akka eyyemamu fi kan hin hayyamamne kan ibsanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kosher foods are those that are considered to be fit for consumption according to Jewish law.
entries.translation: Nyaatonni kooshar akka seera Yihudootaatti warreen nyaataf akka mijatutti kan ilaalamani dha. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The laws of kosher are based on the Torah, the first five books of the Hebrew Bible.
entries.translation: Seeronni kooshar kakuu moofaa irratti kan bu’uureffaman yoo ta'u, isaanis kitaabota isaan jalqabaa Macaafa Qulqulluu Afaan Ibrootaa shanan irraa kan dhufanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These laws prohibit the consumption of certain animals, such as pigs and shellfish, as well as the consumption of blood and meat from animals that have not been slaughtered in a specific way.
entries.translation: Seerotni kunneen soorannaa bineensota akka boyyee fi qola qurxummii adda addaa kan dhorkan yoo ta'u, dhiigaa fi foon bineensota bifa adda ta’een hin qalamne irraa argamu nyaachuus ni dhorku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kosher foods are also subject to a number of other regulations, such as the separation of dairy and meat products.
entries.translation: Nyaatni kooshar dambiiwwan hedduu biro irratti illee ni xiyyefata, isaanis kannen akka adda ba'insa oomisha aannaniifi fooniiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kosher food is prepared in a way that ensures that it is fit for consumption according to Jewish law.
entries.translation: Nyaanni kooshar akkaataa mijaa'ina fayyadama seera Yihudootaa mirkaneesseen qophaa'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The observance of kosher laws is an important part of Jewish religious practice.
entries.translation: Seera kooshar kabajun gocha amantii Yihudootaa keessatti kutaa barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For many Jews, eating kosher food is a way to show their devotion to God and to connect with their heritage.
entries.translation: Yihudoota hedduudhaaf nyaata kooshar nyaachuun Waaqayyoof of kennuu isaanii argisiisuu yoo ta'u fi hambaa isaanii wajjin walitti dhufeenya uumuuf karaa itti fayyadamani dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of reasons why Jews observe kosher laws.
entries.translation: Sababoonni hedduun Yihuudonni maalif seera Kooshar kabajan ibsan ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm telling you, this is going to be the funniest thing ever," said Tom.
entries.translation: Toomis "Sitti himaan jira, kun waan baay'ee nama kofalchiisu ta'uuf deema" jedhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Just wait until you see the look on people's faces when they see my new tattoo!"
entries.translation: "Hanga namootni yeroo tumaa koo haaraa kana argan argitutti qofa eegi!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I don't know, Tom," said his friend, Ben.
entries.translation: Hiriyyan isa Beenis"Ani hin beeku, Toom" jedhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "A green question mark on your forehead seems like it could be a bit of a risky move."
entries.translation: "Mallattoon gaaffii magariisa aadda kee irratti mul'atu suni xiqqooshee sochii balaa qabu ta'uu akka danda'u kan agarsiisu fakkaata."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's what makes it so funny," said Tom "People are going to be so confused.

entries.translation: Namoonni Gaambiyaa keessa jiran hedduun isaanii hojii qonnaa, qurxummii qabuu yookin immoo hojii turiizimii irratti bobaa'aniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others work in government, business, or education.
entries.translation: Kaan immoo hojii mootummaa, daldala yookiin barnoota irratti hojjetu. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the afternoon, people may take a break from work to relax or socialize.
entries.translation: Waaree boodas, namoonni hojii irraa boqonnaa fudhachuun yookiin hawasummaadhaan yeroo dabarsuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They may go for a walk, visit friends and family, or play games.
entries.translation: Deemsaaf gad ba'u, hiriyootaafi maatii isaanii daawwachuu yookin tapha taphachuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the evening, people often eat dinner with their families.
entries.translation: Gara galgalaattis, yeroo baay'ee namoonni maatii isaanii waliin irbaata nyaatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dinner is typically a simple meal of rice, vegetables, and meat or fish.
entries.translation: Irbaannis yeroo baay'ee nyaata salphaa isaan ruuzii, kuduraalee fi foon yookin qurxummii irraa qophaa'anidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The gadgets and utensils of the kitchen are a language, a means of communication between cook and food.
entries.translation: Meeshaaleen mana nyaataa akka qooqaatti kan tajaajilan yoo ta'u, qunnamtiin nama nyaata bilcheessuu fi nyaata qophaa'u gidduutti akka uumamuuf haala mijeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The whisk, the tongs, the ladle, the spatula - each has its own meaning, its own purpose.
entries.translation: Fal'aanichi, qabduun, cirfaa, sochooftu - tokkoon tokkoon isaanii hiika mataa isaanii akkasumas kaayyoo mataa isaanii qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To use them well is to understand the language of cooking, to season the dish with the flavors of experience and skill.
entries.translation: Isaanin akka gaariitti fayyadamuu jechuun afaan nyaata bilcheessuu hubachuufi mi'aa nyaata muuxannoo fi ogummaa waliin walitti makuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The whisk is a whisk, the tongs are tongs, and the ladle is a ladle.
entries.translation: Fala'anichi fala'ana dha, qabduunis qabduu dha, cilfaanis cilfaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a whisk, the cook can whip up a frothy batter or emulsify a delicate sauce.
entries.translation: Fal'aanichaan, namni nyaata sana hojjatu waliitti makee fooli haawwataa baasa yookin soosi mi'aawa ta'e ni hojjata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With tongs, he or she can flip a steak or turn a roast.
entries.translation: Qabduu fayyadamuu dhaan inni yookin isheen foon waaddamee garagalchuu danda'a yookiin ni dandessi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a ladle, he or she can ladle out a steaming bowl of soup or sauce.
entries.translation: Inni yookin isheen cirfaa dhaan, soosii yookin wanta danfaa jiru tokko baasuu dandaʼa yookin ni dandeessii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The gadgets and utensils of the kitchen are more than just tools.
entries.translation: Qoodaaleen fi meeshaaleen mana nyaataa meeshaalee qofa osoo hin taane waan baay’ee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are a means of expression, a way to create something beautiful and delicious.
entries.translation: Meeshaaleen mana nyaataa meeshaa kalaqa ibsuu wanta bareedaa fi mi'aawaa ta'e hojjechuuf gargaaranidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A seed is a small, dormant plant embryo that is capable of developing into a new plant under the right conditions.
entries.translation: Sanyii jechuun miciree biqiltuu xiqqaa kan ciisa irra jiruu fi haala sirrii ta’een gara biqiltuu haaraatti guddachuu danda’uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a seed sprouts, it begins to grow roots and shoots.
entries.translation: Sanyiin tokko yommuu biqilu hiddaaf jirma guddisuu jalqaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The roots anchor the plant in the soil and absorb water and nutrients from the ground.
entries.translation: Hiddichi biqiltuu kana biyyee keessatti kan hidhe jiru yoo ta’u, bishaan fi soorata lafa irraa xuuxa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The shoots grow upwards towards the sun, and the leaves begin to photosynthesize, producing food for the plant.
entries.translation: Jirmiin gara aduun jirutti kan ol guddatan yoo ta’u, baalli isaas footosinteesii jalqabuun biqiltuu kanaaf nyaata oomisha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the plant grows, it develops a stem, leaves, flowers, and fruit.
entries.translation: Biqiltuun kun akkuma guddachaa deemuun hundee, baala, daraaraa fi firii horata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flowers produce seeds, which are dispersed by wind, water, or animals.
entries.translation: Daraaroonni kun sanyii kan horatan yommuu taʼu, sanyiiwwan kun qilleensaan, bishaanin, yookin bineensotaan facaʼu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a seed lands in a suitable location, it can germinate and begin the process of growth all over again.
entries.translation: Sanyiin tokko bakka mijaawaa ta’etti yeroo bu’u, biqiluu fi adeemsa guddinaa hunda irra deebi’ee jalqabuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of seed germination is a marvel of nature.
entries.translation: Adeemsi sanyiin itti biqiluu ajaa'iba uumamaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a testament to the power of life and the resilience of the natural world.
entries.translation: Humna jireenyaa fi damdamannaa addunyaa uumamaa tiif ragaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a seed sprouts, it is a sign of hope and new beginnings.
entries.translation: Sanyiin tokko yommuu biqilu mallattoo abdii fi jalqabbii haaraati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have been given a clear and concise warning.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have been told that if you continue to engage in this behavior, you will be banned.
entries.translation: Amala kana irratti hirmaachuu yoo itti fuufte akka dhorkamtu sitti himamee turee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have now had two chances to correct your behavior, and you have failed to do so.
entries.translation: Amma amala kee sirreessuuf carraa lama qabda turte, kanas gochuu dadhabdde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, you will now be banned from this forum.
entries.translation: Kanarraan kan ka'e, amma waltajjii kana irraa ni dhorkamta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This ban is permanent, and you will not be allowed to create a new account or participate in this forum in any way.
entries.translation: Uggurri kun dhaabbataa waan ta'eef, galmee haaraa uumuu yookin waltajjii kana irratti karaa kamiinuu hirmaachuun siif hin hayyamamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We hope that this ban will serve as a warning to others who may be tempted to engage in similar behavior.
entries.translation: Uggurri kun namoota biroo amala wal fakkaatu irratti hirmaatanif akeekkachiisa ta’ee akka tajaajilu abdii qabna. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will not tolerate this type of behavior on our forum, and we will take action to protect our community from it.
entries.translation: Amala gosa akkanaa waltajjii keenya irratti hin obsinu, hawaasa keenya irraa eeguufis tarkaanfii ni fudhanna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about this ban, please do not hesitate to contact us.
entries.translation: Waa'ee uggurraa kanaa gaaffii yoo qabaattan, nu qunnamuu irraa duubatti hin jedhinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: "Na dhoorkitee! Akka balaan narra gahu gootee turte!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to. I was just trying to get around that slow-moving truck."
entries.translation: "Dhiifama, akkas gochuu hin barbaanne. Konkolaataa fe'umsaa suuta socho'u sana biraa naanna'uuf qofan yaalaan ture." ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Well, you could have at least used your turn signal!"
entries.translation: "Egaa, yoo xiqqaate ille mallattoo nannesuu kee fayyadamuu dandeessa turte!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, you didn't! You just pulled right out in front of me!"
entries.translation: "Lakki, hin ibsine! Ati calliste dhuma fuuldura kootti baatee!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm telling you, I used my turn signal!"
entries.translation: "Siitti himaan jira, mallattoo nannessuu koo fayyadameera!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: "Waan fedhe haa ta'u. Ati ammallee konkolaachisaa badaa dha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "At least I know how to drive!"
entries.translation: "Yoo xiqqaate ani akkamitii akka konkolaataa oofan nan beeka!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Oh, yeah? Well, I'm a better writer than you are!"

entries.english: Grace: Can you tell me a little bit about its history?
entries.translation: Girees: Waa'ee seenaa isaa waan xiqqoo natti himuu dandeessaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Of course. Tea originated in China, where it has been cultivated for over 5,000 years.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa: Eeyyeen. Shaayiin kan madde Chaayinaatti yoommu ta'u, waggoota 5,000 oliif achitti misoomee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first written record of tea dates back to the 3rd century BC, when it was mentioned in a Chinese medical text.
entries.translation: Galmeen barreeffamaa jalqabaa waa'ee shaayii ibsu Dh.K.D jaarraa 3 ffaa keessa kan ture yoo ta’u, yeroo sanatti barreeffama yaalaa Chaayinaa keessatti caqafame ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tea was originally used as a medicinal herb, but it quickly became a popular drink among Chinese people of all social classes.
entries.translation: Shaayiin jalqaba akka baala qorichaatti kan faayidaarra oole yoommu ta'u, namoota Chaayinaa sadarkaa hawaasummaa hunda keessa jiran biratti garuu dafee dhugaatii jaallatamaa ta'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: What about outside of China? When did tea start to spread to other parts of the world?
entries.translation: Girees: Chaayinaan alatti hoo? Shaayiin kutaalee addunyaa birootti babal'achuu kan jalqabe yoom dha?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Tea was first introduced to Europe in the 16th century by Portuguese traders.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa: Shaayiin jalqaba gara Awurooppaatti kan dhiyaate jaarraa 16 ffaa keessa daldaltoota Poorchugaaliin ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It quickly became popular among European elites, and by the 18th century, tea had become a staple of British culture.
entries.translation: Innis dafee beektootoota Awurooppaa biratti jaallatamummaa kan argate yoommu taʼu, jaarraa 18 ffaatti shaayiin aadaa Biriteen keessatti dhuugaatii ijoo taʼee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, tea was also introduced to North America, where it became a popular drink among both colonists and Native Americans.
entries.translation: Jaarraa 19ffaa keessa shaayiin Ameerikaa Kaabaattis kan dhiyaate yoommu ta'u, achittis koloneeffattootaa fi dhalattoota Ameerikaa biratti dhugaatii jaallatamaa ta'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: That's really interesting.I never knew that tea had such a long history.
entries.translation: Girees: Sun dhuguma nama hawwata. Shaayiin seenaa dheeraa akkasii akka qabu siruma hin beekun ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: It's a fascinating story, and it's one that's still being written today.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa: Seenaa nama hawwatuu dha, har'as kan barreeffamaa jiruu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During World War II, the Allies and Axis powers used a variety of aircraft to achieve air superiority.
entries.translation: Yeroo Waraana Addunyaa Lammaffaa humnoonni Michuu fi Siiqqee olaantummaa qilleensaa galmaan ga’uuf xiyyaarota adda addaa fayyadamaa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important factors in determining the outcome of a battle was the accuracy of the aircraft's bombing.
entries.translation: Bu'aa lola tokkoo murteessuuf wantoota barbaachisoo ta'an keessaa inni tokko sirrii ta'uu boombii xiyyaarichaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The height at which an aircraft could fly was also a critical factor, as it determined how far it could travel and how much weight it could carry.
entries.translation: Xiyyaarri tokko hammam deemuu akka dandaʼuu fi ulfaatina hammamii baachuu akka dandaʼu waan murteessuuf, olkaʼiinsi xiyyaarri tokko balaliʼuu dandaʼus dhimma murteessaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The United States developed a number of high-altitude bombers during the war, including the B-17 Flying Fortress and the B-29 Superfortress.
entries.translation: Ameerikaan yeroo waraanaa sanatti xiyyaaroota boombii olka’iinsa guddaa ta’an hedduu hojjattee turte, kanneen keessaa B-17 Filaaying Fortires fi B-29 Superfortiress kan dabalatee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were able to fly at altitudes of over 30,000 feet, which made them difficult for enemy fighters to intercept.
entries.translation: Xiyyaaronni kunneen olka’iinsa kophee 30,000 ol balali’uu waan danda’aniif, loltoonni diinaa addaan kutuun akka isaan rakkisu taasiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also carried a large payload of bombs, which could be used to attack targets deep behind enemy lines.
entries.translation: Boombii guddaa fe'umsa qabu kan sarara diinaa duuba dhaqee gadi fageenyaan haleeluu danda'us qabatanii turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The German Luftwaffe also developed a number of high-altitude bombers, including the Heinkel He 177 Greif and the Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.translation: Luuftwaaffen Jarmaniis xiyyaarota boombii olka'aa irratti argaman hedduu hojjateera, kanneen keessaa Heyinkeel He 177 Gireef fi Masarshimiit Me 264 boombii Ameerika ni dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were not as successful as their American counterparts, however, due to a number of technical problems.
entries.translation: Xiyyaaronni kunneen garuu rakkoolee teeknikaa hedduu irraa kan ka’e akka gita isaanii Ameerikaa milkaa’ina hin arganne ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know what you did yesterday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You posted a picture of yourself wearing that green rag on social media.
entries.translation: Suuraa kee citaa magariisa sana uffatte miidiyaa hawaasumma irratti maxxansite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you thought it was funny, but it wasn’t.
entries.translation: Qoosaa akka sitti fakkaate nan beeka, garuu akkas hin turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was disrespectful to your mother, and it hurt her feelings.
entries.translation: Haadha keetif kabaja dhabuu kee kan gaarsiiu yoommu taʼu, miira ishiis miidheera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m not asking you to apologize because I’m mad at you.
entries.translation: Ani waanan sitti aaree jiruf miti dhiifama gaafadhu kanan jedhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m asking you to apologize because it’s the right thing to do.
entries.translation: Waan sirrii wanta ta’eefiin dhiifama akka gaafattu si gaafadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your mother loves you, and she deserves your respect.
entries.translation: Haati kee si jaallatti, kabajni kees isheef mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please call her today and tell her you’re sorry.
entries.translation: Mee har’a bilbiltee dhiifama ishee gaafadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her that you didn’t mean to hurt her feelings, and that you promise to never wear that green rag again.
entries.translation: Miira ishee miidhuu akka hin barbaanne, akkasumas lammata uffata cittuu magariisa sana akka hin uffanne waadaa galiif.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you’re a good person, and I know you love your mother.
entries.translation: Ani akka ati nama gaarii taate nan beeka, haadha kee akka jaallattus nan beeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So please, do the right thing and apologize.
entries.translation: Kanaaf maaloo, waan sirrii hojjadhuu dhiifamas gaafadhuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After you apologize to your mother, I want you to burn that green rag.
entries.translation: Erga haadha kee dhiifama gaafattee booda, akka ati uffata cittuu magariisa sana gubdu nan barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your disrespect, and it needs to be gone.
entries.translation: Mallattoo kabaja dhabuu kee waan ta’eef, baduu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know it might be hard to let go of that rag, but it’s important.
entries.translation: Uffata citaa sana gadi dhiisuun rakkisaa ta’uu akka danda’u nan beeka, garuu kun barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your past, and it’s time to move on.
entries.translation: Kun mallattoo seenaa kee kan darbee yoo ta’u, yeroon kun yeroo itti fuftu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And you don’t need that rag to define you anymore.
entries.translation: Kana booda si ibsuuf immoo uffanni citaan sun si hin barbaachisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burn it and let it go.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And then go hug your mother and tell her you love her.
entries.translation: Sana booda deemtee haadha kee hammadhuuti akka ishee jaallattu itti himi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A car was driving too fast and lost control, swerving into the other lane and hitting a car head-on.
entries.translation: Konkolaataan tokko saffisaan oofaa waan tureef to'annaa dhabee, gara daandii isa biroo itti garagalee konkolaataa tokko waliin mataa wal rukute.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The driver of the first car was killed instantly, and the driver of the second car was seriously injured.
entries.translation: Konkolaachisaan konkolaataa isa jalqabaa battalumatti kan du'e yoommu ta'u, konkolaachisaan konkolaataa lammaffaa ammoo akka malee miidhameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend Joseph called me to talk about it.
entries.translation: Hiriyaan koo Joseef waaʼee dhimma kanaa akka haasoofnuuf naaf bilbile.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's so sad," he said. "I can't imagine how the families of the victims are coping."
entries.translation: "Baay'ee nama gaddisiisa" jedhe. "Maatiin namoota miidhamtootaa akkamitti akka damdamachaa jiran tilmaamuun na rakkisa." ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Me neither," I responded. "It's a reminder that we need to be careful when we're driving.
entries.translation: "Anille" jedheen deebiseef. "Yeroo konkolaataa oofan of eeggannoo gochuu akka qabnu kan yaadachisu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Even a small mistake can have devastating consequences."
entries.translation: Dogoggorri xiqqaan illee bu'aalee hamaa fiduu danda'a."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I agree," replied Jo. "We all need to follow the rules of the road and drive defensively."
entries.translation: "Ani nan walii gala" jedhee deebise Joon. "Hundi keenya seera daandii hordofuu fi ittisaan konkolaachisuu qabna."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know," said Jo sheepishly. "I'm guilty of it myself sometimes."
entries.translation: "Ani beeka" jedhe Joon suutumatti. "Ani ofii kootii yeroo tokko tokko yakka kana nan qaba."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the small town of Malgudi, there was a corrupt police inspector named Ramasamy.
entries.translation: Magaalaa xiqqoo Maalgudii jedhamtu keessatti inspeektara poolisii malaammaltummaa raawwatu maqaan isaa Raamaasaami jedhamu tokkotu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He would often take bribes from the people he arrested, and he would also use his power to harass and intimidate people.
entries.translation: Yeroo baay’ee namoota inni hidhe irraa qarshii fudhata, akkasumas humna isaatti fayyadamee namoota rakkisaa fi sodaachisaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ramasamy arrested a young man named Krishnan for a crime he did not commit.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko, Raamaasaamin dargaggeessa Kirishnaan jedhamu yakka inni hin raawwanneen to'annaa jala oolche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan was innocent, but Ramasamy refused to listen to him.
entries.translation: Kirishnaan qulqulluu ture, garuu Raamaasaamin isa dhaggeeffachuu dide.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He demanded a bribe from Krishnan, and when Krishnan refused to pay, Ramasamy threw him in jail.
entries.translation: Innis Kirishnaan irraa qarshii gaafate, Kirishnaan kaffaluu yeroo didu Raamaasaamin mana hidhaatti isa darbate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan's father, a poor farmer, was desperate to get his son out of jail.
entries.translation: Abbaan Kirishnaan qonnaan bulaa hiyyeessa ture, ilma isaa mana hidhaa keessaa baasuuf abdii kutatee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He went to see Ramasamy and begged him to release Krishnan, but Ramasamy refused.
entries.translation: Innis Raamaasaami ilaaluufi Kirishnaan akka gadhiisu dhaqee isa kadhate, Raamaasaamin garuu ni dide.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer then went to the local temple and prayed to God for help.
entries.translation: Sana booda qonnaan bulaan kun gara mana qulqullummaa naannoo sanaa dhaqee gargaarsa akka argatu Waaqayyoon kadhate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next day, the farmer was walking home from the temple when he saw a large snake crossing the road.
entries.translation: Guyyaa itti aanutti, qonnaan bulaan kun mana qulqullummaati gara manaatti osoo deemaa jiruu bofa guddaa karaa qaxxaamuraa jiruu arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer was afraid of snakes, but he knew that he had to do something to help his son.
entries.translation: Qonnaan bulaan kun bofa sodaata ture, garuu ilma isaa gargaaruuf waan tokko gochuu akka qabu beeka ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He picked up the snake and carried it to the police station.
entries.translation: Bofa sanas fuudhatee gara waajjira poolisiitti geesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Ramasamy saw the snake, he was terrified.
entries.translation: Raamaasaamin yeroo bofa kana argu baay'ee sodaate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: Let me take a look. [Examines the patient's teeth.] Hmm, it looks like you have a cavity.
entries.translation: Ogeessa Ilkaanii: Mee haa ilaalu. [Ilkaan dhukkubsataa qorata.] qaawwa waan qabdu fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to need to drill out the decay and fill the hole.
entries.translation: Cacabaa kana gadi baase qaawwa sanan guuta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: It might be a little uncomfortable, but I'll do my best to make it as painless as possible.
entries.translation: Ogeessa Ilkaanii: Xiqqoo mijataa taʼuu dhiisuu dandaʼa, garuu hamma dandaʼametti dhukkubbii akka hin qabne gochuuf waanan dandaʼu hunda nan godha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: (gives the patient a local anesthetic) Okay, this will numb the area so you won't feel anything.
entries.translation: Ogeessa ilkaanii: (dhukkubsatichaaf qoricha namaa hadoochu naannoo sanaa itti kenne) Tole, kun bakkicha ni dadhabsiisa kanaaf homtu akka sitti hin dhagahamnee godha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: (drills out the decay and fills the hole) All done!
entries.translation: Ogeessa ilkaanii: (cacabaa sana gadi baase qaawwa sana guute) Akka jirutti isaanii hojjatameera!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thank you, doctor. That wasn't so bad.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Galatoomaa dooktor. Haaga kanas hamaa hin turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dentist: You're welcome. Just be sure to brush and floss regularly to prevent future cavities.
entries.translation: Ogeessa Ilkaanii: Rakkina hin qabu. Gara fuulduraatti qaawwi akka hin uumamneef yeroo hunda buruushii dhaan dhiquu fi keessa isaa qulqulluu gochuu kee qofa mirkaneessi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I will Dentist: (hands the patient a list of instructions) Here are some instructions on how to care for your new filling.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa:Tole Dooktor: (tarree qajeelfama dhukkubsataa itti kenne) Akkaataa guutinsa haaraa kee kana itti kunuunsitu qajeelfamni tokko tokko kunooti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dear [Name], I hope this letter finds you well.
entries.translation: Kabajamaa [Maqaa], xalayaan kun akka gaariitti akka si bira gahu abdiin qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm writing to you from our family farm, where the harvest has been going well this year.
entries.translation: Qonna maatii keenyaa, bakka midhaan bara kana akka gaariitti itti deemaa jiru irraan si barreessaa jira. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're expecting a bumper crop of sugarcane, which is used to make rum.
entries.translation: Midhaan shonkooraa baay'ee guddaa ta'e eegaa jirra, kunis raamii hojjachuuf kan ooludha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum is a distilled spirit made from sugarcane molasses or sugarcane juice.
entries.translation: Raamii jechuun hafuura adeemsa distileeshnii kan molaasasa shonkooraa yookin dhangala'aa shonkoora irraa hojjatamuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's typically aged in wooden barrels, which gives it its characteristic flavor.
entries.translation: Akkaataa idileetti barmeela mukaa keessatti kan turu yoommu ta'u, kunis amala mi'aa isaaf kenna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or mixed in cocktails.
entries.translation: Raamiin duwwaa isaa, cabbii waliin yookin kokteelii keessatti makamee mi’eeffamuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of rum, each with its own unique flavor profile.
entries.translation: Raamii gosa adda addaa hedduun kan jiruyoo ta’u, tokkoon tokkoon isaanii ibsa mi’aa addaa mataa isaanii qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most popular types of rum include light rum, dark rum, and spiced rum.
entries.translation: Gosoonni raamii baay’ee jaallataman keessaa muraasni raamii salphaa, raamii dukkanaa’aa fi raamii mi’ooftuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Light rum is typically made from molasses and has a light, sweet flavor.
entries.translation: Raamiin salphaan akkuma bekaamutti moolaasasa irraa kan hojjatamu yoo ta'u, mi'aa salphaa fi mi'aawaa ta'e qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dark rum is made from sugarcane juice and has a richer, more complex flavor.
entries.translation: Raamii dukkanaa'aan dhangala'aa shonkooraa irraa kan hojjatame yoommu ta'u, mi'aa badhaadhaa fi walxaxaa ta'e qaba. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Spiced rum is made with added spices, such as cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves.
entries.translation: Raamiin mi’aawaa kan hojjatamu mi’eessituuwwan itti dabalamaniin kan akka qarafaa, muuzaa fi quruunfuuda tiin dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum is a versatile spirit that can be used in a variety of cocktails.
entries.translation: Raamiin wanta baay'ee faayidaarra oluu danda'u yoo ta'u, kokteelii adda addaa keessatti fayyadamuun ni danda'ama. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some classic rum cocktails include the daiquiri, the mojito, and the pina colada.
entries.translation: Kookteeliin raamii idilee tokko tokko daykurii, moyitoo fi pinaa kooladaa dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rum can also be used in more creative cocktails, such as the Hemingway Daiquiri or the Painkiller.
entries.translation: Raamiin kokteelii kalaqaan guutame, kan akka Heemingwee Dakiiri yookin Peenkilar keessattis fayyadamuf gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must reject the forces of division and hate.
entries.translation: Humnoota qoqqoodamuu fi jibbaa ganuu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We must break the chains of poverty and ignorance.
entries.translation: Nutis sansalata hiyyummaa fi wallaalummaa cabsuu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And we must bind ourselves together in a common purpose: to build a better future for Nigeria.
entries.translation: Akkasumas kaayyoo waloo tokkoon of hidhuu qabna: Naayijeeriyaaf egeree fooyya’aa ijaaruuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The destiny of Nigeria is not to be a land of division and conflict.
entries.translation: Hireen Naayijeeriyaa lafa qoqqoodinsaa fi waldhabdee ta'uu miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is to be a land of unity and progress.
entries.translation: Lafa tokkummaa fi fooya'ina ta'uu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is to be a land where everyone has a chance to succeed, regardless of their background or circumstances.
entries.translation: Lafa namni hundi, duuba isaa fi haala isaa osoo hin ilaalin carraa milkaa'ina kan itti argatu ta'uu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But we cannot achieve this future without working together.

entries.english: "Complete your Amazon shopping experience with our new and improved ad service!" the ad read.
entries.translation: "Muuxannoo bittaa keessan karaa tajaajila beeksisa haaraa fi fooyya'aa ta'een xumuraa!" dubbisa beksisichaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "With our service, you'll never have to worry about missing out on a great deal again.
entries.translation: "Tajaajilli keenya yeroo hunda odeeffannoo akka qabaattanii fi dhiyeessiin ajaa'ibaa kamiyyuu akka sin jalaa hin hafne mirkaneessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just sign up for an account and start adding products to your cart.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're ready to check out, our service will automatically find the best deals for you and apply them to your order.
entries.translation: Isin ilaaluudhaaf yeroo barbaaddanitti, tajaajilli keenya ofumaan waliigaltee isa baay'ee gaarii ta'e isiniif dhiheessun ajajni keessaniif akka oolan nii taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So what are you waiting for?

entries.english: Sign up for our service today and start saving money on all your Amazon purchases!"

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the customer clicked on the ad, they were whisked away to a new website.
