entries.english: The website was full of ads for all sorts of products, all of which were supposedly on sale.
entries.translation: Marsariitiin kunis beeksisa oomishaalee gosa hundaan kan guutame yoo ta'u, hundi isaanii gurgurtaaf kan dhiyaataniidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer was tempted to buy a few things, but they hesitated.
entries.translation: Maamiltichis meeshaalee wayii bituu barbaadee ture, garuu ni dhiise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had heard stories about people getting scammed by online ads, and they didn't want to be one of them.
entries.translation: Oduu namoonni beeksisa toora marsariitiitin gowwamfamuu dhagahanii waan turaniif, isaan keessaa tokko ta'u hin barbaanne ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The customer decided to do some research on the company that was running the ad.
entries.translation: Maamilti sunis dhaabbata beekisisa kana maxxansee ture irratti qorannoo tokko tokko qorachuuf murteesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They found a few negative reviews, but most of the reviews were positive.
entries.translation: Yaadotni xiqqoo gaarii hin taanee jiraatanis, baay'een isaanii gaarii turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The black dog came to me in the night.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had cold, wet fur and its eyes were like coals.
entries.translation: Innis jiidhee fi itti qorree kan ture yoo ta'u, ijji isaas akka dhagaa boba'aa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It growled at me and I could smell its breath, hot and reeking of death.
entries.translation: Nattis waan duteef hafuurri isaa ho'aa fi du'a du'a xiraa'us funfachuuf danda'een ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that I must run, but my legs were leaden and I could not move.
entries.translation: Fiiguu akkan qabu nan beeka ture, haa ta'u iyyuu malee miilli koo natti ulfaatee waan tureef socho'uu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog came closer and closer, its teeth bared.
entries.translation: Sarichis garakoo dhihaachuu jalqabe, ilkaan isaas duwwaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and waited for the end.
entries.translation: Ija koo dunuunfadheen wanta dhufu eeggachuun jalqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I heard a voice.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a woman's voice, soft and gentle.
entries.translation: Sagalichiis kan dubaraa yoo ta'u sirrii fi lallaafaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Do not be afraid," she said. "I will help you."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I opened my eyes and saw the woman standing in front of me.
entries.translation: Ijakoo yeroon banus dubarri tokko fuuldurakoo dhaabateen arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was tall and slender, with long black hair and dark eyes.
entries.translation: Isheenis dheertuu fi qal'oo taatee, rifeensa gurraacha dheeraa fi ija gurraacha'e qabdi ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She wore a white dress that flowed around her like a mist.
entries.translation: Uffata adii akka duumeessaa ishee marse uffateetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who are you?" I asked. "I am the Angel of Death," she said.
entries.translation: "Ati eenyuu?" jedheen gaafadheeni. "Ani Ergamtuu Du'aati" naan jette.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I have come to take you to the other side." I was not afraid anymore.
entries.translation: "Gara addunyaa biraatti si geessuufan dhufe." Ergasii sodaachuus nan dhiise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that the woman would take me to a place where there was no pain or suffering.
entries.translation: Dubartittiin sunis bakka dhukkubiinii fi gidirfamni hin jirre akka na geessitu nan beeke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took her hand and she led me away.
entries.translation: Harka isheen qabadhee, isheenis na fudhatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As we walked, the black dog followed us.
entries.translation: Hammuma nuti deemaa turretti, saree guraachi suni nu duukaa bu'aa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm Dr. Boakye, a pediatrician at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.translation: Ani Dr. Bokyeen jedhama, Hospitaala Barsiisaa Korle Bu keessatti ogeessa fayyaa daa'immaniiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm here today to talk to you about the new malaria vaccine that's been approved for use in Ghana.
entries.translation: Har'a waa'ee talaallii busaa haaraa Gaanaa keessatti fayyadamaaf hayyamame tokkon isin waliin haasa'uufan dhufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I'm not interested in having my children vaccinated.
entries.translation: Abbaa: Ijoolleenkoo akka talaalaman hin barbaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand that you're concerned, but I'd like to take a few minutes to explain why I think it's a good idea to vaccinate your children against malaria.
entries.translation: Dooktara: Yaaddoon keessan naaf gala, garuu ijoollee keessan dhukkuba busaa irraa eeguun maalif akka gaarii ta'e daqiiqaa muraasa fudhadheen isiniif ibsa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I don't need to be convinced. Malaria is a serious disease, but it's not that common in our village.
entries.translation: Abbaa: Akka na amansiistu hin barbaadu. Dhukkubni busaa dhukkuba hamaa ta'us ganda keenya keessatti badaas hin mul'atu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: But my children are healthy. They've never had malaria
entries.translation: Abbaa: Ijoolleen koo garuu fayyaa qabu. Dhibee busaatiinis qabamanii hin beekani
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's good, but it doesn't mean they're immune. Anyone can get malaria, even if they've never had it before.
entries.translation: Dooktara: Kuni gaaridha, haa ta'uyyuu malee dandamachuu danda'u jechuus miti. Namni kamiyyuu kana dura dhukkuba busaatiin qabamee kan hin beekne ta'ellee qabamuu ni danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "So, I was just on the internet, minding my own business, when I saw this pop-up ad that said I had a virus on my computer.
entries.translation: "Kanaafuu, interneetii irratti dhimma mataa kootii osoon hojjechaa jiruu, beeksisa koompiitara koo irratti vaayirasiin akka jiru dubbatun arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I clicked on it, and it took me to this website that looked really official, and it said that I needed to download this software to fix the virus.
entries.translation: Garu sana booda nan tuqe, achis gara marsariitii kanatti na geesse, innis vaayirasii kana balleessuf akkan mosaajii kana busuu qabu natti hime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So I did, and I installed it, and then it started filling my computer with all this malware.
entries.translation: Kanaaf anis nan busee, achis nan fe'ee, innis maalweeroota kana hundaan koompitara koo gutuu jalqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I tried to uninstall it, but it wouldn't let me.
entries.translation: Anis kan fe'ame ballessuf yaale, garu naaf hin heyyamne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I finally had to take my computer to a repair shop, and they had to wipe the whole thing and reinstall Windows.
entries.translation: Anis dhumaratti kompitara koo gara mana suphaa gessee, isaanis waan hunda balleessanii Windoo isaa irra deebi'ani fe'an.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, that's why I'm always so careful about clicking on pop-up ads.
entries.translation: Sababa kanaaf dha beeksiisoota dhufan xuquu irratti eegganoo kanan godhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You never know what they're going to do.
entries.translation: Maal akka isaan hojjechuuf jeedhan goonkuma hin beektu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They could be filled with malware, or they could steal your personal information.
entries.translation: Maalweerootaan guutamu, yookin odeeffannoo dhunfaa kee hatuu danda'uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just not worth the risk.
entries.translation: Balaa dhufuu dhaaf gatii tokkollee hin qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you ever see a pop-up ad that looks suspicious, just close it and don't click on it.
entries.translation: Beeksiisoota shakkisisoo ta'an yoomiyyu yeroo argitan, cufaa qofa malee hin tuqinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if you're ever not sure whether or not it's safe, just don't do it.
entries.translation: Akkasumas akka isaan nagaa qaban yoo mirkaneessuu dadhabde, akka hin tuqne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a delicious pork dish from the county of Lancashire.
entries.translation: Nyaanni mi'awaa foon booy'ee biyya Laankaashaayar irraa dhufe kunooti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: 1. Ho'a oviinii gara digrii 180 tti dursanii ho'isuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Trim the pork belly of any excess fat and score the skin in a criss-cross pattern.
entries.translation: 2. Garaa boyyee cooma garmalee kamiyyuu irraa cicciruudhaan gogaa isaa haala qaxxaamuraa ta'een kuti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a bowl, mix together the mustard, treacle, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and oil.
entries.translation: 3. Sahiinaa keessatti, sanaafiica, tiraakila, dhangaggo, sogidda woorsastershaayir wallitti maki.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rub this mixture all over the pork belly.
entries.translation: Makaa kana garaa booy'ee gutuu irratti dibi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Place the pork belly in a roasting tin and roast in the oven for 2 hours, or until the skin is golden brown and the meat is cooked through.
entries.translation: 4. Garaa booy'ee kanas qaruura waaddituu keessa kaa'itii sa'a 2 f, yookin hanga googaan isaa diimaa duukkanaa'aa warqee fakkaatu ta'utti fi foonichi hanga keessisaa bilchaatutti waaddi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. While the pork is roasting, finely chop the onion, garlic, bay leaves and thyme.
entries.translation: 5. Osoo foon booy'ee kun waaddamaa jiruutti, qullubbi dimaa, qullubbi adii, baala beey fi timira qaqal'isi muri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nelson Mandela is a South African anti-apartheid revolutionary, political leader, and philanthropist who served as the first black president of South Africa from 1994 to 1999.
entries.translation: Neelsan Maandellaan warraaqsaa apaartaayidii Afrikaa Kibbaa, geggeessaa siyaasaa, fi nama tola oltummaa hojjatu, Afrikaa Kibbaa bara 1994 irraa kaasee hanga 1999 tti pireezidaantii gurraacha ta'un kan tajaajile dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is widely regarded as one of the most significant figures in world history.
entries.translation: Seenaa adunyaa keessatti akka nama guddaatti bal'inaan fudhatama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was born in 1918 in Mvezo, South Africa.
entries.translation: Maandellaan bara 1918 keessa Miveezoo, Afrikaa Kibbaa keessatti dhalatee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He grew up in a rural village and was educated at a Methodist mission school.
entries.translation: Ganda baadiyyaa keessatti kan guddate yoo ta'u mana barumsaa mishnii Metoodist keessa barate ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After high school, he studied law at the University of Fort Hare.
entries.translation: Barnoota olaanoo booda, yunivarsitii Foort Heer keessatti seera barate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1944, he joined the African National Congress (ANC), a political organization that was fighting against apartheid.
entries.translation: Bara 1944 tti, Kora Biyyoolessaa Afrikaa (ANC), dhaabbata siyaasaa kan apaartayidii lolaa ture keessa makame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was arrested for his political activities in 1962 and sentenced to life in prison.
entries.translation: Maandeellaan bara 1962 sochii siyaasaa taasisaniin hidhamee hidhaa umurii guutuu itti murtaa'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He spent 27 years in prison, during which time he became a symbol of the anti-apartheid movement.
entries.translation: Waggoota 27 mana hidhaa keessatti dabarseera, yeroo sanattis mallatto sochii farra-apaartaayidii ta'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1990, Mandela was released from prison and elected president of South Africa in 1994.
entries.translation: Bara 1990 keessa, Maandellaan mana hidhaati gad-lakkifamee pireezidaantii Afrikaa Kibbaa ta'un bara 1994 keessa filatame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As president, Mandela worked to unite South Africa and promote reconciliation between blacks and whites.
entries.translation: Pirezidaanti ta'un, Maandellaan Afrikaa Kibbaa tokkummessu fi araara warra adii fi guraacha guddisuu irratti hojjateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also oversaw the end of apartheid and the transition to a democratic government.
entries.translation: Dhuma sirna apaartaayidii fi jijjirraa gara mootummaa dimookraatawaas to'ateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela is a Nobel Peace Prize laureate and has been awarded numerous other honors.
entries.translation: Maandeellaan badhaasa Noobelii nagaa looretii fi badhaasoota heeddu kan biroos badhaafameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After school, I usually go home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Baruumsa booda, yeroo hunda gara manaa deemee hojii manaa koon hojjadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might watch TV or play video games.
entries.translation: Achiis TV n ilaala yookin tapha viidiyoon taphadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes I go out with my friends.
entries.translation: Yeroo tokko tokko hiriyoota koo faana baana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go to the movies, or to a park, or just hang out at someone's house.
entries.translation: Filmii ilaaluf, yookin gara paarki, yookin mana nama tokkootti taphachuuf deemuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On weekends, I often sleep in late.
entries.translation: Dhuma torbanitti, yeroo baay'ee tureen rafa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might go shopping, or see a movie, or go to a museum.
entries.translation: Achis gara qodaa bittaa, yookin filmii ilaaluf, yookin gara godambaa deemun danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also like to spend time with my family.
entries.translation: Maatii koo faana yeroo dabarsuus nan jaaladha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go out to dinner, or play games, or just watch TV together.
entries.translation: Irbaata nyaachuf gadi bahu, yookin tapha taphachuu, yookin waliin taane TV ilaalu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm really enjoying my life after school.
entries.translation: Jireenya koo barumsa booda jiruus sirritti dhamdhamchaan jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a lot of freedom, and I can do whatever I want.
entries.translation: Bilisummaa baaye'een qaba, waanan barbaadu hundas gochu nan danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also learning a lot about myself, and about the world around me.
entries.translation: Waayee mataa koos, akkasumas waayee addunyaa naannoo koo jiruus heedduun barachaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm excited to see what the future holds.
entries.translation: Waan egeree koo qopheesse ilaalufis heedduu gamadaan jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using data to help people with mental health issues is a relatively new field, but it is showing great promise.
entries.translation: Dhimma namoota dhukubbii sammuu gargaaru waliin wal qabatee odeffannoo fayyadamuun dirree haaraa ta'uus, waadaa guddaa agarsiisaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is the use of data to personalize therapy for patients.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyi inni tokko, yaalii dhukkubsattootaa dhuunfaatti jijjiiruuf odeffanoo fayyadamu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By looking at a patient's individual data, therapists can better understand their needs and create a treatment plan that is tailored to them.
entries.translation: Odeeffannoo dhunfaa dhukubsatichaa ilaaluu dhan, yaalotonni waan isaan barbaachisuu hubachufi karoora wal'aansaa kan isaanif malu uumu danda'uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to better outcomes for patients, as they are more likely to receive the help that they need.
entries.translation: Kunis akkuma isaan gargaarsa barbaadan argatanitti, dhukkubsattootaaf gara bu'aa gaariitti kan geessu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the patients who received personalized therapy were more likely to stay in treatment for longer periods of time.
entries.translation: Qorannoon kun dhukkubsattoonni yaala dhunfaa fudhatan yeroo dheeraaf wal'aansa keessa turuuf carraan isaanii guddaa akka ta'es ibseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This study is just one example of how data can be used to improve mental health care.
entries.translation: Qorannoon kun akkaataa odeeffannoon kunuunsa fayyaa sammuu foyyessuf itti fayyadamuu danda'amu keessaa fakkeenya tokko dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As more research is done in this area, we can expect to see even more advances in the use of data to help people with mental health issues.
entries.translation: Gama kanaan qorannoon dabalataa yeroo gaggeeffamu, namoota dhimma fayyaa sammuu qaban gargaaruuf itti fayyadamummaan odeffanno irratti guddina heeddu ni argina jennee eeguu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My sister is a therapist who uses data to help her patients.
entries.translation: Obboleettiin koo dhukkubsattoota gargaaruuf yaaltuu odeffannoo kan fayyadamtu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freshwater lakes are home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, from microscopic algae to large fish and mammals.
entries.translation: Haroonni bishaan qulqulluu, algee maayikirooskopii irraa kaasee hanga qurxummii gurguddoo fi hoosistootaatti biqiltootaafi bineensootaaf bakka jireenyaa bal'aa ta'e dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The unique environment of freshwater lakes provides a variety of habitats for these organisms, and the interactions between them are complex and fascinating.
entries.translation: Naannoon addaa haroowwan bishaan qulqullus orgaanizimoota kanaaf bakka jireenyaa adda addaa kan kennu yoo ta'u, wal-nyaatinsi isaaan gidduu jirus walxaxaa fi hawwataadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most striking features of freshwater lakes is the presence of a distinct zonation of plant life, which is determined by the depth of the water and the amount of sunlight that reaches the bottom.
entries.translation: Wantoota waayee haroowwan bishaan qulqulluu baay'ee nama dinqisisan keessaa tokko jireenya biqiltootaa zoonii adda ta'e jiraachuu isaati, kunis gadi fageenya bishaanii fi hamma ifa aduu jala bishaani ga'uun murta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In shallow areas, where there is plenty of light, a dense mat of rooted plants known as a "macrophyte bed" forms.
entries.translation: Bakka gadi fago, bakka ifni baay'een jirutti, biqiltoota hidda qaban kan "siree maakroofayitii" jeedhaman heedduminaan uumamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This provides a habitat for a variety of invertebrates, fish, and amphibians.
entries.translation: Kunis bineensota lafee hin qabne, qurxummi fi bineensoota bishaan keessa jiraatan adda addaatiif bakka jireenyaa ni kenna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In deeper areas, where there is less light, the water column is dominated by phytoplankton, which are microscopic algae that float freely in the water.
entries.translation: Bakkoota gadi fagoo kan ifa heedduun hin jirreetti, torri bishaanii faayitoplankitan, kanneen algee maaykiroskopikii ta'ani kan bishaan irra bololi'aniin gutamee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These organisms are the primary producers in the lake ecosystem, and they are the basis of the food chain.
entries.translation: Orgaanizimoonni kunneen sirna ikoo naannoo keessatti oomishootajalqabaa yoo ta'an, bu'uura sansalata nyaataa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fauna of freshwater lakes is also diverse, and includes a wide variety of fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals.
entries.translation: Bineensoonni haroowwan bishaan qulqulluu keessa jiranis adda adda yoo ta'an, qurxummi, amfibiyaanoota, kanneen lafarra harkifaman, simbirrootaafi hoosistoota adda addaa of keessatti qabata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fish are the most abundant vertebrates in freshwater lakes, and they play a vital role in the food chain.
entries.translation: Qurxummoonni haroowwan bishaan qulqullu keessatti baay'inaan kan argaman yoo ta'u, sansalata nyaataa keessatti shoora olaanaa taphatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most common fish species in freshwater lakes include trout, bass, pike, and perch.
entries.translation: Gosoonni qurxummi haroowwan bishaan qulqullu keessatti baay'inaan argaman keessaa muraasni tiroot, baas, paayikii fi parchi dabalatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The stainless steel plate is a good conductor of heat, so it can help to dissipate heat from the fire, while the fire proof rock wool is a good insulator, so it can help to prevent the fire from spreading.
entries.translation: Gabateen sibiila hindangaggoofne ho'a kan dabarsu danda'u dha, kanaafis ho'a ibidda keessaa facaasuuf gargaara, dhakaan ibidda ittisu kan ho'a hindabarsinee yoo ta'u, sibilli kun ibidichi akka hin facaaneef gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, the storage area is also equipped with a fire alarm system, so that if there is a fire, the alarm will sound and the fire department will be notified.
entries.translation: Itti dabalunis, bakki kuusaan akekkachistuu ibiddaatin kan marfame yoo ta'u, kunis yoo ibiddi jiraate, akekkachistuun ni iyyitii kutaan balaa ibiddaas ni beeksifama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The storage area is also regularly inspected by the fire department, so that any potential fire hazards can be identified and addressed before they become a problem.
entries.translation: Bakki kusaas yeroo hunda kutaa ibiddaatiin kan sakkata'amuu yoo ta'u, kunis mallattooleen ibiddaa dursa akka baramufii rakkoo osoo hin ta'in dura falli akka itti argamuf gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Sababa tarkaanfiwwan kanaatin, bakki kuusaa wantoota gatii qaban kuusuuf bakka nageenyi isaa mirkanaa'e dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the fire safety measures, the storage area is also equipped with a security system to protect against theft.
entries.translation: Tarkanifiwwan nageenyaa itti dabaluu dhaan, bakki kuusicha hanna irraa eeguuf sirna nageenyaatin marfame jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The security system consists of a surveillance camera, a burglar alarm, and a security guard.
entries.translation: Sirni eegumsaa kaameeraa hordooffii, akeekkachistuu saamtuu, fi eegduu tikaa kan dabalatu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these security measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Sababa tarkaanfiwwan nageenyaa kanneeniin bakki kuusaa meeshaalee gatii gudddaa qaban itti kuusan bakkka nageenya fi eegumsa qabu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook Users Drunkenly Post About Their Lives
entries.translation: Fayyadamtonni Feesbuukii machaa'ani jiruu isaani maxxansuu
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook users are getting drunk and posting about their lives, and it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Fayyadamtonni Feesbuuki machaa'ani jiruu isani yeroo maxxansan, jeequmsa umaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The social media platform has been flooded with photos and videos of people who are clearly intoxicated, and many of them are sharing personal details about themselves that they wouldn't normally share.
entries.translation: Waltajjin miidiyaa haawaasumma loolaa suuraa fi viidiyoo namoota machaa'aniin guutamee jira, akkasumas namoonni jiruu isaani yeroo lafaa hinqoodnee achirratti qoodaa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some users are concerned that the trend is dangerous, as it could lead to people making poor decisions or doing things they regret.
entries.translation: Fayyadamtonni tokko tokko adeemsii kun, namoota gara murtee gaari hin taane yookin wanta bor isaan gaabbisisuutti oofaa waan jiruuf baay'ee soodaachisaa dha jeedhanii dhimmamuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others are simply amused by the antics of their fellow drunk Facebook users.
entries.translation: Warreen kuun ammo goochota addaa fayyadamtoonni Feesbuuki machaa'an akka salphaatti ajaa'ibsifatuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One user posted a photo of herself passed out on the floor with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even stand up."
entries.translation: Fayyadamtuun tokko suura ishee of wallaaltee dhaabbachaa jirtuu barreeffaa "Ani baay'ee machaa'eera danda'ee dhaabbachulle hin dandeenyee" jeedhu waliin maxxansite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another user shared a video of herself dancing on a table while shouting, "I'm the life of the party!"
entries.translation: Fayyadamaan inni biiroo ammo viidiyoo dhuma ishee yeroo isheen minjaala irra dhaabbatte shubbisaa fi "Ani jiruu qophii bashannana kanaati!" jettee yeroo iyyitu agarsiisu qoode.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The trend has even caught the attention of celebrities.
entries.translation: Adeemsi kun xiyyeffanno namoota bebbeekamoo illee qabachu jalqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Comedian Amy Schumer posted a photo of herself on Twitter with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even spell my own name."
entries.translation: Koomediyaanin Emii Shumar jeedhamtu tokko tiwiitara irratti suura ishee barreffama "Ani baay'ee machaa'era maqaa ofikoolle qubeessuu hin dandeenye" jeedhu gadhistee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook has not commented on the trend, but it's clear that it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Feesbuukin adeemsa baratamee kana irrati yaada hin laanne, garuu jeequmsa uumun isaa beekkamaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Only time will tell whether the trend will continue or fade away.
entries.translation: Yerroo qofatu adeemsi kun fufuuf dhaabbachu isaa hima.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.
entries.translation: Zaambiyaan Afriikaa kibbaa keessatti biyya lafaan marfamtee jirtuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia has a population of over 17 million people and a land area of 752,618 square kilometers.
entries.translation: Zaambiyaan uummata miiliyoon 17 caaluu fi bal'ina lafaa iskuweer kiiloo meetira 752,618.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia's current president is Hakainde Hichilema, who was elected in August 2021.
entries.translation: Pireezidaantiin Zaambiyaa ammaa Haakaayindee Hichileemaa dha, innis eebila 2021 keessatti filatamee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hichilema is a member of the United Party for National Development (UPND).
entries.translation: Hichileemaan miseensa Paartii Tokkummaa Misooma Biyyoolessa (UPND).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The UPND is the largest opposition party in Zambia.
entries.translation: UPNDn Zaambiyaa keessatti paarti mormitu isa guddaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The economy of Zambia is based on copper mining.
entries.translation: Diinagdeen Zaambiyaa albuuda sibiila diimaa baasuu irratti kan hundaa'e dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Copper is the country's largest export.
entries.translation: Sibilli dimaan al-ergii biyyatti isa guddaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other important exports include cobalt, zinc, and lead.
entries.translation: Al-ergiilee barbaachisoo biroon koobaaltii, ziinkii fi liidii dabalatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Zambian economy has been struggling in recent years due to low copper prices.
entries.translation: Diinagdeen Zaambiyaa waggoota dhiyoo keessatti gatii sibiila diimaa gadi buu'utiin baay'ee rakkachaa ture.

entries.english: Zambia is a member of the United Nations, the African Union, and the Southern African Development Community (SADC).

entries.english: Of Mice and Men is a novel by John Steinbeck that tells the story of two migrant workers, George and Lennie, who travel together in search of work during the Great Depression.
entries.translation: Kan Hantuutaa fi Dhiraan asoosama Joon Isteenbekii yommu ta'u seena hojjattota godaantoota lamaani, Joorji fi Leenii kan yeroo bara Kufaatii Gudda sana hojii barbaaduuf waliin imala turan kan himu dha.

entries.english: The novel is set in a time and place where the American Dream is all but dead, and the only way to survive is to stick together and look out for each other.
entries.translation: Asoosamichi yeroo fi iddo abjuun Ammerikaa hundi bakka du'eetti, garuu jiraachuu dhaaf falli inni tokkichi walitti maxxananii waliif jiraachuu qofa bakka tureetti kan kaa'ame dha.

entries.english: George and Lennie are both dreamers.

entries.english: George dreams of one day owning a farm, where he and Lennie can live in peace and harmony.

entries.english: Lennie dreams of petting soft rabbits and being gentle with them.

entries.english: But their dreams are constantly thwarted by the harsh realities of the world they live in.

entries.english: One day, George and Lennie find work on a ranch in California.

entries.english: Candy tells George and Lennie about his dream of one day owning a small farm, and the three men decide to pool their money together to buy a farm.

entries.english: But their plans are once again thwarted when Lennie accidentally kills a woman.

entries.english: George is devastated by Lennie's death, but he knows that it was the only thing he could do.

entries.english: Birthdays are a time to celebrate the day you were born.
entries.translation: Kabajnii guyyaa dhalootaa yeroo guyya itti dhalatte kabajuuf oolu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a day to reflect on all the good things in your life and to thank those who have made you who you are.
entries.translation: Guyyichi guyyaa wantoota gaari jiruu kee kessatti si mudatan itti ibsituu fi guyya namoota amma akka bakka kana geessu si godhan itti galateeffattudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a day to set goals for the year ahead and to make plans for the future.
entries.translation: Guyyichi guyyaa ille waggaa dhufuuf galma itti keessufi jiruu gara fulduraaf itti karoorsituu dha.

entries.english: To make the most of your birthday, start by making a list of all the things you are grateful for.
entries.translation: Guyyaa dhaloota kee kabajuuf, wantoota atii galateeffattuf tarreessun jalqabi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include your family, friends, health, home, job, or anything else that is important to you.
entries.translation: Kunis maatii kee, hiriyoota kee, fayyaa kee, mana kee, hojii kee, yookin wantuma siif barbaachisa ta'e dabalachuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have made your list, take some time to reflect on each item and how it has made your life better.
entries.translation: Akkuma tarreesiteen, wanta tarree sanaa tokko tokkoon calaqisuu fi akkamitti akka inni jiruu kee gaari godhe ture ibsuuf yeroo muuraasa fudhadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Next, set some goals for the year ahead.
entries.translation: Achuumaan, waggaa dhufuuf galma tokko kaa'ii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These goals can be anything you want them to be, but they should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.
entries.translation: Galmoonni kunneen wantoota akka atii ta'uu barbaaddu kamiyyu ta'uu danda'aa, garuu waan addaa, lakkaawwamaa, galma gahaamaa, barbaachisaa fi yeroon daanggeffamaa ta'uu qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might set a goal to lose weight, get a promotion at work, or travel to a new place.
entries.translation: Fakkenyaaf, ulfaatina kee hir'isuuf, guulantaa hojii kee dabaluuf, iddo haraa deemuf galma kaa'uu ni dandeesa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, make plans for the day of your birthday.
entries.translation: Dhumarrattis, kabaja guyyaa dhaloota keef karoora karoorsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include spending time with your loved ones, eating your favorite foods, or doing something you have always wanted to do.
entries.translation: Kunis namoota jaalattu waliin yeroo dabarsuu, nyaata ati jaalattu nyachuu, yookin wanta yeroo hunda gochuuf dharratuu gochuu ni dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Nama 1: Nan beeka. Kanaafi dha ammaan boddee koomeedi jaalalaa kanan hin ilaalle.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They give people unrealistic expectations about love.
entries.translation: Jaalala waliin wal qabate waan qabatamaa hin taanee namaaf dabarsu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My first day of school was a day I will never forget.
entries.translation: Guyyan jalqabaa mana barumsaa koo, guyyaa ani yoomille hin daganne dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was both excited and nervous, not knowing what to expect.
entries.translation: Maal akkan eegu waanan hin beekneef gamadees rifadhees ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I woke up that morning, I got dressed quickly and ate a quick breakfast.
entries.translation: Ganama sana yommuun ka'uu, uffata koo dafee jijjirradhee ciree koo dafee nyadheen ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, my mom drove me to school and walked me to my classroom.
entries.translation: Achumaan, haati koo gara mana baruumsaatti na gaggessite gara kutaa koos na faana deemtee turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I walked into the classroom, I was immediately greeted by my teacher, Ms. Smith.
entries.translation: Daree keessa yommun gaku, barsistuun koo Aadde Ismiiz, oggasuma nagaa na gaafatte turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was a kind-looking woman with a warm smile.
entries.translation: Isheen dubartii gara laafessaa kolfa ho'aa qabduu turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She introduced herself to me and then showed me to my seat.
entries.translation: Isheen of beeksiste taa'umsa koo natti argisistee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I sat down next to a girl named Sarah.
entries.translation: Anis dubartii maqaan ishee Saaraa jedhamtu cinaa taa'ee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled at me and said, "Hi, I'm Sarah."
entries.translation: Isheenis akka koolfu jette, "Akkam, ani Saara dha" jette.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back and said, "Hi, I'm Vera."
entries.translation: Anis akka koolfu jedhe, "Akkam, Anis Veeraa dha" jeedheen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a few minutes before the bell rang for class to start.
entries.translation: Barnootni akka jalqabamuu osoo hin bilbilamiin dura daqiiqaawwan muraasaaf hasoofne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Smith began by introducing herself and telling us about the rules of the classroom.
entries.translation: Aadde Ismiizis of beeksiisunifi seeroota daree keessa nutti himun jalqabde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, she started teaching us about math.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was a little bit confused at first, but Ms. Smith explained everything clearly.
entries.translation: Jalqaba irratti xiqqoo burjaaja'us Addee Ismiiz waan hunda ifatti ibsite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After math class, we had a break.
entries.translation: Kutaa heerrega booda, boqonnaa qabna turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah and I went outside to play on the playground.
entries.translation: Ani fi Saaraan taphachuuf gara dirree taphaatti gadi baane.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We played on the swings and the slide for a while, then we went back inside for lunch.
entries.translation: Yeroo muraasaaf tapha gad-bu'uu fi lulluqqachu eerga taphanne booda, laaqana nyaachuf ol galle.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is injured, the body’s immune system sends white blood cells to the area.
entries.translation: Yeroo tishuun keenya midhamu, sirni ittisa qaama keenya seelii dhiga adii gara bakkichatti eerga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause blood vessels to dilate and become more permeable.
entries.translation: Seelonni kunnen keemikaala ujummoon dhiigaa akka bal'atuu fi waan hunda akka fudhatu godhu gadhisuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows fluid and white blood cells to leak out of the blood vessels and into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Kunis dhangala'aanifi seelii dhiiga adiin ujummoo dhigaa keessan akka gadi bahaani gara tishuu midhamee bira dhaqan heeyyama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fluid forms a clear, watery swelling called edema.
entries.translation: Dhangala'aan kun dhita'aa ifa ta'ee, kan bishaan baatu uuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The white blood cells help to fight infection and to remove damaged tissue.
entries.translation: Seelii dhiiga adiin hubama uumame loolufi tishuu midhamee ballessuf gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also release chemicals that stimulate the growth of new tissue.
entries.translation: Keemikaaloota tiishuu haaraa ijaaruuf kan ta'uus ni gadhisuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The classic signs of acute inflammation are redness, heat, swelling, and pain.
entries.translation: Mallattoleen beekkama kan gubaa cimaa diimachuu, hoo'uu, dhita'uu, fi dhukkubbii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These signs are caused by the increased blood flow and the release of chemicals in the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Mallattooleen kunneen sababa dhangala'aa dhiigaa dabaleenifi keemikaaloota gara tishuu miidhamanitti gadhifamaniin ka'aan dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Redness is caused by the dilation of blood vessels.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat is caused by the increased blood flow and the release of inflammatory chemicals.
entries.translation: Hoo'ii dhangala'uu dhigaa dabaleen fi gadhifamuu keemikaaloota gubduutiin ka'aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Swelling is caused by the leakage of fluid from blood vessels into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Dhita'uun dhangala'aan ujummoo dhigaa keessaan gara tishuu midhamee bira dhangala'uu isaatin ka'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain is caused by the release of inflammatory chemicals and the pressure of the swelling.
entries.translation: Dhukkubbin gadhifamuu keemikaalootaa gubduu fi dhiibbaa dhita'aatiin ka'aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is a normal part of the healing process.
entries.translation: Gubuun cimaa ta'e kun adeemsa fayyaa idilee ta'e dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, if it is severe or prolonged, it can damage healthy tissue.
entries.translation: Haa ta'uu malee, hammaataa fi yeroo dheraa kan turuu yoo ta'ee, tishuu fayyaas balleessu danda'aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, acute inflammation can lead to chronic inflammation, which is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Haala tokko tokko keessatti, guubuun kun gubaa kiroonikii, gubaa kan yeroo dheraa dhaaf ture dhukkubbi umuu, miidhamummaa fi du'a fiidu danda'uu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can cause acute inflammation, including infection, injury, and autoimmune diseases.
entries.translation: Hubaa, midhaa, fi dhukkuboota sirna ittisa qaamaa irraan ofumaan ka'aan dabalatee gubaa cimaa kana wantonni kaasuu danda'an baay'eetu jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Infections are caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
entries.translation: Hubaan baakteeriyaa, vaayirasii, yookin fangasii iraan ka'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these organisms enter the body, they can trigger an immune response that leads to inflammation.
entries.translation: Orgaanizimoonni kunnen yeroo qaama keessa seenan, deebi sirna ittisa qaamaa damaqsuu danda'uu kunis gara gubaa cimaatti geessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is damaged, it releases chemicals that attract white blood cells and other immune cells to the area.
entries.translation: Yeroo tishuun midhamuu, keemikaaloota seelii dhiiga adii fi seeloota sirna ittisa qaamaa kanneen biroo ofitti waaman gadhisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause inflammation.
entries.translation: Seelonni kunnen ammo keemikaaloota gubaa cimaa uuman gadhisuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Autoimmune diseases are caused by the body’s immune system attacking its own tissues.
entries.translation: Dhukkubonni sirna ittisa qaamaa ofumaan kan ka'aan yeroo sirni ittisa qaamaa tishuu dhuma ofisaa haleeluu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to inflammation in the affected tissues.
entries.translation: Kunis bakka tishuu haleellamee bira gubaa uuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is usually treated with pain relievers, such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen.
entries.translation: Gubaa cimaan yeroo baay'ee qorichoota dhukkubbi hir'isan kan akka ayibupirofinin yookin aseetaaminofeenin yaalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, corticosteroids may be used to reduce inflammation.
entries.translation: Haala tokko tokko keessatti, koortikosteeroyidsiin akka hiri'stuu gubatti fayyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the inflammation is caused by an infection, antibiotics may be prescribed.
entries.translation: Gubaan hubamuu dhaan kan ka'ee yoo ta'ee, antibayotikiin ni ajajamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Gubaan kiroonikii haala yeroo dheeraaf turuu fi gara dhukubbi, midhama qaamaa fi du'attillee geessuu danda'uu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is often caused by autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn’s disease.
entries.translation: Kunis yeroo baay'ee dhukkuboota sirna ittisa qaamaa ofumaan ka'aan kan akka rihimaatoyiid artritisii fi dhukkuba Kiroonisiitiin ka'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation can also be caused by obesity, smoking, and air pollution.
entries.translation: Gubuun kiroonikii sababa furdiina qaamaa, tamboo xuuxuu, fi faalama qilleensaa tiin ka'aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no cure for chronic inflammation, but it can be managed with medication, lifestyle changes, and physical therapy.
entries.translation: Gubaa kiroonikitiif falli dhumaa hin jiruu, garuu qoorichota, jijjirraa haala jireenyaa, fi wal'aansa qaamaa tiin to'achuun ni danda'ama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mozambican Civil War was a conflict that lasted from 1977 to 1992.
entries.translation: Waraanni biyya keessaa Moozambikii bara 1977 haanga 1992 keessa kan dhume dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war caused widespread devastation and displacement, and led to the deaths of an estimated 1 million people.
entries.translation: Waraanichi gaaga'ama fi buqqa'iinsa bal'aa kan geesiise yoommu ta'u, du'a namoota miiliyoona 1 tti tilmaamamanif sababa kan ta'e dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war began after RENAMO launched an insurgency against FRELIMO in 1977.
entries.translation: Waraanichi kan jalqabee bara 1977 keessa RENAMO n eerga FRELIMO irratti finicila baneen booda dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: RENAMO was opposed to FRELIMO's socialist policies and its close ties to the Soviet Union.
entries.translation: RENAMO n imaammata soshaalistii FRELMO fi walitti dhufeenya cimaa gamtaa Sooviyet waliin qabu kan mormu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war quickly escalated, and by the early 1980s, RENAMO had control of much of the countryside.
entries.translation: Waraanichi dafee kan hammaate yoommu ta'u, jalqaba bara 1980 oota keessa, RENAMO n baadiyyaa biyyatti gutumatti too'ate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: FRELIMO was forced to rely on Soviet and Cuban military aid to keep RENAMO at bay.
entries.translation: FRELIMO n RENAMO dhabuu dhaaf humna gamta Sooviyet fi Kubaa irratti abdachuuf dirqame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1984, FRELIMO and RENAMO signed a peace agreement, but the fighting continued.
entries.translation: Bara 1984 keessa, FRELIMO fi RENAMO n waligaltee nageenyaa mallattessan, garuu waldhabbichi itti fufe ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1992, the two sides signed a new peace agreement, which called for a ceasefire and the holding of multiparty elections.
entries.translation: Bara 1992 keesa, gareen lamaan waligaltee nageenyaa haaraa, kan dhukaasa dhabuu fi filannoo paarti heeddu waamuu mallatteessan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a bright and sunny day in the small village of Locksmiths, and the festival of locks was in full swing.
entries.translation: Guyyichi mandara warra furtuu hojjatan keessatti guyyaa ifaa fi aduu qabu ture, kabajni ayyaana furtuu hojjachus guutummaatti itti fufee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The streets were crowded with people, all eager to see the latest and greatest in lockmaking technology.
entries.translation: Karaan namoota heeddun, hundi isaani teeknoolooji furtuu hojjachuu ilaaluuf arifataniin guutamee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were vendors selling everything from simple padlocks to complex combination locks, and artisans demonstrating their skills in lockpicking and locksmithing.
entries.translation: Daldaltonni heeduu kan furtuu sasalpha irraa kaase furtuu walxaxaatti gurguranis jiru turan, ogeeyyii harkaas ogummaa isaanii furtuu hojjachu fi omishuu irraatti qaban agarsiisaa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the center of the village square, a large stage had been set up for the day's festivities.
entries.translation: Gidduu mandaritti keessatti, agarsiisoo guyyichaaf waltajji guddaan hojjatamee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A group of musicians were playing lively tunes, and a crowd of people were gathered around, clapping and dancing.
entries.translation: Gareen muuziqeessitootaa muziqaa bareedaa taphachaa turan, tuutni namootaas walitti qabamani harka walitti dhahaafi shubbisaa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the stage, a skilled locksmith was demonstrating how to pick a lock, and the crowd was mesmerized by his skill.
entries.translation: Waltajjicha irratti, ogeessi furtuu tokko akkamitti akka furtuun banamu agarsiisaa ture, namoonnis ogummaa isaatin dinqisifamaa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, the festival came to a close.
entries.translation: Akkuma aduun lixaa dhuftuu, ayyaanichii cufamuu eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend, Abel, and I were walking home from school one day when we saw a blood drive being held at our local community center.
entries.translation: Mandara keenya keessatti yommuu dhignii laatamu arginetti hiriyaan koo Abeel, fi ani man baruumsaa irraa gar manaatti deemaa turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both 17 years old, and we had never donated blood before.
entries.translation: Nuti lamaanu umuriin keenya waggaa 17 dha, nutis kanaan dura dhiiga laanne hin beeknu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We decided to stop in and see what it was all about.
entries.translation: Nutis achummatti dhaabbanne wantichi maal akka ta'e ilaaluf murteessine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of donating blood was actually pretty simple.
entries.translation: Adeemsi dhiiga laachun dhugumatti baay'ee salphaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both filled out a questionnaire and answered some questions about our health history.
entries.translation: Lamaan keenyayyu gaaffilee waa'ee seenaa fayyaa keenyaa gaafatan gunnee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, we had our blood pressure checked and our veins were checked to make sure they were big enough.
entries.translation: Achiis, dhibbaa dhiiga keenyaa fi ujummoon dhiiga keenyaa guddaa ta'uu isaa ilaalchisnee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once we were cleared to donate, we each sat down in a chair and had a needle inserted into our arms.

entries.english: Hikers should always bring a map, compass, and a flashlight, and they should tell someone where they are going and when they expect to return.

entries.english: When I was a kid, I would spend hours poring over magazines.

entries.english: I would read every article, look at every picture, and cut out the ones I liked to put in my scrapbook.
entries.translation: Barruulee hunda kanan dubbisu fi fakki hunda kanan ilaalu yoommu ta'u, dabtara fakkii koo irratti maxxansuu isan barbaadee kuteen keessaa baasa ture.

entries.english: I loved the way magazines could transport me to different worlds and make me think about things in new ways.

entries.english: One day, I was reading an article about brain science in a magazine.

entries.english: The article was really interesting, and it made me think about how my brain works.

entries.english: I realized that I could use my brain to learn anything I wanted, and that was an amazing feeling.

entries.english: I've been reading magazines ever since, and I still love the way they can open my mind to new ideas.

entries.english: The debate about whether animals are happier in the wild or in zoos is a complex one with no easy answers.
entries.translation: Falmiin bineensonni boosona keessa jiraachu qabu jeedhufi bakka mana eegumsi godhamuuf keessa jiraachu qabu jeedhu yaada walxaxaa fi deebii salphaa kan hin qabnee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many factors to consider, including the individual animal's needs, the type of zoo, and the quality of care provided.
entries.translation: Fedhii bineensoticha, akaakuu mana eegumsa bineensootichaa, fi qulqullina kunuunsi itti keennamu dabalachuun sababoota ilaalamuu qaban heedduutu jiru.

entries.english: Some animals, such as elephants, are highly social and need to interact with other elephants in order to thrive.
entries.translation: Bineensoonni tokko tokko, kan akka arbaa, baay'ee hawaasa isaani barbaadan yommu ta'u, jiraachuu dhaaf arboota biraa waliin wal argu qabu.

entries.english: In the wild, elephants live in herds of up to 100 individuals.
entries.translation: Boosona keessatti, arboonni tuuta 100 ol ta'ani jiraatu.

entries.english: They spend their days foraging for food, playing, and socializing.
entries.translation: Guyyaa isaanis nyaata barbaadaa, taphachaa fi arboota biraa waliin ta'un dabarsuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a zoo, elephants may not have the same opportunities to interact with other elephants, which can lead to boredom and frustration.

entries.english: Other animals, such as lions, are solitary hunters.

entries.english: In the wild, lions live in prides of up to 15 individuals.

entries.english: However, each lion within the pride has its own territory and does not interact with other lions very often.
entries.translation: Haa ta'uu malee, leencii hunduu daangaa mataa isaa of danda'e kan qabu yoo ta'u, leenca biraa waliin baay'ee wal hin qunnamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a zoo, lions may be able to live in larger enclosures with more space to roam, which can provide them with more opportunities to exercise and explore.
entries.translation: Mana eegumsa bineensootaa keessaati, leencoonni mooraa guddaa bakka gahaa asiif achi itti deeman keessa kan jiraatan yoommu ta'u, kunis carraa sochii qaamaa itti godhan fi waa itti funaanan keennaaf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of zoo also plays a role in the welfare of its animals.
entries.translation: Akaakuun mana eegumsa bineensootichaas fayyummaa bineensotichaa keessatti gahee guddaa taphata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some zoos are very large and provide their animals with spacious enclosures, while others are smaller and may not have as much space.

entries.english: They worked long hours for low pay, and they often had to go without basic necessities like food and healthcare.

entries.english: One such person was a young woman named Amelia.

entries.english: He was homeless, and he was holding a sign that said, "Will work for food." Amelia felt sorry for the man, and she decided to buy him a sandwich.

entries.english: Demonetization is the process of removing legal tender from circulation.

entries.english: In India, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced on November 8, 2016, that all ₹500 and ₹1000 banknotes would cease to be legal tender from midnight.
entries.translation: Hindii keessa, Ministeerri Mummee Naareendraa Modiin, haalkan walakkaa Sadaasa 8, 2016 irraa eegalee nootiin qarshii ruppi 500 fi ruppi 1000 kaffalti seera qabeessa ta'un isaani akka dhaabbatu labsee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This move was intended to crack down on corruption and counterfeiting, but it also caused significant disruption and hardship for many people.

entries.english: There are several reasons to be skeptical of demonetization.

entries.english: First, it is not clear that it will be effective in reducing corruption.
