entries.english: Corruption is a complex problem that cannot be solved simply by removing cash from circulation.
entries.translation: Malaammaltummaan rakkina walxaxaa ta'ee fi callaa naana'aa jiruu balleessu qofaan wanta furamu miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, there is some evidence that demonetization may actually increase corruption, as it makes it more difficult for people to track and trace their money.
entries.translation: Dhugaa dubbachuuf, maallaqa dhorkuun namoonni qarshi isaani haala ittin hordofan waan cimsuuf malaammaltummaa akka dabaluu danda'uu ragooleen tokko tokko ni mul'isu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, demonetization is likely to have a negative impact on the poor.
entries.translation: Inni lamataa, maallaqa dhorkuun namoota hiyyessa irratti dhibbaa gadhe uuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many poor people in India rely on cash for their daily transactions.
entries.translation: Namoonni hiyyessa ta'an heeddun Hindii keessa jiran daldala guyya guyyaa isaanif callaa irratti hunda'uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sudden withdrawal of large-denomination banknotes made it difficult for them to buy food, pay their bills, and access other essential services.
entries.translation: Nootiiwwan maallaqaa gahee guddaa qaban akka tasaa gadi baasuun, nyaata bitachuuf, kaffaltti kaffaluuf, fi tajaajiloota barbaachisoo ta'an argachuuf baay'ee ulfaataa taasiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, demonetization has caused significant disruption to the economy.
entries.translation: Sadaffaa irratti, maallaqa dhorkuun dinagdee irratti jeequmsa guddaa uume ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Businesses had to close for days or even weeks while they adjusted to the new currency.
entries.translation: Daldaltoonni heeddun haanga isaan maallaqa isa haaraa waliin of sirreessanitti guyyootaa fi toorbanootaaf akka cufaman taasiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dish is said to have originated in the Philippines, where it is known as lechon.
entries.translation: Nyaatichi Filipiinsii keessa akka maddeefi maqaan isaas Leechan akka jeedhamu himama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also popular in other parts of Southeast Asia, such as Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.
entries.translation: Innis kuutaalee Eesiyaa Kibba bahaa, kan akka Indoonezhiyaa, Maaleezhiyaa, fi Taayilaand keessa beekamaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To make lechon, a whole pig is gutted and cleaned, then stuffed with a mixture of garlic, ginger, lemongrass, and other spices.
entries.translation: Leechan hojjachuu dhaaf, booyyee guutuun garaachi keessaa baafamee qulqullaa'a, achis makaa qullubbii adii, ziinjibila, loomii fi mi'eessituuwwan kan birootiin guutama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pig is then roasted over a fire of charcoal or wood for several hours.
entries.translation: Achiis booyyechi ibidda kasalaa fi qooraan irratti sa'aati heedduuf ni waaddama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The result is a juicy, flavorful meat that is perfect for a special occasion.
entries.translation: Bu'aan isaas foon dhangala'aa, mi'aawaa ta'ee guyyaa addaa tiif mudaa kan hin qabne dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lechon is often served with rice and vegetables.
entries.translation: Leechanin yeroo baay'ee ruuzii fi kuduraa waliin dhiyaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be eaten as a main course or as an appetizer.
entries.translation: Innis akka nyaata ijootti yookin nyaata jalqabaatti nyaatamu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are ever lucky enough to try lechon, you will not be disappointed.
entries.translation: Yoo atii Leechan yaaluf carromaa taate, yoomiyyuu itti hin gadditu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is truly a unique and delicious dish.
entries.translation: Nyaata dhugumatti addaa fi mi'aawaa ta'ee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the traditional method of cooking lechon, there are also several modern variations.
entries.translation: Mala aadaa Leechan itti hojjatamu itti dabalu dhaan, maloonni haarawaa baay'een jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some chefs cook the pig in a pit oven, while others use a rotisserie.
entries.translation: Shefoonnii tokko tokko booyyicha waaddu dhaaf ovinii yommuu fayyadaman kaan immo eelee waadditu fayyadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also recipes for making lechon in a slow cooker or in the oven.
entries.translation: Leechan waaddituu keessas ta'e ovinii kessatti hojjachuuf qajelfamni ni jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how it is cooked, lechon is always a crowd-pleaser.
entries.translation: Haala kamiinu hojjatamuu ille, Leechan yeroo hunda gamtaa-gammachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a hearty and flavorful dish that is perfect for any occasion.
entries.translation: Kunis nyaata nama qabbannessu, midhagaa ta'e fi yeroo kamiyyuu irratti mudaa kan hin qabne dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you are looking for a new and exciting dish to try, lechon is definitely worth a look.
entries.translation: Kanaaf nyaata haaraa fi nama gammachisuu yaaluuf barbaadaa jirta taanaan, Leechaniin ilaalcha gati qabu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: What's up with your car? It's been making a weird noise lately.
entries.translation: Ani: Koonkolaataan kee maal taate? Sagalee hin baramnee baasuu jalqabeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: Yeah, I know. I'm taking it to the mechanic tomorrow.
entries.translation: Wasiila: Eeyyen, nan beeka. Booru ogeessa bira nan geessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Is it going to be expensive.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: It might be. The car is old, and parts are hard to come by. But I'm hoping it's just a minor issue.
entries.translation: Wasiila: Ta'uu danda'a. Koonkolaatichi dullomeera, kutaalee isaa fiduufis ulfaataa dha. Garuu dhimma xiqqaa akka ta'uu nan yaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Well, good luck. Let me know what the mechanic says.
entries.translation: Ani: Mee haa ta'u, carraa gaari. Waan ogeessichi jeedhe natti himi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Hey, by the way, did you know that nuclear cars are a thing?
entries.translation: Ani: Sii, kanan jeedhu, koonkoolaataa niwukilaraa akka ta'an beekta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: No, I didn't. That's interesting.
entries.translation: Wasiila: Lakki, hin beeku. Kun hawwataa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: Yeah, they're pretty cool. They use nuclear power to generate electricity, which powers the car's motor.
entries.translation: Ani: Eeyye, baay'ee namatti tola. humna elektrikaa maddisisuuf annisa niwukiilara fayyadamu, kunis mootara koonkoolaatichaaf humna kenna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: That sounds like it would be really expensive.
entries.translation: Wasiila: Kuun waan baay'ee qaalii ta'e fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Me: It can be, but it's also a lot more efficient than traditional cars. Nuclear cars can go for hundreds of miles on a single tank of fuel.
entries.translation: Ani: Ta'uu danda'a, garuu konkoolaatoota durii irraa kan humna qabu dha. Konkolaatonni niwukiilaraa taankii boba'aa tokko dhaan maayila dhibbotaan lakkaawwaman deemu danda'uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Uncle: Hmm, I'll have to look into that.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A man walks into a comedy club and orders a filet mignon.
entries.translation: Namichi tokko mana bashannanaa deemee Fileet Mignoon ajajee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The waiter brings him the steak and he starts to eat it.
entries.translation: Keessumeessichi foonicha fideef innis nyaachu jalqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few bites, he stops and says, "This steak is terrible! It's tough and tasteless."
entries.translation: Nyaata xiqqoo booda, nyaachuu dhaabe akkas jeedhe, "Foonichi badaa dha! Jabaa fi mi'aa hin qabne dha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The waiter replies, "Well, sir, you did order a filet mignon."
entries.translation: Keessumeessichis akkas jeedhee deebiseef, "Eegaa, obbo, Fileet Mignoon ajajjee."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, but I didn't order a raw filet mignon!"
entries.translation: "Eeyyen, garuu Fileet Mignoon dheedhi hin ajajne!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Sir, all of our steaks are served raw. We require our customers to cook them themselves."
entries.translation: "Obbo, foon nuti dhiyeessinu hundi dheedhi dha. Maamiltoonni keenya ofuuma isaani akka bilcheeffatan gaaffanna."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But I don't know how to cook!"
entries.translation: "Garuu ani akkamitti akka bilcheeffamu hin beeku!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's not our problem. We're a comedy club, not a restaurant."
entries.translation: "Kun rakkina keenya miti. Nuti mana bashananaa malee mana nyaataa miti."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man angrily gets up and storms out of the club.
entries.translation: Namichis aari dhaan ka'ee kilabicha keessaa ba'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been in a car accident, and he was unconscious.
entries.translation: Balaa konkolaataa keessa waan tureef of hin beeku ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His parents, who had been driving by when the accident happened, rushed to his side.
entries.translation: Maatin isaas yeroo balaan kun mudate konkolaataa ofaa turan ariitiidhaan itti dhiyaatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The paramedics arrived and loaded the boy into an ambulance.
entries.translation: Ogeeyyin fayyaa gargaarsaan dhufanis mucicha ambulaansiidhaan fe'enii deeman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His parents followed in their car, their hearts pounding with fear.
entries.translation: Maatiin isaas konkolaaticha duuka yeroo bu'anis lubbun isaanii sodaadhaan dhahata ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At the hospital, the doctors examined the boy and determined that he had a concussion and a broken leg.
entries.translation: Hospitaalattis ogeeyyin fayya mucicha erga qorataniin boodas raafamaa fi miilli isaa akka cabe mirkaneessaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They admitted him to the hospital and began treatment.
entries.translation: Mucichas erga galchaniin booddee wal'aansa eegalan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy's parents stayed by his side, never leaving him alone.
entries.translation: Maatiin mucichaas isa wajjiin turani, takkaa illee isa hin dhiifne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They watched over him as he slept, their hearts filled with love and hope.
entries.translation: Yeroo rafus isa ilaalaa lubbuun isaanis jaalalaafi abdiidhaan nii guutama ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Royalty," said the Blacksmith, "is a curious thing. It's a kind of magic, really.
entries.translation: "Dhugumatti moti mootummaan gosa falfalaati" jedhe Bilaakismiiz.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People get all worked up about it, and they don't even know why.
entries.translation: Namoonni sababoota kana duuba jiran hubachuu baatanis garmalee waa'ee kanaa nii jeeqamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not as if kings and queens have any real power, these days. They're just figureheads.
entries.translation: Moototni fi giiftoliin yeroo ammaa humna dhugaa ta'e qabaatanii miti. isaan gaggeesitoota fakkeenyaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But people still seem to need them.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee namootni isaan nii barbaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They need someone to look up to, someone to represent the idea of the nation." The Blacksmith paused.
entries.translation: Nama yaada sabaa bakka bu'u ni barbaadu" jedhee hojjetaan sibiilaa sun gidduu galee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I suppose it's a kind of comfort," he continued.
entries.translation: "Gosa jajjabinaati jedheen yaada," jedhee itti fufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "To know that there's someone out there who's better than you.
entries.translation: "Namni ogummaaniifii amalaan si caalu akka jiru hubachuuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Someone who's got it all sorted out.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Someone who can make the world a better place.
entries.translation: Nama addunyaa kana bakka gaarii gochuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, it's all an illusion. But that doesn't make it any less important.
entries.translation: Dhugaadha, hundi isaa abjuudha. Haa ta'u iyyuu malee barbaachisummaa isaa hin hir'isu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People need their illusions. They need to believe in something.
entries.translation: Namootni abjuu isaanii nii barbaadu. Waan itti amanan isaan barbaachisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if that something is a king or a queen, then so be it."
entries.translation: Wanti sunis mootii yookin giiftii yoo ta'e, haa ta'u."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Blacksmith paused for a moment, then smiled.
entries.translation: Namichi dallaa hojjetu erga xinnoo calliseen booda ni kolfe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Old Man and the Sea
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago, an old Cuban fisherman, has gone eighty-four days without catching a fish.
entries.translation: Namichi dulloomaa Kuubaa Saantiyaagoo jedhamu, qurxummii osoo hin qabatiin guyyoota saddeettamii afur tureera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is the oldest man in the village, and the youngest, Manolin, no longer wants to fish with him because the old man is unlucky.
entries.translation: Inni nama hangafaa ganda sanaa yoo ta'u, mucaan quxusuu hundaa ta'e Maanoliin kana booda jaarsichi carraa waan hin qabneed isa waliin qurxummii qabuu hin barbaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Santiago sets out in his skiff and hooks a giant marlin.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko Santiyaagoon bidiruu isaatiin bahee maarliinii guddaa tokko qabate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The marlin is so big that it pulls the skiff far out to sea.
entries.translation: Maarlinichi sun baay'ee guddaa ta'uu isaa irraa kan ka'e daaktuu sana gara galaanaatti harkisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Santiago fights the marlin for two days and nights, but he cannot bring it in.
entries.translation: Saantiyaagoonis guyyaal lamaafi halkan lama maarliinicha olbaasuuf yaalus, hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The marlin is too heavy, and the old man is too tired.
entries.translation: Maarliinichi baay'ee ulfaata dha, jaarsichis dadhabeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, the marlin begins to tire.

entries.english: Then, use your scissors or clippers to clip the tip of the nail.
entries.translation: Sana booda, fiixee qeensaa qoruuf maqasii ykn qortuu fayyadamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be careful not to cut too short, as this can cause pain and bleeding.
entries.translation: Baay'istanii itti buttanii kutuu irraa of eegaa, dhukkubbii fi dhiiga uumuu waan danda'uuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you do cut your dog's nail too short, apply a styptic powder or pencil to stop the bleeding.
entries.translation: Qeensa saree keessanii itti buttanii yoo kuttan, dhiiga dhaabuuf jecha daakuu iskiiptikii ykn qubeessaa itti godhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Styptic powders and pencils are available at most pet stores.
entries.translation: Daakuuwwan iskiiptikii fi qubeessaa dukkaanawwan bineeldaa hedduu keessatti ni argamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've trimmed all of your dog's nails, be sure to reward them with a treat.
entries.translation: Erga qeensa saree keessanii qortanii xumurtanii booda, kunuunsa isaaniif gochuu hin dagatiinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trimming nails can be a stressful experience for some dogs, so it's important to make it a positive experience.
entries.translation: Qeensa qorachuun saroota tokko tokkoof nuffisiisaa ta'uu mala, kanaafuu gara bal'ina qabaachuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little practice, you'll be able to trim your dog's nails like a pro.
entries.translation: Shaakala xiqqoon, akka nama muuxannoo qabuutti qeensa saree keessanii qoruu dandeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And your dog will be happy to have their nails trimmed, too!
entries.translation: Sareen keessan illee qeensi isaa qoramuutti ni gammada!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are a few additional tips for trimming your dog's nails:
entries.translation: Qeensa saree qoruuf gorsoonni dabalataa muraasni akka armaan gadiitti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Start by trimming the nails on your dog's front paws.
entries.translation: * Qeensa saree keessanii qoruu barruu gara fuul-duraa irraa eegalaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is usually the easiest place to start.
entries.translation: Yeroo baay'ee bakka jalqabbii salphaan isa kanadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * If your dog is nervous, try trimming their nails one at a time.
entries.translation: * Sareen keessan bir'ataa yoo ta'e, qeensa isaanii tokko tokkoon qoruu yaalaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Be sure to trim the nails evenly.
entries.translation: * Qeensota sana wal qixxeessitanii muruu keessan mirkaneeffadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You don't want one nail to be shorter than the others.
entries.translation: Qeensi tokko isa kaaniin gadi ta'uu isaa hin barbaaddan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * If you're not sure how to trim your dog's nails, ask your veterinarian or a groomer for help.
entries.translation: * Akkamittiin qeensa saree keessanii akka qortan hin beektan taanaan, ogeessa fayyaa beeyladaa ykn miidhagsaa beeyladaa irraa deggersa gaafadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little care and attention, you can keep your dog's nails trimmed and healthy.
entries.translation: Xiyyeeffannoo fi of-eeggannoo xiqqoodhaan, qeensa saree keessanii qortanii fayyaatti eeguu dandeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ivory Coast is a country in West Africa that has been in the midst of a civil war since 2010.
entries.translation: Aayivoorii Koost biyya Lixa Afrikaa erga bara 2010 kaastee wal waraansa waliinii keessa jirtudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict began after incumbent president Laurent Gbagbo refused to accept defeat in the 2010 presidential election.
entries.translation: Wal waraansi kunis pirezidaantiin yeros aangoo irra turan Looreen Gibaangoon filannaa pirezidaantummaa bara 2010 taasifame irratti mo'atamuu isaanii fudhachuu diduu irraan eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo was eventually ousted by forces loyal to Alassane Ouattara, who was declared the winner of the election.
entries.translation: Booda irra Gibaagboon humnoota amanamoo Alaasaan Ootaaraa, kan mo'ataa filannoo sanaa tureen aangoo irraa buufaman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the conflict has continued, with sporadic violence breaking out in the country.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, wal waraansichi hookkara jabaa biyyicha keessatti dho'een itti fufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, there were hopes that the country would finally be able to move on from the civil war.
entries.translation: Bara 2017 keessa, dhuma irratti biyyattiin wal waraansa kana dhiisuun nagaa buusti abdiin jedhu ni ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, these hopes were dashed when Gbagbo was acquitted of charges of crimes against humanity by the International Criminal Court.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, abdiiwwan turan sun sababa Gibaagboon himannaa yakka dhala namaa irratti raawwachuun himatame irraa Mana murtii Yakka Addunyaatiin bilisa ba'een haphatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo's acquittal was seen as a blow to the peace process, and it led to renewed violence in the country.
entries.translation: Bilisa ba'uun Gibaagboo adeemsa nagaa buusuu keessatti akka gufuutti ilaalamuun biyyittii keessatti hookkara kan biroo dhale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2018, the United Nations Security Council imposed sanctions on Gbagbo and his supporters.
entries.translation: Bara 2018 keessa, Manni maree Nageenyaa Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Gibaagboo fi deggertoota isaanii irra qoqqobbii kaaye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions were aimed at pressuring Gbagbo to end his support for violence in the country.
entries.translation: Kaayyoon qoqqoobbiiwwan kanaas akka Gibgaagboon deggersa hookkara biyyicha keessa jiru dhaabuuf dhiibbaa irratti uumuuf ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions have had some success, and there has been a decrease in violence in Ivory Coast since they were imposed.
entries.translation: Qoqqobbiiwwan sunis bu'aalee muraasa argamsiisuun, ega qoqqoobbiin kaayamee as hookkarri Aayivoorii Koosti keessaa hir'atee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country is still far from stable.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, biyyattiin ammas tasgabbii irraa fagoo jirti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways to do laundry, from using a traditional washing machine and dryer to more eco-friendly methods like hand washing and line drying.
entries.translation: Uffata miicuun, maashina miicee gogsu baratamaa fayyadamuu irraa hanga maloota faalama naannoo eegan kanneen harkaan miicuun hafanii gogsuu dabalatee karaawwan heedduu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to do laundry without using a machine is to hand wash your clothes in a basin or sink.
entries.translation: Uffata keessan osoo maashina uffata miicu hin fayyadamiin karaan ittiin qulqulleessitan uffata harka keessaniin lagatti ykn gabatee irratti miicuunidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, fill the basin with warm water and add a small amount of laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Kana gochuuf, bishaan ho'aa kuusuun daakuuwwan saamunaa uffataa muraasa itti ida'aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Soak your clothes for a few minutes, then scrub them with a washcloth or brush.
entries.translation: Uffata keessan daqiiqaawwan muraasaaf keessa kaayaa, sana booda burushii ykn miiccuu uffataan sukkuumaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rinse your clothes thoroughly in clean water, then wring them out.
entries.translation: Uffata keessan sirriitti bishaan qulqulluun dhiquun,sana booda keessaa baasaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes to dry on a clothesline or drying rack.
entries.translation: Akka goguuf uffata keessan toora uffataa ykn qoorsituu irra hafaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another option is to use a washing machine without a dryer.
entries.translation: Filannoo kan biroon maashina uffataa qoorsituu hin qabne fayyadamuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can save energy and money, but it does require more time and effort.
entries.translation: Kun annisaa fi qarshii ni qusata, yeroo fi dhamaatii baay'ee garuu ni barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To wash clothes in a machine without a dryer, fill the machine with water and add laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Maashina keessatti qoorsituu malee uffata miicuuf, maashinatti uffata guutuun saamunaa laawunderii itti ida'aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Set the machine to the appropriate cycle, then start it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the cycle is complete, remove your clothes from the machine and hang them to dry.
entries.translation: Yeroo marsaan xumuramu, uffata keessan maashina keessaa baasuun akka goguuf rarraasaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you live in an area with a lot of rain, you may be able to use the rain to help you dry your clothes.
entries.translation: Naannoo roobni hedduun jiru jiraattu taanaan, akka uffata keessan gogsuun roobatti fayyadamu dandeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes on a clothesline outside in the rain.
entries.translation: Rooba keessa toora uffataa irra uffata keessan hafaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the beginning, there was only darkness.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe was a vast, empty void.
entries.translation: Hawaan bal'aa fi lafa onaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, out of the darkness, came a spark.
entries.translation: Sana booda, dukkana keessaa, ifti as ba'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This spark was the first sign of life in the universe.
entries.translation: Ifti kunis hawaa keessatti mallattoo jireenyaa isa jalqabaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It grew and expanded, becoming a small ball of fire.
entries.translation: Sunis guddachuun babal'ate, gara kubbaa ibiddaattis jijjiirame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This ball of fire was the sun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Around the sun, the planets began to form.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Earth was the third planet from the sun.
entries.translation: Aduu irraa kaasee Lafti pilaanetii sadaffaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a small, rocky planet with a thin atmosphere.
entries.translation: Pilaanetii xiqqoo, dhagaa qabuu fi atimoosfera qal'oo qabu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the Earth, the first living things began to appear.
entries.translation: Lafa irratti, lubbu qabeeyyiin jalqabaa uumamuu eegalan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These were simple organisms, such as bacteria and algae.
entries.translation: Kunis lubbu qabeeyyii xixiqqoo kanneen akka, baakteeriyaa fi algee fa'a turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Over time, these organisms evolved into more complex forms of life, such as plants and animals.
entries.translation: Yeroo keessa, lubbu qabeeyyiin caasaa jireenyaa wal xaxaa ta'e, kanneen akka biqilootaa fi bineeldotaatti guddate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first humans appeared on Earth about 200,000 years ago.
entries.translation: Namni jalqabaa tilmaamaan naannoo waggaa 200,000 keessa Lafa iratti argame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans have evolved and developed to become the dominant species on Earth.
entries.translation: Namnis Lafa irratti gara sanyii guddaatti guddachuun jijjiirame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe is still expanding and evolving.
entries.translation: Hawaan amma illee guddachaa fi bal'achaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scientists believe that it will continue to expand for billions of years.
entries.translation: Ammallee Saayintistoonni waggaa biiliyoonotaaf guddachuu itti fufa jedhanii amanu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will reach a point where it can no longer expand.
entries.translation: Deemsa keessa, hawaan tuqaa kana booda guddachuu hin dandeessisne irra ni ga'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At this point, the universe will begin to contract.
entries.translation: Tuqaa kana irratti, hawaan walitti suntuuruu eegala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will collapse in on itself and disappear.
entries.translation: Deemsa keessa, hawaan ofuma isaatiin kufee ni bada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the universe may end, the story of life will continue.
entries.translation: Hawaan baduu danda'u illee, seenaan jireenyaa ittuma fufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm concerned about the environment and the impact that climate change is having on our planet.
entries.translation: Waa'een naannoo fi miidhaa jijjiiramni qilleensaa pilaanetii keenya irraan gahaa jiru ana yaaddessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also a big fan of technology and gadgets, so I'm always looking for ways to reduce my carbon footprint without sacrificing my lifestyle.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis ani deggeraa tekinooloojii fi gaajetootaa isa jabaadha, kanaafuu yeroo hundumaa osoon jireenya koo aarsaa hin taasisiin karaan ittiin ashaaraa kaarbonii koo hir'isun barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's why I'm so excited about renewable and alternative energy sources.
entries.translation: Sababa kanaafi kanin maddoota annisaa haaromsamanii fi kan biroo kanin ajaa'ibsiifadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Renewable energy is energy that comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as solar, wind, and water power.
entries.translation: Annisaan haaromfamu annisa madda uumamaan bakka buufamu kanneen akka humna aduu, qilleensaa fi bishaanii irraa maddanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alternative energy is energy that comes from sources that are not traditionally used for power generation, such as biomass and geothermal energy.
entries.translation: Annisaa filannoon immoo annisaawwan madda annisaa baratamoo hin taane irraa dhufan kanneen akka baayoomaasii fi humna ho'a lafa keessaa irraa maddanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Both renewable and alternative energy sources are clean and sustainable, meaning they don't produce greenhouse gases or other pollutants.
entries.translation: Maddeen annisaa haaromfamanii fi filannoo lamaan iyyuu qulqulluu fi amansiisoodha, kana jechuun gaaziiwwan naannoo faalan ykn faaltota kan biroo hin fidan jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best ways to make a difference is to switch to renewable energy sources for your home.
entries.translation: Karaalee ittiin jijjiirama fidan keessaa inni tokko annisaa mana keessanii gara annisaa haaromfamuutti jijjiiruudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The old wooden boat sat on the shore, its sails furled and its hull weathered by the sun and the rain.
entries.translation: Yabaloon mukaa qarqara bishaanii taa'u, bishaan irra raafamaa deeme haalii isaa immoo aduu fi bokkaan itti wal jijjiire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had seen many years of service, carrying its owners on voyages to far-off lands.
entries.translation: Waggoota hedduu tajaajila irratti argameera, abbootii isaa deemsa lafa irraa fagoo ta'e imalsiisee ni beeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But now, it was retired, its days of sailing over.
entries.translation: Amma garuu. soorama ba'ee jira, yeroon yabaluu isaatii xumurameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young boy named Thomas came to the beach.

entries.english: The pair disappeared over the Pacific Ocean on July 2, 1937, and their fate remains unknown.

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are the largest species of arachnid in the world, with some individuals reaching lengths of over 12 inches.
entries.translation: Sarariitiin yeeyyii jedhamu guddichi gosoota araaknidii addunyaa irra jiran keessaa isa guddicha yoo ta'u, kanneen tokko tokko hanga iinchiiwwan 12 dheeratu.

entries.english: They are found in tropical rainforests around the world, and are known for their aggressive behavior and venomous bite.
entries.translation: Isaanin bosonawwan naannoo mudhii lafaa jiran keessatti kan argaman yoo ta'u, amala loltummaa fi summii hadhawaan hidduu isaaniitiin beekamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite their fearsome reputation, giant wolf spiders are actually quite docile creatures.
entries.translation: Sodaachisummaa isaaniitiin kan beekaman yoo ta'e illee, sararatiiwwan yeeyyii gurguddoon kunniin uumama ajajamoodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are not aggressive towards humans unless they are provoked, and their venom is not typically fatal to humans.
entries.translation: Yoo qoccolaman malee dhala namaa hedduu hin lolan, hadhaan isaaniis ilma namaa kan ajjeesu miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, their bite can be quite painful, and can cause swelling, redness, and itching.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, ciniinnaan isaanii dhukkubbii, dhiita'uu, diimachuu fi hooksisa uumuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are excellent climbers, and can use their silk to create webs that can reach up to 30 feet in length.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also very fast runners, and can move at speeds of up to 10 miles per hour.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis fiigichaan baay'ee saffisu, sa'atii tokkotti hanga maayiliiwwan 10 fiiguu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Due to their size, speed, and climbing ability, giant wolf spiders are a popular choice for people who want to experience the thrill of riding a giant arachnid.
entries.translation: Sababa hanga, saffisaa fi dandeettii waa koruu isaanii irraa kan ka'e, namoota guluffii araaknidii guddaa dhandhamuu barbaadaniif sarariitiiwwan yeeyyii gurguddoon kun jaalatamoodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to remember that these creatures are wild animals, and should be treated with respect.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, uumamni kunniin bineeldota bosonaa ta'uu fi kabajaan eegamuu akka qaban hubachuun barbaachisaa dha.

entries.english: "I'm sorry, man.I know how you feel. Heartbreak sucks."
entries.translation: "Nan gadda, jaala ko. Miirri kee naaf gala. Gaddi nama jibbisiisa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It does. I don't know what to do."
entries.translation: "Eyyee. Maal gochuu akkan qabu hin beeku."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cry it out if you need to.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And then, when you're ready, start to move on.
entries.translation: Sana booda, yeroo qophooftutti immoo, jireenya haaraa eegali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are plenty of other fish in the sea."
entries.translation: Galaanicha keessa qurxummiiwwan biroo hedduun ni jiru."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know. But I don't know if I'm ready to date again yet."
entries.translation: "Nan beeka. Garuu irra deebiin beellama jaalaa hangan deebi'ee eegaluuf qophii ta'u hin beeku."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's okay. You don't have to be ready right away. Just take your time and heal."
entries.translation: "Kun hoomaa miti, Battalatti qophaa'uun sirraa hin eegamu. Yeroo fudhadhuu bayyaannadhu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
