entries.english: A: Do you think the dowry system is a good thing?
entries.translation: A: Sirni gabbara gaa'elaa gaariidha jettee yaaddaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I think it's a form of discrimination against women.
entries.translation: Kun bifa qooddaa dubartoota irra ga'udha jedheen yaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It puts an unfair financial burden on the bride's family, and it can lead to women being treated as commodities.
entries.translation: Maatii misirroo irra dhiibbaa dinagdee hin mallee geessisa, akkasumas dubartoonni akka meeshaatti akka ilaalaman taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: But some people say that the dowry system is a way to protect women.
entries.translation: A: Namoonni tokko tokko garuu sirni gabbaraa kun karaa ittiin dubartoota eeganidha jedhanii dubbatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I don't think that's true.
entries.translation: B: Kun dhugaadha jedhee hin yaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, I think it can put women in danger.
entries.translation: Dhugaatti, Dubartoota rakkoo irra buusa jedheen yaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If a woman's family can't afford to pay a dowry, she may be less likely to be able to find a husband.
entries.translation: Maatiin intalaa gabbara kana kaffaluu yoo hin dandeenye, carraan abbaa manaa argachuu ishee dhiphaa ta'uu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if she does get married, she may be more likely to be abused or mistreated by her husband.
entries.translation: Yoo heerumte illee, carraan abbaa manaa isheetiin haleelamuu ykn gidirfamuu ishee guddaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: So what do you think we should do about the dowry system?
entries.translation: A: Kanaafuu waa'ee sirna gabbaraa kana maal gochuu qabna jettee yaadda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I think we should work to abolish it.
entries.translation: B: Balleessuuf hojjechuu qabna jedheen yaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We should educate people about the harmful effects of the dowry system, and we should support laws that make it illegal to demand or accept a dowry.
entries.translation: Waa'ee miidhaa sirna gabbaraa kana uummata barsiisuu qabna, akkasumas seera gabbara kennuus ta'ee fudhachuu dhorku deggeruu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I agree. I think the dowry system is a relic of a bygone era.
entries.translation: A: Ittan waliif gala. Akkan yaadutti sirni gabbaaraa kun hambaa bakkeewwan darbaniiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have been living with type 1 diabetes for over 20 years.
entries.translation: Ani waggoota 20 oliif dhukkuba sukkaaraa gosa 1 jedhamu waliinan jiraachaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was diagnosed when I was just 10 years old, and it has been a lifelong journey.
entries.translation: Yeroo umuriin koo waggaa 10 jirun qoratamee of irratti arge, kunis deemsa jireenyaa dheeraa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There have been many challenges along the way, but I have also learned a lot about myself and what it means to be a strong, resilient person.
entries.translation: Karaa kana hunda keessatti gufuuwwan hedduutu ture, garuu waa'ee mataa kootii akkasumas nama cimaa fi cichoomina qabu jechuun maal akka ta'es nan baradhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest challenges I have faced is managing my blood sugar levels.
entries.translation: Gufuu guddaan ana mudate madaallii sadarkaa sukkaara dhiiga koo keessa jiru to'achuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Diabetes is a condition that affects the way your body turns food into energy.
entries.translation: Dhukkubni sukkaaraa rakkoo haala qaamni keenya soorata gara annisaatti jijjiiru miidhu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you eat, your body breaks down the carbohydrates in your food into glucose, which is then absorbed into your bloodstream.
entries.translation: Yeroo soorannu, qaamni keenya kaarboohaayidireetii soorata keessa jiru gara gilukoosiitti jijjiira, sana booda yaa'insa dhiiga keenyaatiin xuuxama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your pancreas releases insulin, a hormone that helps glucose get from your blood into your cells.
entries.translation: Paankiriyaan hormonii giluukoosii dhiiga keenya keessaa gara seelota keenyaatti geessu insuliinii jedhamu gadhiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In people with type 1 diabetes, the pancreas doesn't make enough insulin, or it doesn't make any at all.
entries.translation: Namoota dhukkuba sukkaaraa gosa 1 qaban keessatti, paankiriyaan isuliinii gahaa hin maddisiisu, ykn guutummaa guutuutti hin oomishu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that people with type 1 diabetes have to take insulin injections to help their bodies use glucose for energy.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun namoonni dhukkuba sukkaaraa gosa 1 qaban annisaadhaaf giluukoosii fayyadamuuf marfee insuliinii fudhachuu qabu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Managing my blood sugar levels can be a tricky business.
entries.translation: Sadarkaa sukkaara qaama kootii to'achuun hojii baay'ee waliin nama dhahudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a lot of factors that can affect my blood sugar, including what I eat, how much I exercise, and how much stress I am under.
entries.translation: Maal akkan sooradhu, sochii qaamaa hagamii akkan godhu, akkasumas cinqama hangamii jala akkan jiru dabalatee sababoonni sukkaara dhiiga koo keessa jiru miidhan hedduutu jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have to constantly monitor my blood sugar levels and make adjustments to my insulin doses as needed.
entries.translation: Akka barbaachisummaa isatti yeroo yeroodhaan sadarkaa sukkaara dhiiga koo keessa to'achuun dooziiwwan insuliinii koo irratti jijjiirama gochuun qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors dance on your tongue, creating a symphony of delight.
entries.translation: Mi'aan arraba kee irratti shubbisu, dhandhama gammachuus ni uumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pineapple is sweet and tart, the apple is crisp and juicy, the stone fruit is juicy and flavorful, and the pear is sweet and refreshing.
entries.translation: Anaanaasiin mi'aawaa fi qomoxxoxaadha, appiliin dhangala'aa fi cuunfaadha, istoon firuutiin cuunfaa fi mi'aawaadha, akkasumas piiriin immoo mi'awaa fi kan nama bashannansiisudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flavors are perfectly balanced, and each one complements the others.
entries.translation: Mi'aan sun sirriitti kan wal madaalanidha, inni tokko isa biroo cimsa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Makaan sun salphumatti kan namni diduu danda'u miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can enjoy this delicious fruit salad on its own, or as a topping for yogurt or ice cream.
entries.translation: Firii salaaxaa mi'awaa kana kophaa isaa, ykn aayis kireemii ykn itittuu kee irratti dabalachuun dhandhamuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a great addition to a summer picnic or potluck.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis akka miiltoo piiknikii gannaa ykn pootilaakiitti ni gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how you enjoy it, you are sure to love this fruit salad.
entries.translation: Hagam itti gammaddus, firii salaaxaa kana jaalachuun kee beekamaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Did you know that deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change?
entries.translation: A: Bosona ciruun sababoota jijjiirama qilleensaa warra hangafa keessaa tokko akka ta'e ni beektaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, when we cut down trees, we're not just destroying the trees themselves.
entries.translation: A:Tole, yeroo nuti muka murru, muka qofa balleessaa jirra miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're also destroying the habitats of countless animals and plants.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis lubbuu bineeldotaa fi bineensota daangaa hin qabnee balleessina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And when we lose these habitats, we also lose the benefits that they provide us.
entries.translation: Yeroo lubbuuwwan kunniin dhabnu, faayidaa isaan irraa argannu dhabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Well, for example, trees help to regulate the climate.
entries.translation: A: Tole, fakkeenyaaf, mukoonni haala qilleensaa tasgabbeessuuf gargaaru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen.
entries.translation: Kaarboondaay ooksaayidii qilleensa keessaa xuuxuun oksijiinii immoo qilleensa keessatti gadhiisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also help to prevent soil erosion and flooding.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis dhiqama biyyee fi lolaa ni ittisuuf ni gargaaru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And they provide food and shelter for animals.
entries.translation: Bineensotaaf immoo bakka jireenyaa fi soorata ni dhiheessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: So deforestation has a lot of negative effects.
entries.translation: B: Kanaafuu bosona mancaasuun miidhaalee hedduu qaqqabsiisa jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And it's a problem that's only getting worse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Every year, we lose millions of acres of forest to deforestation.
entries.translation: Waggaa waggaadhaan, sababa manca'iinsa bosonaa irraa kan ka'e bosona hektaara miiliyoonotaan lakka'amu dhabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if we don't do something to stop it, the consequences will be devastating.
entries.translation: Kana dhaabuuf waa hin hojjennu taanaan, miidhaan isaa baay'ee hammaataa ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: What can we do to stop it?
entries.translation: B: Kana dhaabuuf maal gochuu qabna?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: There are a number of things we can do.
entries.translation: A: Waantonni nuti hojjechuu dandeenyu hedduutu jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can reduce our demand for wood products.
entries.translation: Fedhii oomishaalee bu'aa mukaa keenya hir'isuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was fortunate to attend a school that offered a wide range of AP courses and extracurricular activities, which gave me the opportunity to explore my interests and learn about different career paths.
entries.translation: Mana barnootaa gosoota leenjii AP fi sochiiwwan kaarikulaara dabalataa bal'aa kennu, akkan fedhiiwwan kiyya bira ga'uu fi daandiiwwan hojii kan biroo ana barsiisetti barachuu koof carra qabeessan ta'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things I learned in high school was how to think critically and solve problems.
entries.translation: Waantota baay'ee barbaachisoo ani mana barumsaa ol'aanaatti baradhe tokko bal'isanii yaaduu fi akkaataa ittiin rakkoo furanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My AP English and math classes taught me how to analyze text and data, and my science classes taught me how to design and conduct experiments.
entries.translation: Dareewwan barnoota AP Ingiliffaa fi herregaa kiyya akkamiin akkan barreeffamaa fi daataa xiinxalu, dareewwan saayinsii immoo qorannoowwan akkamitti akkan saxaxuu fi geggeessu ana barsiisan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been essential in my college courses and my career as a software engineer.
entries.translation: Dandeettiiwwan kunniin kolleejjii koo fi hojii koo akka mandiisa moosaajii keessatti baay'ee barbaachisoodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important thing I learned in high school was how to work effectively with others.
entries.translation: Mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa keessatti waanti barbaachisaan ani baradhe kan biroon namoota biroo waliin akkamitti sirriitti hojjechuu akkan qabudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These skills have been invaluable in my career, where I often have to collaborate with others to solve complex problems.
entries.translation: Dandeettiiwwan kunniin hojii kiyya keessatti, rakkoowwan wal xaxoo ta'an furuuf kanneen biroo waliin tumsuun ala ga'ee biroo taphachaa hin turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, my high school experience helped me to develop a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
entries.translation: Xumura irratti, muuxannoon koo mana barnoota sadarkaa lammaffaa keessattii,duudhaa jabaatanii hojjechuu fi kaka'umsaa akkan guddifadhuuf ana gargaaree jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The challenging academic courses I took taught me the importance of hard work and perseverance, and the extracurricular activities I participated in taught me the value of teamwork and dedication.
entries.translation: Gosoonni barnootaa ulfaatoon ani baradhe faayidaa jabaatanii hojjechuu fi cichoominaa ana barsiisan, sochiiwwan kaarikuleemiin alaa immoo gatii hojii garee fi of kennuu ana barsiisan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These qualities have helped me to succeed in college and in my career.
entries.translation: Dandeettiiwwan kunniin kolleejjii fi hojii kiyya keessatti akkan milkaa'uuf ana gargaaranii jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am grateful for the opportunity to have attended a high school that provided me with such a strong educational foundation.
entries.translation: Carraa mana barnoota sadarkaa lammaffaatti seenuun hundee barnoota cimaa akkasii barachuu anaaf kenname kanaaf baay'een galateeffadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I believe that the skills and knowledge I gained in high school have helped me to become a successful college student and a professional.
entries.translation: Dandeettiiwwan ani mana barumsa sadarkaa lammaaffaatti argadhe barataa kolleejjii fi hojjetaa milka'aa akkan ta'uuf ana gargaaree jira jedheen amana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is a craft that involves making objects out of clay.
entries.translation: Suphee dha'uun ogummaa suphee irraa meeshaalee hojjechuu dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pottery is often used for utilitarian purposes, such as storing food or water, but it can also be used for decorative purposes.
entries.translation: Supheen yeroo baay'ee tajaajila manaa kanneen akka kuusaa nyaataa fi bishaaniif fayyada, garuu tajaajila faayaatiifis ni gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of making pottery begins with gathering clay.
entries.translation: Adeemsi suphee dhahuu suphee walitti qabuu irraa eegala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Clay is a natural material that is found in the ground.
entries.translation: Supheen meeshaa uumamaa lafa keessatti argamudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay has been gathered, it is mixed with water and kneaded until it is soft and pliable.
entries.translation: Erga supheen walitti qabamee booda, bishaaniin jiifamee hanga lallaafee maramuu danda'utti bukeeffama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The potter then uses a variety of tools to shape the clay into the desired form.
entries.translation: Sana booda suphe dhooftuun sun meeshaalee adda addaa fayyadamuun suphicha gara boca barbaadeetti sirreessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the clay is shaped, it is dried and fired in a kiln.
entries.translation: Suphichi erga bocameen booda gogfamuun boolla keessatti gubama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are a common occurrence in many parts of the world, and they can have a significant impact on our lives.
entries.translation: Roobni obomboleettii makate kutaawwan addunyaa hedduu keessatti kan baratame yoo ta'u, jireenya keenya irratti dhiibbaa ol'aanaa geessisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can bring much-needed water to parched land, but they can also cause flooding, mudslides, and other damage.
entries.translation: Lafa gogeef bishaan gahaa fiduu danda'u, garuu lolaa, sigigaachuu dhoqqee, fi miidhaawwan kan biroos fiduu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms are caused by the rising of warm air, which causes water vapor to condense and form clouds.
entries.translation: Roobni obomboleettii makate dabaluu qilleensa ho'aa, kan hurki bishaanii walitti qabamuun duumessa akka ta'u godhu dabaluu irraa dhufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the water droplets in the clouds become too heavy, they fall as rain.
entries.translation: Yeroo cophni bishaanota duumessa keessa jiranii ulfaatan, bifa roobaatiin gad dhangala'uu eegalu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The amount of rain that falls in a rainstorm is measured in inches.
entries.translation: Hangi bokkaa rooba obomboleettiin makame keessatti roobu iinchiidhaan safarama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A light rainstorm might produce only a few inches of rain, while a heavy rainstorm can produce over a foot of rain.
entries.translation: Roobni obomboleettiin makame salphaan rooba iinchiiwwan muraasa qofa rooba, roobni obomboleettiin makame guddaan garuu rooba hanga faana tokkoo ol ta'u rooba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can have a variety of effects on our lives.
entries.translation: Roobni obomboleettii makatan jireenya keenya irratti dhiibbaawwan adda addaa ni qabaatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can wash away dirt and debris, making roads and sidewalks impassable.
entries.translation: Xura'aa fi hafteewwan dhiqee deema, daandiiwwan immoo ni cufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also cause power outages and flooding.
entries.translation: Adda ciccituu humna ibsaa fi lolaa uumuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Flooding can be especially dangerous, as it can quickly sweep away people and property.
entries.translation: Keessumaa immoo lolaan baay'ee balaafamaadha, namaa fi qabeenya battalatti haree balleessuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the potential dangers, rainstorms can also be beneficial.
entries.translation: Balaan jiru akkuma jirutti ta'ee, roobni obomboleettiin makame kun bu'aa illee ni qabaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can help to improve soil quality and water the plants.
entries.translation: Qulqullina biyyee ni dabalu biqilootas bishaan ni obaasu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rainstorms can also be a source of entertainment, as people enjoy watching the rain and listening to the thunder.
entries.translation: Roobni obomboleettii makate, sababa namoonni rooba ilaalaa qaqawweessa dhaggeeffachuutti bohaaraniif madda bashannanaas ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eyes are complex organs that allow us to see.
entries.translation: Iji qaamota wal xaxoo arguuf nu fayyadanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are located in the front of the head and are protected by the eyelids.
entries.translation: Kunis fuul-dura mataatti kan argamanii fi qoochoo ijaatiin eegamanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each eye is made up of three layers: the sclera, the choroid, and the retina.
entries.translation: Tokko tokkoon ija sanaa baqqaanota sadii, iskeleeraa, korooyidii, fi reetinaa jedhaman irraa ijaaraman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sclera is the white part of the eye, the choroid is the dark layer behind the sclera, and the retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
entries.translation: Iskeleeraan kutaa ijaa isa adii yoo ta'u, korooyidiin baqqaana dukkana'aa iskeleeraa boodatti argamu, akkasumas reetinaan baqqaana ifa-sodaatu dudduuba ijaatti argamudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The retina contains millions of light-sensitive cells called rods and cones.
entries.translation: Reetinaan seelota ifa-sodaatan miiliyoonotaan lakka'aman roodii fi koonota jedhaman qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rods are responsible for night vision, while cones are responsible for color vision.
entries.translation: Roodonni ifa halkanii arguuf gargaaru, koononni immoo halluuwwan arguuf gargaaru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When light hits the retina, it is converted into electrical signals that are sent to the brain via the optic nerve.
entries.translation: Yeroo ifti reetinaa xuqu, mallattoolee elektirikaa karaa nerviiwwan agartuutiin gara sammuutti ergamanitti jijjiirama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My family has always kept animals.
entries.translation: Maatiin kiyya yeroo hundumaa bineeldota eegu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was a child, we had a dog, a cat, and a few fish.
entries.translation: Yeroo ani daa'ima turetti, saree, adurree fi qurxummiilee muraasa qabna ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I got older, we added a few more animals to the mix, including a rabbit, a guinea pig, and a hamster.
entries.translation: Akkuma ani guddataa deemeen, illeettii, booyyeewwan giinii fi haamisterii dabalatee bineensota muraasa gara qabiyyeetti daballe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I loved taking care of all of our animals and learning about their different needs.
entries.translation: Bineeldota keenya hundumaa kunuunsuu fi waa'ee fedhii isaanii adda addaa sana beekuu nan jaaladhan ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite animals that we ever kept was a rabbit named Cocoa.
entries.translation: Bineeldota horanne hunda keessaa kan ani baay'ee jaaladhu illeettii Kaakawoo jedhamtu tokkodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cocoa was a brown and white Holland Lop rabbit.
entries.translation: Kaakawoon illeettii booraa fi adii Hoolaandi Looppidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was the sweetest animal I've ever met and she loved to be cuddled.
entries.translation: Isheen bineeldota ani arge hunda keessaa hedduu kan namatti toltuu fi hammatamuu kan jaalattu turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was also very smart and could learn tricks like sit, stay, and come.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis baay'ee qaruuxee fi tooftaawwan akka taayuu, ciisuu fi kottu jedhu hunda baruu dandeessedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was playing with Cocoa in the backyard when I noticed that she was chewing on something.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko, ani dudduuba manaa Kaakawoo waliin taphadhuun ture kan ani waa alanfachuu ishee hubadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I went over to investigate and saw that she was chewing on a piece of fiber from one of our clothes.
entries.translation: Anis uffata keenya keessaa faayiberii tokko irratti maal akka isheen alanfataa jirtu qorachuufin garas deeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took the fiber away from her and showed it to my mom.
entries.translation: Anis faayiberii sana ishee irraa fuudheen harmee kiyyatti agarsiise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My mom explained that rabbits need to eat fiber in order to digest their food properly.
entries.translation: Harmeenis illeettiin sooranni nyaatte akka daakamuuf faayiberii nyaachuu akka qabdu na hubachiiste.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She said that we should give Cocoa some hay to eat, which is a good source of fiber.
entries.translation: Isheenis madda faayiberii gaarii kan ta'e dirqoosha akka nyaattuuf Kaakawoof kennuu qabna naan jette.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I gave Cocoa some hay and she loved it!
entries.translation: Anis dirqoosha muraasa Kaakawoof nan kenne isheenis ni jaalatte!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: An earthquake is a sudden and violent shaking of the Earth's crust that can cause great damage.
entries.translation: Kirkirri lafaa hurgufamuu baqqaana lafaa isa gara olii hookkara qabuu fi battalatti uumamuu fi miidhaa guddaa qaqqabsiisuu danda'udha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common cause of earthquakes is the movement of tectonic plates, which are large pieces of the Earth's crust that ride on top of the molten rock beneath the surface.
entries.translation: Sababni uumamuu kirkira lafaa inni guddaan sochii geengoowwan tektoonikii, kanneen qabiyyee guddaa irra Lafaa ta'anii fi mataa dhagaawwan baqanii kan dachee gad jiraniitti argamudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these plates move past or collide with each other, they can cause the Earth's crust to break and produce seismic waves.
entries.translation: Yeroo geengoowwan kunneen socho'anii wal bira taran ykn walitti rukkutaman, irra keessoon lafaa caccabuun dambaliiwwan hunkurama lafaa akka uuman taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These waves travel through the Earth and can cause the ground to shake.
entries.translation: Dambaliiwwan kunniin lafa keessa deemuun akka lafti hol'atu taasisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The magnitude of an earthquake is measured on the Richter scale, which ranges from 0 to 9.
entries.translation: Hangi kirkira lafaa kun Riicher iskeelii, 0 hanga 9 gidduu jiruun safarama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The higher the magnitude, the more powerful the earthquake.
entries.translation: Hangi yoo guddate, kirkirri lafichaas guddaadha jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can cause damage in a variety of ways, including ground shaking, landslides, tsunamis, building collapses, fires, and loss of life.
entries.translation: Kirkirri lafaa, hol'annaa lafaa, sigigaachuu lafaa, suunaamii, kufaatii ijaarsawwanii, ibiddaa fi lubbuu balleessuu dabalatee balaawwan karaa hedduu qaqqabsiisuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earthquakes can also trigger other hazards, such as avalanches.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis kirkirri lafaa balaawwan akka kuufama cabbii kakaasuuf sababa ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The damage caused by an earthquake depends on a number of factors, including the magnitude of the earthquake, the distance from the epicenter, the type of soil, and the construction of buildings.
entries.translation: Miidhaan kirkira lafaan uumamu, hanga kirkira lafichaa, fageenya eeppiiseenterii irraa qabu, gosa biyyee, fi ijaarsa gamoowwanii fa'a dabalatee sababoota hedduu irratti hunda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have no idea how the real world works, and you think that everything should be handed to you on a silver platter.
entries.translation: Jiruun addunyaa maal akka ta'e hin beektu, waan hundinuu gabatema irratti akka siif kennamuu qabutti yaadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're always complaining about something, and you never seem to be happy with anything.
entries.translation: Yeroo hunda waa komachuu jaalatta, guyyaama tokkollee waan tokkotti gammadaa fakkaattee hin beektu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're a bunch of entitled brats, and I'm sick of it.
entries.translation: Ati mataa qananiiwwaniiti, kun immoo ana jibbisiiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world doesn't owe you anything.
entries.translation: Addunyaan kun abbaa idaa kee miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have to work hard to get what you want.
entries.translation: Waan barbaaddu argachuuf jabaattee hojjechuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There's no such thing as a free lunch.
entries.translation: Waanti tola taayanii nyaatan hin jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want something, you have to go out and earn it.
entries.translation: Waan tokko yoo barbaadde, ala baatee argachuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not going to get you anywhere.
entries.translation: Kun essaan iyyuu si hin ga'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have a problem, then solve it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't just sit around and cry about it.
entries.translation: Callistee teessee waa'ee isaa hin booyiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's time to start acting like adults.
entries.translation: Akka ga'eessaatti jiraachuu yeroo itti eegaltudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm tired of dealing with your childish behavior.
entries.translation: Amala daa'imaa kee kana waliin dhiphachuun ana nuffisiiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you don't start acting like adults, then I'm going to have to cut you out of my life.
entries.translation: Akka ga'eessaatti jiraachuu hin eegaltu taanaan, jireenya koo keessaa si baasuufan deema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I don't have time for your nonsense.
entries.translation: Kachachala kee kanaaf yeroo hin qabu ani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grow up and start acting like adults, or I'm out of here.
entries.translation: Guddadhuu akka ga'eessaatti jiraachuu eegali, ykn ani asiin ba'ee deema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was recently cleaning out my attic when I came across a box of old recipes that had been passed down from my grandmother.
entries.translation: Tibba kana osoon kutaa qassoo koo qulqulleessuu sanduuqa yaadannoo qophiilee nyaata durii akkoo kiyya irraa nutti darben arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: New Study Finds That Breast Cancer Screenings Can Lead to False Positives

entries.english: A new study published in the journal JAMA Internal Medicine has found that breast cancer screenings can lead to false positives.
entries.translation: Qorannoon haaraan barruu JAMA Fayyaa Keessoo irratti maxxanfame qorannoowwan kaanserii harmaa poozetiivii sobaatti geessuu akka danda'an ifoomse.

entries.english: The study, which was conducted by researchers at the University of California, San Francisco, found that one in five women who underwent a mammogram had a false positive result.
entries.translation: Qorannoon, qorattoota Yuuniversiitii Kaalifoorniyaa, Saan Firaansiiskootiin godhame kun, dubartoota shan maamoogiraamii taasisan keessaa tokko bu'aa poozetiivii sobaa akka qaban mul'ise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A false positive result is when a mammogram shows that a woman has breast cancer, when she actually does not.
entries.translation: Bu'aa poozetiivii sobaa jechuun yeroo maamogiraamiin dubartiin qoratamte sun osoo kaanserii harmaa hin qabaatiin, kaanserii qabdi jedhee agarsiisudha.

entries.english: This can lead to unnecessary anxiety and stress, as well as unnecessary medical procedures, such as biopsies.

entries.english: The study found that the rate of false positives was higher among women who were younger, had dense breasts, and had a family history of breast cancer.

entries.english: The researchers say that these findings are important because they highlight the need for women to understand the risks and benefits of breast cancer screening before they decide whether or not to undergo a mammogram.

entries.english: The study also found that the use of sound waves, known as ultrasound, to screen for breast cancer can help to reduce the number of false positives.

entries.english: However, as computers became smaller and more affordable, they began to be used in a wider variety of applications.

entries.english: This led to a blurring of the lines between computers and electronics.

entries.english: One of the most significant developments in the history of computers and electronics was the invention of the personal computer (PC).

entries.english: The PC was first introduced in the 1970s, and it quickly became a popular tool for both personal and business use.

entries.english: PCs were originally designed for use in homes and offices, but they soon found their way into other settings, such as schools and libraries.

entries.english: The PC's portability and versatility made it an ideal tool for a wide range of tasks, from word processing to gaming.

entries.english: Freedom of the press is the freedom of communication and expression through mediums including printed media and the internet.
entries.translation: Bilisummaa pireesii jechuun karaawwan akka miidiyaalee maxxansaa fi interneetaa fayyadamuun bilisummaa qunnamtii fi yaada ofii ibsachuu jechuudha.

entries.english: It is a fundamental human right recognized by Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and reaffirmed in Article 19 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
entries.translation: Kunis mirga namoomaa isa bu'uraa ta'uun Labsii Mirgoota Namoomaa Waliigalaa keewwata 19 jalatti tumamee fi Kakuu Mirgoota Siivilii fi Siyaasaa Idil-addunyaa keewwata 19 jalatti irra deebiin mirkanaa'edha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The right to freedom of expression is recognized as a necessary precondition for the enjoyment of all other human rights.

entries.english: It allows citizens to access information and to hold their government accountable.

entries.translation: Miidhaan walii galaa sirni qonnaa addunyaa baay'ee wal xaxaa fi tilmaamamummaan isaa hir'achuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most direct effects of climate change on agriculture is the increase in the frequency and severity of extreme weather events.
entries.translation: Miidhaan kallattii jijjiiramni qilleensaa qonna irratti qabu inni tokko hangii fi hammaannaan taateewwan haala qilleensaa badaan dabaluu isaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat waves, droughts, floods, and storms can all damage crops and livestock, and make it difficult for farmers to get their crops to market.
entries.translation: Dambaliiwwan ho'aa, gogiinsi, lolaan, akkasumas roobni obomboleettii makate hundinuu dhangaa fi lubbuu horii ni miidhu, qote bulaan oomisha isaa gabaatti akka hin geessine illee ni taasisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, these events can cause entire crop yields to be lost, leading to food shortages and price increases.
entries.translation: Haalota muraasa keessatti, oomishni midhaanii guutummaatti akka badu gochuun, hanqina midhaan nyaataa fi daballii gatii midhaaniitti geessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to extreme weather events, climate change is also leading to changes in the average temperature and precipitation patterns.
entries.translation: Taateewwan haala qilleensaatti dabaluun, jijjiiramni qilleensaa jijjiirama hanga ho'aa fi amalaa fi haala roobaas fidee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These changes are making it more difficult to grow some crops in certain areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
entries.translation: Jijjiiramoonni kunniin naannolee muraasa keessatti guddina dhangaa kan daangessu yoo ta'u, naannolee birootti immoo carraawwan qonnaa haaraa bana jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was driving home from work one day when I got cut off by another driver.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko osoon bakka hojiitii gara manaatti konkolaachisaa jiruu konkolaachiaa kan biroon daandii anatti cufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so angry that I started tailgating him and flashing my lights.
entries.translation: Baay'ee waanan itti aaree tureef isa hordofuun ibsaawwan kiyya itti ibsuun eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He just kept driving slower and slower, and I was getting more and more frustrated.
entries.translation: Innis suutuma suuta konkolaachisuu itti fufe, ani immoo caalaadhumatti ittuu ana aarse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, I couldn't take it anymore.
entries.translation: Dhuma irratti, kana caalaa obsuu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I pulled up next to him and started yelling at him.
entries.translation: Dudduuba isaa dhaabeen isatti iyuu eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He rolled down his window and started yelling back at me.
entries.translation: Innis foddaa isaa gad buusuun deebisee anatti iyyuu eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both so angry that we were shaking.
entries.translation: Nuti lamaan iyyuu baay'ee waan aarreef qaamni nu hollachaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other driver pulled over to the side of the road, and I followed him.
entries.translation: Konkolaachisaan kan biroon immoo daandii bukee karaa gama konkolaachisaa isaa dhaabe, anis isa hordofuun eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We got out of our cars and started yelling at each other even louder.
entries.translation: Nutis konkolaataa keessaa buunee sagalee keenya ol kaasnee walitti iyyuu eegalle.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so close to hitting him that I could smell his breath.
entries.translation: Hangan hafuura isaa fuunfachuu danda'utti isa dhahuuf baay'een itti dhihaadhee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when I thought it couldn't get any worse, a police car pulled up.
entries.translation: Kana caalaa hammaachuu hin danda'u jedhee battala ani yaadetti, konkolaataan poolisii dhufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The officer got out of his car and asked us what was going on.
entries.translation: Qondaalli poolisichaa konkolaataa keessaa ba'uun maaltu ta'aa akka jiru nu gaafate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both told him our sides of the story, and he started writing us a ticket.
entries.translation: Nuti lamaanis seenaa gama keenyaan jiru itti himne, inni immoo tikeetii nuuf barreessuu eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I was walking back to my car, I realized that I had learned my lesson.
entries.translation: Akkuma ani gara konkolaataa kootti deemuu eegaleen, barnoota akkan argadhen hubadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Road rage is never worth it.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not worth getting angry over, and it's not worth getting a ticket.
entries.translation: Aaruun, akkasumas tikeetii argachuunis hin barbaachisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful river that flowed through a lush forest.
entries.translation: Dur dur, bishaan bareedaa bosona jiidhaa keessa yaa'u tokkotu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The river was home to many creatures, including fish, frogs, turtles, and birds.
entries.translation: Bishaanichis, qurxummiilee, raachawwan, qocaa bishaanii, fi simbirroota dabalatee lubbu qabeeyyii hedduuf mana ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The river was also a popular spot for humans to swim, fish, and relax.
entries.translation: Bishaanichi immoo bishaan daakuu, qurxummii qabuu, fi bashannanaaf iddoo namoonni baay'ee jaalatanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young girl named Lily was playing near the river when she saw a turtle caught in a fishing net.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko, intalli xiqqoon Liillii jedhamtu qarqara bishaanii sana osoo taphattuu qocaa saaphana qurxummiin qabamte tokko argite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily knew that she had to help the turtle, so she ran home to get her father.
entries.translation: Liilliinis ishee gargaaruuf murteessite, sana booda abbaa isheetti himuuf jecha gara manaatti fiigde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily's father helped her to free the turtle, and the two of them returned to the river.
entries.translation: Abbaan Liiliis qocaa sana gargaaree bilisa baase, sana booda lachuu isaanii gara bishaaniitti deebi'an.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The turtle thanked Lily for saving her life, and Lily promised to always be kind to animals.
entries.translation: Qocaan sunis luubbuu ishee waan oolchiteef Liilii galateeffatte, Liiliinis yeroo hundumaa bineensotatti gaarummaa agarsiisuuf waadaa seente.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily continued to visit the river often, and she always made sure to look out for any animals that might be in danger.
entries.translation: Liiliinis irra deddeebiin bishaanicha daawwachuu itti fufte, bineensonni balaa keessa akka hin seennes yeroo hunda ni mirkaneeffatti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Lily saw a group of boys throwing rocks at the fish in the river.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko, Liiliin ijoollee dhiiraa qurxummii bishaan keessaatti dhagaa darbatan argite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily knew that she had to stop them, so she ran up to the boys and told them that what they were doing was wrong.
entries.translation: Liiliinis isaan dhaabuu akka qabdu hubatte, kanaafuu gara ijoollee dhiiraa sanatti fiigdee waan isaan hojjechaa jiran dogoggora akka ta'e isaan hubachiifte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boys were surprised to hear this from Lily, but they listened to her and stopped throwing rocks.
entries.translation: Ijoolleen dhiiraa sunis waan sana Liillii irraa dhagahuu isaaniitti baay'ee raajeffatan, garuu waan isheen jette dhagahanii dhagaa darbachuu sana dhaaban.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What is the meaning of becoming a queen?" asked the young woman.
entries.translation: "Hiikaan giiftii ta'uu maalii?" dubartii dargaggeettii tokkotu gaafate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It is to learn to accommodate all that is," said the old woman.
entries.translation: "Waan jiru hunda danda'anii keessumsiisuu barachuudha," jettee deebiste jaartiin tokko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "To hold in your heart the beauty and the pain, the joy and the sorrow, the light and the darkness.To see the world as it is, and to love it nonetheless."
entries.translation: "Miidhamas ta'ee miidhaga, gammachuu fi gadda, ifaa fi dukkana laphee kee keessatti qabachuu. Akkuma inni jirutti addunyaa ilaaluu,waan fedhes ta'u immoo jaalachuu danda'uudha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But how can I do that?" asked the young woman. "The world is so full of suffering."
entries.translation: "Garuu akkamittan kana gochuu danda'aa?" jettee gaafatte dubartii dargaggeettiin. "Addunyaan miidhamaan guutuudha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, it is," said the old woman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But it is also full of beauty. And it is our task to find the beauty in the suffering, and to let it transform us.
entries.translation: "Garuu miidhaginaanis guutuudha. miidhama sana keessaa miidhagina barbaaduu, fi akka inni nu jijjiiru heyyamuun immoo ga'ee keenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "When you become a queen, you will have power.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But power is not a thing to be used for your own gain.
entries.translation: Aangoon garuu meeshaa ati fedhii dhuunfaa keetiif itti fayyadamtu miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a responsibility to be used for the good of others.
entries.translation: Itti gaafatamummaa ati fedhii namoota birootiif jecha baattudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You must learn to use your power to heal the world, not to harm it.
entries.translation: Aangoo kee fayyadamtee akkaataa itti addunyaa suphitu baruu qabda malee akkaataa ittiin miitu ta'uu hin qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You must also learn to be humble.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A queen is not above others, but she is also not below them."
entries.translation: "Giiftiin namoota biroon ol miti, isaanii gadis miti."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fielding side tries to prevent this by stopping the ball with their own bats, with their hands or with the wicket itself and then throwing the ball back to the bowler.
entries.translation: Gareen dirree jiru baatii isaanii, harka isaanii ykn wiiketii matuma isaa fayyadamuun kana dhaabuu yaalu, sana booda immoo kubbicha deebisanii gara darbattuu ykn boowuleriitti darbatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cricket is a game that requires a lot of skill and practice.
entries.translation: Kiriiketiin tapha dandeettii fi shaakala hedduu barbaadudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be a very rewarding game, but it also takes a lot of hard work.
entries.translation: Tapha gatii gaarii namaaf deebisudha, garuu immoo jabaatanii hojjechuu gaafata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you want to be a good cricketer, you need to be honest with yourself about your abilities and be willing to put in the time and effort to train.
entries.translation: Taphataa kirikeetii gameessa ta'uu yoo barbaadde, waa'ee dandeettii keetii fi yeroo fi humna kee shaakalliif kennuu ilaalchisee mataa kee waliin ifa ta'uu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vegetarian cuisine encompasses a wide variety of dishes and ingredients that are prepared without the use of meat, poultry, or fish.
entries.translation: Gosoonni nyaataa foonii fi bu'aalee isaa irraa bilisaa nyaataa fi qabiyyeewwan hedduu kanneen foon, lukkuu ykn qurxummii of keessaa hin qabne irraa qophaa'an qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While some vegetarians avoid all animal products, including dairy and eggs, others may consume dairy or eggs but not meat.
entries.translation: Namoonni foonii fi bu'aa isaa hin sooranne tokko tokko bu'aalee aannanii fi killee dabalatee, bu'aalee bineeldotaa hunda kan hin nyaanne yoo ta'an, kanneen biroon immoo fooniin ala aannanii fi killee ni sooratu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vegetarian food can be just as delicious and satisfying as meat-based dishes, and there are a number of ways to incorporate plant-based proteins into your diet.
entries.translation: Sooranni foon-maleeyyiin kunniin akkuma kanneen foon-qabeeyyii sanatti miyaa'oo fi kan namatti tolan ta'uu danda'u, karaaleen ittiin pirootinii biqiloota irraa argaman soorata keenyatti idaanu hedduutu jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some popular vegetarian proteins include beans, lentils, tofu, tempeh, and seitan.
entries.translation: Pirootiniiwwan biqilootaa warri beekamoon baaqelaa, leentilii, toofuu, teempee, fi seeyitaan fa'a dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also a number of meat substitutes available on the market, such as veggie burgers, chicken nuggets, and soy-based hot dogs.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis kanneen akka bargeriiwwan biqilootaa, naagetiiwwan lukkuu, akkasumas hoot doogiiwwan sooyii fa'a dabalatee bakka buutonni foonii hedduu ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're new to vegetarian cooking, there are a number of resources available to help you get started.
entries.translation: Nyaata foon-maleessa bilcheessuuf haaraa yoo taatan, jalqabuuf kan isin gargaaran leecalloowwan hedduutu jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are cookbooks, websites, and blogs dedicated to vegetarian cuisine, and there are also a number of cooking classes available.
entries.translation: Kitaabilee soorata qopheessuu, marsaaratiiwwan, akkasumas xiinxalawwan soorata foon-maleeyyii, dabalataanis dareewwan barnootaa nyaata qopheessuu hedduun ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little creativity and experimentation, you can easily create delicious and satisfying vegetarian meals for yourself and your family.
entries.translation: Kalaqaa fi yaalii xiqqoodhaan, mataa fi maatii keessaniif salphumatti nyaata foon-maleeyyii miyaa'oo fi gaggaarii hojjechuu dandeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a large bowl, combine the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
entries.translation: Sa'anii guddaa keessatti, zayita, vaayingaarii, ashaboo fi qeexoo walitti makaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Add the chicken and toss to coat.
entries.translation: Sana booda lukkuu fi toosii kootiitti ida'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to overnight.
entries.translation: Haguuguun yoo xiqqaate daqiiqaa 30f, ykn immoo halkan guutuu qabbaneessituu keessa godhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
entries.translation: Jalqaba hanga digirii Faaranaayitii 400 (digiriiwwan C 200) tti dursuun oovenii keessan ho'isaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Place the chicken on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
entries.translation: Lukkuu sana daqiiqaawwan 20-25tti tolchituu irra godhaa, ykn hanga inni sirriitti bilchaatutti keessa godhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some variations on this recipe:
entries.translation: Nyaaticha ilaalchisee garaa garummaawwan jiran akka armaan gadiitti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Marinate the chicken in a mixture of olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and herbs.
entries.translation: * Lukkuu sana makaa dhadhaa ejersaa, cuunfaa loomii, qullubbii adii, fi baalota jiruti makaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Add some chopped vegetables to the marinade, such as red onion, bell pepper, or zucchini.
entries.translation: * Kuduraalee mummuramoo kanneen akka qullubbii adii, qeexoo, ykn zikkunnii itti ida'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Serve the chicken with a side of rice, quinoa, or salad.

entries.english: Rental cars are a convenient way to get around when visiting a new city or country.
entries.translation: Yeroo biyya ykn magaalaa haaraa daawwattutti konkolaataawwan kiraa mala bayeessa ittiin naannoftudha.

entries.english: They offer the flexibility to explore at your own pace and can be a more affordable option than public transportation.

entries.english: When renting a car, it is important to compare prices from different companies and to read the fine print of the rental agreement carefully.
entries.translation: Yeroo konkolaataa kireffannutti, gatii dhaabbatoota adda addaa wal madaalchisuu fi boosaajii walii galtee kiraa sana sirriitti dubbisuun baay'ee barbaachisaadha.

entries.english: Be sure to ask about any additional fees, such as fuel charges, insurance, or tolls.
entries.translation: Waa'ee kaffaltiiwwan dabalataa, kanneen akka kaffaltiiwwan boba'aa, inshuraansii, ykn kaffaltiiwwanii gaafachuu hin dagatiin.

entries.english: It is also a good idea to take pictures of the car before you drive it away, so that you have proof of its condition in case of any damage.
entries.translation: Konkolaaticha ooftee deemuu keen dura suura kaafachuunis yaada gaariidha, miidhaan kam iyyuu yoo qaqqabe haala konkolaatichi dura irra tureef ragaa siif ta'a waan ta'eef.

entries.english: If you are planning to rent a car for an extended period of time, you may be able to get a better deal by purchasing a rental car package.
entries.translation: Konkolaaticha yeroo dabalataaf kireeffachuu karoorsite taanaan, paakejii konkolaataa kiraa bituudhaan caalaatti fayyadamuu dandeessa.

entries.english: These packages typically include a set number of days of rental, as well as unlimited mileage and other extras.
entries.translation: Paakejiiwwan kunniin guyyoota kiraaan sun turu akkasumas maayileejiiwwan daangaa hin qabnee fi dabalata kan biroo of keessatti qabatu.

entries.english: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.

entries.english: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.

entries.english: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.

entries.english: You should also take pictures of the car before you drive it away.

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs are a group of 23 Anglican and 22 Roman Catholic Christians who were killed between 1885 and 1887.
entries.translation: Wareegamtoonni Ugaandaa garee Kiristiyaanota Angilikaanii 23 fi Kaatolikii Roomaa 22 of keessaa qabu bara 1885 hanga 1887 gidduutti ajjeefamanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were killed by the king of Buganda, Mwanga II, for refusing to renounce their faith.
entries.translation: Isaan sababa amantii isaanii ganuu didaniif jecha, mootii Bugaandaa, Mwaangaa II n ajjeefaman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The martyrs were canonized by Pope Paul VI in 1964.

entries.english: They are considered to be among the most important figures in the history of Christianity in Uganda.

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs' Day is celebrated on June 3rd every year.

entries.english: It is a national holiday in Uganda and is observed by Christians all over the world.

entries.english: The martyrs are remembered for their courage and their willingness to die for their faith.

entries.english: In the upcoming months, I will be honored to receive an award for my work in the field of French language studies.
entries.translation: Ji'oota dhufan keessatti, hojiin muummee barnoota Afaan Faransaay keessatti godheef badhaasa nan fudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The award will be presented by the Société Française de Linguistique, a prestigious organization dedicated to the advancement of French language and linguistics.
entries.translation: Badhaasni sunis Société Française de Linguistique, dhaabbata baay'ee qaalii kan guddina afaanii fi looga Faransaayii guddisuuf dhaabbateen kennama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am humbled and grateful to be recognized by such a distinguished organization, and I look forward to continuing my work in French language studies.
entries.translation: Anis dhaabbata baay'ee qaalii ta'e akkasii kanaan filamuu kootiif gammachuu fi kabajatu natti dhagahama, kanaafuu hojiin barnoota Afaan Faransaay keessatti jalqabe ittan fufa.

entries.english: My research interests lie in the area of historical linguistics, and I have focused my work on the development of French from its origins in the Gallo-Romance dialects of the early Middle Ages.
entries.translation: Qorannoon koo muummeewwan akka afaanota seena qabeenyyii irratti fuulleffata, ani immoo guddina Afaan Faransaay hundee isaa loqoda Gallo-Roomaansii Baroota Giddu galeessaa gara jalqabaa irraa dhufe irrattin xiyyeeffadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am particularly interested in the ways in which French has been influenced by other languages, such as Latin, Germanic languages, and Arabic.
entries.translation: Keessumaa immoo Afaan Faransay akkamitti afaanota akka Laatiin, Jarman, fi Afaan Arabaa irraa dhiibbaan irra gahe irrattin xiyyeeffadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research has been published in leading journals in the field of linguistics, and I have presented my work at conferences around the world.
entries.translation: Qorannoon koo barruulee muummee afaaniin beekamoo ta'an irratti maxxanfamaa ture, anis hojii koo yaa'iiwwan idil-addunyaa hedduu irratti dhiheesseen jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am based at a university located near the French border, and I have had the opportunity to collaborate with scholars from France and other Francophone countries.
entries.translation: Ani yuuniversiitii naannoo daangaa Faransaay jiru keessan maandheeffadhe, kanaafuu carraa hayyoota Faransaayii fi biyyoota Firaankoofoon irraa dhufan waliin hojjechuuf carraa argadheen jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research has made a significant contribution to the field of French language studies, and I am proud to have been recognized for my work.
