entries.translation: Inistaagiraamii irratti hordooftota miiliyoona 200 ol qabaachuun, Kaardaashiyaan induustirii faashinii, miidhaginaa fi haala jireenyaa keessatti humna jabduudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She has also used her platform to speak out about social issues, such as criminal justice reform and women's rights.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis pilaatfoormii ishee fayyadamuun waa'ee dhimmoota hawaasummaa, kanneen akka mirga dubartootaa fi rifoormii sirna haqa yakkaa dubbatti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there is a dark side to the world of social media influencers.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, dhiibba uumtonni miidiyaa hawaasaa kun roga dukkanaas ni qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some influencers are paid by foreign governments to spread propaganda and disinformation.
entries.translation: Dhiibba uumtonni muraasni odeeffannoowwan sobaa fi olola akka oofaniif mootummoota alaatiin kaffalamaaf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is a serious problem, as it can greatly influence public opinion and undermine democracy.
entries.translation: Kun, yaada uummataa irra waan dhiibbaa geessisuu fi dimokiraasii tuffachuu waan danda'uuf rakkoo jabaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2016, it was revealed that Russian trolls used social media to spread propaganda and disinformation during the US presidential election.
entries.translation: Bara 2016 keessa, jabdoonni Raashiyaa yeroo filannoo pirezidaantummaa US tti odeeffannoo sobaa fi olola facaasuuf miidiyaa hawaasummaa fayyadaman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The trolls created fake accounts and used them to post pro-Trump messages and anti-Hillary Clinton messages.
entries.translation: Jarreen kunis enyummeessawwan sobaa banachuun ergaawwan Tiraampiin deggeranii fi Hilaarii Kiliinten balaaleffatan facaasan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This had a significant impact on the election, as it helped to sway public opinion in favor of Trump.
entries.translation: Kunis yaada uummataa gara Tiraampitti qajeelchuun, filannicha irratti dhiibbaa guddaa geessise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cairo, the capital of Egypt, is the largest city in the Middle East and the third largest city in Africa.
entries.translation: Kaayiroo, magaalaa guddittiin Misir, Baha Giddu galeessaa keessatti magaalaa guddoo yoo taatu Afrikaa keessatti immoo magaalaa guddittii sadarkaa sadaffaa irra jirtudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is home to some of the world's most famous landmarks, including the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum.
entries.translation: Kunis hawwatawwan teessuma lafaa babbareedoon addunyaa muraasni, kanneen akka Piraamidii Giizaa, Isfiniiksii, fi Godambaa Misirii bakka itti argamanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other important places in Egypt include Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan, and the Sinai Peninsula.
entries.translation: Bakkeewwan barbaachisoon Gibxii warri biroon Aleksaandeeriyaa, Luuksor, Aswaan, fi Gammoojjii Siinaa fa'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alexandria is Egypt's second largest city and was once the capital of the Ptolemaic Kingdom.
entries.translation: Aleksaanderiyaan magaala guddoo Gibxii ishee lammaffaa yoo taatu yeroo Mootummaa Pitoolemaatikiitti immoo magaala guddoo turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Luxor is home to the Valley of the Kings, where many of the pharaohs of ancient Egypt were buried.
entries.translation: Luuksor mandhee Suluula Moototaa, bakka fara'oononni Gibxii durii itti awwaalamanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aswan is located on the Nile River and is known for its beautiful scenery and its many ancient temples.
entries.translation: Aswaan Laga Abbayaa irratti kan argamtuufi miidhagina ilaalchaa fi siidaawwan duriitiin kan beekamtudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Sinai Peninsula is located in the eastern part of Egypt and is home to the famous Mount Sinai, where Moses is said to have received the Ten Commandments.
entries.translation: Gammoojjiin Siinaa immoo qarqara baha Gibxiitti kan argamuu fi mandhee Gaara Siinaa, bakka Museen abboommiiwwan kurnan itti fudhate jedhamee odeeffamuuti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The gardener's journey began with a simple drive to the local nursery.
entries.translation: Hojiin kunuunsituu biqiltuu sanaa gara wiirtuu oolmaa daa'immaniitti haala salphaan konkolaachisuun eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been planning this trip for weeks, ever since he had seen the advertisement in the paper.
entries.translation: Inni imala kana erga gafa beeksisa waraqaa irratti argee kaasee, torbanootaaf karoorsaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The nursery was offering a 20% discount on all plants, and he was determined to take advantage of the sale.
entries.translation: Oolmaan daa'immanii sun biqiltuuwwan hunda irratti hir'ina gatii 20% kan taasise yoo ta'e, innis gurgurtaa kanatti fayyadamuuf murteesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he arrived at the nursery, he was immediately overwhelmed by the selection of plants.
entries.translation: Yeroo bakka oolmaa daa'immanii ga'u, filannaa biqilootaa sanatti baay'ee ajaa'ibame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were flowers of every color and shape, vegetables of all sizes, and trees that reached for the sky.
entries.translation: Abaaboowwan bocaa fi halluu garaa garaa, kuduraalee hanga hundarraa walitti babba'an, akkasumas mukkeen dheerinni samii tuqantu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He wandered around for hours, admiring the plants and dreaming of the beautiful garden he would create.
entries.translation: Innis sa'atiilee hubachaa, biqiloota sana ajaa'ibsiifataa akkasumas gorduuba akkamii akka uumuu danda'u abjotaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, he made his selections and headed to the checkout counter.
entries.translation: Dhuma irratti, filannoo isaa xumuruun ilaaluuf gara minjaalaa deeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was paying for his plants, he noticed a sign that said "Free delivery for orders over $50" He smiled and added a few more plants to his cart.
entries.translation: Akkuma biqiloota isaaf kaffalaa jiruun, mallattoo "Ajajawwan $50 oliif dhiheessiin bilisa" kan jedhu hubatee xiqqoo seequun biqiloota muraasa gara gaarii isaatti ida'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few days later, the gardener received a delivery of his new plants.
entries.translation: Guyyoota murasa booda, kunuunsituun biqilootaa sun dhiheessii biqiloota isaa haaraa fudhate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He eagerly unpacked them and began to plant them in his garden.
entries.translation: Innis ariitiin banee biqiloota sana gorduuba isaa keessa dhaabuu eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He worked for hours, carefully placing each plant in the perfect spot.
entries.translation: Inni sa'atiiwwaniif, biqiltoota sana bakka sirrii of eeggannoon kaayuun hojjetaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he was finished, he stood back and admired his work.
entries.translation: Yeroo xumurutti, dudduubatti siqee dhaabatee hojii isaa dinqisiifachuu eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The garden was beautiful, and he knew that he would enjoy spending many hours tending to it.
entries.translation: Grduubichi bareedaa ture, sa'atiiwwan hedduuf kunuunsuun akka isa gammachiisu beekee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These are just a few of the issues that can plague a car that has been in a minor accident.
entries.translation: Kunneen rakkoowwan muraasa konkolaataa balaa xiqqoon isa mudate dhiphisuu danda'anidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While the damage may not seem significant, it can still be dangerous and expensive to fix.
entries.translation: Osoodhuma miidhaan sun xiqqaa fakkaatu, suphaan isaa ulfaataa fi qaalii ta'uu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of worn or falling apart rubber pieces, this can be a safety hazard.
entries.translation: Baqaquu ykn harca'uu mukeenii yoo ta'e, kun balaa nageenyaa ta'uu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rubber is used in a variety of places on a car, including the tires, brake pads, and seals.
entries.translation: Mukti, gommaa, qabduu luugamaa, fi siilii dabalatee kutawwan konkolaataa garaa garaa keessatti dhimma itti ba'ama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When rubber becomes worn, it can crack, split, or otherwise deteriorate.
entries.translation: Mukti yoo baqaqe, cabuu, gar gar ba'uu, ykn manca'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a number of problems, such as reduced traction, decreased braking performance, and leaks.
entries.translation: Kun harkisa hir'isuu, dandeettii luugamaa hir'isuu, fi dhimmisuu dabalatee rakkoowwan hedduu uumuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Missing roof rail pieces can also be a safety hazard.
entries.translation: Haguugduuwwan baaxii dhabuunis rakkoo nageenyaa ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Roof rails are designed to help protect passengers in the event of a rollover accident.
entries.translation: Baaxiiwwan kunniin yeroo balaan gara galuu uumamutti imaltoota balaa irraa eeguuf saxaxaman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the roof rails are missing, the roof of the car is more likely to collapse in a rollover, which can cause serious injuries or death.
entries.translation: Yoo qabduun baaxii dhabame, yeroo balaan gara galuu uumamutti baaxiin konolaatichaa kufuun balaa ulfaataa ykn du'a uumuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A broken fuel tank door lock can also be dangerous.
entries.translation: Balballi kuusaa boba'aa cabuunis balaafamaa ta'uu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the fuel tank door cannot be locked, it could come open while the car is moving.
entries.translation: Balballi kuusaa boba'aa cufamuu too hin dandeenye, yeroo konkolaataan deemu banamuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could spill fuel onto the road, which could cause a fire or explosion.
entries.translation: Kunis akka boba'aan daandii irratti dhangala'u taasisa, kun immoo ibidda ykn dho'iinsa uumuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the safety risks, these types of damage can also be expensive to fix.
entries.translation: Sodaa nageenyaatti dabaluun, gosti miidhaawwan kanaa suphuufis qaaliidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rubber pieces can be difficult to replace, and roof rails and fuel tank door locks can be expensive to repair or replace.
entries.translation: Mukeen bakka buusuun dadhabamuu mala, qabduu baaxii fi balbala kuusaa boba'aa suphuu ykn bakka buusuun immoo qaalii ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, it may be more cost-effective to total the car and buy a new one.
entries.translation: Haalota tokko tokko keessatti, konkolaaticha gurguruun haaraa bituun caalaatti baasii qusachuu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are considering buying a used car that has been in a minor accident, be sure to have it inspected by a qualified mechanic.
entries.translation: Konkolaataa hojjete kan miidhaa xiqqoon irra gahe bituf yaadaa jirta taanaan, makaanikii sirriin qoratamuu isaa mirkaneeffadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will be able to identify any damage that may not be visible to the naked eye, and they can advise you on whether or not the car is safe to buy.
entries.translation: Miidhaawwan ija namaan hin mul'anne adda baasuun, konkolaticha bituun gaarii ykn yaraa ta'uu isaa si hubachiisuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A bicycle is a thing of beauty, sleek and streamlined, its wheels a blur of motion as it glides along the road.
entries.translation: Biskileetiin meeshaa miidhagaa, sirrataa fi qajeelaa, gommaan isaa yeroo daandii gubbaa naanna'u bareedudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what happens when you bring a bike into a small room?
entries.translation: Garuu yeroo ati biskileetii gara kutaa xiqqaatti fiddu maaltu uumama?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, all that grace and efficiency is lost, and the bike becomes a clumsy, awkward intruder.
entries.translation: Battalumatti, gahumsii fi ayyaanni sun ni dhabama, biskileetichis gara waan jibbisiisaa fi bakka dhiphisaatti geddarama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I once had a bike in a small room.
entries.translation: Ani yeroo wayii kutaa dhiphaa keessatti biskileetii qaban ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a cramped, dingy apartment in a rundown neighborhood, and the bike took up most of the space.
entries.translation: Appaartaamaa dhiphaa ollaa walitti gobbataa keessa ture, kanaafuu irra jireessa kutichaa biskileetatu qabate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I could barely get through the door without knocking it over, and I had to be careful not to trip over it when I was in the middle of the night.
entries.translation: Osoon biskileeticha hin rukkutiin dirqamumaan dhiibbadheen mana bana, yeroo lafti halkan ta'u immoo akkan takaalamee hin kufneefin of eeggadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the bike was a nuisance, I couldn't bring myself to get rid of it.
entries.translation: Biskileetichi yoo ana jeeqe iyyuu, gatuu immoo hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a reminder of a better time, when I was young and free and full of hope.
entries.translation: Yaadannoo yeroo gaarii, yeroon ijoollee fi abdii guutuu qabuu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would sit on the bike and dream of all the places I could go, all the adventures I could have.
entries.translation: Biskileeticha irra taayeen bakkoota deemaa ture, bakkeewwan bashannanaan abjochaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I finally decided to get rid of the bike.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took it to the curb and put it out for the trash.
entries.translation: Gara bakka to'annaa ykn karbii geesseen balfa keessa buuse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I watched it being hauled away, I felt a pang of regret.
entries.translation: Yeroo inni harkifamee deemu, gaabbiitu natti dhagahame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early 1900s, Americans were introduced to the drug “morphine” through the use of over-the-counter cough syrups.
entries.translation: Jalqaba bara 1900ta keessa, Amerikaanonni karaa shirooppiiwwan utaalloo kallattiin qoricha "moorfiin" waliin wal baran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this drug was initially used to treat pain, it soon became addictive and led to a rise in the number of drug addicts in the United States.
entries.translation: Jalqa irra qorichi kun dhukkubbii yaaluuf kan hojjetame ta'us, booda irra araada qabsiisuu eegale kana irraa kan ka'e lakkoofsi namoota araadaan qabamanii Yunaayitid Isteetis keessatti akka dabalu taasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most tragic stories of this era is that of the “Kitten Lady”.
entries.translation: Seenaawwan gaddisiisoo yerichaa keessaa inni tokko "Kiiten Leedii" dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This woman was a morphine addict who had a litter of kittens.
entries.translation: Dubartiin kun araada moorfinii fi adurreewwan xura'an qabdi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved her kittens very much and would often play with them for hours on end.
entries.translation: Isheen adurreewwan ishee hedduu kan jaalattuu fi yeroo baay'ee sa'atiiwwaniif isaan waliin taphatti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, her addiction soon took over and she began to neglect her kittens.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, araadni sun dafee ishee mo'achuun akka isheen adurreewwan ishee dagattu gochaa deeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She would leave them for days at a time, only coming back to feed them and give them water.
entries.translation: Yeroo sanatti guyyootaaf isaan gattee deemti, nyaataa fi bishaan isaaniif kennuu qofaaf deebitee dhufti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The kittens eventually began to suffer from the neglect.
entries.translation: Deemsa keessa dagatamuu sana irraa kan ka'e adurreewwan sun miidhamuu eegalan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They became thin and sickly, and their fur began to fall out.
entries.translation: Isaan dhukkubsachuun huqqatan, bashannanni isaaniis dhabamuu eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One by one, they started to die.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Kitten Lady was devastated by the loss of her kittens, but she was unable to stop her addiction.
entries.translation: Kiiten Leediiniis du'aatii adurreewwan isheetiin hedduu hubamte, ta'us araada ishee dhaabuu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She eventually died of a morphine overdose, leaving her kittens behind.
entries.translation: Deemsa keessa moorfiinii humnaa ol fudhachuun duute, adurreewwan ishees kophaatti dhiiste.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This story is a reminder of the dangers of drug addiction.
entries.translation: Seenaan kun yaadachiistuu miidhaan araadaa qaqqabsiisu isa gaariidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a reminder of the love and devotion that animals can have for their humans.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis yaadachiistuu jaalalaa fi amanamummaa bineeldonni ilma namaaf qaban agarsiisu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) people are people who identify with a sexual orientation or gender identity that is different from the majority population.
entries.translation: Namoonni leesbiyaanii, geeyii, saala dacha, fi tiraansijenderii (LGBT) n namoota enyummaan koorniyaa ykn ibsamni saala isaanii kan namoota hedduu irraa adda ta'edha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sexual orientation refers to a person's romantic and sexual attraction to others, while gender identity refers to a person's internal sense of being male or female.
entries.translation: Ibsamni saalaa hawwattummaa jaalalaa ykn saalaa namni tokko kan biraaf qabu yoo ta'u, enyummaan koorniyaa immoo miira keessoo namni tokko dhiira ykn dhalaa ta'uuf qabudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people face discrimination in many areas of life, including employment, housing, and healthcare.
entries.translation: Namoota LGBT hojii, mana jireenyaa, fi kunuunsa yaalaa dabalatee rogawwan jireenyaa hedduu keessatti qoqqooddaan isaan mudata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also more likely to experience violence and abuse.
entries.translation: Carraan hookkaraa fi miidhaaf saaxilamuu isaaniis bal'aadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no one single cause of LGBT identity.
entries.translation: Sababni enyummaa LGBT qeenxeen hin jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people are born with an innate sense of their sexual orientation or gender identity, while others develop these feelings over time.
entries.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko miira ibsama saalaa ykn enyummaa koorniyaa kana waliin dhalatu, kanneen biroon immoo deemsuma keessa miirota kanneen guddisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people are just as diverse as the rest of the population.
entries.translation: LGBT n akkuma namoota biroo baay'ina qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They come from all walks of life and have a wide range of interests and experiences.
entries.translation: Isaan kutaalee jireenyaa hunda keessaa kan walitti baba'anii fi fedhii fi muuxannoowwan hedduu kan qabanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The medical community recognizes that sexual orientation and gender identity are not mental illnesses.
entries.translation: Hawaasni fayyaa ibsamni saalaa fi enyummaan koorniyaa dhibee sammuu akka hin taane mirkaneessanii jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, the American Psychiatric Association removed homosexuality from its list of mental disorders in 1973.
entries.translation: Dhugaa dubbachuuf, Gamtaan Fayyaa Xiin-sammuu Amerikaa jaalala saala wal-fakkaataa tarree dhibee sammuu keessaa bara 1973 haqee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people should be able to live their lives openly and authentically.
entries.translation: Namoonni LGBT karaa ifaa fi bilisa ta'een jireenya isaanii jiraachuu danda'uu qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They deserve to be treated with respect and dignity.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many countries, there are laws that protect LGBT people from discrimination.
entries.translation: Biyyoota hedduu keessatti, seeronni namoota LGBT qoqqooddaa irraa eegan ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hello, and welcome to your annual checkup.
entries.translation: Dooktera: Harka fuune, qorannoo keessan kan waggaatti baga nagaan dhuftan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Har'a miira akkamiitu itti dhagahamaa jira?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm feeling pretty good, all things considered.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Haalli kaan akkuma jirutti ta'ee, akka gaariin jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been getting a little more sleep lately, and my diet has been pretty healthy.
entries.translation: Dhiheenyatti xiqqoo ishee kan duriirra hirriba argachaan jira, haalli nyaataa koos fayyaalessadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to start by taking your vital signs.
entries.translation: Amma mallattoolee barbaachisoo keessan fudhachuunin eegala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The doctor takes the patient's blood pressure, pulse, and temperature.]
entries.translation: [Dooketiin dhiibbaa dhiigaa, dhahannaa dhiigaa, fi ho'iinsa qaamaa dhukkubsatichaa fudhate.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Now, let's talk about your diet.
entries.translation: Amma, mee waa'ee haala soorata keessanii haa dubbannu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What are you eating on a typical day?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I usually have a bowl of cereal for breakfast, a sandwich for lunch, and a salad for dinner.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Cireef seeriyaalii sa'anii tokko, laaqanaaf saanduuchii, dhiyaanaaf immoo salaaxaan nyaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also try to eat fruits and vegetables throughout the day.
entries.translation: Guyyaa guutuu kuduraalee fi muduraalees soorachuun yaala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That sounds like a healthy diet.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I try to get at least 30 minutes of exercise most days of the week.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Irra jireessa guyyoota torbanii yoo xiqqaate guyyaatti sochii qaamaa daqiiqaa 30f gochuun yaala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I walk to work, and I play basketball once or twice a week.
entries.translation: Gara hojiitti miilaanin deema, torbanitti guyyaa tokko ykn lama kubbaa kachoo nan taphadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's great. Exercise is an important part of a healthy lifestyle.
entries.translation: Dooktera: Kun baay'ee gaariidha. Sochiin qaamaa kutaa jireenya ilma namaa keessaa isa barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I know. I'm trying to be more active.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Nan beeka. Kana caalaa dammaqaa ta'uufin yaalaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is a country in Central Africa with a population of over 80 million people.
entries.translation: Rippabilikii Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo (DRC) n biyya Giddu galeessa Afrikaatti argamtuu fi baay'ina uummataa miiliyoona 80 qabdudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the second-largest country in Africa by area, and is endowed with vast natural resources, including copper, cobalt, diamonds, and gold.
entries.translation: Bal'ina lafa isheetiin afrikaa irraa lammaffaa yoo taatu,koopperii, koobaaltii, diyaamendii fi warqii dabalatee qabeenyawwan uumamaa isheetiin beekamti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the DRC has been plagued by conflict for decades, which has had a devastating impact on its people and economy.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, DRC n saddeeta muraasaaf waraana uummataa fi dinagdee ishee balleesseen hubamaa jirti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major conflict in the DRC was the First Congo War, which lasted from 1996 to 1997.
entries.translation: Wal waraansi guddichi jalqabaa DRC keessatti mudate Waraana Koongoo Isa duraa bara 1996 hanga 1997 gidduutti turedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This war was fought between the government of Mobutu Sese Seko and a rebel group led by Laurent Kabila.
entries.translation: Waraanichis mootummaa Moobuutuu Seesee Seekkoo fi humna finciltootaa Looreen Kaabilaan durfamu gidduutti geggeeffame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kabila eventually succeeded in overthrowing Mobutu and taking power.
entries.translation: Kaabiilaanis waraanichaan irra aanee mootummaa Moobutuu kuffiisuun aangoo qabate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Haat'umalee, yeroon bulchiinsa Kaabilaa gabaabaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1998, he was overthrown by a new rebel group led by Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.translation: Bara 1998 keessa, humna finciltootaa Piyeer Beembaan dursamuun aangoo irraa kaafame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to the Second Congo War, which lasted until 2003.
entries.translation: Kunis biyyattii gara Waraana Koongoo Lammaffaa kan hanga bara 2003tti turetti geesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Second Congo War was the deadliest conflict in modern African history, and resulted in the deaths of over 5 million people.
entries.translation: Waraanni Koongoo Lammaffaan seenaa Afrikaa keessatti, waraana isa balaafamaa fi du'aatii lubbuu miiliyoona 5 qaqqabsiisedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The DRC has also been plagued by political instability.
entries.translation: DRC n dabalataanis tasgabbii dhabuu siyaasaatiin hammacamti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Last week, my uncle was out in the field harvesting corn when he spotted a snake slithering across the ground.
entries.translation: Torban darbe, eessumni koo osoo dirree keessaa boqqolloo cabsuu bofa lafa irra lo'u arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He decided to take a closer look, and as he got closer, he realized that it was a huge rattlesnake!
entries.translation: Itti siqee ilaaluuf murteesse, itti siqee yeroo argu, bofa guddaa ta'uu isaa hubate!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly backed away, but the snake was already on the move.
entries.translation: Inni dafee duubatti deebi'e, bofichi garuu deemsa eegalee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It headed straight for my uncle, who started to run.
entries.translation: Inni kallattiimaan, gara eessuma koo baqachaa jiruutti fiige.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ran as fast as he could, but the snake was gaining on him.
entries.translation: Inni hanga danda'e baqataa ture, bofichi garuu isatti dhiyaachaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when it seemed like the snake was going to catch him, my uncle tripped and fell.
entries.translation: Battaluma bofichi eessuma koo waan qabate fakkaatetti, eessumni koo gufatee kufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed in a big pile of manure, and the snake slid right past him.
entries.translation: Innis tuullaa xaa'oo keessatti kufe, bofichi garuu kallattiimaan isarra tare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My uncle was so relieved that he had escaped, but he was also covered in manure.
entries.translation: Eessumni koo miliquu isaatiif xiqqoo gammade, ta'us xaa'ootiin uwwifamee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The plastic bag is a ubiquitous object in our modern world.
entries.translation: Korojoowwan pilaastikaa addunyaa ammayaa keessatti meeshaa bakka hundatti argamudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is used for everything from carrying groceries to picking up dog poop.
entries.translation: Dhiheessiiwwan nyaataa itti qabachuu hanga udaan sarootaa itti baachuutti waan hundaaf dhimma itti ba'amu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what is the true cost of this seemingly innocuous item?
entries.translation: Garuu gatiin meeshaa miidha maleessa ta'uu inni dhugaan maalidha?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic bags are made from a type of plastic called polyethylene, which is derived from fossil fuels.
entries.translation: Korojoowwan pilaastikaa gosa pilaatikaa pooliitiliinii jedhamu kan boba'aa bososaa irraa hojjetamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The production of plastic bags requires a great deal of energy, and it also releases harmful pollutants into the environment.
entries.translation: Oomishni korojoowwan pilaastikaa annisaawwan hedduu kan fixuu fi faaltota hamoo gara naannootti kan gadhiisudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once plastic bags are discarded, they can take hundreds of years to decompose.
entries.translation: Korojoowwan pilaastikaa kun yeroo hojii dhaaban, bososuudhaaf waggaa dhibboota itti fudhata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that they can accumulate in landfills and oceans, where they can harm wildlife and pollute our water supply.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun lafaa fi garboota keessatti kuufamuun, bineensota irra miidhaa geessisu akkasumas bishaan faalu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic bags are also a major source of litter.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis korojoowwan pilaastikaa kun madda balfaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be found on beaches, in parks, and even in our own neighborhoods.
entries.translation: Qarqara bishanii, paarkiiwwan keessa, akkasumas ollaa keenyatti argamuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Litter is unsightly and can be a hazard to wildlife.
entries.translation: Balfi kan hin mul'annee fi bineensota irraan miidhaa geessisuu danda'udha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The plastic bag is a symbol of our throwaway culture.
entries.translation: Korojoon pilaastikaa agarsiistuu aadaa itti fayyadamanii gatuu keenyaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We use them for a few minutes and then discard them, never giving a thought to the environmental consequences.
entries.translation: Daqiiqaawwan muraasaaf itti fayyadamnee ganna, tasuma iyyuu miidhaa inni naannoo irraan gahu yaada keessa hin galchinu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to find ways to reduce our use of plastic bags.
entries.translation: Karaa itti fayyadama korojoowwan pilaastikaa hir'isnu barbaaduu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can bring our own reusable bags when we go shopping, and we can recycle plastic bags whenever possible.
entries.translation: Korojoo irra deebiin fayyadamuu dandeenyu kan mataa keenyaa qabannee gara dukkaanaa deemuu dandeenya, yeroo danda'ame hundas korojoowwan pilaastikaa kunneen irra deebiin fayyadamuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also lobby our elected officials to pass laws that restrict the use of plastic bags.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis seera baastonni filanne seera itti fayyadama korojoo pilaastikaa daangessu akka baasaniif dhiibbaa gochuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kofi and Sameer met in college at a bar that Kofi's father owned.
