entries.english: Some of these experiences have been positive, while others have been less than ideal.
entries.translation: Muuxannoowwan kunniin gariin isaanii gaggaariidha, gariin immoo xiqqoo daandii irraa kan maqe dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, one experience that I will never forget is the time I got "prison beer" delivered to my dorm room.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, yeroo ani matumaa hin daganne gaafa "biiraan piriizin" jedhamu doormii kootti anaaf dhiyaatudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It all started when I was hanging out with some friends one night, and we decided to order a pizza.
entries.translation: Kun kan eegale gaafa nuti galgala tokko hiriyyoota muraasa waliin ala baanee piizaa ajajuuf murteessine ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We placed our order online, and within minutes, we received a notification that our pizza was being delivered.
entries.translation: Ajaja keenya karaa toora irraa qaqqabsiisne, daqiiqaawwan muraasa booda, piizaan keenya qaqqabuu isaa beeksisni nu gahe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, when the delivery guy showed up, he was not carrying a pizza.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, namichi piizaa dhiyeessu, piizaa qabatee hin turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, he was carrying a case of beer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were all confused, but the delivery guy explained that he had gotten our order mixed up with another order.
entries.translation: Hunda keenya bitaa nu gale, namichi meeshaa dhiyeessu sun garuu ajaja nama biroo kan keenya fakkeeffachuu isaa nutti hime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He said that the other person had ordered a case of beer, and he had accidentally delivered it to us instead.
entries.translation: Namni biroon biiraa sanduuqa tokko akka ajajate, inni immoo dogoggoraan akka nuuf dhiheesse nutti hime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were all a little hesitant at first, but we eventually decided to keep the beer.
entries.translation: Nuti hundi keenya jalqaba irra garaa hirree turre, booda garuu biiraa sana fudhachuuf murteessine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After all, it was free beer.
entries.translation: Kun hundi ta'ee garuu, biiraa bilisaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We opened the case of beer and started drinking.
entries.translation: Nutis sanduuqa biiraa sana bannee dhuguu eegalle.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The beer was actually pretty good, and we all had a great time.
entries.translation: Biiraan sun dhugumatti bayeessa ture, nutis yeroo gaarii qabaanne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My colleague was a hard worker, but she was always getting passed over for promotions.
entries.translation: Miiltoon koo hojjettuu cimtuudha, garuu yeroo guddinni dhufu hunda ishee irra tara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was told that she needed to "work harder" or "be more visible," but it seemed like no matter what she did, she couldn't get ahead.
entries.translation: Isheenis "jabaattee akka hojjettu" ykn "namatti mumul'achuu" akka qabdu itti himame, dalagaan ishee maalis ta'u, duratti tarkaanfachuu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The manager was also a problem.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was always micromanaging everyone, and he was quick to criticize.
entries.translation: Inni nama hundayyuu waanuma xixiqqoon secca'aa ture, nama ceepha'uufis ni jarjara ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He didn't seem to care about the employees' work-life balance, and he expected them to be available 24/7.
entries.translation: Inni waa'ee madaallii jiruu fi jireenya hojjetootaa irraa dhimma hin qabu namni hundinuu 24/7 akka hojiif dhufu barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My colleague eventually reached her breaking point.
entries.translation: Deemsa keessa miiltoon koo fiixee dubbii irra geesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She couldn't take the stress of the job anymore, and she knew that she wouldn't be able to advance her career there.
entries.translation: Dhiphina hojii kana caalaa dandamachuu hin dandeenye, bakka sanatti hojii ishee fooyyessuu akka hin dandeenyes bartee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She gave her two weeks' notice and started looking for a new job.
entries.translation: Isheenis akeekkachiisa torban lamaa kennitee hojii haaraa barbaaddachuu eegalte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She found a new job that was a much better fit for her.
entries.translation: Isheenis hojii haaraa caalaadhumatti ishe gitu argatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pay was better, the hours were more reasonable, and the manager was supportive and understanding.
entries.translation: Kaffaltiin isaa fooyya'aa, sa'atiiwwan hojii dhama qabeeyyii, bulchaan sun immo kan nama hubatuu fi garraamii ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's much happier now, and she's glad that she made the decision to leave her old job.
entries.translation: Isheen amma baay'ee gammadduudha, hojii durii sana gadhiisuuf murteessuu isheettis ni gammaddi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm not sure what the manager is doing now, but I hope that he's learned his lesson.
entries.translation: Bulchaan sun amma maal akka hojjetu quba hin qabu, garuu barnoota argateera jedheen yaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He can't treat his employees like that and expect them to stay.
entries.translation: Hojjettoota isaa haala sanaan qabatee akka isaan achi turan eeguu hin qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he wants to keep good people, he needs to change his ways.
entries.translation: Namoota gaggaarii achitti hambifachuu yoo barbaade, haala isaa jijjiirrachuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for my colleague, she's doing great in her new job.
entries.translation: Miiltoon koo sun, amma hojii ishee haaraa sana keessatti akka dansaa jirti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's getting the recognition that she deserves, and she's finally able to advance her career.
entries.translation: Isheen beekamtii isheef malu argatte, dhuma irrattis sadarkaa hojii ishee ol butachuu dandesseetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's a great example of what happens when you stand up for yourself and refuse to put up with a bad situation.
entries.translation: Isheen yeroo waanti gadheen si irratti raawwatu mormuu fi mataa keef dhaabbachuun maal akka fidu fakkeenya sirriidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Funny pictures and videos are a dime a dozen these days, but some of them stand out from the rest.
entries.translation: Suuraa fi suur-sagaleewwan bashannansiisoon yeroo ammaa gargar hin ba'an, garuu yeroo tokko tokko gariin isaanii wal irraa adda ba'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These are the ones that are so relatable or absurd that they make us laugh out loud.
entries.translation: Kunneen warra walitti dhufeenya qaban ykn kanneen baay'ee nu kolfisiisanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is a recent video that went viral of a cat trying to fit into a small box.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyi tokko suur-sagalee dhiyeenya baay'ee beekame kan adurreen tokko sanduuqa xiqqootti gituuf yaaltu agarsiisudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cat is clearly struggling, but it keeps trying, and the whole thing is just so funny.
entries.translation: Adurritiin rakkachaa turte, sanas ta'u immo yaaluu ittuma fufte, haalli hundinuu nama kolfisiisa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another example is a picture of a dog wearing a hat that is way too big for it.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyi kan biroon suura saree baarnexaa baay'ee isheerra ba'u uffattee jirtu tokkooti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog looks so ridiculous that it's impossible not to laugh.
entries.translation: Sareen sun baay'ee of gattuu fakkaatti kanaafuu kolfuu dhiisuun hin danda'amu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These types of funny pictures and videos are often shared on social media, and they can quickly become a "meme" A meme is a humorous image, video, or piece of text that is copied and shared online.
entries.translation: Suronni fi suur-sagaleewwan akkanaa kun miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti qoodamu, battalumatti immoo "qoosaa" ta'u. Qoosaan suura, suur-sagale, ykn barreeffamoota xixiqqaa waraabamanii toora irratti qoodamanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Memes often use familiar images or phrases, and they can be used to express a wide range of emotions.
entries.translation: Qoosaawwan yeroo baay'ee suuraalee ykn gaaleewwan bebbeekamoo fayyadamuun, miira baay'ee bal'aa ta'e ibsuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One thing that must happen when a funny picture or video goes viral is that it is shared with others.
entries.translation: Wanti gaariin yeroo suurri ykn suur-sagaleen beekamaa ta'u uumamu tokko namoota gidduuti qoodamuu isaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is what makes memes so popular.
entries.translation: Waanti qoosaawwan beekamoo taasisus isa kana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People see a funny picture or video, and they want to share it with their friends so that they can laugh too.
entries.translation: Namoonni suura ykn suur-sagalee nama kolfisiisu ni argu, sana booda isaan illee akka kolfan waan barbaadaniif hiriyyoota isaaniif qooduu barbaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is why memes can spread so quickly across the internet.
entries.translation: Sababni qoosaan salphumatti marsaalee interneetaa hunda irratti dafee bal'atus kanaafi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world, standing at 8,848 meters above sea level.
entries.translation: Gaarri Everest gaara guddicha addunyaa yoo ta'u, sirrii galaanaan ol meetira 8,848 olka'ee mul'ata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.
entries.translation: Mahaalaanguur Hiimaal kan tuta xiqqaa Himaaliyaa keessatti argama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mountain is a popular destination for mountaineers, and many people attempt to summit it each year.
entries.translation: Gaarri kun kanneen gaara koranii fi kanneen waggaa waggaan isa koruuf yaalaniif bakka namni deemu isa beekamaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the climb is dangerous, and many people have died trying to reach the top.
entries.translation: Haata'umalee, gaaricha koruun balaafamaadha, namoonni baay'een fiixee irra ba'uuf yaalanii du'aniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first recorded attempt to summit Everest was made in 1921 by a British expedition led by George Mallory.
entries.translation: Korri gaara Everest koruuf yaale abuuraa lammii Biriitish Joorji Maalooriin durfamu yeroo jalqabaaf bara 1921 galmaa'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mallory and his climbing partner Andrew Irvine disappeared during their attempt, and their bodies were not found until 1999.
entries.translation: Maaloorii fi miiltoon isaa Andiriw Irvaayin yeroo yaalii koruu sanatti dhabaman, reeffi isaaniis hanga bara 1999 tti hin argamne ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay became the first people to successfully summit Everest.
entries.translation: Bara 1953 keessa, Eediman Hilaarii fi Teenziing Noorgaay namoota yeroo jalqabaaf fiixee Everest yaabuun milka'anidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since then, thousands of people have followed in their footsteps.
entries.translation: Erga sanaa, namoonni kumaatamootaan lakka'aman faana isaanii hordofanii jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The climb to the summit of Everest is a long and arduous journey.
entries.translation: Deemsi fiixee Everest koruuf godhamu deemsa dheeraa fi nuffisiisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It typically takes climbers about two months to complete the journey, and they must overcome a number of challenges along the way.
entries.translation: Yeroo baay'ee gaaricha koranii xumuruuf gara ji'a lamaa kan fudhatuu fi deemsa kana keessatti gufuuwwan hedduu darbuutu isaan irra jiraata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These challenges include altitude sickness, extreme weather conditions, and the risk of falling.
entries.translation: Gufuuwwan kunniin jeeqama sodaa olka'insaan dhufu, haala qilleensaa baay'ee ulfaataa, fi carraa kufuu fa'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the dangers, the climb to the summit of Everest is a rewarding experience.
entries.translation: Balaawwan kunniin akkuma jiranitti ta'ee, fiixee Everest irra ba'uun muuxannoo baay'ee bayeessadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: The telescope is used to look at objects in space.
entries.translation: Harmee: Teleskooppiin waantota hawaa keessa jiran arguuf fayyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Child: Can I look through it?
entries.translation: Mucaa: Isa keessa dabarsee ilaaluu nan danda'aa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: Sure, but be careful not to bump it.
entries.translation: Harmee: Eyyee, garuu akka hin kuffiisneef eeggadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The child looks through the telescope and sees a bright star.
entries.translation: Mucaanis karaa teleskooppii ilaalee urjii ifu arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: Yes, it is. The stars are so far away, but with a telescope, we can see them up close.
entries.translation: Harmee: Eyyee, Urjiileen baay'ee fagoodha, karaa teleskooppii garuu, dhiheessinee ilaaluu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The child looks at other objects in space, including planets and moons.
entries.translation: Mucaanis pilaanetootaa fi baatiiwwan dabalatee waantota biroo hawaa keessa jiran arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are amazed by how small and insignificant they feel compared to the vastness of the universe.
entries.translation: Bal'ina hawaan yeroo wal madaalu xiqqeenyaa fi hagam gati dhabeeyyii fakkaachuu isaaniitti baay'ee dinqame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Child: I can't believe how big space is.
entries.translation: Mucaa: Guddina hawaa kana amanuu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mother: It is, but it's also full of amazing things.
entries.translation: Harmee: Akkasi, garuu waantota ajaa'ibsiisoo hedduun kan guutamedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was worried that I might have contracted Lyme disease, but I went to the doctor and he said that I didn't have anything to worry about.
entries.translation: Dhukkuba Laayimiinan qabame jedhee yaadda'een ture, garuu yeroo ani gara dookteraa deemu, wanti ana yaaddessu akka hin jirre anatti hime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told me that the rash was probably just a reaction to the tick's saliva.
entries.translation: Shifiin qaamaa sunis tarii furdachuu hancufaa irraa akka dhufe anatti hime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was relieved to hear that I didn't have Lyme disease, but I was still a little bit concerned about the rash.
entries.translation: Dhukkuba Laayimii dhabuu kootti nan gammade, ta'us shifiin qaamaa sun ana yaaddessee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The doctor told me that it would go away on its own, but it took a few weeks for it to completely disappear.
entries.translation: Dookteriin sun ofuma isaatiin bada jedhee anatti hime, guutummaatti baduuf garuu toorbanoota muraasa itti fudhate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, I tried to keep the rash clean and dry.
entries.translation: Yeroo keessa, shifii sana gogaa fi qulqulluutti eeguun yaale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also applied some over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream to help relieve the itching.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis hooqsisaa isaa obbaafachuuf jecha dibatawwan haayidirookoortisoonii muraasan itti dibe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rash was itchy and unsightly, but it didn't cause me any other problems.
entries.translation: Shifiiwwan kunniin xixiqqoo fi hooqsisaa ture, garuu rakkoowwan kan biroo ana irratti hin qaqqabsiisne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm just glad that I didn't have Lyme disease.
entries.translation: Dhukkuba Laayimsiin qabamuu dhabuu kootti baay'een gammade.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you find a tick attached to your body, it's important to remove it as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Qaama keessan irratti waan akka silmii yoo argitan, hanga danda'aametti daftanii of irraa buqqisuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can use a pair of tweezers to grasp the tick as close to the skin as possible and pull it straight out.
entries.translation: Silmicha gogaa keessanitti maxxansitanii buqqisuuf tiwiizerii fayyadamuun kallattiimaan harkisaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't twist or jerk the tick, as this could cause the head to break off and remain in your skin.
entries.translation: Mataan isaa gogaa keessan keessatti hafuu waan danda'uuf silmicha hin naannessiinaa ykn fiixee qabdanii hin harkisiinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've removed the tick, wash the area with soap and water.
entries.translation: Erga silmii buqqaastaniin booda, naannawaa isaa bishaanii fi saamunaan dhiqaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also apply a topical antibiotic ointment to help prevent infection.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis daariqa ykn infeekshinii ittisuuf dibata farra baakteeriyaa irra keessatti dibuu dandeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to watch for signs of Lyme disease after being bitten by a tick.
entries.translation: Erga silmiin ciniinamtaniin booda mallattoolee Laayimii of irratti eeguun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These symptoms can include fever, headache, fatigue, muscle aches, and a characteristic rash.
entries.translation: Mallattooleen kunis guba qaamaa, mataa bowwuu, dadhabbii, dhukkubbii maashaalee, fi shifii qaama irratti ba'u fa'a dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you develop any of these symptoms, see your doctor right away.
entries.translation: Mallattooleen kunniin yoo isin irratti mul'atan, hatattamaan dooktera keessan bira deemaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lyme disease is a serious illness, but it can be treated with antibiotics.
entries.translation: Dhukkubni Laayimis dhukkuba hamaadha, garuu qorichoota farra baakteeriyaan yaalamuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment is important to prevent serious complications.
entries.translation: Dhukkuba wal xaxaa hambisuuf jecha dafanii yaalamuun bayeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about ticks or Lyme disease, talk to your doctor.
entries.translation: Waa'ee silmii ykn dhukkuba Laayims gaaffii yoo qabaattan, dooktera keessan dubbisaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Three women are sitting at a table, talking about their cats.
entries.translation: Dubartoonni sadii minjalicha bira taayuun, waa'ee adurreewwan isaanii haasa'aa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: My cat, Sangeetha, is always there to greet me at the door when I come home from work.
entries.translation: Kostaansi: Adurreen kiyya, Sangeetaan, yeroo ani hojiidhaa galu hundumaa karra dura dhaabattee nagaa ana gaafatti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ayanda: Me too! I have two cats of my own. They make me feel wanted.
entries.translation: Ayaandaa: Ani illee akkasuma! Adurreewwan laman qaba. Akkan of jaaladhu ana godhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: I know what you mean. Sangeetha always makes me feel better when I'm having a bad day.
entries.translation: Kostaans: Maal jechuu akka ati barbaadde nan beeka. Yeroo haalli koo gaarii hin taane hunda Sangeetaan akka ani tasgabbaa'u ana gooti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aditi: I've always wanted a cat, but I'm allergic.
entries.translation: Adiitii: Ani yeroo hunda adurreen barbaadan ture, garuu alaarjii adurreen qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ayanda: That's too bad. Cats are really great companions.
entries.translation: Ayaandaa: Kun waan yaraadha. Adureewwan miiltoo gariidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aditi:I know! I've always admired people who have cats. They seem to have such a special bond with their pets.
entries.translation: Adiitii: Nan beeka! Yeroo hundumaa namoota durree qaban nan ajaa'ibsiifadha. bineelda isaanii faana walitti dhufeenya jabaa waan qaban anatti fakkaatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Constance: I think it's because cats are very independent animals. They don't need you to take care of them every minute of the day.
entries.translation: Kostaans: Sababa adurreewwan bineelda of danda'oo ta'aniif anatti fakkaata. Yeroo hundumaa akka ati isaan kunuunsitu hin barbaadan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But they still love you and enjoy your company.
entries.translation: Garuu si jaalatu miiltummaa keettis ni gammadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of Ethiopia is long and complex, with a rich and varied culture.
entries.translation: Seenaan Itoophiyaa dheeraa fi wal xaxaa, kan aadaalee hedduudhaan duroomedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The earliest evidence of human settlement in Ethiopia dates back to the Paleolithic period, with the discovery of stone tools and other artifacts.
entries.translation: Ragaan qubsuma ilma namaa Itoophiyaa inni ganamaa gara yeroo Paaleyootikitti nu geessa, yeroo kalaqa meeshaalee dhagaa fi ogummaa harkaatiin dabaalame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major civilization in Ethiopia was the Aksumite Empire, which flourished from the 1st century BC to the 8th century AD.
entries.translation: Qaroominni Itoophiyaa guddichi inni jalqabaa yeroo Impaayera Aksum ture, kunis DH.K.D jaarraa 1ffaa hanga DH.K.B jaarraa 8faatti dagaagee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Aksumites were a powerful trading empire that controlled much of the trade between Africa and the Middle East.
entries.translation: Aksum impaayera humna qabeessa daandiilee daldalaa Afrikaa fi Baha Giddu-galeessaa irra jireessaan to'atee turedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also built many impressive monuments, including the Great Stelae of Aksum.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis, Siidaa Guddicha Aksum dabalatee siidaawwan bebbeekamoo hedduu ijaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After the fall of the Aksumite Empire, Ethiopia was ruled by a series of different kingdoms and dynasties.
entries.translation: Kufaatii Impaayera Aksum booda, Itoophiyaan moototaa fi sirnoota-bittaa hedduutiin bultee jirti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 16th century, Ethiopia was invaded by the Ottoman Empire, but the Ethiopians were able to defeat the Ottomans and maintain their independence.
entries.translation: Jaarraa 16ffaa keessa, Itoophiyaan Turkoota Otoomaaniin weeraramte, garuu Itoophiyaanonni Turkoota of irraa ittisuun birmadummaa isaanii kabachiifatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, Ethiopia was ruled by Emperor Tewodros II, who is considered one of the greatest Ethiopian rulers.
entries.translation: Jaarraa 19ffaa keessa, Itoophiyaan Tewoodiroos 2ffaa, qaallicha mootota Itoophiyaa jedhamuun beekamuun bulte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tewodros II was a strong and ambitious ruler who sought to unite Ethiopia and to modernize the country.
entries.translation: Tewoodiroos 2ffaan bulchaa jabaa fi mul'ata biyya Itoophiyaa tokkummeessuu qabu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also fought against European colonialism, and he is remembered for his famous letter to Queen Victoria of England, in which he demanded that she stop interfering in Ethiopian affairs.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis inni koloneeffattoota Awurooppaa falmaa ture, xalayaa inni Giiftittii Ingilaand kan taate Viktooriyaaf barreesse, kan akka isheen giddu seentummaa dhimma Itoophiyaa akka dhaabdu gaafatuun beekama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: What kind of style are you looking for?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: I'm mostly interested in something neutral and understated.
entries.translation: Maamila: Waanta xiqqoo giddu galeessa ta'ee fi baay'ee ol hin kaanen barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: We have a few options that might work. This one is made from wool and has a simple geometric pattern.
entries.translation: Namicha gurguru: Filannoowwan si gitan muraasa qabna. Kun suufii irraa hojjetame saxaxaan ji'oomeetirii isaas salphaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: I like that. It's perfect for my living room.
entries.translation: Maamila: Kana jaaladheera. Kutaa jireenya kootiif gita sirriidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salesperson: Great! I'm happy to help. We can also deliver and install the rug for you if you'd like.
entries.translation: Namicha gurguru: Baay'ee gaarii! Si gargaaruu danda'uu koof nan boona! Yoo si barbaachise hafaticha mana keetti siif dhiheessinee, siif sirreessuu ni dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Customer: That would be great. I'm willing to pay a little extra for that.
entries.translation: Maamila: Kun waan baay'ee gaariidha. Sanaaf kaffaltii dabalataa muraasa kaffaluu nan jaaladha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sickness has been a part of human life since the beginning of time.
entries.translation: Jalqabuma irraa kaasee dhukkubni qaama jiruuf jireenya ilma namaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the common cold to the bubonic plague, countless diseases have ravaged our species, causing pain, suffering, and death.
entries.translation: Utaalloo irraa eegalee hanga dha'icha ykn weerara biiboonikiitti, dhukkuboonni lakkoofsa hin qabne sanyii keenya lafarraa fixaniiru, dhukkubbii fi rakkina du'atti geessu qaqqabsiisaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But where did these illnesses come from?
entries.translation: Garuu dhukkuboonni kunniin maal irraa maddan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One popular myth about the origin of sickness is that it was caused by a curse from the gods.
entries.translation: Durdurii beekamaan waa'ee madda dhukkubaa balballoomsu tokko dhukkubni abaarsa waaqolii akka ta'e dubbata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: According to this myth, the gods were angered by the behavior of humans, so they sent down a plague to punish them.
entries.translation: Akka durdurii kanaatti, waaqayyooliin amala namootaatti waan aaraniif, akka dheekkamsaatti dhukkuboota gad ergan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this myth is certainly a powerful story, there is no evidence to support it.
entries.translation: Durduriin kun balballoomii humna qabeessa ta'us, ragaan kana deggeru garuu hin jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, most scientists believe that sickness is caused by natural factors, such as bacteria and viruses.
entries.translation: Dhugumatti, saayintistoonni hedduun dhukkubni sababoota uumamaa kanneen akka, baakteeriyaa fi vaayireesota irraa akka madde amanu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These pathogens are always present in our environment, and they can cause disease when they enter our bodies.
entries.translation: Lubbu qabeeyyiin dhukkuba fidan kunniin yeroo hundumaa naannoo keenya keessa jiru, yeroo qaama keenya seenatti immoo dhukkuba uumu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, the myth of the gods' curse is just one of many stories about the origin of sickness.
entries.translation: Dhugaa dubbachuuf, durduriin abaarsa waaqaati jedhu seenaawwan dhufaatii dhukkubootaa warra hangafa keessaa isa tokkodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other myths and legends that attempt to explain why we get sick.
entries.translation: Maal irraa dhukkubni akka nu qabu ilaalchisee durdurii fi seenessoota hedduutu jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I can't believe we're going to be learning how to cook Indian food today," said 10-year-old Priya excitedly.
entries.translation: "Har'a akkaataa itti soorata Hindii qopheessinu barachuuf deemuu keenya amanuu hin dandeenye," intala waggaa 10 Piriyaatu gammachuun akkas jedhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's delicious," said Priya "It's usually very flavorful, with a lot of spices. And there are so many different dishes to choose from."
entries.translation: "Baay'ee miyaa'a," jette Piriyaan "Yeroo baay'ee dhandhamaa fi miyeessituuwwan hedduu of keessaa qaba. Kan keessaa filachuufis nyaatawwan hedduutu jira."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The class arrived at the kitchen, and Ms. Singh began to set up.
entries.translation: Barattoonnis kushinaa seenan, Aadde Siing sirreessuu eegalan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Today, we're going to be making a simple dish called dal makhani," she said.
entries.translation: "Har'a, nyaata salphaa dal Makaanii jedhamu hojjenna," jette.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's a type of lentil soup that's very popular in India."
entries.translation: "Gosa shoorbaa misiraa kan Hindii keessatti baay'ee beekamaa ta'eeti."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Singh showed the class how to measure out the ingredients and cook the lentils.
entries.translation: Aadde Siing akkamitti qabiyyeewwan keenya akka safarruu fi misira itti bilcheessinu nutti himan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The students helped each other chop vegetables and stir the pot.
entries.translation: Barattoonnis kuduraalee muruu fi xuwwee qulleessuutti wal gargaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As they worked, they chatted about their favorite foods and what they were looking forward to trying in India.
entries.translation: Yeroo hojjetaa jiranitti, waa'ee gosa nyaataa jaalatanii fi nyaata Hindii sana dhandhamuuf jarjaruu isaanii haasa'aa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the dal makhani was finished, the students sat down to eat.
entries.translation: Yeroo dal makaaniin xumuramutti, barattoonni nyaachuuf gad taayan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My favorite season is the one in which all is green, the trees are in full bloom, and the birds are singing.
entries.translation: Waqtii ani jaaladhu kan waan hundi magarisaa, mukeen hundi abaaboon faayaman, waqtii simbirroonni faarsanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time of new beginnings, as the world wakes up from its winter slumber and begins to grow and change.
entries.translation: Addunyaan hirriba bonaa irraa dammaquun guddachuu fi jijjiiramuu eegalteetti, kun yeroo jalqabbii haaraati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I love to spend this time outdoors, enjoying the fresh air and sunshine.
entries.translation: Yeroo akkasii alatti dabarsuun, qilleensa qulqulluu fi ho'a aduu dhandhamachuun jaaladha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is nothing quite like taking a walk in the woods on a spring day, breathing in the scent of the flowers and listening to the birdsong.
entries.translation: Guyyoota birraa keessa waanti hanga miilaan mukkeen keessa deemuu, foolii abaaboo fuunfachuu fi faaruu simbirrootaa dhaggeeffachuu ga'u hin jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time of hope and renewal, and I always feel invigorated by it.
entries.translation: Yeroo abdii fi haaromsaati, yeroo hundumaas waan ittiin haaroman namatti fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The days are getting longer and the nights are getting shorter, and the sun is shining brighter.
entries.translation: Guyyoonni dheeroo fi halkanoonni immoo gabaaboodha, aduun immoo sirriitti baati.

entries.english: Bouazizi was a 26-year-old street vendor who set himself on fire in December 2010 in protest of police harassment and corruption.

entries.english: His death sparked a wave of protests across Tunisia that eventually led to the overthrow of President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali.

entries.english: Today's action films are more complex, with characters who undergo significant transformations over the course of the film.

entries.english: In the film "The Batman," for example, the title character goes from being a vengeful vigilante to a symbol of hope for the city of Gotham.

entries.english: On the one hand, machines are becoming increasingly sophisticated and capable, and they are already performing many tasks that were once thought to be the exclusive domain of humans.

entries.english: On the other hand, humans have a unique set of skills and abilities that machines are unlikely to ever replicate, such as creativity, empathy, and intuition.

entries.english: One of the key areas where machines are rapidly outpacing humans is in the field of artificial intelligence (AI).

entries.english: AI is a branch of computer science that deals with the creation of intelligent agents, which are systems that can reason, learn, and act autonomously.

entries.english: AI is already being used in a wide range of applications, from self-driving cars to medical diagnosis.

entries.english: And as AI continues to develop, it is likely to become even more powerful and capable.

entries.english: However, there are also a number of areas where humans are likely to retain a significant advantage over machines.

entries.translation: Jaarsicha: Ittan waliif gala. Garuu akkaataa inni itti daldala miidhuuf deemu yoon ilaalus ana yaachisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I mean, I'm a good guy. I don't sell liquor to minors.
entries.translation: Jechuun kiyya, Ani nama gaariidha. Dhugaatii guddattootatti hin gurguru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I'm also not going to let some government bureaucrat tell me who I can and can't sell liquor to.
entries.translation: Garuu birokiraatiin mootummaa tokko maal gochuu akkan qabuu fi hin qabne akka natti himus hin heyyamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Young Man: I get what you're saying. But you have to be careful.
entries.translation: Dargaggeessicha: Waan ati jechaa jirtu naaf gala. Garuu of eeggachuu qabda.

entries.english: Family planning in India has been a topic of debate for many years.
entries.translation: Qusannaan maatii Hindii keessatti waggoota dheeraaf ijoo falmii ta'ee itti fufee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1976, the Indian government passed the controversial National Emergency Act, which imposed a forced sterilization program on men and women.
entries.translation: Bara 1976 keessa, mootummaan Hindii Seera Yeroo Hatattamaa kan Biyyoolessaa wal falmisiisaa ta'e, kan sagantaa dirqamaan dhiirotaa fi dubartoota maseensuu of keessaa qabu raggaasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This program was met with widespread resistance and eventually overturned by the Indian Supreme Court.
entries.translation: Sagantaan kun mormiin bal'aan kan isa mudate yoo ta'u Mana Murtii Walii gala Hindiitiin kufaa taasifame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, the Indian government has taken a more progressive approach to family planning.
entries.translation: Waggoota dhiyoo keessatti, mootummaan Hindii qusannaa maatii ilaalchisee tarkaanfii fooyyee qabu fudhateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2010, the government launched the National Family Planning Program, which provides free contraception and sterilization services to all Indian citizens.
entries.translation: Bara 2010 keessa, mootummaan Sagantaa Qusannaa Maatii Biyyoolessaa, kan lammiilee Hindii hundumaaf maloota ittisa da'umsaa fi maseenummaa bilisaan kennu hojiirra oolche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The program has been successful in reducing the fertility rate in India, but it still faces challenges, such as a lack of awareness and access to services.
entries.translation: Sagantichis Hindii keessatti hanga da'umsaa hir'isuuf milkaa'ina kan agarsiise ta'us, yeroo ammaa illee rakkoowwan akka, hanqina hubannoo fi dhaqqabamummaa tajaajilaatiin takaalamaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important challenges to family planning in India is the lack of awareness about the benefits of family planning.
entries.translation: Gufuun jabaan sagantaa karoora maatii Hindii keessatti mudataa jiru faayidaa qusannaa maatii ilaalchisee hanqina hubannoo jirudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many Indian couples believe that it is their duty to have as many children as possible.
entries.translation: Maatiiwwan Hindii hedduun isaanii hanga danda'ametti ijoollee hedduu horachuun dirqama isaanii akka ta'etti hubatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This belief is often reinforced by cultural and religious norms.
entries.translation: Hubannoon kunis yeroo baay'ee duudhaalee aadaa fi amantii irraa kan maddedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge to family planning is the lack of access to services.
entries.translation: Gufuun qusannaa maatii inni kan biroo hanqina dhaqqabamummaa tajaajilaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rural areas, there are often few or no family planning clinics.
entries.translation: Naannolee baadiyyaatti, yeroo baay'ee kilinikoonni qusannaa maatii hin jiran ykn muraasadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it difficult for couples to access the services they need.
entries.translation: Kunis maatileen tajaajila barbaadan argachuun akka itti ulfaatu taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, the Indian government is committed to providing family planning services to all its citizens.
entries.translation: Gufuuwwan kunniin akkuma jiranitti ta'ee, mootummaan Hindii tajaajiloota qusannaa maatii lammiilee isaa hunda biraan ga'uuf kutannoo qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science is a systematic enterprise that builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the natural world.
entries.translation: Saayinsiin interpiraayiza sirnawaa beekumsa waa'ee addunyaa uumamaa karaa tilmaamaa fi ibsama qoratamuu danda'uun ijaaruu fi qindeessudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In its broadest sense, science encompasses all human knowledge and activity motivated by a desire to understand the natural world and its phenomena.
entries.translation: Karaa bal'aa ta'een immoo, saayinsiin beekumsaa fi sochiiwwan ilma namaa kan fedhii addunyaa uumamaa fi amala isaa beekuu irraa madde hundumaa ofitti hammatudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science is also often seen as a particular body of knowledge derived from such investigation, as well as a method of discovery.
entries.translation: Yeroo baay'ee saayinsiin akka qaama beekumsa addaa qorannoo akkasumas mala abuurraa irraa argameetti ilaalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The earliest roots of science can be traced to Ancient Greek philosophy, particularly the works of Aristotle, who attempted to explain natural phenomena through observation and reason.
entries.translation: Hundeen saayinsii inni ganamaa filosoofii Giriik irraa madde, addumaan immoo hojiiwwan Aristootil, kan amala uumamaa karaa sababeessuu fi xiinxalaatiin ibsuuf yaalu irraa kan maddedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Over the centuries, science has developed into a more rigorous discipline, with the development of the scientific method, which emphasizes evidence, hypothesis testing, and repeatability.
entries.translation: Jaarraalee keessa, saayinsiin gara muummee guddaa, kan maloota saayinsawaa, kanneen ragaa, qorannaalee yaad-rimee, fi irra deddeebii ofitti hammataniitti guddatee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Science has had a profound impact on human society, leading to the development of new technologies, medicines, and understanding of the natural world.
entries.translation: Saayinsiin jiruuf jireenya ilma namaa irratti gahee guddaa taphate, kunis gara guddina tekinooloojiiwwan haaraa, qorichawwanii fi hubannaa addunyaa uumamaa fiduutti ceesise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has also played a role in shaping social and political thought.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis yaadota siyaasaa fi hawaasummaa bocuu irratti gahee mataa isaa taphatee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, science is a major part of modern life, and it continues to play an important role in the advancement of knowledge and understanding.
entries.translation: Yeroo ammaa, saayinsiin qaama jireenya ammayaa isa guddaadha, guddina beekumsaa fi hubannoo keessattis gahee guddaa taphachuu isaa ittuma fufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've already asked for one this semester, and I don't want to seem like I'm not taking my classes seriously.

entries.english: The flapper era is in full swing, and young women are enjoying their newfound freedom.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are dressing in short skirts and bobbed hair, smoking cigarettes, and drinking cocktails.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also dating more freely than ever before.

entries.english: She is a beautiful young woman with a sharp wit and a rebellious streak.

entries.english: She is not interested in finding a husband, but she does enjoy the attention of men.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Josephine is at a party when she meets a young man named Jack.
entries.translation: Guyyaa tokko, Joosefiin yeroo dargaggeessa Jaak jedhamu tokko yeroo wal bartetti paartiirra turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jack is everything that Josephine is not.
entries.translation: Jaak guutummaatti Joosefiin irraa adda dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is conservative, polite, and serious.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there is something about him that Josephine finds attractive.

entries.english: Jack and Josephine begin dating, and they quickly fall in love.

entries.english: They spend their days dancing at the bars and their nights talking for hours on end.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Josephine has never felt this way about anyone before.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Jack is not the only man in Josephine's life.

entries.english: Egypt faces a number of challenges, including:
entries.translation: Gibxiin kanneen itti aanan dabalatee rakkoowwan hedduutu ishee mudate:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A rapidly growing population. Egypt's population is expected to grow from 100 million today to 140 million by 2050.
entries.translation: * Lakkoofsa uummataa saffisaan dabalu. Lakkoofsi uummataa gibxii amma jiru miiliyoona 100 yoo ta'u bara 2050tti miiliyoona 140tti guddata jedhamee tilmaamama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will put a strain on the country's resources, including its food supply, water supply, and infrastructure.
entries.translation: Kun leecalloowwan biyyattii kanneen akka dhiyeessii nyaataa fi bishaanii, akkasumas bu'uraalee misoomaa irratti huuba qoonqoo ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A widening gap between the rich and the poor. Egypt has a high Gini coefficient, which measures inequality.
entries.translation: * Bal'achuu garaa garummaa jireenya hiyyeessaa fi sooressa gidduu jiru. Gibxiin ibsa garaa garummaa jireenyaa, kanb wal caalmaa safaruu ol'aanaa qabdi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that the wealth is concentrated in the hands of a few, while the majority of the population lives in poverty.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun qabeenyi harka dureeyyii muraasaatti yoo walitti qabamu, hawaasni bal'aan hiyyuma keessa jiraata jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * High unemployment. Egypt's unemployment rate is around 12%.
entries.translation: * Hoji dhabdummaa guddaa. Sadarkaan hoji dhabdummaa gibxii naannoo 12%ti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is especially high among young people.
entries.translation: Kun keessumaa dargaggoota biratti immoo ol'aanaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A lack of economic opportunity. Egypt's economy is heavily reliant on tourism and agriculture.
entries.translation: * Hanqina carraa dinagdee. Dinagdeen Gibxii irra jireessaan turiizimii fi qonna irratti hundaa'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These sectors are vulnerable to external shocks, such as the global financial crisis and the Arab Spring.
entries.translation: Sekteroonni kunniin dhiibbaa rakkoowwan alaa kanneen akka kufaatii dinagdee idil-addunyaaa fi Warraaqsa Arabaatiif saaxilamoodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This instability has made it difficult for the government to implement reforms and improve the economy.
entries.translation: Tasgabbii dhabuun kunis mootummaan imaammata haaromsaa fi fooyya'iinsa dinagdee hojiirra oolchuu akka hin dandeenye taasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vehicle repair and maintenance is essential for keeping your car in good condition and preventing costly repairs down the road.
entries.translation: Konkolaataa suphuu fi haaromsuun konkolaataa kee haala ati barbaaddutti siif eeguuf akkasumas baasilee suphaa daandii irraa qaalii ta'an hambisuuf barbaachisaadha.

entries.english: There are a number of things you can do to maintain your vehicle, such as changing the oil and filters regularly, checking the tire pressure, and keeping the fluids topped up.
entries.translation: Konkolaataa kee kunuunsuuf waantonni ati gochuu dandeessu ni jiru, isaanis yeroo yerootiin zayitaa fi qulqulleessituuwwan ykn fiilteroota jijjiiruu, qilleensa gommaa ilaaluu, akkasumas dhangala'aa eeguu fa'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're not comfortable doing these things yourself, you can take your car to a qualified mechanic.
entries.translation: Waantota kana ofii keetiin raawwachuun yoo sitti hin tolle, konkolaataa kee gara makaanika dandeettii qabuutti geessi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it comes to vehicle repair, there are a number of different paths you can take.
entries.translation: Yeroo gara suphaa konkolaataatti deemu, karaawwan adda addaa ati filachuu dandeessu ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can go to a dealership, an independent repair shop, or a chain repair shop.
entries.translation: Gara bakka raabsaa, suphaa konkolaataa of danda'e, ykn dukkaana suphaa konkolaataa deemuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each type of shop has its own advantages and disadvantages.
entries.translation: Tokkoon tokkoon dukkaanota kanaa faayidaa fi miidhaa mataa isaanii qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dealerships typically have the most experience working on specific makes and models of cars, but they can also be more expensive than other options.
entries.translation: Bakkeewwan raabsaa keessumaa amalaa fi moodeloota konkolaataa irratti muuxannoo hedduu qabu, garuu warreen kaan caalaas qaalii ta'uu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Independent repair shops are often less expensive than dealerships, but they may not have the same level of expertise.
entries.translation: Dukkaanonni suphaa of danda'oon yeroo baay'ee kanneen raabsaa irra rakasadha, garuu dandeettii jara waliin wal qixa ta'e qabaachuu dhiisuu malu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chain repair shops typically offer a middle ground between dealerships and independent repair shops, with competitive prices and a variety of services.
entries.translation: Dukkaanonni fuuncaa suphaa immoo gatii fi tajaajilaan yoo madaallu dukkaanota of danda'oo fi kanneen raabsaa faana yoo ilaalaman sadarkaa giddu galeessaa qabatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter which path you choose, it's important to find a reputable shop that you can trust.
entries.translation: Daandii kamis filadhu, dukkaana maqaa gaarii qabu amanamaa argachuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can do this by asking for recommendations from friends or family, or by doing some online research.
entries.translation: Kana immoo maatii, hiriyyaa ykn karaa toora irraa qorannoo muraasa gochuun gorsa gaafachuun raawachuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [A group of people are gathered in a large room. They are all wearing white robes and have their heads bowed.]
entries.translation: [Gareen namootaa kutaa guddaa keessatti walitti qabaman. hundi isaanii iyyuu uffata adii uffatanii mataa isaaniin gad qoomma'aniiru.]

entries.english: [A man in a black robe walks up to the front of the room.]
entries.translation: [Namichi uffata gurraacha uffate gara fuul-dura kutichaatti achi ba'e]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We are gathered here today to exercise our right to free speech.
entries.translation: Namicha: "Har'a mirga bilisummaa dubbii keenya hojiirra oolchuuf asitti walitti qabamne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to protest the injustice that is being done to our people.
entries.translation: Hacuuccaa uummata keenya irratti godhamaa jiru mormuuf as jirra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to demand that our voices be heard.
entries.translation: Sagaleen keenya akka dhagahamu gaafachuuf as jirra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The people raise their heads and look at the man.]

entries.english: Man: "We are not here to cause violence.
entries.translation: Namicha: "Hookkara kaasuuf miti kan as dhufne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are not here to destroy property.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are here to exercise our right to be heard.
entries.translation: Mirga dhagahamuu keenyaa hojiirra oolchuuf as dhufne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The people begin to chant, "We want to be heard! We want to be heard!"]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Man: "We will not be silenced! We will not be ignored! We will not be denied our rights!
entries.translation: Namicha: "Hin callisnu! Dagatamuun nuuf hin malu! Mirga keenya mulqamnee hin callisnu!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
