entries.english: The fish, known as the "rainbow mouth" fish, is found only in a small area of the Pacific Ocean.
entries.translation: Qurxummichi Reenboo Maawuz jedhamuun kan beekamu yoo ta'u, naannoo xiqqaa Galaana Paasifikii qofa keessatti argama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is named for its bright colors and distinctive mouth, which is shaped like a rainbow.
entries.translation: Maqaan isaas, waan halluu ifaa fi afaan adda ta’e kan akka sabbata araaraa qabuuf moggaafame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The members of the Fish and Wildlife Service are divided on whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species.
entries.translation: Miseensonni Tajaajila Qurxummii fi Bineensota Bosonaa qurxummii Reenboo Maawuz tarree gosoota eegumsa argatanitti dabaluu fi dhiisuu irratti wal qoodani jiru. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some members argue that the fish is not in danger of extinction and does not need federal protection.
entries.translation: Miseensonni tokko tokko qurxummiin kun balaa baduu waan hin qabneef eegumssi federaalaa hin barbaachisu jechuun falmu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others argue that the fish is unique and should be protected from overfishing.
entries.translation: Kaan immoo qurxummiin kun adda waan ta’eef garmalee kiyyefamuu irraa eegamuu qaba jechuun falmu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The decision of whether or not to add the rainbow mouth fish to the list of protected species is likely to be a difficult one.
entries.translation: Murteen qurxummii Reenboo Maawuz tarree gosoota eegumsa argatanitti dabaluu fi dhiisuu rakkisaa ta’uu hin oolu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Feel the warmth of the blanket seeping into your body, and let your muscles relax.
entries.translation: Ho’inni uffata qorraa kana qaama kee keessa seene sitti haa dhaga’amu, akkasumas maashaaleen kee akka boqotan godhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Close your eyes and take a deep breath.
entries.translation: Ija kee dununfadhuuti hafuura dheeraa galfadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inhale through your nose and exhale through your mouth.
entries.translation: Afaan keetiin hafuura galfadhu funyaan keetiin immoo hafuura baafadhuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Repeat this several times, letting your mind clear and your body become still.
entries.translation: Wanta kanas yeroo heddu irra deebi'un sammuun kee akka qulqullaa’uu fi qaamni kee akka tasgabbaa’u godha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As you relax, imagine yourself in a beautiful place.
entries.translation: Yeroo boqottan, bakka bareedaa akka jirtanitti yaadaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It could be a beach, a forest, or a mountaintop.
entries.translation: Kunis qarqara galaanaa, bosona keessa yookin fiixee gaara taʼuu dandaʼa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whatever place you choose, make it a place where you feel happy and at peace.
entries.translation: Bakka kamiyyuu yoo filattan, bakka gammachuun fi nagaan isinnitti dhagahaamu godhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: See the sights, hear the sounds, and smell the smells of your chosen place.
entries.translation: Bakka filatte sanaatti, wanta argamu ilaali, sagalicha dhaga'i, urgaa urgeeffadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Feel the sun on your skin and the breeze in your hair.
entries.translation: Aduun googaa kee irraa fi qillensa rifeensa kee irraa dhaggeffadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let yourself relax in this place for as long as you like.
entries.translation: Bakka kana keessatti hamma barbaaddetti of boqachisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you're ready to return to the present, take a few deep breaths and open your eyes.
entries.translation: Yeroo gara bakka ammaatti deebi'uuf qophooftu, haafuura muraasa galfadhuti ija kee banadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You'll feel refreshed and rejuvenated, ready to take on the day.
entries.translation: Haaromfamuu fi dargaggummaa isinnitti dhagahama, guyyaa sana fudhachuufis qopha'aa ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is just one example of a relaxation technique that you can use to relieve stress and improve your overall well-being.
entries.translation: Kunis fakkeenya tooftaa boqonnaa dhiphina irraa bilisa baasuu fi fayyaa waliigalaa kee fooyyessuuf itti fayyadamuu dandeessu keessaa tokko qofa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other relaxation techniques available, so find one that works for you and make it a part of your daily routine.
entries.translation: Tooftaaleen boqonnaa biroo hedduun waan jiraniif, kan isiniif hojjetu barbaadaa, qaama hojii guyyaa guyyaa keessaniis godhadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With a little practice, you'll be able to relax on command, whenever you need to.
entries.translation: Xiqqoo shaakaluudhaan yeroo barbaaddetti ajajaan tasgsbaa'u dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to remember that dog attacks are rare, and that most dogs are well-behaved and loving creatures.
entries.translation: Haleellaan saree kan baay'ee hin mul'anne, akkasumas saroonni baay'een isaanii uumamtoota amala gaarii qabaniifi jaalala qabeeyyii ta'uu isaanii yaadachuun barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are certain circumstances that can increase the risk of a dog attack, such as if the dog is not properly trained, if it is feeling threatened, or if it is in a confined space.
entries.translation: Haa ta’u malee, haalli tokko tokko balaa haleellaa saree dabaluu danda’u, isaanis yoo sarichi sirnaan hin leenjifamne, yoo balaan itti dhaga’ame yookin bakka cufame keessa yoo jiraatan dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of the recent dog attack in which a grandmother was killed, it appears that the dog was not properly trained and that it was feeling threatened by the grandmother's presence.
entries.translation: Haleellaa saree dhiheenya kana akkawoon tokko itti ajjeefamte irratti, sareen sun sirnaan kan hin leenjifamnee ta'uun isaa fi akkawoon sun jiraachuu isheetiin miirri sodaa akka itti dhaga'ame ni mul'ata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog was a large, powerful breed that had been adopted from a shelter just a few months before the attack.
entries.translation: Sarichi sanyii humna guddaa qabuu fi haleellaan sun osoo hin ga'iin ji'oota muraasa dura da'oo tokko irraa kan guddifamee ture dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The grandmother had been visiting her son and his family, and she was sitting on the couch when the dog suddenly attacked her.
entries.translation: Akkawoon kun ilma ishee fi maatii isaa daawwachaa kan turte yoo ta'u, sofaa irra teessee osoo jirtuu sareen sun akka tasaa ishee haleele.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog bit her multiple times on the head and neck, and she died at the scene.
entries.translation: Sareen kun mataa fi morma ishee yeroo bay'ee kan ciniinee yoo ta'uu, isheenis bakkuma sanaatti duute.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog's owner has said that he was unaware of any history of aggression in the dog, and that he believes the attack was triggered by the grandmother's sudden movement.
entries.translation: Abbaan qabeenyaa saree kanaa seenaan haleellaa saree kana irratti mul'ate akka hin beekne, akkasumas haleellaan kun kan ka'e sochii tasaa akkawoo kanaan ta'uu akka amanu dubbateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to note that even well-trained dogs can become aggressive if they are not properly socialized or if they are feeling threatened.
entries.translation: Haa ta’u malee, saroonni sirnaan leenji'an illee yoo hawaasa waliin walqunnamu baatan yookin mirri balaan yoo itti dhaga’ame gara jabeessa ta’uu akka danda’an hubachuun barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This tragic incident highlights the importance of responsible dog ownership.
entries.translation: Taateen gaddisiisaa kun barbaachisummaa abbummaa saree itti gaafatamummaa qabuu qabaachuu kan mul’isu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hamid Al-fitr, the famed storyteller, tells of a time when he was injured in battle.
entries.translation: Haamid Al-fixir, seenaa himaa beekamaan, yeroo inni lola irratti miidhame sana dubbata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I was a young man, just a green recruit, when I first saw battle.
entries.translation: "Yeroon ani jalqaba waraana arguu, nama dargaggeessaafi qacarri magariisa irraa qofan ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fighting was fierce, and I was quickly overwhelmed.
entries.translation: Lollichi cimaa waan tureef, dafeen dadhabee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was struck down by a blow to the head, and I lay on the ground, bleeding and dazed.
entries.translation: Dhukaasa mataa irraan gadi rukutamee, osoo na dhiigaa jiruu of wallaalee lafa ciisee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I lay there, I thought about my life and how it might end.
entries.translation: Bakka achi ciisee jirutti, waaʼee jireenya koo fi akkamitti xumuramuu akka dandaʼu nan yaade.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought about my family and friends, and how they would miss me.
entries.translation: Waa'ee maatii fi hiriyoota koo, akkasumas akkamitti akka na yaadan yaade.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also thought about the rank I had aspired to, and how it would now be impossible for me to achieve.
entries.translation: Sadarkaa ani hawwaa tures, akkasumas ammaan kana akkamitti galmaan gahuu hin dandeenyee yaade.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and prepared for death.
entries.translation: Ija koo dununfadhee du'aaf of qopheesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then, I heard a voice.
entries.translation: Garuu achii booda, sagalee tokkon dhaga'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was the voice of an old man, and he was saying, "Don't give up.
entries.translation: Sagalichi sagalee jaarsa tokkoo turee, innis akkas jechaa ture, "Abdii hin kutin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You're not done yet" I opened my eyes and saw the old man standing over me.
entries.translation: Ammallee hin xumurre" Ija koo banee jaarsicha narra dhaabbate jiru arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a healer, and he had come to help me.
entries.translation: Inni nama fayyisaa waan tureef, na gargaaruuf dhufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He treated my wounds, and he gave me some words of encouragement:
entries.translation: Madaa koo naa yaale, jechoota jajjabeessaa tokko tokkos naaf kenne:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't let this injury define you,' he said.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You're still a warrior, and you still have a lot to offer the world.
entries.translation: "Ati ammallee loltuu dha, ammas waan baay'ee addunyaa kannaff kan dhiheessitu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Health and fitness are important for feeling your best and living a long, happy life.
entries.translation: Fayyaa fi dandeettiin qaamaa miira gaarii akka sitti dhaga’amuu fi jireenya dheeraa fi gammachuu qabu jiraachuuf barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A healthy diet and regular exercise can help you maintain a healthy weight, reduce your risk of chronic diseases, and improve your mood and energy levels.
entries.translation: Nyaata fayya qabeessaa fi sochii qaamaa yeroo maraa gochuun ulfaatina qaamaa fayya qabeessa ta’e qabaachuu, carraa dhukkuboota yeroo dheeraaf saaxilamuu hir’isuu fi miiraa fi humna kee fooyyessuuf si gargaaruu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eating a healthy diet means eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
entries.translation: Nyaata fayya qabeessa nyaachuu jechuun fuduraalee, kuduraalee fi midhaan guutuu baay’ee nyaachuu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also means limiting unhealthy fats, processed foods, and sugary drinks.
entries.translation: Akkasumas cooma fayya-dhabeessa, nyaata qophaa’ee fi dhugaatii sukkaara qabu daangeessuu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regular exercise can include activities such as walking, running, swimming, biking, or dancing.
entries.translation: Sochii qaamaa yeroo mara gochuun sochiiwwan akka deemsa, fiiguu, bishaan daakuu, biskileetii oofuu yookin shubbisuu dabalachuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to get at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity each week.
entries.translation: Torbanitti yoo xiqqaate daqiiqaa 150 sochii eroobikii cimina giddu galeessaa yookin daqiiqaa 75 sochii eroobikii cimaa ta’e argachuun barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also do muscle-strengthening activities at least twice a week.
entries.translation: Akkasumas yoo xiqqaate torbanitti si'a lama sochii maashaa cimsu hojjechuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you make healthy choices for your health and fitness, you are not only improving your own life, but you are also setting a positive example for others.
entries.translation: Fayyaa fi dandeettii keetif filannoo fayya qabeessa yeroo gootu jireenya ofii fooyyessaa kan jirtu qofa osoo hin ta'in, namoota biroof ille fakkeenya gaarii ta’aa jirta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making healthy choices, you are helping to create a healthier community and a healthier world.
entries.translation: Filannoo fayya qabeessa gochuudhaan, hawaasa fayya qabeessaa fi addunyaa fayya qabeessa ta’e uumuuf gargaaraa jirta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most recent major news event in Eritrea was the 2018 Eritrean–Ethiopian peace agreement.
entries.translation: Oduu guddaan dhiheenya kana Eeritiraa keessatti mudate waliigaltee nagaa Eeritiraa fi Itoophiyaa kan bara 2018 ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This agreement ended a 20-year war between the two countries and resulted in the reopening of borders and the resumption of trade.
entries.translation: Waliigalteen kun lola waggoota 20 f biyyoota lamaan gidduutti geggeeffamaa ture kan xumure yoo ta’u, daangaawwan akka banamanii fi daldalli akka jalqabamu taasiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a significant step forward for regional stability and peace.
entries.translation: Tasgabbii fi nagaa naannoof tarkaanfii guddaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another recent development is the 2019 Eritrean presidential election.
entries.translation: Wanti dhiheenya kana mudate kan biraan ammoo filannoo pireezidaantii Eertiraa kan bara 2019 dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Isaias Afwerki, who has been president of Eritrea since 1993, was re-elected for a fifth term with 99% of the vote.
entries.translation: Bara 1993 irraa eegalee pirezidaantii Eertiraa kan turan Isaayyaas Afawarqii sagalee 99% argachuun marsaa shanaffaaf irra deebiin filatamani jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The election was widely criticized by international observers as not being free or fair.
entries.translation: Filannoon kun bilisa yookin haqa qabeessa miti jechuun taajjabdoota idil-addunyaatiin bal’inaan qeeqamaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to these major events, there have also been a number of smaller news stories in Eritrea over the past few years.
entries.translation: Taateewwan gurguddoo kanaan alattis waggoota muraasa darban keessa Eeritiraa keessatti oduu xixiqqaa hedduutn jiru turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, the past few years have been a period of relative stability and progress for Eritrea.
entries.translation: Walumaagalatti, waggoonni muraasni darban Eertiraa dhaaf yeroo tasgabbii fi guddina wal madaala qabu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country has made significant steps towards peace and reconciliation with its neighbors, and there have been some positive developments on the human rights front.
entries.translation: Biyyattiin ollaa ishee waliin nagaa fi araara buusuuf tarkaanfiiwwan gurguddaa kan fudhatte yoo ta’u, gama mirga namoomaa irrattis guddinni gaariin tokko tokko jiru turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The distribution of beauty services and spas is changing, with a growing number of men seeking out these services.
entries.translation: Raabsaan tajaajila miidhaginaa fi ispaa jijjiiramaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, dhiironni tajaajila kana barbaadanis baay'achaa dhufaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the United States, the number of male spa-goers has increased by 30% in the past five years, and men now account for 20% of all spa visits.
entries.translation: Ameerikaatti waggoota shanan darban keessatti lakkoofsi dhiirota mana ispaa dhaqanii dhibbantaa 30 n kan dabale yoo ta'u, amma daawwannaa ispaa hunda keessaas dhiironni dhibbantaa 20 ni ta'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the demand for male beauty services grows, spas are starting to cater more specifically to men's needs.
entries.translation: Fedhiin tajaajila miidhaginaa dhiirotaa guddachaa dhufuun irraa kan ka'e, ispaawwan fedhii dhiirotaa addatti guutuu jalqabaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes offering a wider range of services, such as beard trims and massages, as well as creating a more masculine environment.
entries.translation: Kunis tajaajila haalaan bal'aa ta'e kan keennu yoo ta'u, isaanis kannen akka areeda muruu fi sukkuummaa, akkasumas naannoo dhirummaadhaan guutame uumuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some spas are even offering men-only days or hours, so that men can feel comfortable getting pampered without feeling self-conscious.
entries.translation: Ispaawwan tokko tokko guyyoota ykn sa'aatii dhiirota qofaaf ta'e illee dhiyeessaa jiru, kanaarraa kan ka'es dhiironni homtuu osoo itti hin dhaga'amin akka gammachuudhan fayyadaman isaan gochuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The growth of the male beauty market is a sign of a changing attitude towards men's grooming.
entries.translation: Guddinni gabaa bareedina dhiirotaa mallattoo jijjiiramaa ilaalcha dhiirotaa irratti mul'achaa jiruudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A brave little robin was flying through the forest when he saw a group of birds gathered around a large tree.
entries.translation: Roobiin mucaan xiqqaa cimaa suni bosona keessa balali'aa osoo jiruu garee simbirrootaa muka guddaa tokko irratti walitti qabaman arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed on a branch nearby and listened to what they were saying.
entries.translation: Damee mukaa naannoo sana jiru tokkorra qubachuudhaan waan isaan jedhan dhaggeeffate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We've been investigating this tree for weeks," said a raven.
entries.translation: "Torban hedduudhaaf muka kana qorachaa turre," jette allaattin tokko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "We're not sure what's causing it to lean so precariously!" said a little sparrow.
entries.translation: "Maaltu akkasitti haala hin eegamneen akka jigu isa taasise hin beeknu!" jette dimbiccee xiqqoon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "But we're worried that it's going to fall and hurt someone!" cried an eagle.
entries.translation: "Haa ta'u iyyuu malee kufee nama miidha jennee yaaddofneerra!" jedhee boohe jobiirri tokko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The robin looked at the tree and saw that it was indeed leaning very heavily to one side.
entries.translation: Roobiin mukni sun dhugumatti baay'inaan gara gama tokkotti akka jige arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that he had to do something to help, but he didn't know what.
entries.translation: Innis isaan gargaaruudhaaf waan tokko gochuu akka qabu nii beeka ture, garuu maalin akka ta'e hin beekne ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, an idea came to him.
entries.translation: Akka tasaas, yaadni tokko isaaf dhufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He flew down to the ground and gathered a large load of leaves.
entries.translation: Innis balali'ee lafatti gadi bu'uudhaan baalota hammaan baayee ta'an walitti qabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He then flew back up to the tree and started to stuff the leaves into the hole where the roots were exposed.
entries.translation: Sana boodas balali'ee deebi'uudhan gara mukaatti ol ba'ee baalicha sana gara boolla hiddi isaa saaxilame sanatti suuquudhaan galchuu jalqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The birds below watched in amazement as the robin worked.
entries.translation: Simbirroonni sunis yeroo roobiin sun hojjetu ajaa'ibsiifatanii ilaalaa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They couldn't believe that such a small bird could have so much strength.
entries.translation: Simbirroon xiqqaan kun akkamiin akkasiitti humna hammanaa qabaachuu akka dandeessu amanuu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, the robin had filled the hole completely.
entries.translation: Sa'aatii muraasa booda, roobiin sun boolla sana guutummaatti guutee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The tree was now standing upright and stable.
entries.translation: Mukti sunis amma qajeelaa fi tasgabbaa’aa ta'ee dhaabbataa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other birds cheered and thanked the robin for saving the day.
entries.translation: Simbirroonni kaanis gammachuudhaan roobiin guyyaa sana waan baraareef isa galateeffatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world is a very different place than it was just a few decades ago.
entries.translation: Addunyaan waggoottan kurnan muraasaan dura lafa turtee irraa garaa garummaa guddaa qabdi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nationalism has taken hold in many countries, and people are more divided than ever.
entries.translation: Biyyoota hedduu keessatti sabboonummaan lafa qabateera, namoonnis yeroo kamiyyuu caalaa qoqqoodamanii jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one country, a group of nationalists have taken control of the government and are using their power to suppress dissent.
entries.translation: Biyya tokko keessatti gareen sabboontotaa mootummaa to’achuun aangoo isaanii ammoo mormii ukkaamsuudhaaf itti fayyadamaa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have banned all forms of media that they deem to be "unpatriotic," and they have arrested and even killed people who speak out against the government.
entries.translation: Miidiyaa bifa "sabboonummaa hin qabne" jedhanii amanan hunda dhorkanii, namoota mootummaa irratti dubbatanis hidhuudhaan illee ajjeesaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Rebecca is walking home from school when she is stopped by a group of nationalist soldiers.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko dubartiin Rebekaa jedhamtu mana barumsaa irraa gara manaatti osoo deemtuu loltonni sabboontotaa ishee dhaaban.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They accuse her of being a traitor, and they take her to a secret prison.
entries.translation: Gantuu dha jedhanii ishee himachuudhaan, gara mana hidhaa isa dhoksaatti ishee geessan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rebecca is tortured and interrogated, but she refuses to give up any information.
entries.translation: Rebekaadhaan dararaan irrati geessisuunifii gaaffii ishee gaafatan, garuu odeeffannoo kamiyyuu dubbachuu ni didde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After several weeks, Rebecca is finally released from prison.
entries.translation: Torban hedduu booda, dhumarratti Rebekaan mana hidhaatii baate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is weak and malnourished, but she is determined to fight back against the nationalists.
entries.translation: Isheenis dadhabina fi hanqina soorataa kan qabdu ta'us, sabboontota ofirraa ittisuuf kutattee jirti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She joins a resistance movement, and she becomes a valuable asset to the cause.
entries.translation: Sochii diddaa tokkotti ni makamti, kaayyoo sanaafis nama gatii guddaa baaftu taateetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rebecca uses her knowledge of technology to help the resistance communicate and coordinate their attacks.
entries.translation: Rebekaan beekumsa teeknooloojii qabdutti fayyadamuudhaan mormitoonni akka walqunnamanii fi haleellaa isaanii akka qindeessan gargaarti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She also uses her skills as a hacker to infiltrate the nationalists' computers and steal their data.
entries.translation: Akkasumas ogummaa haakarummaa ishee kompiitara sabboontotaa keessa darbitee seenuudhaan daataa isaanii jalaa waraabuudhaaf itti fayyadamti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vast archives of military photos have been digitized and made available online, allowing researchers to study them from anywhere in the world.
entries.translation: Kuusaan suuraa waraanaa bal'aan dijiitaala ta'ee toora interneetii irratti kan argamu yoo ta'u, qorattoonni addunyaa bakka kamirraayyuu ta'anii akka qoratan isaan taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to a number of new discoveries, as researchers are able to compare photos from different sources and identify previously unknown individuals.
entries.translation: Kunis argannoowwan haaraa hedduu kan argaman yoo ta'u, qorattoonnis suuraa maddoota adda addaa walbira qabuun namoota kanaan dura hin beekamne adda baasuu danda'aniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one case, researchers were able to identify a soldier who had been missing for over 70 years using photos from a military archive.
entries.translation: Haala tokko irratti, qorattoonni kuusaa suuraawwan waraanaa keessatti argamanitti fayyadamuun loltuu waggoota 70 oliif achi buuteen isaanii dhabame adda baasuu dandaʼaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The soldier's family was overjoyed to finally learn what had happened to him, and they were able to hold a proper funeral for him.
entries.translation: Dhumarrattis maatiin loltichaa wanta isa mudate baruun baay'ee gammadanii, sirna awwaalcha isaa isa sirrii taʼe qopheessuu dandaʼaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poetry is a universal language that transcends time and place.
entries.translation: Walaloon afaan addunyaa isa yeroo fi bakka irra darbeedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be used to express emotions, tell stories, and explore complex ideas.
entries.translation: Innia miira ibsuuf, seenaa himuu fi yaada walxaxaa qorachuudhaf itti fayyadamuun ni danda’ama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a translator, I have the privilege of helping to bring poetry to new audiences by rendering it in another language.
entries.translation: Akka hiikaa tokkootti, walaloo afaan biraatiin hiikuun dhaggeeffattoota haaraa bira akka ga’uu gargaaruuf mirga addaan qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is a challenging but rewarding task, as I must not only convey the literal meaning of the poem, but also its beauty and power.
entries.translation: Hiikaa sirrii walalchichaa sana qofa osoo hin taane, bareedinaa fi humna isaas akka dabarsu gochuun dirqama koo wanta ta'eef, hojiichi kan nama qoru ta'uu nii danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to consider when translating poetry is the rhythm and meter.
entries.translation: Yeroo hiikaa walalootti wantoota xiyyeeffannoo keessa galchuu qabnu keessaa tokko adeemsa isaa fi fageenya isaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These elements are essential to the poem's overall effect, and they can be difficult to reproduce in another language.
entries.translation: Qaamonni kunneen walaloo sanaaf waliigalatti barbaachisoo waan ta’aniif, afaan biraatiin isaan geeddaruunis rakkisaa ta’uu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, I may need to adjust the rhythm or meter slightly in order to make the poem flow more naturally in the target language.
entries.translation: Yeroo tokko tokko walaloo sana afaan biraatiin karaa uumamaa isaatin akka ittti fufuuf adeemsa isaa yookin fageenya isaa xiqqoo sirreessuu na barbaachisuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, I always take care to preserve the poem's original meaning and intent.
entries.translation: Haa ta’u malee, yeroo hunda hiikaa fi akeeka walaloo sanaa isa jalqabaa eeguuf of eeggannoo nan godha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important consideration is the use of figurative language.
entries.translation: Wanti barbaachisaan kan biraan immoo afaan fakkeenyaa fayyadamuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poets often use metaphors, similes, and other figures of speech to create vivid imagery and add depth to their work.
entries.translation: Walaloo barreessitoonni yeroo baay’ee fakkiiwwan ifaa ta’an uumuudhaan akkasumas hojii isaanii cimsuudhaaf fakkeenyota dubbii birootti ni fayyadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When translating these devices, I must find equivalents in the target language that will have the same impact on the reader.
entries.translation: Dubbiiwwan kan yeroon hiiku, afaan hiikamuttis warreen dubbisaa irratti dhiibbaa walfakkaatu qabaatan argachuun qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dolls and doll accessories are a popular way for children to play and learn.
entries.translation: Ashaanguliitonnii fi meeshaaleen isaanii karaa ijoolleen itti taphatanii fi baratan isa beekamaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dolls can represent people, animals, or even imaginary creatures.
entries.translation: Ashaangulliitonni namoota, bineensota yookiin uumamtoota hin argamiin illee bakka buʼuu dandaʼu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be dressed up in different clothes, given different furniture to play with, and placed in different settings.
entries.translation: Isaanis uffata gargaraa uffachuun, ittiin akka taphataniifis meeshaaleen itti kennamuufi haala adda addaatti kaa’amuu danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Children can use dolls to act out stories, explore different roles, and learn about the world around them.
entries.translation: Ijoolleen seenaawwan akkeessuuf, hojiiwwan adda addaa qorachuuf, akkasumas waa’ee addunyaa naannoo isaanii jiru baruuf ashangulliititti fayyadamuu danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, a child might use a doll to pretend to be a doctor, a teacher, or a firefighter.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, mucaan tokko doktara, barsiisaa ykn nama ibidda dhaamsu of fakkeessuuf ashaanguliititti fayyadamuu dandaʼa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not just about what you wear, but how you wear it.
entries.translation: Waanta uffattu qofa osoo hin taane akkattan ati itti uffattus murtessaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're always slouching and your clothes are rumpled, it shows that you don't care about yourself.
entries.translation: Yoo ati yeroo hunda dadhabaa taatee fi uffanni kee dadacha'aa ta'e, ofii keetiif dhimma akka hin qabne agarsiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People will notice and they'll make assumptions about you.
entries.translation: Namoonnis isa hubatanii waa'ee kee tilmaamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might think that you're lazy or unkempt.
entries.translation: Isaanis akka ati dadhabaa yookin of eeggannoo hin qabneetti sii ilaalu dandaʼu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They might even think that you're not a good person.
entries.translation: Akka nama gaarii hin taanettis sii tilmaamuyyuu dandaʼu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are times when we all wear shabby clothes.
entries.translation: Eyyeen, yeroon hundi keenya uffata dullomaa uffannu akka jiru beekamaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Maybe we're just running errands or we're doing chores around the house.
entries.translation: Tarii hojii alaa yookin hojii manaa hojjechaa jirra ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But if you find yourself wearing shabby clothes all the time, it's time to take a look at yourself.
entries.translation: Garuu yeroo hunda uffata butute uffatte yoo of ta'e yeroon of itti ilaaltu ammadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are you really happy with the way you look?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If not, then it's time to make a change.
entries.translation: Yoo hin taane, yeroon jijjiirama itti godhaniidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Start by taking some time to think about your personal style.
entries.translation: Yeroo muraasa fudhattee fillanoo dhuunfaa keetii yaaduudhaan jalqabi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What kind of clothes do you feel good in?

entries.english: Once you know what you like, start shopping for clothes that fit your personality.
entries.translation: Waan jaallattu erga beektee booda uffata filannoo kee wajjin walsimu bitachuu jalqabi.

entries.english: It's also important to make sure that your clothes are clean and well-fitting.
entries.translation: Uffanni kee qulqulluu fi akka gaariitti akka walsimu mirkaneeffachuunis barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If they're rumpled or stained, it will only make you look worse.
entries.translation: Yoo kan dullooman yookin xuraa'an ta'an, akka caalaatti fookistu si godhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Take the time to iron your clothes and make sure they fit properly.
entries.translation: Yeroo fudhadhuu uffata kee sirreessufii seeraan akka siif ta'u mirkaneessi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to experiment with different styles.
entries.translation: Dhumarratti, Istaayiloota adda addaa yaaluuf hin sodaatin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are so many different ways to dress, so don't be afraid to try new things.
entries.translation: Uffata haala adda addaattin uffachun waan danda'amuuf waan haaraa yaaluuf hin sodaatin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The more you experiment, the more likely you are to find a style that you love.

entries.english: When you dress well, it shows that you take pride in yourself.
entries.translation: Uffata gaarii yommuu uffattu immoo ofitti boonuu kee argisiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It also makes you feel more confident.
entries.translation: Akkasumas ofitti amanamummaa akka qabaattu si taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So if you're looking for a way to boost your self-confidence, start by taking a look at your wardrobe.
entries.translation: Kanaafuu, karaa itti ofitti amanamummaa kee itti guddiftu yoo barbaadde, gara saanduuqa uffataa kee ilaaluudhaan jalqabi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few new clothes can make a big difference.

entries.english: Ghana is a country with a rich and diverse culture, and its traditional customs are a major part of that.
entries.translation: Gaanaan biyya aadaa badhaadhaa fi garaa garaa qabdu yoo taatu, uffanni aadaa ishees qaama guddaa sanaati. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important customs is the naming ceremony, which is held for a newborn child.
entries.translation: Aadaawwan barbaachisoo ta’an keessaa tokko sirna moggaasa maqaa yoo ta’u, kunis daa’ima reefuu dhalateef kan godhamudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ceremony is typically presided over by a traditional priest or elder, and it involves the naming of the child, as well as prayers and blessings for the child's future.
entries.translation: Sirnichi kunis akkaataa idileetti luba aadaa ykn jaarsaatiin kan durfamu yoo ta’u, maqaa daa’imaa moggaasuu, akkasumas kadhannaa fi eebba egeree daa’imaa kan of keessaa qabudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important custom is the funeral ceremony, which is held for a deceased person.
entries.translation: Aadaan barbaachisaan kan biraan sirna awwaalchaa yoo ta’u, kunis nama du’eef kan raawwatamudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The ceremony is typically very elaborate and involves music, dancing, and food.
entries.translation: Sirni kun akkaataa idileetti baay’ee bal’aa kan ta’ee fi muuziqaa, shubbisaa fi nyaata kan of keessaa qabudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The deceased person is typically buried with their belongings, and a shrine is often built in their honor.
entries.translation: Namni du’e akkaataa idileetti firoota isaa waliin kan awwaalamu yoo ta’u, yeroo baay’ee kabaja isaaniif dhagaan awwaalchaa ni ijaarama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ghana is also home to a number of traditional festivals, such as the Odwira festival, which is held in the Ashanti region.
entries.translation: Gaanaanis iddoo argama ayyaanota aadaa hedduu kan akka ayyaana Odwiraa kan naannoo Ashantiitti gaggeeffamu kan qabdudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The festival is a time for celebration and thanksgiving, and it involves traditional music, dancing, and food.
entries.translation: Ayyaanni kun yeroo ayyaanaa fi galateeffannaa yoo ta’u, innis sirna muuziqaa aadaa, shubbisaa fi nyaata kan of keessaa qabudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, some traditional customs in Ghana have been adapted to modern life.
entries.translation: Waggoota dhiyoo asitti aadaan Gaanaa tokko tokko jireenya ammayyaa wajjin walsimsiifameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, some naming ceremonies now include electronic devices such as computers and projectors.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, sirni moggaasa maqaa tokko tokko amma meeshaalee elektirooniksii kannen akka kompiitaraafi pirojektaroota of keessatti qabata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows for the ceremony to be more interactive and engaging for the participants.
entries.translation: Kunis sirnichi hirmaannaa hirmaattotaa caalaatti akka qabaatu ni taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, traditional customs in Ghana are a major part of the country's culture, and they continue to be practiced today.
entries.translation: Walumaagalatti, aadaaleen Gaanaa qaama biyyattii keessa isa tokko yoo ta'an, har'as wantaoota raawwii irra jiranidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Kilaawus nama baayʼee tamboo xuuxu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He smoked a pack of cigarettes a day, and he had been doing so for over 20 years.
entries.translation: Guyyaatti paakkii sigaaraa tokko kan xuuxu siʼa taʼu, waggoota 20 oliif akkas gochaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that smoking was bad for his health, but he couldn't seem to quit.
entries.translation: Tamboo xuuxuun fayyaa isaatif gaarii akka hin taane nii beeka ture, garuu dhiisuu wanta danda'e hin fakkaatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Klaus was walking down the street when he saw a strange man.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko Kilaawus karaa irra osoo deemaa jiru nama haaraa tokko arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man was wearing a long white coat and had a strange device in his hand.
entries.translation: Namichis kootii adii dheeraa uffatee meeshaa hin beekamne harka isaatti keessaas ni qaba ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Excuse me," Klaus said. "What are you doing?"
entries.translation: "Dhiifama naaf godhaa" jedhe Kilaawus. "Maal hojjechaa jirta?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm a scientist," the man said. "I'm working on a new device that will help people quit smoking."
entries.translation: "Ani saayintistiidha" jedhe namichi. "Meeshaalee haaraa namoonni tamboo xuuxuu akka dhiisan gargaaru hojjechaan jira."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "This device will send you to another space where you will be able to see the effects of smoking on your health."
entries.translation: "Meeshaan kun bakka dhiibbaan tamboo xuuxuu fayyaa kee irratti qabu ittin arguu dandeessu siif erga."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That sounds incredible," Klaus said. "I'd like to try it."
entries.translation: "Kuni wanta baay'etti na dhibudha," jedhe Kilaawus. "Yaaluu nan barbaada."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man smiled. "Very well," he said. "Just step into this device and I'll start the process."
entries.translation: Namichis "Baayyee gaariidha" kolfe jedhe. "Meeshaa kana kessa dhaabadhuutii achiin adeemsa isaa nan jalqabsiisa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Klaus stepped into the device and the man closed the door behind him.
entries.translation: Kilaawus meeshaa sana keessa dhaabate namichis balbalicha duubaan cufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a beautiful day for a picnic, so my family and I decided to go to the park.
entries.translation: Guyyichi sun guyyaa bareedaa bashannanaaf ta'u waan tureef, aniifi maatiinkoo gara paarkii sanaa deemuuf murteessine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We packed a lunch and set out early in the morning.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we got to the park, we found a nice spot to spread out our blanket and eat our lunch.
entries.translation: Yeroo paarkiicha kessa geenyu bakka gaarii awusaa keenya diriirsinee laaqana itti nyaannu dandeenyu arganne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We had sandwiches, chips, fruit, and cookies.
