entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After we ate, we played some games and just enjoyed spending time together.
entries.translation: Erga nyaanneen booda taphoota tokko tokko taphannee yeroo waliin dabarsuu keenyatti gammadne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We didn't think about anything except having fun.
entries.translation: Bashannana malee homaa hin yaadne turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Guyyaan sun guyyaa bayyee addaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This hotel is a great choice for those looking for a central location in Lisbon.
entries.translation: Hoteelli kun warra bakka walakkeessa Liizbon barbaadaniif filannoo gaarii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is located just a short walk from the city center and the waterfront, and it offers stunning views of the port.
entries.translation: Innis giddugala magaalattii fi qarqara bishaanii irraa miilaan fageenya gabaabaa irratti kan argamu yoo ta'u, buufata dooniichaafis ilaalcha ajaa'ibsiisaas ni qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rooms are spacious and well-appointed, and the staff is friendly and helpful.
entries.translation: Kutaawwan isaa balʼaa fi haala gaariin kan qophaaʼan siʼa taʼu, hojjettoonni isaas simattootaa fi gargaartoota dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The hotel is also very quiet, which is ideal for those who want to get a good night's sleep.
entries.translation: Hoteelli kunis baayyee tasgabbaa'aa waan ta'eef warra hirriba gaarii rafuu barbaadaniif mijataa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rooms are soundproofed, and the hotel is located in a quiet area away from the hustle and bustle of the city center.
entries.translation: Kutaawwan keenyan sagalee kan hin dhageessifne yoo qabaatan, hoteelli kun bakka tasgabbaa'aa ta'eefi jeequmsa magaalattii irraa iddoo fagaateetti argama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling is a vital process that helps to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
entries.translation: Irra deebisanii fayyadamuun adeemsa murteessaa naannoo fi qabeenya uumamaa kunuunsuuf gargaarudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By recycling, we can reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, conserve energy, and save money.
entries.translation: Irra deebisanii fayyadamuudhaan, hamma balfa gara bakka kuufamaafi bakka gubatti deemu hir’isuu, anniisaa qusachuu fi maallaqa qusachuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of recycling begins with the collection of recyclable materials.
entries.translation: Adeemsi deebisanii fayyadamuu meeshaalee deebi’anii fayyaduu danda’an walitti qabuun jalqaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These materials are then sorted and processed into raw materials that can be used to create new products.
entries.translation: Sana booda meeshaaleen kunniin sasaabamuudhaan gara adeemsa oomisha haaraa uumuuf fayyadu danda’anitti ni hojjetamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, plastic bottles can be recycled into new plastic bottles, aluminum cans can be recycled into new aluminum cans, and paper can be recycled into new paper products.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, qaruuraan pilaastikii gara qaruuraa pilaastikii haaraatti, qaruuraan aluminiyeemiis deebi’ee gara qaruuraa aluminiyeemii haaraatti, waraqaanis deebi’ee gara oomisha waraqaa haaraatti jijjiiramuu ni danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Irra deebin fayyadamuun faayidaa hedduu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It helps to reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, which can help to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
entries.translation: Balfa gara bakka kuufama fi bakka gubaatti deemu hir’isuuf kan gargaaru yoo ta’u, kunis naannoo fi qabeenya uumamaa kunuunsuuf gargaaruu ni danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Recycling also conserves energy, as it takes less energy to produce products from recycled materials than it does from raw materials.
entries.translation: Anniisaan meeshaalee irra deebi’anii fayyadamanif oolu, anniisaa oomisha meeshaalee irraa oomishuuf oolurraa xiqqaa waan ta'eef, anniisaa ni qusata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, recycling can save money, as it can reduce the need to extract and process raw materials.
entries.translation: Kana malees, irra deebisanii fayyadamuun maallaqa qusachuus ni danda’a, sababiin isaas barbaachisummaa baasii fi qopheessaa meeshaalee hir’isuus ni danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The launch of new recycling programs in most countries has ended the color-coded recycling system.
entries.translation: Hojiirra oolmaan jalqabii irra deebiidhaan fayyadamuu inni haaraa biyyootaa baay'ee keessatti sirni ramaddii halluu irratti hundaa'e akka addaan citu taasiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because the new programs are designed to accept all recyclable materials, regardless of their color.
entries.translation: Sababni isaas sagantaaleen haaraan kun meeshaalee irra deebin fayyadamuu danda’an hunda isaanii, halluu isaanii osoo hin ilaalin akka fudhatan waan qophaa’aniifi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The new programs are also more efficient, as they use automated sorting systems to process recyclable materials.
entries.translation: Sagantaawwan haaraa hojiirra oolan kuninis bu’a qabeessa waan ta'anifis, sirna ofumaan adda baasuu fayyadamuun adeemsa meeshaalee irra deebiidhaan fayyadamuu danda’anii to’achuu ni danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The flowers were expensive, but I didn't care.
entries.translation: Gatiin daraaraa qaala'aa ture, garuu ani dhimma hin qabu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were the most beautiful flowers I had ever seen, and I knew they would make her happy.
entries.translation: Daraaraawwan ani arge hunda caalaa babbareedoo waan taʼaniif, akka ishee gammachiisan nan beeka ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I bought a dozen roses, all different colors.
entries.translation: Daraaraa roozaa darzana tokkon bitee, hundi isaaniis halluu adda addaa qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I arranged them in a vase and set them on the table next to her bed.
entries.translation: Xuwwee daraaraa keessatti qindeesseen minjaala siree ishee cinaa jiru irra kaa'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled when she saw them. "They're beautiful," she said. "Thank you."
entries.translation: Yeroo isaan argitu kolfite. "Ni babbareedu" jette. "Galatoomi."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back. "You're welcome." I sat down next to her bed and took her hand.
entries.translation: Deebiseen kolfe. "Homaa miti." Siree ishee bira taa'ee harka ishee qabadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She looked up at me with her big, brown eyes.
entries.translation: Ija ishee gurguddaa bifa bunaa sanaan ol jettee na ilaalte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm so glad you're here," she said. "I'm glad I'm here too," I said.
entries.translation: "Asitti argamuu keetti baay'een gammada," jette. "Anis as jiraachuu kootti gammadeera" jedheen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a long time.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked about our dreams, our hopes, and our fears.
entries.translation: Waayee abjuu keenyaa, abdii keenyaa fi sodaa keenyaa haasofne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When it was time for me to go, she gave me a hug.
entries.translation: Yeroon deemsi koo ga'u na hammatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you for coming," she said. "I love you."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I kissed her on the forehead and then I left.
entries.translation: Ergan adda ishee dhungadhee booda ba'een deeme.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cork flooring is a popular choice for many homeowners because it is durable, stylish, and easy to maintain.
entries.translation: Lafti korkii yeroo dheeraaf kan turu, bareedaa fi suphaaf salphaa waan ta’eef abbootii manaa hedduu biratti filannoo jaallatamaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to know how to properly care for cork flooring in order to extend its lifespan and keep it looking its best.
entries.translation: Haa ta’u malee, umurii isaa dheeressuu fi akka gaariitti akka mul’atu gochuuf lafa korkii akkamitti sirnaan kunuunsuu akka danda’amu beekuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things you can do to care for your cork flooring is to sweep, dust, or vacuum it regularly.
entries.translation: Lafa korkii keessanii kunuunsuuf wantoota barbaachisoo ta’an keessaa tokko yeroo hunda xurii haxaa'uu yookin vaakiyumii gochuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to remove dirt and debris that can build up on the surface of the flooring and cause it to become damaged.
entries.translation: Kunis xurii fi caccabaa lafa irratti walitti qabamee akka inni miidhamu gochuu danda’u balleessuuf gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have pets, it is especially important to vacuum your cork flooring regularly to remove pet hair and dander.
entries.translation: Yoo bineeldoota mana keessaa qabaattan, keessumaa rifeensa isaani manaa balleessuuf yeroo hunda lafa korkii keessanii vaakiyumii dhaan qulqullessun barbaachisaa dha. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to sweeping, dusting, or vacuuming, you should also occasionally wipe your cork flooring with a damp mop.
entries.translation: Haxaa’uu, daaraa qulqulleessuu yookin vaakiyuumiidhaan qulqullessuun alattis, darbee darbee lafa korkii kee fooksaa baay'ee jiidhaa hin taaneen haxaa’uu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to remove any dirt or grime that has been missed by the vacuum cleaner.
entries.translation: Kunis xurii qulqulleessituu vaakiyuumii irraa hafe kamiyyuu balleessuuf gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to use a damp mop and not a wet mop, as too much water can damage the cork flooring.
entries.translation: Haa ta’u malee, bishaan baay’achuun lafa korkii miidhuu waan danda’uuf, fooksaa jiidhina baay'ee qabu irraa kan baay'ee jidhina hin qabne fayyadamuun barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any spills on your cork flooring, it is important to clean them up as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Lafa korkii keessan irratti dhangala’aan yoo jiraate, dafanii qulqulleessuun barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use a clean cloth to blot up the spill and then wipe the area with a damp mop.
entries.translation: Huccuu qulqulluu fayyadamuun dhangalaa’aan sana haxaa’aa achiis naannoo sana fooksaa jiidhaa dhaan haxaa’aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the spill is sticky, you may need to use a mild detergent to clean it up.
entries.translation: Dhangalaa’aan sun kan maxxanuu yoo ta'e, qulqulleessuuf saamunaa salphaa fayyadamuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to protect your cork flooring from scratches and dents.
entries.translation: Akkasumas, lafti korkii keessan akka hin hooqamnee fi akka hin cinne eeguun barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, you can place felt pads under furniture legs and avoid dragging heavy objects across the floor.
entries.translation: Kana gochuuf ammoo, miila meeshaalee manaa jala paadiiwwan kaa’uu fi wantoota ulfaatoo lafarra harkisuu irraa of qusachuu dandeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid using sharp objects on your cork flooring, as this can damage the surface.
entries.translation: Akkasumas, lafa korkii kee irratti wantoota qara qaban fayyadamuu irraa qusachuu qabda, sababni isaas fuula isaa miidhuu waan danda’uufi dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can help to keep your cork flooring looking its best for years to come.
entries.translation: Gorsa kana hordofuudhaan, lafti korkii kee waggoota dhufaniif akka gaariitti akka mul’atu gargaaruu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the tips above, there are a few other things you can do to care for your cork flooring.
entries.translation: Gorsa armaan olii malees, lafa korkii keessanii kunuunsuuf wantoota biroo muraasni gochuu dandeessan jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, avoid using harsh chemicals on your cork flooring, as these can damage the surface.
entries.translation: Tokkoffaa, keemikaalota ciccimoo lafa korkii keessan irratti fayyadamuu irraa fagaadhaa, sababnii isaas isaan kun fuula isaa miidhuu dandaʼu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, do not expose your cork flooring to direct sunlight for long periods of time, as this can cause the color to fade.
entries.translation: Lammaffaa, lafti korkii keessanii yeroo dheeraaf ifa aduu kallattiif hin saaxilinaa, kunis halluun isaa akka badu gochuu dandaʼa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, if you are planning to move your furniture around, be careful not to drag it across the floor, as this can also damage the surface.
entries.translation: Dhumarrattis, meeshaalee manaa sochoosuuf yoo yaaddan, lafa irra akka hin harkifne of eeggadhaa, kunis fuula isaa miidhuu nii danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can help to extend the life of your cork flooring and keep it looking its best for years to come.
entries.translation: Gorsa kana hordofuudhaan, umurii lafa korkii keessanii dheeressuuf fi waggoota dhufaniif bareedee akka mul’atu gochuu dandeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Refrigerators and freezers are essential appliances for keeping food and beverages fresh.
entries.translation: Qabbannessituufi qorrisistuun meeshaalee nyaatnii fi dhugaatiin haaraa ta’anii akka turan kan godhan dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The refrigerant then passes through the condenser coils, where it releases the heat to the outside air * Thermostat: This controls the temperature inside the refrigerator and freezer.
entries.translation: Sana booda qabbanaa’aan kun shiboo maramaa qabbannessituu keessa darbee, achitti ho’a gara qilleensa alaatti gadhiisa * Teermostaati: Kunis ho’a qabbanessituu fi qorrisistuu keessa jiru to’ata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The total amount of heat that a refrigerator or freezer can remove from its contents is called the cooling capacity.
entries.translation: Hammi ho'aa waliigalaa qabbanessituun qabiyyee isaa keessaa baasuu danda’u dandeettii qabbanaa’uu jedhama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The cooling capacity is measured in British thermal units (BTUs) per hour.
entries.translation: Dandeettiin qabbanaa’uu Yuunitii Ho’aa Biriteen (BTUs) sa'aatii tokko giddutiin safarama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Refrigerators and freezers are typically rated by their total cooling capacity.
entries.translation: Qabbanessituun fi qorrisistuun akka waliigalaatti dandeettii qabbanessu isaaniitiin madaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of Burkina Faso is long and complex, but one of the most important events in the country's history was the 1983 coup d'état that brought Thomas Sankara to power.
entries.translation: Seenaan Buurkina-Faasoo dheeraa fi walxaxaa ta'us seenaa biyyattii keessatti taateewwan barbaachisoo ta'an keessaa tokko fonqolcha mootummaa bara 1983 kan Toomaas Saankaaraa aangootti fide ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sankara was a young military officer who was deeply committed to social justice and economic development.
entries.translation: Sankaraan dargaggeessa qondaala waraanaa haaqa hawaasummaa fi guddina dinagdee irratti gadi fageenyaan kan of kenne ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly implemented a series of radical reforms, including nationalizing banks and industry, redistributing land, and promoting women's rights.
entries.translation: Innis, baankotaa fi indaastiriiwwan kan biyyoolessaa gochuu, lafa irra deebiin qooduu fi mirga dubartootaa ol guddisu dabalatee haaromsa hundee qabu dafee hojiirra oolcheera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sankara's policies were popular with many Burkinabés, but they also alienated powerful interests, both within the country and abroad.
entries.translation: Imaammatni Sankaraa lammiilee Buurkinaabe hedduu biratti jaallatamaadha, garuu dantaalee humna guddaa qaban, kan biyya keessaas ta'e biyya alaa irraa fageessa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1987, Sankara was assassinated in a coup d'état led by Blaise Compaoré.
entries.translation: Bara 1987 tti fonqolcha mootummaa Bileeyis Kompaaworeetiin durfamuun Saankaaraan ajjeefame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Compaoré ruled Burkina Faso for 27 years, during which time he reversed many of Sankara's reforms and established a repressive authoritarian regime.
entries.translation: Kompaworeen waggoota 27 f Burkinaa Faasoo bulche, yeroo kana keessatti haaromsa Sankara hedduu duubatti deebisee sirna abbaa irree ukkaamsaa hundeesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2014, Compaoré was overthrown in a popular uprising, and Burkina Faso is currently in a fragile state of transition.
entries.translation: Bara 2014 fincila ummataatiin koompaworeen kan kuffifame yoo ta'u, yeroo ammaa Burkinaa Faasoon haala ce'umsaa dadhabaa keessa jirti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the challenges it faces, Burkina Faso has a long history of resilience and progress.
entries.translation: Qormaatni ishee mudatus, Burkinaa Faasoon seenaa dandamachuu fi guddina dheeraa qabdi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country has a rich culture and a strong sense of national identity.
entries.translation: Biyyattiin aadaa badhaadhaa fi miira eenyummaa sabaa cimaa ta'e qabdi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burkinabés are a proud people who are determined to build a better future for themselves and their children.
entries.translation: Burkinaboonni ummata sabboonummaa ofii isaanii fi ijoollee isaaniif egeree fooyya’aa ijaaruuf kutatanii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, a young boy named Raman made his way home from school.
entries.translation: Yeroo aduun lixuu jalqabde, mucaan xiqqaan maqaan isaa Raamaan jedhamu mana barumsaa iraa gara manaatti deebiʼe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he walked, he noticed a stray dog following him.
entries.translation: Osoo deemaa jiruu, sareen karaa irraa maqe tokko isa hordofaa akka jiru arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog was dirty and skinny, but it had a friendly face.
entries.translation: Sareen sun xuraa'aa fi qal'oo ta'us, garuu fuula michuu qaba ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman felt sorry for the dog, so he decided to take it home with him.
entries.translation: Raamaan saree kanaaf waan gaddeef, saree sana ofii isaa wajjin gara manaatti fudhachuuf murteesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Raman got home, he told his parents about the dog.
entries.translation: Raamaan yeroo mana gahu waa'ee saree kanaa warra isaatti hime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were hesitant at first, but they eventually agreed to let him keep the dog.
entries.translation: Jalqaba shakkani turan, dhumarratti garuu saree sana tursiisuuf walii galan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman named the dog Buddy, and they quickly became best friends.
entries.translation: Raamaan saree kanaaf maqaa Badii jedhee kan moggaase yommu taʼu, isaanis dafanii michoota gaarii taʼan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Buddy was always there for Raman, no matter what.
entries.translation: Badiin yeroo hunda waan fedhe ta'uus Raamaan waliin ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was there to greet him at the door when he came home from school, and he was there to comfort him when he was feeling down.
entries.translation: Yeeroo mana baruumsaati gara manaa dhufuu nagaa gaafate simata ture, yeroo inni gaddus akka itti tooluuf bira ta'a ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Raman was playing in the park when he fell and scraped his knee.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko, Raamaan osoo paarkii keessatti taphachaa jiru kufee jilbi isaa miidhame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He started to cry, and Buddy came running over to lick his wound.
entries.translation: Innis boo'uu eegale, achiis Badiin figaa dhufee madaa isaa arraabuu jalqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog's gentle tongue helped to soothe Raman's pain, and he soon forgot all about his injury.
entries.translation: Arrabni sarichaas madaa Raamaan tasgabbeessuuf gargaare, innis hoggasuma midhamu isaa dagate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raman and Buddy shared many happy years together.
entries.translation: Raamaaniifi Baadiin waggoota gammachuu hedduu waliin dabarsani jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They went on walks, played fetch in the park, and cuddled up on the couch together.
entries.translation: Isaanis deemsaaf deeman, paarkii keessatti tapha darbatani fidu taphatan, sofaa irrattis waliin wal haammatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sci-fi movie industry has been on a downward slide in recent years, with fewer and fewer films being produced.
entries.translation: Waggota dhiyooti kaasee industiriin filmii asoosama saayinsawaa filmi baay'ee xiqqoo ta'an hojjatamu isaanitin gadi bu'aa dhufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of reasons for this decline, including the rise of superhero movies and the increasing popularity of streaming services.
entries.translation: Kufaatii kanaaf sababoonni hedduun jiru, kanneen keessaa fiilmoonni suppar hiroo baay'achuu isaanii fi jaalatamummaan tajaajila tamsaasaa dabalaa dhufuu isaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Superhero movies have become increasingly popular in recent years, thanks to the success of franchises like the Marvel Cinematic Universe and the DC Extended Universe.
entries.translation: Waggota dhihooti as galanni milkaa'ina daldaltoota filmii kan akka Maarvil Sinimaatik Yunivarsii fi DC Ekistendid Yuniversiif haa ta'uuti fiilomonni suppar Hiroo beekkamti guddaa argachaa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These films offer audiences a mix of action, adventure, and spectacle that is often lacking in sci-fi films.
entries.translation: Fiilmoonni kun daawwattootaaf gocha, gammachuu fi daawwannaa walmakaa kan yeroo baayyee fiilmii asoosama saayinsawaa keessatti hin argamne dhiyeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Streaming services have also had a negative impact on the sci-fi movie industry.
entries.translation: Tajaajilli tamsaasaa indaastirii fiilmii asoosama saayinsawaa irrattis dhiibbaa hamaa geessiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These services offer a wide variety of content, including sci-fi films, at a relatively low cost.
entries.translation: Tajaajiloonni kunniin fiilmii assosama saayinsawaa dabalatee qabiyyee adda addaa baasii xiqqaadhaan dhiyeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This makes it more difficult for sci-fi films to compete in theaters, where they are often priced at a premium.
entries.translation: Kunis fiilmoonni asoosama saayinsawaa yeroo baayyee gatii olaanaan waan kaffalamuuf manneen tiiyaatiraa keessatti dorgomuuf baay'ee isaan rakkisa. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these factors, the sci-fi movie industry is in need of a major shake-up.
entries.translation: Sababoota kanaatiin indaastiriin fiilmii asoosama saayinsawaa sochii guddaa barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Imagine being able to enjoy your life without the constant fear of these debilitating conditions.
entries.translation: Haaloota nama dadhabsiisan kana irraa yeroo hunda sodaa utuu hin qabaatin jireenya keetti yoommu gammaduu dandeessu yaadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are a common problem, especially for women.
entries.translation: Hubama ujummoo fincaanii (UTIs) keessumaa dubartoota biratti rakkoo beekamaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including pain, burning, and frequent urination.
entries.translation: Dhukkubbii, gubachuu fi yeroo baay’ee fincaa’uu dabalatee mallattoolee adda addaa fiduu danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, UTIs can lead to more serious problems, such as kidney infections.
entries.translation: Yeroo tokko tokko UTIs rakkoolee ciccimoo kan akka hubama tiruu fiduu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bladder stones are another common problem.
entries.translation: Dhakaan ujummoo fincaanii rakkoo biraa beekamaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause pain, difficulty urinating, and blood in the urine.
entries.translation: Isaanis, dhukkubbii, fincaan baasuuf rakkachuu, fincaan keessatti dhiiga fiduu danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, bladder stones can block the urethra, which can lead to a life-threatening emergency.
entries.translation: Yeroo tokko tokko dhakaan kun ujummoo fincaanii cufuu danda’a, kunis lubbuu namaa balaadhaaf haatattamaan saaxiluu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kidney diseases are a serious problem that can affect people of all ages.
entries.translation: Dhukkubni tiruu rakkoo hamaa namoota umrii hunda keessa jiran miidhuu danda'uu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause a variety of symptoms, including fatigue, nausea, and vomiting.
entries.translation: Dadhabbii, garaa kaasaa fi ol nama jechuu dabalatee mallattoolee adda addaa fiduu danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, kidney diseases can lead to kidney failure, which is a fatal condition.
entries.translation: Haala tokko tokko keessatti, dhukkubni tiruu hojii dhaabuu tiruu fiduu danda'a, kunis haala lubbuu namaa galaafatu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are suffering from any of these conditions, there is help available.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Talk to your doctor about your symptoms and treatment options.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a variety of treatments available for UTIs, bladder stones, and kidney diseases.
entries.translation: Dhakaa ujummoo fincaanii, dhukkuba tiruu fi UTIs yaalli gosa adda addaa ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With proper treatment, you can get relief from your symptoms and prevent further complications.
entries.translation: Wal’aansa sirrii ta’een mallattoolee kee irraa boqonnaa argachuu fi rakkoolee dabalataa ittisuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Don't let these conditions control your life.
entries.translation: Haaloonni kun jireenya kee akka to'atan hin heeyyamin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Talk to your doctor today and start on the path to recovery.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Ms. Smith," I said, "I'm really looking forward to the food and wine festival this weekend.

entries.english: "I won't," I said. "I'll just sample a few things from each booth."

entries.english: "That's a good plan," Ms. Smith said. "And be sure to drink plenty of water to stay hydrated."

entries.english: The boy turned around and saw a man standing next to him.
entries.translation: Mucaan ofirra galagalee namichi isa cina dhaabbatu arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was tall and thin, with a long beard and a kind face. "Are you a paleontologist?" the boy asked.
entries.translation: Dheeraa fi qallaa ture, Fuula garraamii fi areeda dheeraa kan qabu. "Hayyuu waa'ee foosilii qoratuudhaa ati?" jedhee gaafate mucihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, I am," the man said. "I've been studying dinosaurs for many years."
entries.translation: Namichi akkas jedheen, "Eyyeen, Daayinoosarii waggootaaf qo'ataan ture."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy was excited to meet a real paleontologist, and he asked him many questions about dinosaurs.
entries.translation: Ogeessa kana quunnamuu isaatti mucichi baayyee gammade, waa'ee daayinoosariis gaaffii baayyee isa gaafate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man answered all of his questions patiently, and the boy learned a lot about these fascinating creatures.
entries.translation: Namichis gaaffiisaa hunda obsaan deebiseef, mucichis waa'ee uumama addaa kanaa waan baayyee barate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a while, the boy's parents called him over, and he said goodbye to the paleontologist.
entries.translation: Yeroo xiqqoo booda, maatiin isaa isa waamnaan ogeessichaan nagaatti jedhe sokke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freedom is a word that has been used and abused by so many people, in so many contexts, that it has almost lost its meaning.
entries.translation: Biliisummaan jecha namoota bayyeen haalota baayyee keessatti fayyadamamee fi jallifame ta'e amma sadarkaa hiika isaa dhabuu irra ga'ee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But for me, freedom is a very simple thing.
entries.translation: Garuu anaaf, biliisummaan waan baayyee salphaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the ability to live my life on my own terms, without being controlled or oppressed by others.
entries.translation: Anaaf dandeettii jireenyakoo haalota ani murteessuun jiraachuuti, namoonni biroo utuu nan to'atinii fi nan cunqursin jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was born into a time and place where women were not considered to be fully equal to men.
entries.translation: Ani yeroo fi bakka duubartiin dhiiraa wajjin wal qixa hin ilaalamnettin dhaladhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were expected to stay at home, raise children, and take care of our husbands.
entries.translation: Nuti mana teenyee ijoollee guddisuu fi abbaa manaa keenya kunuunsuutu nurraa eegama ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I never wanted to live that kind of life.
entries.translation: Garuu jireenya akka sanaa tasuma jiraachuu hin barbaannen ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I wanted to be free to pursue my own dreams, to learn and grow, and to make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: Abjuu dhugoomsuuf, guddachuu fi barachuuf, adduyaa kana irratti jijjiirama uumuuf biliisummaan barbaadan ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was fortunate to have parents who supported my ambitions.
entries.translation: Maatiikee hawwiikoo akkan dhugoomsuuf na deggeran qabaachuukootti carra qabeettiin ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They encouraged me to go to college, to get a job, and to live my life on my own terms.
entries.translation: Kolleejjii akkan dhaquuf, hojii akkan argadhuu fi jireenyakoo akka mataakootti akkan jiraadhuuf na jajjabeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And I am grateful for the opportunities that I have had to travel, to meet new people, and to learn about different cultures.
entries.translation: Carraa ani addunyaa irra imaluudhaaf, namoota haaraa baruudhaafi aadaa garaa garaa barachuuf argadheetti baayyeen galateeffadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I know that not everyone is as lucky as I was.
entries.translation: Garuu namni akkakoo carra qabeettiin akka hin turre nan beeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are still many people in the world who are denied their freedom, simply because of their race, their gender, or their religion.
entries.translation: Ammayyuu addunyaa kanarra namoota biliisummaa isaanii sababu halluu bifa isaaniif, sababa saala isaanii fi amantii isaaniitif dhaban baayyeetu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A hospital is a healthcare institution providing patient treatment in an inpatient setting.
entries.translation: Hospitaalli dhaabbata eegumsa fayyaa kan mana keessatti dhukkubsataaf yaala kennuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inpatient care is provided by hospital inpatient departments, emergency departments and outpatient clinics.
entries.translation: Yaalli mana keessaa kutaa yaala mana keessaa, kutaa balaa hatattamaa fi kilinika yaala alaatiin kennama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are usually staffed by professional and registered nurses, physicians, and other health professionals.
entries.translation: Hojjettoonni hospitaalaa yeroo baayyee neersota, doktoorota fi ogeessa fayyaa birootiin qabama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A hospital can also include a number of support departments, such as medical records, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, and rehabilitation.
entries.translation: Akkasumas hospitaalli kutaa deggersaa baayyee, kanneen akka seenaa fayyaa, mana qorichaa, laaboraatorii, raadiyooloojii fi bakka bayyaannannaa of keessaa qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are often classified by the type of care they provide, such as general hospitals, specialty hospitals, and psychiatric hospitals.
entries.translation: Hospitaalonni yeroo baayyee tajaajila kennan irratti hundaa'uun hospitaala waliigalaa, hospitaala addaa fi hospitaala sammuu jedhamuun qoodamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: General hospitals provide a wide range of services, including medical, surgical, obstetrical, and pediatric care.
entries.translation: Hospitaalli walii galaa tajaajiloota garaa garaa kanneen akka fayyaa, baqaqsanii yaaluu, kan dahumsaa fi yaala daa'immanii kenna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Specialty hospitals focus on a particular type of care, such as cancer care, cardiac care, or orthopedic care.
entries.translation: Hospitaalli addaa kunuunsa addaa kanneen akka yaala kaanserii, yaala onnee fi yaala lafee irratti xiyyeeffata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Psychiatric hospitals provide care for people with mental illness.
entries.translation: Hospitaalli sammuu ammoo namoota dhukkuba sammuu qaba yaala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals are an important part of the healthcare system.
entries.translation: Siisteema eegumsa fayyaa keessatti hospitaalli qaama barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide care for a variety of illnesses and injuries, and they play a vital role in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of disease.
entries.translation: Miidhaa fi dhukkuba garaa garaaf yaala kan kennan yoo ta'u, dhukkuba ittisuu, adda baasuu fi yaaluu irratti ga'ee guddaa taphatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hospitals also provide education and training for healthcare professionals, and they conduct research to improve the quality of care.
entries.translation: Akkasumas, hospitaalonni ogeessota eegumsa fayyaaf barnootaa fi leenjii kan kennanii fi qulqullina yaalaa fooyyessuuf qorannoo geggeessu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of hospitals dates back to ancient times.
entries.translation: Seenaan hospitaalaa gara baroota duriitti achi nu deebisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first hospitals were established in India, China, and Greece.
entries.translation: Hospitaalonni jalqabaa Indiyaa, Chaayinaa fi Giriik keessatti hundeeffaman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the Middle Ages, hospitals were often run by religious organizations.
entries.translation: Baroota giddu galeessaa keessa, hospitaalli dhaabbatoota amantiitiin hogganama ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first time I tried embroidery, I was determined to make a small, intricate design.
entries.translation: Gaafan hojii ajaa'ibsiisaa ta'e argu, dizaayinii xiqqoo fi kan wal xaxaa ta'e hojjechuufin yaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I chose a pattern with lots of tiny stitches, and I started working on it with great enthusiasm.
entries.translation: Akkaa hodhaa xixiqoo qabu filadheen kutannoo guddaadhaan irratti hojjechuu jalqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, after a few hours, I realized that I was making a mistake.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, sa'atii muraasa booda akkan dogoggoraa jiruun hubadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The stitches were too small and tight, and my hand was cramping up.
entries.translation: Hodhaan sun baayyee xiqqoo fi walitti siqataadha, harkikoos na dhiita'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I decided to put the project aside and try something else.
entries.translation: Piroojektii sana dhiisee waan kan biraa jalqabuufin murteesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next time I tried embroidery, I chose a larger pattern with looser stitches.
entries.translation: Yeroon kan biraa ani waantota miidhagoo hojjechuuf yaale, waan guddaa fi hodhaa walirraa fagoo qabun filadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was able to work on the project for longer periods of time without getting tired, and the stitches were easier to make.
entries.translation: Utuun hin dadhabiin yeroo dheeraadhaaf piroojekticha irratti hojjechuu danda'eera, hodhaan sunis nama hin rakkisu hin ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was also able to create a more beautiful result.
entries.translation: Bu'aa isa duraa caalaa baayyee bareedaa argamsiisuu danda'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're new to embroidery, I recommend starting with a larger pattern with looser stitches.
entries.translation: Waantota miidhagoo hojjeechuuf haaraa yoo taate, waantota gurguddoo fi hodhaa walirraa fagoo qaban akka filattun si gorsa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will make it easier to learn the basic stitches and techniques.
entries.translation: Kunis akkaataa hodhaaf hundee ta'an salphaatti akka barattu si taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you've mastered the basics, you can start experimenting with smaller patterns and tighter stitches.
entries.translation: Bu'uura kana gaafa sirriitti fixxu, warroota xixiqqoo fi hodhaa walitti dhiyoo qaban yaaluu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The capital and largest city in Malawi is Lilongwe.
entries.translation: Magaalaan guddoo fi teessoon mootummaa Maalaawwii Liloongiwee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malawi is a diverse country with a rich culture and history.
entries.translation: Maalaawwiin biyya waan garaa garaa keessa jiruu fi aadaa fi seenaa sooressa qabduudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important places in Malawi include Lake Malawi, the Shire River, and the Nyika Plateau.
entries.translation: Bakkoota baayyee barbaachisoo Maalaawwii keessaa muraasni Hara Maalaawwii, Laga Shiree fi Pilaatoo Nyiikaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lake Malawi is the third-largest lake in Africa and is home to a wide variety of fish and other wildlife.
entries.translation: Harri Maalaawwii harawwan gurguddoo Afrikaa keessaa sadarkaa sadaffaa irratti kan argamuu fi bakka jireenya qurxummii garaa garaa fi lubbu qabeeyyii birooti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Shire River is a major tributary of the Zambezi River and is an important source of water for irrigation and transportation.
entries.translation: Lagni Shiree Laga Zaambeezitti kan yaa'uu fi madda bishaan geejjibaa fi jaldhisii beekamaadhas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Nyika Plateau is a highland region in northern Malawi and is home to a variety of wildlife, including elephants, lions, and leopards.
entries.translation: Pilaatoon Nyiikaa lafa baddaa Kaaba Maalaawwii tti argamuu fi bakka jireenya bineensota kanneen akka arba, leencaa fi lootuu faa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important historical figures in Malawi include David Livingstone, John Chilembwe, and Hastings Kamuzu Banda.
entries.translation: Namoota bebbeekamoo Maalaawwii keessaa muraasni ammoo Daviid Liivingistoon, Joon Chileenbiwe fi Haastiingis Kamuuzuu Baandaa faa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Livingstone was a Scottish missionary and explorer who was instrumental in the abolition of the slave trade in Africa.
entries.translation: Liviingistoon miishineerii fi abuuraa Iskootilaandi kan ta'ee fi daldala garbaa Afrikaa balleessuu keessatti nama ijoo ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chilembwe was a Malawian Baptist minister who led an uprising against British colonial rule in 1915.
entries.translation: Chiiliimbiween ministeera cuuphaa Maalaawwii kan turee fi Kolonii Biriiteen irratti bara 1915 nama fincila hoogganeedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Banda was the first president of Malawi and ruled the country from 1964 to 1994.
entries.translation: Baandaan pirezedaantii jalqabaa Maalaawwii kan bara 1964 - 1994 tti bulcheedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Golden Temple, a shimmering monument to human vanity and folly, stands as a testament to the destructive power of desire.
entries.translation: Manni qulqullummaa warqee irraa hojjetame, siidaa dadhabinaa fi gowwummaa nama ibsu akka kakuu badii fedhiin namaa fiduutti dhaabbatee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a place where dreams are made and broken, where hopes are raised and dashed, and where love and hate, life and death, are all inextricably intertwined.
entries.translation: Bakka abjuun uumamee itti cabu ture, bakka abdiin kaafamee deebi'ee duwwaa ta'u ture, bakka jibbaa fi jaalalli, jireenyaa fi du'i akka adda ba'uu hin dandeenyetti walitti dabalamuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The temple was built by a wealthy maharaja who wanted to create a place where he could worship his god in peace.
entries.translation: Manni qulqullummaa sun namicha sooressa Mahaaraajaa jedhamu kan nagaadhaan waaqasaa keessatti waaqeffachuu barbaaduun ijaarame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the temple quickly became a magnet for pilgrims from all over the world, and it soon became a place of commerce and trade.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, manni qulqullummaa kun gara sochii amantiif godhamuutti jijjiiramee dhumarrammoo gara bakka daldalaatti jijjiirame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The maharaja's dream of a peaceful place of worship was quickly shattered, and the temple became a place of greed, corruption, and violence.
entries.translation: Abjuun Mahaaraajaan bakka waaqeffannaa naga qabeessa ijaaruuf karoorfatee battalumatti caccabe, manni qulqullummaa sunis gara ofiittummaa, malammaltummaa fi gaaga'amaatti jijjiirame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young man named Amritsar arrived at the temple.
entries.translation: Guyyaa tokko, namichi maqaansaa Amiristaar jedhamu gara mana qulqullummaa kanaa dhufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a simple man with a simple dream: to find peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Nama salphaa fi nama abjuu salphaa qabu ture: Nagaa fi gammachuu barbaaduu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Amritsar soon found that the temple was no place for peace.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, Amiristaar manni qulqullummaa sun bakka nagaa akka hin taane hubate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was drawn into the vortex of greed and corruption, and he eventually lost everything he had.
entries.translation: Maraammartoo ofiittummaa fi malaammaltummaa keessa gale, innis waan qabu hundumaa dhabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Amritsar's story is a cautionary tale about the dangers of desire.
entries.translation: Seenaan Amiristaar oduu balaa fedhii namaarraa of eeggachuuti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a reminder that the things we crave most may not be what is best for us.
entries.translation: Waanti nuti baayyee barbaannu waanta hunda caalaa nu fayyadu ta'uu dhiisuu akka danda'u nu yaadachiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm just your friendly neighborhood Uber driver, here to take you wherever you need to go.

entries.english: Fufu is a starchy, doughy food made from pounded plantains or cassava.
entries.translation: Fufuun nyaata istaarchii kan biqiloota bilchaatan irraa hojjetamuu fi bukoo ta'eedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a staple food in many West African countries, and is often served with soups or stews.
entries.translation: Inni nyaata ijoo biyyoota Dhiha Afrikaa keessaati, yeroo baayyee shoorbaa yookin waxiidhaan dhiyaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fufu is typically made by pounding the plantains or cassava in a large mortar and pestle until they are smooth and pasty.
entries.translation: Fufuun yeroo baayyee biqiloota yookin kaasaavaa moortaarii guuddaa fi peestaalii keessatti bilcheessuudhaan kan hojjetamu yoo ta'u, hanga inni wal qixxaatuttis eegamuu qaba.

entries.english: The resulting fufu is then shaped into balls or logs and served.
entries.translation: Fufuun isa kanarraa argamu isa booda bifa kubbaatti bocamuun nyaataaf dhiyaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fufu is a very filling food, and it is often eaten as a main course.
entries.translation: Fufuun yeroo baayyee nyaata garaa nama guutuu fi yeroo baayyee akka nyaata of danda'atti nyaatama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a good source of carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals.
entries.translation: Akkasumas madda gaarii kaarboohaayidireetii, viitaaminii fi albuudotaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fufu is a traditional food that has been eaten in West Africa for hundreds of years.

entries.english: It is a part of the culture and identity of many West African societies.

entries.english: Person A: There is a lack of originality in the perfume and fragrance industry. The perfumes all smell the same, and they don't really say anything about me.
entries.translation: Nama A: Industirii urgooftuu keessa hanqinni isa jalqabaa ta'uu dhabuu ni jira, urgooftuuwwan sun hundisaanii foolii wal fakkaataa qabu, garuu waa'eekoo waan tokko hin jenne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person B: I know what you mean. I've been looking for a unique perfume that will make me stand out from the crowd, but I haven't had any luck.
entries.translation: Nama B: Waanti ati jettu beeka. Urgooftuu namoota hunda keessa adda na baaftuu barbaadaan ture, garuu carraa hin qabun ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person A: I think we should start our own perfume company. We could create fragrances that are truly original and that reflect our personality.

entries.english: Person B: That's a great idea! I'm so excited to get started.

entries.english: Person A: We could call it "Back to Australia". It would be a tribute to our home country and a celebration of our unique scents.
entries.translation: Nama A: "Gara Aawustiraaliyaa tti deebi'aa" jennee waamuu dandeenya. Kabaja biyya keenyaa fi yaadannoo urgaa addaa keenya ta'uu danda'a.

entries.english: The Suez Canal was a major engineering feat that connected the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea.
entries.translation: Siwiiz Kaanaaliin hojii injiineringii guddaa galaana medetiraaniyaanii fi galaana diimaa wal quunnamsiisuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was built by the French and opened in 1869.

entries.english: The canal was a vital trade route for Egypt and the rest of the world.

entries.english: It also allowed for the movement of troops and supplies, which was important during wartime.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1956, Egypt nationalized the Suez Canal, which led to the Suez Crisis.
entries.translation: Bara 1956 tti, Masiriin Siwiiz Kaanaalii gara biyyoolessaatti deebiste, kunis gaaga'am Siwiiz kaase.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The crisis was a major international incident that was eventually resolved through a United Nations peacekeeping force.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Suez Canal is still a vital trade route today and is one of the most important waterways in the world.
entries.translation: Hanga arraattis Siwiiz Kaanaaliin karaa daldalaa barbaachisaa fi karaa bishaanii baayyee barbaachisoo addunyaa keessaa isa tokkoodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a young man named Rajiv who lived in a small village.

entries.english: "Do not touch my apples," the tree said. "They are not for you."

entries.english: But Rajiv was hungry, and he didn't listen to the tree.

entries.english: They offer a variety of goods and services, from fresh produce to handmade crafts.

entries.english: Open-air markets are also a great place to people-watch and enjoy the local culture.

entries.english: They're usually bustling with activity, and there's always something to see and do.

entries.english: You'll hear the sound of vendors calling out to customers, the smell of fresh-baked bread and pastries, and the sight of people haggling over prices.

entries.english: Another advantage of open-air markets is the variety of goods and services available.

entries.english: And because the vendors are independent businesses, they're often willing to negotiate prices.

entries.english: So if you're looking for a bargain, an open-air market is the place to be.
