entries.english: Ambedkar was born into a Dalit family, a group of people who were considered to be untouchables in the caste system of India.
entries.translation: Ambeedkaar maatii Daaliit irraa dhalate, garee namoota sirna Indiyaa keessatti tuqamuu hin danda'an jedhamanii lakkaa'aman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He faced discrimination and hardship throughout his life, but he never gave up on his dream of equality for all Indians.
entries.translation: Jireenyasaa keessatti loogii fi ulfaatina jireenyaatu isa mudachaa ture, garuu abjuu isaa kan walqixxummaa Indiyaanota hundumaa arguuf qabu tasumaa hin daganne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ambedkar was a brilliant student and went on to earn a doctorate in law from Columbia University in the United States.
entries.translation: Ambeedkaar barata qaxalee kan ture yoo ta'u doktooreetii isaa Yunversiitii Kolombiyaa biyyaa Ameerikaatti argamu irraa karaa Seeraatiin eebbifameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also studied at the London School of Economics and became a barrister.
entries.translation: Mana barumsaa Ikoonoomiksii London ttis barachuudhaan abbaa seeraa ta'ee tajaajileera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After returning to India, Ambedkar became a leading figure in the Indian independence movement.
entries.translation: Erga gara Indiyaatti deebi'ees, Ambeedkaar sochii biliisummaa Indiyaa keessatti nama ijoo ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a member of the Indian National Congress, but he eventually broke away from the party and formed his own political organization, the Scheduled Castes Federation.
entries.translation: Miseensa koongireesii biyyoolessa Indiyaa keessas ture, garuu dhumarra paartii sana keessaa bahuun dhaabbata siyaasaa mataa isaa kan Scheduled Castes Federation jedhamu hundeesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ambedkar was also a key figure in the drafting of the Constitution of India.
entries.translation: Akkasumas, Ambeedkaar wixinee heeraa Indiyaa kaa'uu keessatti nama ijoo ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is the intentional infliction of pain, suffering, or death upon an animal.
entries.translation: Gara jabinni bineensotaa miidhaa, dararama fi ajjeechaa isaanirra ga'uuf sababa kan ta'eedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can take many forms, from physical abuse to neglect.
entries.translation: Bifa hedduu qabaachuu danda'a, miidhaa qaamaa irraa hanga tuffatamuutti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animals may be beaten, kicked, burned, starved, or even killed for no reason other than human entertainment.
entries.translation: Bineensonni bashannana namaatootiin alatti sababa biraa malee rukutamuu, gubachuu, hagabsamuu fi ajjeefamuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is a serious problem that affects millions of animals every year.
entries.translation: Gara jabinni bineensotaa rakkoo guddaa kan waggaatti bineensota miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman gaaga'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is illegal in most countries, but enforcement is often lax.
entries.translation: Biyyoota baayyee keessatti seeraan ala ta'us raawwiinsaa baayyee laafaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many organizations that work to prevent and stop animal cruelty, but more needs to be done.
entries.translation: Gara jabina bineensotaa ittisuu irratti dhaabbatoonni baayyeen hojjetaa jiru, garuu dabalataan itti fufuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can all help to stop animal cruelty by being more aware of the issue and by speaking out against it.
entries.translation: Gara jabina bineensotaa dhaabsisuu irratti nuti hundi hirmaachuu dandeenya, waa'ee dhimmichaa sirriitti hubachuu fi mormuudhaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also choose to buy from businesses that do not support animal cruelty and to support organizations that work to protect animals.
entries.translation: Dhaabbatoota daldalaa gara jabina bineensotaa hin deggerre irraa bitachuu fi dhaabbatoota bineensota eeguuf hojjetan deggeruudhaan gargaaruu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal cruelty is a terrible thing that happens every day.
entries.translation: Gara jabinni bineensotaa waanta badaa guyyaadhaa gara guyyaatti ta'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can all help to make a difference by speaking out against it and by supporting organizations that work to stop it.
entries.translation: Waanta kana mormuudhaan fi dhaabbatoota waan kana dhaabsisuuf hojjetan deggeruudhaan garaagarummaa uumuu ni dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because the average age of a woman's first menstrual period is 12 years old, and the average age of menopause is 45 years old.
entries.translation: Kun sababnisaa umriin giddu galeessaa duubarri tokko marsaa laguu itti jalqadu waggaa 12 yoo ta'u, umriin giddu galeessaa duubarri tokko marsaa laguu itti dhaabdu waggaa 45.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that a woman has approximately 33 years to bear children.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun duubarri tokko yeroo itti daa'ima godhachuu dandeessu waggaa 33 qabdi jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, fertility begins to decline in a woman's mid-thirties, and by the time she is 40, her chances of conceiving naturally are significantly reduced.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee dandeettiin daa'ima godhachuu duubaraa walakkeessa waggaa soddomaa irraa kaasee hira'ataa deema, yeroo waggaa 40 geessu, carraan isheen daa'ima godhachuuf qabdu baayyee hir'isa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of factors that can contribute to a woman's declining fertility, including age, smoking, obesity, and certain medical conditions.
entries.translation: Dandeettiin dhala godhachuu duubartootaa gadi bu'uuf sababoota baayyeetu jira, umrii, xuuxuu, furdina garmalee fi haala fayyaa murtaa'oo ta'an.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a woman ages, her eggs become less healthy and more likely to have chromosomal abnormalities.
entries.translation: Akkuma umriin duubartootaa dabalaa deemuun, fayyuummaan hanqaaquusheetii kan gadi bu'uu fi carraan rakkina kiroomoosoomii olka'aa deema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can increase the risk of miscarriage, stillbirth, and birth defects.
entries.translation: Kunis carraa daa'ima du'aa dahuu fi daa'ima qaama miidhamaa ta'e godhachuu dabala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Smoking can also damage a woman's fertility by reducing blood flow to the uterus and ovaries.
entries.translation: Xuuxuunis yaa'iinsa dhiigaa gara yuteerasi fi oovaaaritti deemuu miidhuudhaan carraan dhala dhabdummaa akka dabalu taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Obesity can lead to hormonal imbalances that can interfere with ovulation.
entries.translation: Furdinni garmalee wal madaaluu dhabuu hoormoonii fiduudhaan adeemsa hanqaaquu oomishuu jeeqa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And certain medical conditions, such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and endometriosis, can also make it difficult for a woman to conceive.
entries.translation: Akkasumas haalli fayyaa murtaa'oon kanneen akka Pooliisaaytik oovaarii fi indoometirioosis duubarri ulfaa'uuf akka rakkattu gochuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are a woman who is over 30 and are thinking about having children, it is important to talk to your doctor about your fertility.
entries.translation: Yoo duubara waggaa 30 olii kan daa'ima godhachuuf yaalaa jirtu taate, waa'ee dandeettii daa'ima godhachuukeetii dokooriikee haasofsiisuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that you can do to improve your chances of conceiving, including losing weight if you are overweight or obese, quitting smoking, and getting regular exercise.
entries.translation: Dandeettii ulfaa'uukeetii dabaluuf waantota ati gochuu dandeessu baayyeetu jira, yoo ulfaatina garmalee qabda ta'ee ulfaatinakee hir'isuu, xuuxuu dhiisuu fir yeroo hunda sochii qaamaa gochuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your doctor may also recommend fertility medications or other treatments to help you conceive.
entries.translation: Doktooriinkee qoricha ulfaa'uuf si gargaaru yookin yaala dandeettii ulfaa'uu keetii dabalu sii kennuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to remember that there are many other ways to have a family, even if you are unable to conceive naturally.
entries.translation: Akkasumas karaa uumamaatiin maatii horachuun yoo dadhabames, karaan ittiin maatii horatan jiraachuusaa beekuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Adoption and surrogacy are two options that you may want to consider.
entries.translation: Guddifachaa fi kunuunsituu ta'uun filannoowwan lamaan ati yaaluu dandeessuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With the help of modern medicine, there are many ways to have a family, no matter what your age or fertility.
entries.translation: Qorichawwan ammayyaa gargaaramuun, dandeettii dhala argachuukee fi umrii kee utuu hin dageessin karaan ittiin maatii horatan baayyeedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants are the largest land animals on Earth and can weigh up to 15,000 pounds.
entries.translation: Arbi bineensota lafarraa keessa isa guddichaa fi ulfaatina hang pound 15,000 kan qabuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are herbivores and their diet consists mainly of leaves, bark, and fruit.
entries.translation: Isaan biqiloota duwwaa kan sooratanii fi nyaati isaanii baayyinaan baala, qola fi ija mukaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants have a long trunk that they use for many purposes, including drinking, bathing, and gathering food.
entries.translation: Arbi kumbii waantota baayyeef itti fayyadamu qaba, kanneen akka bishaan dhuguu, dhiqachuu fi nyaata funaannachuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also use their trunks to communicate with each other and to defend themselves from predators.
entries.translation: Walii isaanii wajjin walii galuu fi bineensota kan biroo irraa of ittisuufis kumbii isaaniitti fayyadamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants live in herds and are very social animals.
entries.translation: Arbi gurmuudhaan kan jiraatuu fi bineensa baayyee walii galtee danda'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They form strong bonds with each other and care for their young.
entries.translation: Walii isaanii wajjin walitti dhufeenya jabaa kan qabanii fi ijoollee isaaniitiif baayyee kan dhimmaniidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elephants are also very intelligent animals and have been known to use tools.
entries.translation: Arbi bineensa baayyee qaxalee ta'ee fi meeshaalee tokko tokko fayyadamuu kan danda'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Unfortunately, elephants are threatened by habitat loss and poaching.
entries.translation: Carraa badaa ta'e garuu arbi hirdhina bidoollee fi adamoodhaan yaadda'aa jiraata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are many conservation efforts underway to protect these amazing animals.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, bineensa ajaa'ibaa kana kunuunsuudhaaf tattaaffii gaaritu godhamaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Up until that point, it had been a fairly standard fairy tale, with the princess living a sheltered life in her tower and the prince coming to rescue her.
entries.translation: Hanga qabxii sanaatti, seenaa hamma ta'e sadarkaa isaa eeggateedha, Intalli mootii gamooshee keessa jiraatti hanga ilmi mootii dhufee ishee baraarutti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But once she steps outside, the story takes on a whole new tone.
entries.translation: Garuu gaafasheen gadi baaterraa jalqabee, seenichi guutummaatti jijjiirame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The princess is immediately confronted with a harsh and unforgiving world.
entries.translation: Intalli mootii battalumatti addunyaa gogaa fi dhiifama hin beekne waliin wal dura dhaabbatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is forced to learn how to survive on her own, and she quickly discovers that she is not as helpless as she thought she was.
entries.translation: Qofaashe akkamitti akka jirattu barachuufis dirqamte, fi nama na gargaaru hin qabu jettee akkasheen yaaddofte utuu hin taane gargaarsa xiqqoo akka qabdu hubatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She meets a variety of interesting characters along the way, and she learns a lot about herself and the world around her.
entries.translation: Kana keessatti amaloota gaarii baayyee argite, akkasumas waa'eeshee fi waa'ee addunyaa naannooshee baayyee baratte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The novel ends with the princess finding her own way in the world, and she is finally happy and content.
entries.translation: Seenichi intalli mootii addunyaa kana keessatti karaa mataa ishee argachuushee fi gammadduu ta'uu isheetiin xumurame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She has learned that she is strong and independent, and she is no longer afraid to face whatever challenges come her way.
entries.translation: Cimtuu fi of dandeessuu ta'uushees baratteetti, akkasumas qormaatawwan ishee mudatan kamuu dura dhaabbachuuf akka hin sodaanne hubatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The novel is a coming-of-age story, and it follows the princess as she grows from a sheltered young woman into a confident and capable adult.
entries.translation: Asoosamichi seenaa umriin dhufu yoo ta'u, adeemsa intalli mootii duubartii mana keessa eegamtu irraa gara ofitii amanamummaa fi ga'eessummaatti akka guddattu irratti xiyyeeffata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the global economy continues to grow, so too does the demand for cotton.
entries.translation: Galiin addunyaa guddachaa akkuma dhufeen fedhiin jiribiis akkusuma guddate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Furthermore, the increasing popularity of sustainable fashion is driving up demand for organic cotton.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis, daballiin beekamtii faashinii walitti fufaa barbaadamuu jirbii orgaanikaa baayyee dabalaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to a surge in investment in the cotton industry, with new plantations being established in countries such as India and China.
entries.translation: Kunis Industirii jirbii irratti investimeentiin godhamu akka dabaluu taasisee jira, Biyyoota akka Indiyaa fi Chaayinaa keessatti akkaataan biqilaa itti dhaaban haaraan ba'uudhaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, this growth has not been without its challenges.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, guddinni kun qormaata malee hin raawwatamne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The increased demand for cotton has put a strain on water resources, and the use of pesticides and fertilizers has led to environmental pollution.
entries.translation: Daballiin fedhii jirbii qabeenya bishaanii irratti daangeeffama kan fide yoo ta'u, qoricha farra biqilootaa fi xaa'oo fayyadamuun faalama naannootiif sababa ta'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Furthermore, the low wages paid to cotton farmers in developing countries has led to concerns about labor exploitation.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis, maallaqi gadi bu'aan biyyoota guddataa jiran keessatti qotee bultoota jirbiitiff kaffalamu itti fayyadama humna namaa irratti yaaddoo uumera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, the cotton industry remains an important part of the global economy.
entries.translation: Qormaatawwan kunis ha jiraataniyyuu malee, industiriin jirbii qaama barbaachisaa galii addunyaa ta'ee itti fufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It provides jobs for millions of people and is a source of vital income for many developing countries.
entries.translation: Namoota miliyoonaan lakkaa'amniif carraa hojii kan uumee fi madda galii barbaachisaa namoota biyyoota guddataa jiran keessa jiraataniif ta'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Furthermore, cotton is a versatile and sustainable material that is used in a wide range of products, from clothing to home furnishings.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis, jirbiin waanta turuu danda'uu fi waan baayyeef ooluu danda'u ta'ee oomishaalee kanneen akka uffataa fi meeshaalee manaa garaa garaa keessatti ni fayyadamama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the global population continues to grow, the demand for cotton is likely to remain high.
entries.translation: Akkuma baayyinni uummata addunyaa dabalaa deemuun, barbaachisummaan jirbii dabalaa deema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This presents both challenges and opportunities for the cotton industry.
entries.translation: Kun industirii jirbiitiif carraa fi qormaata qabatee dhufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I remember the day I collected the first harvest of our family farm.
entries.translation: Guyyaan itti oomisha jalqabaa qonna keenyaa itti sassaabne nan yaadadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a hot summer day, and the sun was beating down on us as we worked in the fields.
entries.translation: Yeroo gannaa hin turre, aduun yeroo nuti maasii keessaa hojjennu nu waxalaa turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But we didn't mind, because we were excited to see the fruits of our labor.
entries.translation: Garuu nuti dhimma ittii hin godhanne, ija gatii dafqa keenyaa ilaaluuf baayyee ariifannee waan turref.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We had been working hard all season, and it was finally time to reap the rewards.
entries.translation: Waqtii guutuu cimnee hojjechaa waan turreef, yeroo itti badhaasa keenya fudhannu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We picked the ripe tomatoes and peppers, and we carefully loaded them into the back of the truck.
entries.translation: Timaatimii fi qaaraa bilchaatan fuunee suuta jennee konkolaataa fe'umsaa irratti fe'aa turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then we drove them back to the farm, where we washed and sorted them.
entries.translation: Isa booda gara maasiitti geessuudhaan miiccinee toora galchine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After we had finished cleaning the vegetables, we put them in the smoker.
entries.translation: Kuduraalee kana erga miiccinee fixnee booda, aara irra keenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had let others tell her that she was wrong, that she was dirty, that she was not worthy of love.
entries.translation: Namoonni biroon akkasheen dogoggorte, akkasheen xurooftuu turte fir akkasheen jaallatamuuf hin taane akka itti himaniif hayyamteetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But at the reunion, she finally saw that they were wrong.

entries.english: She was worthy of love, and she deserved to be happy.

entries.english: Bella's anger was healthy because it was a response to the injustice she had faced.

entries.english: She was angry that she had been made to feel ashamed of herself, and she was angry that she had been denied her right to love.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It motivated her to fight for her rights, and it helped her to reclaim her sense of self-worth.

entries.english: At the reunion, Bella finally found the strength to stand up for herself.

entries.english: She then walks away, her mind filled with thoughts of how she will feed herself and her children.

entries.english: He looked like he was in a hurry, but he stopped when he saw the little girl.

entries.english: "What are you doing out here all alone?" he asked.

entries.english: "I'm trying to sell matches," the little girl said. "But no one will buy them."

entries.english: "Well, I'll buy one," the man said "But you have to give me a rose in exchange."

entries.english: The little girl was surprised, but she agreed.

entries.english: She ran home and picked a beautiful rose.

entries.english: Then she went back to the man and gave him the match and the rose.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you," the man said "You're a kind girl." He took the match and lit it.

entries.english: The elephants can roam freely without fear of being hunted, and the farmers can be sure that their crops will not be destroyed.

entries.english: Radio collars are small devices that are attached to an animal's neck.
entries.translation: Raadiyoo koolaariin meeshaa xiqqoo morma bineensotaatti ka'amtuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They emit a signal that can be tracked by a receiver.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows scientists to track the animal's movements over time.
entries.translation: Kun saayinsistoonnii sochiin bineensotaa yeroodhaa gara yerootti maal akka fakkaatu to'achuuf gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of elephants, this information can be used to create maps of their home ranges and to identify areas where they are most likely to come into conflict with humans.
entries.translation: Waa'ee arbaa irratti, odeeffannoon kun kaartaa bakka jireenya isaanii kennuu fi bakka isaan itti namaa wajjin walitti bu'uuf carraa baldhaa qaban agarsiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Farmers can use this information to take steps to protect their crops from elephants.
entries.translation: Qotee bultoonni odeeffannoo kana argachuun oomishni isaanii arbaan akka jalaa hin miidhamneef tarkaanfii fudhachuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can build fences, plant thorny bushes, or use other methods to deter elephants from entering their fields.
entries.translation: Isa booda dallaa ijaaruu, biqiloota qoraattii qaban dhaabuu yookin mala biraa fayyadamuun arbi akka maasii isaanii hin lixne gochuu danda'u.

entries.english: By working together, scientists and farmers can help to keep both elephants and humans safe.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In Kenya, scientists from the University of Cambridge have been working with local communities to track the movements of elephants.
entries.translation: Keeniyaa keessatti Saayinsistoonni yuniversiitii Kaambiriidji sochii arbaa to'achuuf hawaasa naannoo wajjin hojjetaa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This information has been used to create maps of the elephants' home ranges.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The maps have been shared with farmers, who have used them to build fences around their fields.
entries.translation: Kaartaan kun qotee bultootaaf qoodamee isaanis isa fayyadamuun naannoo maasii isaanitti dallaa ijaaraniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has helped to reduce the number of conflicts between elephants and humans.
entries.translation: Kun hanga lola namootaa fi arba giddu jiruu hirdhisuuf fayyadeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Radio collars are a valuable tool for studying elephants and for helping to reduce human-elephant conflict.
entries.translation: Raadiyoo koolaariin meeshaa arba qorachuu fi walitti bu'iinsa arbaa fi nama gidduu jiru hirdhisuuf baayyee barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide scientists with valuable information about elephant behavior, and they can help farmers to protect their crops.
entries.translation: Isaan saayinsistootaaf waa'ee amala arbaa odeeffannoo barbaachisaa ergu, akkasumas qotee bultoonnis oomisha isaanii akka eeggatan gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By working together, scientists and farmers can help to create a future where elephants and humans can live together in harmony.
entries.translation: Walii wajjin hojjechuudhaan, saayintistoonni fi qote bultoonni gara fuulduraatti arbaa fi namni wal ta'iinsaan akka jiraatan gochuun ni dandaa'ama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mali Empire was a West African empire that reached its peak in the 13th and 14th centuries.
entries.translation: Impaayerri Maalii impaayera Dhiha Afrikaa ta'ee jaarraalee 13ffaa fi 14ffaa keessa guddinasaa isa dhumaarra kan ga'e ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was founded by Sundiata Keita in 1235 and stretched from the Atlantic Ocean to the Niger River.
entries.translation: Impaayerichi nama Sundiyaataa Keeyitaa jedhamuun bara 1235 kan hundeeffame yoo ta'u, garba Atilaantik irraa ka'ee hange laga Niijer tti kan dheeratu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mali Empire was a major center of trade and learning, and its rulers were known for their wealth and power.
entries.translation: Impaayerri Maalii giddu-gala daldalaa fi barnootaa guddaa kan ture yoo ta'u, bulchitoonni isaanii qabeenya fi aangoo isaaniitiin beekamu turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The empire declined in the 15th century, and was eventually conquered by the Songhai Empire in the 16th century.
entries.translation: Impaayerichi jaarraa 15ffaa keessa kan kufe yoo ta'u jaarraa 16 ffaa keessammoo impaayera Soongaayii tiin qabame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important events in Mali's history was the Battle of Kirina in 1235.
entries.translation: Seenaa Maalii keessaa inni barbaachisaan tokko Dirree lolaa Kiriinaa bara 1235 ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This battle marked the end of the Ghana Empire and the rise of the Mali Empire.
entries.translation: Dirreen lolaa kun dhuma impaayera Gaanaa fi ka'umsa impaayera Maalii ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sundiata Keita, the founder of the Mali Empire, led his army to victory over the forces of the Ghana Empire.
entries.translation: Sundiyaataa Keeyitaa namichi impaayera Maalii hundeesse waraanasaa hoogganuun impaayera Gaanaa irratti injifannoo argate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This victory gave Sundiata Keita control of the gold mines of the Sahel region, and helped to establish the Mali Empire as a major power in West Africa.
entries.translation: Injifannoon kun Suundiyaataa Keeyitaan albuuda warqee naannoo Saahel jiru irratti to'annoo akka argatu fi impaayerri Maalii Dhiha Afrikaa keessati giddu-gala aangoo akka taasisuuf isa dandeessise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important event in Mali's history was the reign of Mansa Musa.
entries.translation: Taateen barbaachisaan seenaa Maalii keessaa inni biraanimmoo ka'uu Maansaa Muusaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mansa Musa was the third ruler of the Mali Empire, and he reigned from 1312 to 1337.
entries.translation: Maansaa Muusaan mootii sadaffaa impaayera Maalii yoo ta'u bara 1312 hanga 1337 tti bulche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a Google spreadsheet, an absolute reference will always refer to the same cell, regardless of where it is copied or moved to.
entries.translation: Spiriidshiitii Googilii keessatti heertuu sirriin yeroo hundumaa seelii wal fakkaataatti geessiti, essatti akka galagalfame yookin geeffame utuu yaada keessa hin galchin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolute references are useful for cells that contain data that you do not want to change when you copy or move the formula.
entries.translation: Heertuu sirriin seeliiwwaan daataa ati yeroo galgalchuu yookin bakka biraatti geessituu akka hin jijjiiramne barbaaddu qabaniif barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if you have a formula that calculates the total sales for each month, you would want to use an absolute reference for the cell that contains the starting date.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, yoo foormulaa idaa'ama gurgurtaa ji'a hundaa shallagu qabda ta'e, seelii guyyaa jalqabaa qabatee jiruuf heertuu sirrii fayyadamuu barbaadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This way, the formula will always refer to the same cell, even if you copy it to a different row or column.
entries.translation: Karaa kanaan foormulichi yeroo hunda gara seelii wal fakkaataatti geessa, yoo gare tarree fi garee kan biraatti galagalchita ta'es.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can create an absolute reference by adding a dollar sign ($) to the row number and column letter of the cell reference.
entries.translation: Heertuu sirrii uumuu yoo barbaadde mallatto doolaaraa($) lakkoofsa tarree tti fi qubee garee heertuu seeliitti dabaluu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the absolute reference for the cell A1 would be $A$1.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, heertuu sirriin seelii A1 $A$1 ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also use absolute references to reference a range of cells.
entries.translation: Heertuu sirrii fayyadamuudhaan seelii garaa garaa heeruu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, add a dollar sign to the row number and column letter of each cell in the range.
entries.translation: Kana gochuudhaaf mallattoo doolaaraa lakkoofsa tarree tti fi qubee gareetti dabali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, the absolute reference for the range A1:B1 would be $A$1:$B$1.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, heertuu sirriin seeliiwwan A1:B1 dhaa $A$1:$B:$1 ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolute references are a powerful tool that can be used to make your formulas more flexible and easier to use.
entries.translation: Heertuun sirriin meeshaa cimaa foormulaakee baayyee jijjiiramaa fi fayyadamuuf akka salphatu taasisuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By understanding how to use absolute references, you can create formulas that will work even when you copy or move them to different locations.
entries.translation: Akkamittiin akka heertuu sirrii fayyadamtu beekuudhaan, foormulaa gaafa bakka biraatti galagalchituu fi geessitu hojjetu uumuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some additional tips for using absolute references:
entries.translation: Heertuu sirrii akkamitti akka fayyadamtu irratti gorsi dabalataa kunooti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use absolute references for cells that contain data that you do not want to change.
entries.translation: * Seelii daataa ati jijjiiruu hin barbaadne qabuuf heertuu sirrii fayyadami.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use relative references for cells that contain data that you do want to change.
entries.translation: *Seelii daataa ati jijjiirtu qabuuf ammoo heertuu birqabaa fayyadami.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Be careful when using mixed references, which are references that contain both absolute and relative references.
entries.translation: * Yeroo heertuu walitti makamaa fayyadamtu of eeggadhu, jechuun heertuu heertuu sirrii fi heertuu birqabaa qabu gaafa fayyadamtu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Use the F4 key to toggle between absolute, relative, and mixed references.
entries.translation: * F4 fayyadamuudhaan heertuu sirrii, heertuu birqabaa fi heertuu wal makaa tti jijjiiruu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By following these tips, you can use absolute references to create powerful and flexible formulas that will make your work in Excel easier and more efficient.
entries.translation: Gorsa kana hordofuudhaan, heertuu sirrii fayyadamuudhaan foormulaa baayyee cimaa ta'e kan hojiikee Excel irraa si salphisu uumuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because they do not feed on blood.
entries.translation: Sababnisaa isaan dhiiga waan hin sooranneefi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, they feed on nectar from flowers.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Female mosquitoes, on the other hand, do feed on blood.
entries.translation: Bookee busaa dhaltuun garuu dhiiga nii sooratti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They need blood in order to produce eggs.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Male mosquitoes are attracted to light, so they are often found near windows and doors.
entries.translation: Bookee buusaa inni dhiiraa ifa jaallata, kanaafuu yeroo baayyee naannoo balbalaa fi foddaa jiraata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also attracted to the smell of sweat and CO2.
entries.translation: Foolii dafqaa fi CO2 baayyee jaallatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Female mosquitoes are attracted to the same things, but they are also attracted to the smell of certain chemicals in human blood.
entries.translation: Bookee busaa dhaltuun waan kana fakkaatus ni jaallatu, akkasumas keemikaalota murtaa'oo dhiiga namaa keessa jiran tokko tokkos ni jaallatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When a female mosquito bites a human, she injects saliva into the skin.
entries.translation: Yeroo bookee busaa dhaltuun nama ciniintu, gorora gogaa namaa keessatti dhangalaafti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This saliva contains anticoagulants, which prevent the blood from clotting.
entries.translation: Gororich farra kantaruu dhiigaa waan of keessa qabuuf dhiigni akka hin kantarre ittisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mosquito then sucks up the blood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bites can cause itching and swelling.
entries.translation: Ciniinnaan bookee hooqsisuu fi dhiita'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, they can also cause an allergic reaction.
entries.translation: Al tokko tokkommoo dhibee aleergikii fiduu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common type of allergic reaction to mosquito bites is hives.
entries.translation: Dhibeen aleergikii beekamaan ciniinnaa bookeetiin dhufu isa nama hooqsisuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hives are red, raised bumps that appear on the skin.
entries.translation: Hooqxoon kun diimaadha, gogaa irratti waanti dhidhiita'ee muldhatu ni jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be itchy or painful.
entries.translation: Baayyee kan nama hooqsisaniifi nama dhukkubsan ta'uu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In rare cases, mosquito bites can cause more serious problems.
entries.translation: Darbee darbee, ciniinnaan bookee rakkaa ulfaataa qaqqabsiisuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, some people can develop an infection at the site of the bite.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, namoonni tokko tokko bakka ciniiname irratti infeekshinii uumuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, mosquito bites can even lead to death.
entries.translation: Yeroo tokko tokkommoo, ciniinnaan bookee nama ajjeesuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to avoid mosquito bites is to wear long sleeves and pants when you are outdoors.
entries.translation: Karaan filatamaan ciniinnaa bookee ittiin ittisnu gad-lixoo fi butaantaa dheeraa uffachuudhaani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also use insect repellent.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you do get bitten by a mosquito, you can apply a cold compress to the bite to relieve the itching and swelling.
entries.translation: Yoo bookeedhaan ciniinamte, waan diilalla'aa irraa ka'uudhaan dhiita'uu fi hooqsisuu qabbaneessuun hin dandaa'ama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also take an over-the-counter antihistamine to relieve the symptoms of an allergic reaction.
entries.translation: Akkasumas aantitestaamiinii fayyadamuudhaan mallatto dhibee aleerjikii sanaa ofitti fooyyessuu ni dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are important carriers of disease.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can transmit a variety of diseases, including malaria, dengue fever, and yellow fever.
entries.translation: Dhukkuboota baayyee kanneen akka buusaa, hoo'ina qaamaa deenjii fi busaa keelloo daddabarsuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are responsible for the deaths of millions of people each year.
entries.translation: Bookeen busaa waggaa waggaatti du'a namoota miliyoonaan lakkaa'amaniif sababa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can be done to control mosquito populations.
entries.translation: Baayyina bookee ittisuuf waantonni godhamuu dandaa'an baayyetu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to reduce the number of places where mosquitoes can breed.
entries.translation: Karaan tokko bakka itti bookeen wal hortu xiqqeessuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by draining standing water and clearing away vegetation.
entries.translation: Kunis bishaan ciisuu gogsuu fi kuduraalee karaa irraa kaasuudhaani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to control mosquito populations is to use insecticides.
entries.translation: Karaan biraan ittiin baayyina bookee hirdhisnu qoricha farra ilbiisotaa fayyadamuudhaani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insecticides can be used to kill mosquitoes both indoors and outdoors.
entries.translation: Qorichi farra ilbiisotaa bookee mana keessaa fi ala jiran ajjeesuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquitoes are a major public health problem.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are a number of things that can be done to control mosquito populations and reduce the risk of mosquito-borne diseases.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, waantotni ittiin baayyina bookee hirdhisnuu fi dhukkuboota bookee dhaan dhufan ittiin xiqqeessinu baayyedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He taught that all beings are caught in a cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, and that this cycle is perpetuated by our attachments to things in the world.
entries.translation: Akkanni yaadetti namni hundinuu marsaa dhalootaa, du'aa fi irra deebi'anii dhalachuutiin qabamu, marsaan kunis kan itti fufsiisame waantota addunyaa kanatti maxxanuu keenyaani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These attachments can be to anything, from material possessions to ideas and beliefs.
entries.translation: Maxxanummaan kun meeshaadhaa hanga yaadaatti yookin amantiitti ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are attached to something, we become possessive and controlling, and we suffer when we lose or cannot have what we want.
entries.translation: Yeroo waan tokkotti maxxannu, waan sana turfachuuf ni yaalla akkasumas gaafa waan sana dhabnu hin miidhamna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Buddha taught that the way to end suffering is to let go of our attachments.
entries.translation: Akka Buuddaan yaadutti karaan nuti miidhama sana irraa oollu waan sana ofirraa fageessuudhaani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is not easy, but it is possible through meditation and other spiritual practices.
entries.translation: Kuni salphaa miti, garuu karuu giddu seentummaa fi adeemsa hafuuraa birootiin raawwatamuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we let go of our attachments, we become free from the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth, and we can experience true peace and happiness.
entries.translation: Gaafa waan itti maxxanne sanarraa adda baanu, marsaa dhalootaa, du'aa fi irra deebi'anii dhalachuu irraa biliisa baanee nagaa fi gammachuu dhaan jiraanna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important things to remember when trying to let go of our attachments is that we are not our possessions.
entries.translation: Waanti baayyee murteessaan yeroo waan sana irraa biliisa ba'uuf jennu yaadachuu qabnu, nuti waanta qabanne sana akka hin taane yaadachuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are not our ideas or beliefs.
entries.translation: Nuti yaada keenya yookin amantii keenya miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are simply beings who are experiencing the world through our senses.
entries.translation: Nuti namoota addunyaa kana karaa miira keenyaa dhaggeeffataa jirruudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we can see ourselves in this way, it becomes easier to let go of the things that we think we need to be happy.
entries.translation: Yeroo ofii keenya karaa kana ilaallu, waantota gammachuu keenyaaf dirqama nu barbaachisu jennee yaadnu dhiisuudhaaf nuu salphata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Letting go of our attachments does not mean that we have to give up everything.
entries.translation: Waantota itti maxxanne irraa fagaachuu jechuun garuu waan hundumaa dhiisuu jechuu miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It simply means that we need to be able to let go of things when it is time.
entries.translation: Gabaabaadhumatti waaninni jechuu barbaadu waan tokko gaafa yeroonsaa ga'u ga'e jechuu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to be able to let go of the things that are no longer serving us, and we need to be able to let go of the things that we are attached to out of fear or insecurity.
entries.translation: Waantota nu fayyadaa hin jirre dhiisuu danda'uu qabma, sodaa dhaaf yookin raafamaaf jecha kan itti maxxanne ofirraa dhiisuu danda'uu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we can let go of our attachments, we open ourselves up to a new world of possibilities.
entries.translation: Gaafa waan itti maxxanne irraa adda of baasne gara addunyaa haaraatti of deebisna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We become free to live our lives in a way that is true to ourselves, and we become free to experience the joy and happiness that is our birthright.
entries.translation: Jireenya keenya biliisaan karaa nuuf sirrii ta'een akka nuti jiraanne taasisa, gammachuu keenya kan dhalootaan nuuf kenname akka nuti fayyadamnu nu taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Trains have been a vital part of transportation for centuries.
entries.translation: Geejjiba irratti baaburri qaama barbaachisaa ta'e jaarrotaaf itti fufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are a safe, efficient, and reliable way to travel long distances.
entries.translation: Isaan karaa dheeraa ittiin deemuudhaaf mijatoo, amanamoo fi ga'umsa kan qabaniidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the railroad industry requires regular updates to keep pace with the changing needs of passengers.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, abbootiin geejjibaa baaburaa fedhii imaltootaa jijjiiramaa deemu guutuuf yeroo dhaa gara yerootti fooyya'iinsa agarsiisuu qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important updates that trains need is the installation of new safety features.
entries.translation: Fooyya'iinsa baabura keessatti godhamuu qabu keessaa inni baayyee barbaachisaan amaloota nageenyaa haaraa diriirsuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there have been a number of high-profile train accidents, which have highlighted the need for better safety measures.
entries.translation: Waggoota muraasa asitti, balaan baaburaa akkan ulfaataa ta'an mudataniru, tarkaanfiin nageenyaa fooyya'aan akka fudhatamuuf akeekeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another important update that trains need is the installation of new technology.
entries.translation: Fooyya'insi baaburri barbaadu keessaa inni tokkomoo teekinooloojii haaraa diriirsuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the past, trains were powered by steam engines.
entries.translation: Dur dur baaburri mootora danfaa tiin hojjeta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, steam engines are inefficient and pollute the environment.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, mootorri danfaa ga'umsa kan hin qabnee fi naannoo kan faalan turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, most trains are powered by diesel engines or electric motors.
entries.translation: Arra baaburri baayyeensaanii mootora boba'aa ykn mootora elektiroonikaa tiin hojjetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These engines are more efficient and environmentally friendly.
entries.translation: Mootoronni warri kan ga'umsa fooyya'aa kan qabanii fi naannoo kan hin faallee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to safety and technology updates, trains also need to be updated to accommodate the needs of passengers.
entries.translation: Nageenyaa fi fooyya'iinsa teekinooloojiin alattis, baaburri fedhii imaltoota keessummeessuuf of haaressuu isa barbaachisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there has been an increase in the number of passengers who travel by train.
entries.translation: Yeroo dhiyoo asitti, baayyinni namoota baaburaan imalanii daballii agarsiiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This has led to overcrowding on trains, which can make for a less comfortable and enjoyable experience.
entries.translation: Kunis imaltoonni garmalee akka baayyatan taasisuun turtiin isaan gammachiisaa akka hin taane taasisuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had always been a talented painter, but after her loss, she found that she was no longer interested in painting pretty landscapes or still lifes.
entries.translation: Kanaan dura dandeettii fakkii kaasuu guddaa qabdi turte, garuu erga dhabuun itti dhagaa'me ta'uumsa lafaa bareedaa kaasuu irraa fedhii dhabdeetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, she began to create dark, brooding works of art that reflected her inner turmoil.
entries.translation: Isa dhiisftee hojii aartii yaaddoo keessa ishee calaqqisiisan hojjechuu jalqabde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of her most famous paintings, "The Death of My Son," is a stark and disturbing image of a young boy lying in a coffin.
entries.translation: Fakkiishee baayyee beekamaa keessaa inni tokko, "Du'a Ilma Kiyyaa," kan baayyee nama dhiphisu kan dargaggeessa saanduqa reeffaa irra ciisuu qabu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy's face is peaceful, but his body is twisted and contorted in pain.
entries.translation: Fulli mucichaa nagaa qaba, garuu qaamnisaa dhukkuba irraan kan ka'ee maramee jajjaldhateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The painting is full of symbolism, and it is clear that Mary is using her art to process her grief and anger.
entries.translation: Fakkichi bakka bu'eedhaan kan guutameedha, akkasuma Meeriin aartii ishee fayyadamuun gaddaa fi aariishee ibsataa jirti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mary's shift in artistic style was not without its critics.
entries.translation: Meeriin gaara aartiitti deebi'uun ishee komii kaasuu hin dhiisne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people accused her of being exploitative and insensitive.
entries.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko fayyadamtuu fi miira hin qabdu jedhanii kasasaa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is bordered by Egypt to the north, Libya to the northwest, Chad to the west, the Central African Republic to the southwest, South Sudan to the south, Ethiopia to the southeast, and Eritrea to the east.
entries.translation: Karaa Kaabaatiin Masirii dhaan daangeffamti, karaa Kaaba Dhihaatiin Liibiyaa dhaan, karaa Lixaa tiin Chaad, karaa Kibba Dhihaa tiin Giddu-gala Rippaabiliika Afrikaa tiin fi karaa Bahaa tiin Eertiraa dhaan daangeffamti.

entries.english: Sudan has a population of over 40 million people and a land area of over 1.8 million square kilometers.

entries.english: Sudan's history is long and complex.

entries.english: The area has been inhabited by humans for thousands of years, and the first known civilization in Sudan was the Kingdom of Kush, which flourished from around 750 BC to 350 AD.
entries.translation: Lafichi waggoottan kumootaaf dhala namaatiin qabatameera, qaroominni yeroo jalqabaaf Sudaan keessatti beekame qarooma Kuush kan bara 750 DH.K.D hang 350 DH.K.B tureedha.

entries.english: Kush was a powerful kingdom that controlled much of the Nile River valley.

entries.english: In the 7th century AD, Sudan was conquered by the Arabs, who brought Islam to the region.

entries.english: Sudan was ruled by a series of Arab sultanates for centuries, until it was conquered by Egypt in 1821.

entries.english: Egypt ruled Sudan until 1885, when it was conquered by the Mahdi, a religious leader who led a rebellion against Egyptian rule.
entries.translation: Masiriin Sudaaniin hanga 1885 tti bitte, hanga Mahaadii kan hoogganaa amantii ture Masirii irratti fincilee isaan weerarutti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mahdi's rule was short-lived, and Sudan was reconquered by the British in 1898.

entries.english: My dear daughter, I know you've been wondering about the nature of light and darkness.

entries.english: It's a big question, and one that scientists have been trying to answer for centuries.

entries.english: But I think I can give you a simple explanation that will help you understand it a little better.

entries.english: Light is a kind of energy that travels in waves.

entries.english: We can see light because it enters our eyes and stimulates the retina, which is a light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye.

entries.english: The retina sends signals to our brain, which interprets them as images.

entries.english: Darkness is the absence of light.

entries.english: When there is no light, we can't see anything.

entries.english: Light and darkness are two opposites, but they're also two sides of the same coin.

entries.english: Darkness helps us to rest and sleep.

entries.english: It also creates a sense of mystery and wonder.

entries.english: So next time you're outside at night, take a moment to appreciate the darkness.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: ## Road Safety: A True Door to a Safer Future
entries.translation: ## Nageenya Karaa: Balbala Dhugaa Nageenya Egereef
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Road safety is a major public health issue.
entries.translation: Nageenyi karaa rakkoo nageenya hawaasaa isa guddaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2020, an estimated 38,000 people were killed in motor vehicle crashes in the United States.
entries.translation: Bara 2020 keessa, Ameerikaa keessatti galagalu konkolaattota mootoraatiin namoota 38,000 ta'antu ajjeefame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's an average of one person every 135 minutes.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun giddu galeessaan daqiiqaa 135 tti nama tokkotu du'a jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many things that can be done to improve road safety, including enforcing traffic laws, educating drivers and pedestrians, and making roads safer.
entries.translation: Nageenya karaa fooyyeessuf waantota godhaman baayyetu jira, isaanis: seera tiraafikaa raawwachiisuu, konkolaachiiftotaa fi warra miillaan deemaan barsiisuu fi karaa wal qixxee goochuu faa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One important step is to make sure that all vehicles have properly functioning doors.
entries.translation: Tarkaanfiin barbaachisaan tokko, konkolaattonni hunduu balbala dalagu qabaachuusaanii mirkaneessuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A door that doesn't open or close properly can be a major safety hazard.
entries.translation: Balballi sirnaan banamee hin cufamne balaa karaa isa guddaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If a door is stuck, it can prevent a person from escaping from a vehicle in the event of a crash.
entries.translation: Balballi yoo socho'uu dide, namoonni yeroo balaan konkolaataa uumame akka hin baqannee ittisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A door that opens too easily can also be dangerous, as it could allow a person to be ejected from the vehicle in a crash.
entries.translation: Balballi salphaatti banamus balaa fiduu danda'a, yeroo balaan uumamu nama gad darbachuu waan danda'uuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to make sure that all doors on your vehicle are in good working order.
entries.translation: Balbaloonni konkolaataakeerra jiran sirnaan dalagaa jiraachuu isaanii mirkaneessuun gaariidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have a door that doesn't open or close properly, you should have it repaired or replaced as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Balbala sirnaan banamee hin cufamne yoo qabaatte, yookiin suphisiisuu yookinimmoo jijjiirsisuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By making sure that all vehicles have properly functioning doors, we can help to reduce the number of traffic-related deaths and injuries.
entries.translation: Konkolaataan balbaloota sirnaan hojjetaa jiran qabaachuusaa mirkaneessuun, madaa fi du'a tiraafikaan wal qabatanii dhufan hirdhisuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I was driving down a tight road in a small town when I saw a sign that said "Parking Extra Tight."

entries.english: I laughed and thought, "That's a funny way to say it!"

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I realized that it was actually a very accurate description of the parking situation.

entries.english: The spaces were so narrow that I could barely fit my car in them.

entries.english: I had to pull in and out several times before I was finally able to get parked.

entries.english: As I was getting out of my car, I saw a man standing next to me.

entries.english: He smiled and said, "I see you found the parking extra tight!"

entries.english: I laughed and said, "Yes, I did. But I finally made it!"
