entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The man shook my hand and said, "Welcome to our town. We're glad you're here,"
entries.translation: Namichis harka na fuudhee akkas jedhe, "Gara magaalaa keenyaa baga nagaan dhufte. As jiraachuukeetti gammanneerra".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled and said, "Thank you. I'm glad to be here."
entries.translation: Anis kolfeen, "Galatoomi. Anis as jiraachuukootti gammadeera."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I got into my car and drove away.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I was driving, I thought about the man's words.
entries.translation: Yeroon oofaa jiru, waa'ee jecha namicha sanaan yaade.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was glad to be in that town.
entries.translation: Magaalaa sana keessa jiraachuukootti gammadaan ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a friendly place, and the people were welcoming.
entries.translation: Bakka namatti tolu ture, namoonnisaaniis baayyee nama simatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Old Mrs. Brown stood on the porch of her small cottage, watching the children play in the yard.
entries.translation: Aadde Biroowin baarandaa manashee xiqqoo keessa dhaabbattee yeroo ijoolleen dirree keessa taphatan ilaalaa turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled as she saw her granddaughter, Lily, run and jump with the other children.
entries.translation: Intalli mucaasheetii, Liilliin yeroo ijoollee biroo wajjin fiigdee utaaltuu arguusheetti ni kolfite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lily was a bright and cheerful child, and Mrs. Brown was proud of her.
entries.translation: Liilliin ijoollee gammadduu fi iftuu turte, akkasumas aadde Biroown ittiin boonti turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Brown had been a grandmother for many years, and she had seen many changes in the world.
entries.translation: Aadde Biroown waggaa dheeraadhaaf akkoo turte, addunyaa irrattis jijjiirama baayyee argiteetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had seen the rise and fall of empires, the birth and death of new technologies, and the coming and going of many different fashions.
entries.translation: Ka'uu fi kufaatii impaayerotaa argiteetti, dhalachuu fi du'uu teekinooloojii haaraa fi dhufaatii fi badiisa faashinoota garaa garaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But through it all, one thing had remained constant: the love between a grandmother and her grandchild.
entries.translation: Garuu waan kana hunda keesatti, waanti tokko dhaabbataa ture: jaalala isheefi intala mucaasheetii gidduu jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Brown knew that she was not the only grandmother who felt this way.
entries.translation: Aadde Biroown akkoon waan akkasii itti dhagaa'amu ishee qofa akka hin taanee beekteetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: All over the world, there were grandmothers who loved their grandchildren just as much as she loved Lily.
entries.translation: Addunyaa hunda irratti, akkoon akka isheen itti intala mucaasheetii jaallattetti ijoollee ijoolleesaanii jaallatan turaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And this love was a powerful force that could stand against anything.
entries.translation: Jaalalli kunis humna jabaa waan hundumaa dura dhaabbachuu danda'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Brown had seen the love between a grandmother and her grandchild stand against the ravages of time, the cruelty of war, and even the indifference of death.
entries.translation: Aadde Biroown jaalalli akkoo fi ijoollee ijoolleeshee gidduu jiru jibbiinsa yeroo, gara jabina lolaa fi al-qoodiinsa du'aa dura dhaabbachuu akka danda'u agarteetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that this love was a precious gift, and she was grateful for every day that she could spend with her granddaughter.
entries.translation: Jaalalli kun kennaa gati-jabeessa ta'usaa beekteetti, intala mucaa isheetii duukaa yeroo dabarsitee hundumaafis galateeffattuu turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has been used for warmth, cooking, and protection, and it has also played a role in shaping the landscape.
entries.translation: Hoo'isuuf, bilcheessuuf, eegguf akkasumas taa'umsa lafaa qajeelchuuf ga'eesaa ba'ateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, however, the relationship between humans and fire has become increasingly complex.
entries.translation: Waggoota muraasaa asitti garuu, walitti dhufeenyi namootaa fi abidda gidduu baayyee wal xaxaa ta'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Climate change is making fires more frequent and more intense, and this is having a devastating impact on forests, homes, and lives.
entries.translation: Jijjiiramni qilleensa baramaa balaan abiddaa akka daddafee uumamuu fi bosona, mana fi jireenya irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people argue that the best way to deal with this problem is to suppress all fires.
entries.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko akka jedhanitti fala waaraan dhimma kana ittiin to'atan abidda dhabamsiisuudhaani jedhanii yaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This approach has been used for centuries, but it is not always effective.
entries.translation: Malli kun jaarraadhaaf kan fayyadamame ta'us garuu, yeroo hundumaa bu'a qabeessa miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, it can sometimes make things worse.
entries.translation: Dhugaa dubbachuf, yeroo tokko tokko waantonni akka badan gochuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When fires are suppressed, they build up fuel and become more likely to cause a large, destructive fire.
entries.translation: Ibiddi gaafa walitti qabamu, bobaa'aa uumuudhaan abidda baayyee guddaa fi badii hamaa qaqqabsiisuu uumuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another approach is to let fires burn naturally.
entries.translation: Mallil kan biraan abiddi ofumasaatii boba'ee akka dhaabbatu taasisuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This approach can be effective in some cases, but it is not always safe or practical.
entries.translation: Malli kun dhimma tokko tokko irratti bu'a qabeessa ta'uu danda'a, garuu yeroo hunda bu'a qabeessaa fi waan hojiirra oolu miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many cases, it is necessary to intervene to protect people and property.
entries.translation: Bakka baayyeetti, gidduu seenanii uummataa fi qabeenya baraaruun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to deal with fire is to find a balance between suppression and natural burning.
entries.translation: Karaan waaraan ittin abidda to'atan madaala walitti qabuu fi gubachuu isaa eeguudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This approach requires planning and cooperation, but it is the most effective way to reduce the risk of wildfires.
entries.translation: Malli kun karoora fi wal tumsuu barbaada, garuu mala baayyee bareedaa ittiin balaa bosonarra ga'u ittiin ittisaniidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Resilience and adaptation are key to this approach.
entries.translation: Cichoomina fi itti baruun mala kanaaf furtuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Resilience is the ability to withstand and recover from a disturbance, while adaptation is the ability to adjust to a changing environment.
entries.translation: Cichoominni dandeetti jeequmsa irraa bayyaannachuu fi dura dhaabbachuuti, itti baruunimmo naannoo jijjiiramaatti dandeettii baruuti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Both resilience and adaptation are important for humans and for ecosystems.
entries.translation: Cichoominnii fi madaqiinsi namootaa fi sinakkoo dhaaf barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans can build resilience to fire by taking steps to reduce the risk of wildfires, such as clearing brush and creating firebreaks.
entries.translation: Namoonni abidda irratti cichoomina uumuudhaan balaa abiddaa bosona irra ga'u ittisuuf tarkaanfii fudhachuu danda'u, fakkeenyaaf burushii qulqulleessuu fi to'attuu abiddaa uumuu faa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also adapt to fire by learning how to live in fire-prone areas.
entries.translation: Akkaataa itti naannoo balaa abiddaaf saaxilamaa ta'e keessa jiraachuu baruudhann abiddattis madaquu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ecosystems can also be resilient to fire.
entries.translation: Sirnakkoonins balaa abiddaa kan dandamatu ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fire is a natural part of many ecosystems, and it can actually help to maintain healthy forests.
entries.translation: Abiddi qaama uumamaa sirnakkoo baayyeeti, akkasumas bosona nagaa qabu eegsisuu keessatti s gargaaruu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When fires are suppressed, they can disrupt the natural cycle of fire and forest growth.
entries.translation: Abiddi gaafa ukkaamsaman, marsaa uumamaa abiddaa fi guddina bosonaa jeequu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By working together, humans and ecosystems can build resilience to fire.
entries.translation: Waliin hojjechuudhaan, namoonni fi sirnakkoon dandamannaa abiddaa guddifachuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This will help to reduce the risk of wildfires and protect lives and property.
entries.translation: Kunis balaa abiddaa bosona irra ga'u ittisuu fi qabeenyaa fi lubbuu eeguuf gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, further investigation revealed that he had been poisoned with cyanide.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, qorannoon dabalataa akka muldhisetti, summii saayinaayidi jedhamu nyaachifamuusaa muldhiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police are now looking for the person who killed Bilici.
entries.translation: Poolisoonni amma nama Biliichii ajjeese barbaadaa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bilici was a successful businessman who had made a lot of enemies in his time.
entries.translation: Biliichiin daldalaa milkaa'a fi yeroosaa keessatti nama diina baayyee horateedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was known to be ruthless and ambitious, and he had no qualms about stepping on people to get what he wanted.
entries.translation: Araarama kan hin qabnee fi nama fedhii guddaa qabu ta'usaatiin beekama, waan barbaadu argachuuf nama miidhuudhaaf mamii hin qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is likely that one of his enemies killed him in an attempt to get revenge.
entries.translation: Diinota isaa keessa namni tokko haaloo ba'uuf akka isa ajjeesetu tilmaamama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police are currently interviewing Bilici's friends, family, and business associates in an attempt to find out who killed him.
entries.translation: Poolisiin yeroo ammaatti nama isa ajjeese baruuf hiriyoota, maatii fi waayila daldalaa Biliichii af-gaaffii taasisaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also looking into Bilici's financial records and his personal life in an attempt to find any clues that might lead them to the killer.
entries.translation: Ragaa faayinaansii fi jireenya dhuunfaa Biliichi qorachuudhaanis odeeffannoo xiqqoo waa'ee namicha isa ajjeesee argachuuf yaalaa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The police are confident that they will eventually find Bilici's killer.
entries.translation: Poolisoonni dhuma irratti nama Biliichiin ajjeesa akka argatan ofitti amanamummaa guutuu qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have a strong team of investigators working on the case, and they are determined to bring the killer to justice.
entries.translation: Garee qorataa cimaa dhimmicha irratti hojjetaa jiru qabu, ajjeesaa sanas seeratti dhiyeessuuf karoorfatanii jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bilici's death is a tragedy, and his family and friends are heartbroken.
entries.translation: Duuti Biliichi gadda guddaadha, maatii fi hiriyoota isaa lapheen cabeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the police are committed to finding Bilici's killer and bringing him to justice.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, poolisoonni nama Biliichiin ajjeese seeratti dhiyeessuuf kutataniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They believe that the killer will be brought to justice, and that Bilici's family and friends will finally get the closure they deserve.
entries.translation: Akka isaan yaadanitti namni Biliichiin ajjeese seeratti ni dhiyaata, maatii fi hiriyoonni Biliichis dhumarratti dhimma kana irratti waan eeggataa jiran ni argatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A newspaper is a periodical publication containing current news, informative articles, diverse features, advertising, and other content.
entries.translation: Gaazexaan maxxansa yeroo yeroodhaan maxxanfamuu if oduu haala yeroo, keeyyata odeeffannoo qaban, amaloota garaa garaa fi qabiyyee biroo of keessaa qabuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is typically printed on relatively inexpensive, low-grade paper called newsprint.
entries.translation: Yeroo baayyee kan maxxanfamuu fi gatiinsaas rakasa, waraqaa sadarkaan gadi-bu'aa maxxanxa gaazexaa jedhamu kan ta'eedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Most newspapers are published daily or weekly, but some may be published less frequently.
entries.translation: Gaazexaan baayyeen guyyaa guyyaadhaan yookin torban toorbaniin kan maxxanfamaniidha, akkasumas kan daddafanii hin maxxanfamnes ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Newspapers are distributed through a variety of channels, including print, online, and mobile.
entries.translation: Gaazexaan chaanaliiwwan garaa garaan raabsamuu danda'a, maxxansaan, interneetaan fi bilbila dabalatee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Newspapers have been around for centuries, and they have played an important role in informing the public about current events.
entries.translation: Gaazexaan jarraadhaaf ture yoo ta'u waa'ee dhimma yeroo irratti hawaasaaf odeeffannoo kennuu irratti gahee guddaa ba'ataniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early days of newspapers, they were often the only source of information for people living in rural areas.
entries.translation: Yeroo jalqabaa isaarratti gaazexaan namoota naannoo baadiyyaa jiraatanif maddi odeeffannoo isa qofa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, newspapers continue to be a valuable source of information, but they face competition from other media outlets, such as television, radio, and the internet.
entries.translation: Arra, gaazexaan madda odeeffannoo gaarii ta'ee itti fufeera, garuu miidiyaalee akka televiijinii, raadiyoo fi interneetii rraa morkiin itti dhufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of newspapers, each with its own target audience.
entries.translation: Gosoota gaazexaa garaa garatu jira, hundi isaaniyyuu qaama dhaqqabuu barbaadaan kan mataa ofii qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some newspapers are general-interest publications, while others focus on specific topics, such as business, sports, or entertainment.
entries.translation: Gaazexaan tokko tokko maxxansa fedhii walii galaati, warri kaan mata-duree murtaa'e kanneen akka daldala, ispoortii yookin bashannana irratti xiyyeeffatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Newspapers can also be classified by their political leanings, with some being considered liberal or left-wing, while others are considered conservative or right-wing.
entries.translation: Gaazexaan qabiyyee siyaasaa isaatiiniis qoodamu danda'u, gar-tokkoonsaa yoo kan biliisaa yookiin baallee bitaa ta'e, gar-tokkoon isaammoo seera kan cimsu yookin baallee mirgaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to providing news and information, newspapers also play an important role in shaping public opinion.
entries.translation: Odeeffannoo fi oduu dhiyeessuun cinatti, gaazexaan yaada hawaasaa luuccessuu irratti ga'ee guddaa qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The regular shape of a circle is what makes it so terrifying.
entries.translation: Boci idilee geengoo waantota yaaddessaa isa taasisan keessaa isa tokko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the perfect geometric form, with no flaws or imperfections.
entries.translation: Bifa ji'omeetirii sirriidha, mudaa fi hanqina kan hin qabneedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is symmetrical and balanced, and its center is the focal point of all attention.
entries.translation: Bifa naanna'aa fi madaalamaadha, akkasumas gidduun isaa qabxii fuulleffannaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This perfection is what makes it so unsettling.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do you want a space that is relaxing and inviting, or something more energetic and stimulating?
entries.translation: Bakka nama boqonnaa sii kennuu fi akka deemtuuf si hawwatu moo bakka si humneessuu fi si kakaasu barbaadda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you're looking for, you can start to narrow down your choices.
entries.translation: Gaafa waanta barbaaddu bartu, filannookee dhiphisuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're looking for a relaxing and inviting bedroom, consider choosing neutral colors and soft fabrics.
entries.translation: Yoo bakka boqonnaa fi hawwataa barbaadda ta'e, halluu biliisaa fi oomisha lallafaa filadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid anything too bright or loud, as this can create a negative atmosphere.
entries.translation: Waan baayyee calaqqisuu yookin sagalee dhageessisu hin fayyadamiin, atimoosferii iyiintaa uumuu waan danda'uuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also make sure there is plenty of comfortable seating, such as a bed, armchair, or chaise lounge.
entries.translation: Waanti irra taa'an kan akka siree, teessuma, bakki nyaataa ga'aa fi mijataan jiraachuusaa mirkaneessi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're looking for a more energetic and stimulating bedroom, you can choose bolder colors and patterns.
entries.translation: Bakka caalaatti si humneessuu fi si kakaasuu barbaadda yoo ta'emmoo, halluu jabaa fi sirna jabaa filachuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also add in some interesting design elements, such as a statement piece of furniture or a unique light fixture.
entries.translation: Elemeentii dizaayinii kanneen akka meeshaa gaggaarii yookiin ifa adda ta'e itti dabaluu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just be careful not to overdo it, as too much stimulation can be overwhelming.
entries.translation: Hanga barbaadamuu ol akka hin hojjenne qofa of eeggadhu, kaka'umsi gar malee humnaa ol ta'uu waan danda'uuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, no bedroom is complete without a comfortable bed.
entries.translation: Kutaan ciisiichaa siree mijataa hin qabnemmoo guutuu ta'uu hin danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I remember when you were little, you loved going to the beach during the holidays.
entries.translation: Nan yaadadha yeroo xiqqoo turte guyyaa ayyaana irra gara qarqara galaanaa deemuu jaallatta turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You would spend hours playing in the sand and swimming in the ocean.
entries.translation: Sa'atii dheeraa cirracha irra taphachuu fi garba keessa daakuu dhaan dabarsita.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I remember one time, you were so excited to build a sandcastle that you didn't even want to go swimming.
entries.translation: Nan yaadadha yeroo tokko, masaraa cirrachaa ijaaruu baayyee barbaaddee daakaa dhaquuyyuu hin barbaanne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You worked on that castle for hours, and when it was finally finished, it was the most amazing sandcastle I had ever seen.
entries.translation: Sa'aatii dheeraaf masaraa sana irra hojjette, gaafa xumurtu masaraa cirrachaa ani argee beeku keessaa isa gaarii ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You were so proud of yourself, and I was so proud of you.
entries.translation: Ati ofiikeetti baayyee boonte anis baayyeen siin boone.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I remember taking a picture of you standing next to your castle, and you had the biggest smile on your face.
entries.translation: Suuraa ati masaraakee cina dhaabbattuu si kaasuukoo nan yaadadha, atis gammachuu guddaatu fuulakeerraa dubbifamaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That was one of my favorite memories of our holidays together.
entries.translation: Sun guyyaa anif ati wajjin dabarsine keessaa isa gaarii ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you're older now, and you might not like the beach as much as you used to.
entries.translation: Amma akkati guddatte beeka, akkasumas amma qarqara galaanaa deemuu akka duraa jaallachuu dhiisuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I hope you'll always remember the joy you used to find in playing in the sand and swimming in the ocean.
entries.translation: Garuu gammachuu cirracha keessa taphachuu fi garba daakuu irraa argataa turte yeroo hundumaa akkati yaadattu nan abdadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Those are some of the best memories of my life, and I hope they're some of yours too.
entries.translation: Yaadannoo jireenyaakoo keessaa isaan kun isa tokko yoo ta'an, kan kees akka ta'an nan abdadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kindness is one of the most important virtues that a person can possess.
entries.translation: Garraamummaan gaarummaa namni qabaachuu danda'u keessaa isa tokko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the act of being considerate and thoughtful of others, and it is something that can make a real difference in the world.
entries.translation: Gocha nama hubachuu fi waa'ee namoota biroo yaaduu dha inni, addunyaa kana keessattis waan jijjiirama dhugaa fiduu danda'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A kind word, a smile, or a helping hand can go a long way to brighten someone's day and make them feel better about themselves.
entries.translation: Jechi gaariin, seeqni yookin harki gargaarsaa guyyaa nama tokkoo ibsuu fi waa'ee mataa isaanii waanti gaariin akka itti dhagaa'amuu gochuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways to show kindness.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can volunteer your time at a local soup kitchen or homeless shelter, donate to a charity that you believe in, or simply be a good listener to someone who is going through a tough time.
entries.translation: Yerookee nama naannookeetii saamunaa gurguru yookiin nama mana jireenyaa hin qabneef,dhaabbata gargarsaaf gumaacha taasisuu yookinimmoo nama yeroo ulfaataa dabarsaa jiruuf dhaggeeffataa gaarii ta'uu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: No matter how big or small the act, kindness is always appreciated.
entries.translation: Gochichi guddaas ha ta'u xiqqoo, garraamummaan yeroo hunda ni galateeffachiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a simple act that can make a big difference.
entries.translation: Gocha xiqqoo jijjiirama guddaa uumuu danda'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So next time you see someone who could use a little help, don't hesitate to reach out and lend a hand.
entries.translation: Kanaafuu yeroo itti aanu yoo nama gargaarsa xiqqoo barbaadu agarte, bira geessee gargaaruuf hin mamin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You might just make their day.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One classic example of kindness is the story of the Good Samaritan.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyi sirriin garraamummaa seenaa Samaariyaa gaarii sanadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In this story, a man is beaten and left for dead on the side of the road.
entries.translation: Seenaa kana keessatti, namichi tokko haga du'aatti tumamee daandii cinatti gatame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Two men pass by, but they do not help him.
entries.translation: Namoonni lama bira darban, garuu gargaarsa hin kennineef.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, a third man, who is a Samaritan, stops to help the injured man.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, namichi sadaffaan Samariyaa ta'e, namicha madaa'ee gargaaruuf dhaabbate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I walked through the crowded festival grounds, I couldn't help but smile.
entries.translation: Bakka kabaja ayyaanaa namaan guutame keessa yeroon deemu, seequu malee gargaaruu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sun was shining, the music was blaring, and everyone was wearing their sunglasses and eyeglasses.
entries.translation: Aduun ifaa turte, muuziqaanis iyyaa ture, namni hundu fuullee aduu fi fuullee ijaa uffatee jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was like a sea of color and style, and it made me feel happy to be a part of it.
entries.translation: Galaana halluu fi haalaa fakkaata ture, qaama waan sanaa ta'uukoottis akkan gammadu na taasiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I saw people wearing all sorts of different glasses, from simple, round frames to elaborate, cat-eye shapes.
entries.translation: Namoota fuullee garaa garaa hunda uffatanin arge, fireemii geengoo salphaa irraa hanga isa boca ija adurree qabuutti jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were sunglasses in every color of the rainbow, and some people even had glasses that lit up or changed colors.
entries.translation: Hallii sabbata waaqaa hundaan fuullen aduu tureera, namoonni tokko tokkommoo fuullee ifuu danda'uu fi halluu jijjiirratu faa uffataa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was like a fashion show, and I couldn't help but admire everyone's unique style.
entries.translation: Agarsiisa faashinii fakkaata ture, garuu haala addaa nama hundumaa dinqisiifachuu irraan kan hafe gargaaruu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I stopped to talk to a woman who was wearing a pair of bright yellow sunglasses.
entries.translation: Duubartii fuullee aduu cimdii ifaa fi keelloo uffattu haasofsiisfuufin dhaabbadhe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She told me that she loved wearing sunglasses because they made her feel more confident and stylish.
entries.translation: Fuulleen aduu ofitti amanamummaan akka itti dhagaa'amu akka godhee fi haala addaa akka qabaattu akka ishee taasise natti himte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She said that she always felt like she was wearing a costume when she didn't have her glasses on, and that they helped her to express her personality.
entries.translation: Akkasheen natti himtetti gaafa fuullee ishee hin uffanne akka waan uffata biyya tokko uffattuu kan itti dhagaa'amuu fi namummaa ishee ibsuuf akka ishee fayyadu dubbatti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I continued on my way, and I couldn't help but feel more optimistic about the world.
entries.translation: Karaakoon itti fufe, waa'ee addunyaa kanaa abdii godhachuu irrraan kan hafe gargaaruu hin dandeenye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Online shopping is the process of buying goods or services from a retailer over the Internet.
entries.translation: Gabaa sarara irraa jechuun adeemsa daldalaa irraa meeshaalee karaa interneetaa bituuti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is different from traditional shopping in that the consumer does not physically visit a store to purchase the product.
entries.translation: Adeemsa bittaa fi gurgurtaa aadaa irraa adda kan ta'eefi namni waa bitu namicha gurguru sana qaamaan arguun hin barbaachisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instead, the consumer browses through products and makes purchases online.
entries.translation: Ijaasaa, namni waa bitu oomishaalee jiran ilaalee karaa sarara irraa bittaa raawwata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The consumer then receives the product at their home address.
entries.translation: Isa booda waan isaan bitan teessoo mana isaanitti isaan dhaqqaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many benefits to online shopping.
entries.translation: Bittaa fi gurgurtaan sarara irraa bu'aa baayyee qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it is often more convenient than traditional shopping.
entries.translation: Jalqaba irratti isa aadaa wajjin yeroo wal bira qabamu, inni kun baayyee mijataadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consumers can shop from the comfort of their own home, at any time of day or night.
entries.translation: Warri bituu barbaadan michuu mana isaanii keessa ta'ani halkaniif guyyaa bittaa raawwachuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also compare prices from different retailers and read reviews of products before making a purchase.
entries.translation: Akkasumas daldaltoota garaa garaa irraa gatii wal bira qabuu kan danda'aniif waa'ee oomisha sanaa waanta jedhame bituun dura dubbisuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, online shopping can be more affordable than traditional shopping.
entries.translation: Lammata, bittaan sarara irraa bittaa isaa aadaa irra rakasa ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many retailers offer discounts and promotions on their online products.
entries.translation: Daldaltoonni baayyeen, oomisha isaanii sarara irra jiru irratti beeksisaa fi hirdhina gatii afeeru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, online shopping can be more environmentally friendly than traditional shopping.
entries.translation: Sadaaffaa, bittaan sarara irraa isa aadaa caalaa naannoo wajjin kan wal simatuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consumers do not have to drive to the store, which reduces emissions.
entries.translation: Warri bitan gara mana kuusaatti konkolaataa oofuun irra hin jiru, kunimmoo faalama xiqqeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are also some drawbacks to online shopping.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, bittaan sarara irraa hanqinoota muraasa ni qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, consumers cannot try on clothes or test out products before they buy them.
entries.translation: Tokkoffaa, warri bitan uffata uffatanii ilaaluu hin danda'an bituun duratti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to disappointment if the product does not fit or meet the consumer's expectations.
entries.translation: Kunis yoo oomishi sun waan isaan irraa eegaa jiran guutuu fi dide isaan aarsuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, online shopping can be more risky than traditional shopping.
entries.translation: Lammaffaa, bittaan sarara irraa isa aadaa caalaa rakkoo qabaachuu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consumers need to be careful about providing their credit card information online.
entries.translation: Warri bitan odeeffannoo kireedit kaardii isaanii sarara irraan qooduu irratti of eeggannoo taasisuu qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The history of space technology is a relatively short one, but it has already had a profound impact on our world.
entries.translation: Seenaan teekinooloojii hawaa isa kaanii wajjin gaafa ilaalamu gabaabaadha, garuu addunyaa keenya irratti dhiibbaa qabatamaa uumeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 1950s, the United States and the Soviet Union launched the first artificial satellites into orbit, ushering in a new era of space exploration.
entries.translation: Bara 1950 gara jalqabaa keessa, Ameerikaa fi Gamtaan Sooviyeet saatalaayitii nam-tolchee jalqabaa gara oorbitiitti ergan, kunis qorannoo hawaa keessatti jabana haaraa jalqabsiise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Since then, we have sent humans to the Moon, built space stations, and launched countless satellites into orbit.
entries.translation: Ergasii, namoota gara ji'aatti ergineerra, buufata hawaa ijaarreerra, akkasumas saatalaayitii lakkoofsa hin qabne gara oorbitiitti ergineerra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These achievements have not only led to new scientific discoveries, but they have also made our world more interconnected and has given us a new perspective on our place in the universe.
entries.translation: Milkaa'insi kun qorannoo saayinsaawaa haaraa argachuu qofa osoo hin taane, addunyaan keenya akka isheen sirritti walitti hidhamtuu fi bakka keenya addunyaa irraa keessatti haala haaraa akka qabaannu nu taasiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Today, space technology is used for a wide variety of purposes, including telecommunications, navigation, weather forecasting, and Earth observation.
entries.translation: Arra, teekinooloojiin hawaa waantota garaa garaa kanneen akka teeleekomunikeeshinii, odeeffannoo funanuu, haala qilleensaa tilmaamuu fi lafa xiinxaluuf gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As space technology continues to develop, it is likely to play an even greater role in our lives.
entries.translation: Akkuma teekinooloojiin hawaa guddataa deemuun, jireenya keenya keessatti ga'ee guddaa taphachuu itti fufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the future, we may see humans colonizing Mars, mining asteroids for resources, and using space-based solar power to generate electricity.

entries.english: The government can also provide farmers with training and education, so that they can learn new ways to farm and increase their productivity.

entries.english: Finally, the government can work to improve the lives of farmers by providing them with better access to healthcare, education, and other social services.

entries.english: That's why it's important to take care of art, especially if you're a collector.

entries.english: One of the most important things you can do to care for art is to keep it in a controlled environment.

entries.english: This means keeping the temperature and humidity at a constant level, and protecting the art from direct sunlight.

entries.english: You should also avoid exposing art to dust and dirt, and make sure it's not hung too close to a heat source.

entries.english: Here are a few additional tips for caring for art:

entries.english: * Don't touch the art with your bare hands.

entries.english: Use gloves or tissue paper to handle it.

entries.english: * Avoid hanging art in direct sunlight.
entries.translation: * Ifa aduu keessatti rarraasuu irraa of qusadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Keep art away from heat sources, such as fireplaces and radiators.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Protect art from dust and dirt by dusting it regularly with a soft brush.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dimly lit or dark places can be both mysterious and alluring.

entries.english: They can provide a sense of seclusion and privacy, but they can also be dangerous and frightening.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In literature, dark and dim places are often used to create a sense of suspense or horror.
entries.translation: Litireecharii keessatti, bakka dukkanaa fi ifa xiqqoo qabu miira sodaachisuu fi haawwachuu uumuuf fayyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, in Edgar Allan Poe's "The Tell-Tale Heart," the narrator's description of the dark room in which he murders the old man is both chilling and evocative.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf "Onnee oduu durii Himi" Eejaar Alaan Pooyee keessatti, akkaataan namichi seenaa himu mana dukkanaa keessatti jaarsa tokko ajjeese kan nama diilalleessuu fi nam kakaasuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In real life, dark and dim places can also be dangerous.
entries.translation: Jireenya keessatti bakka dukkanaa fi ifa xiqqoo qabu balaafamaa ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be difficult to navigate, and they can provide cover for criminals.
entries.translation: Arguuf baayyee rakkisaa ta'uu danda'a, akkasumas nama yakka hojjetu haguuguu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Additionally, dark places can make people feel vulnerable and afraid.
entries.translation: Dabalataanis, bakki dukkanaa namoonni saaxilamummaa fi sodaan akka itti dhagaa'amu godha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For this reason, it is important to be aware of your surroundings and to take precautions when entering a dark or dimly lit area.
entries.translation: Sababa kanaaf, gaafa bakka ifa xiqqoo qabuu fi dukkanaa'aa ta'e ol seennu naannoo keenya sirnaan ilaaluu fi of eeggannoo godhuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the potential dangers, dark and dim places can also be beautiful and inspiring.
entries.translation: Rakkoon jiraachuu danda'us, bakki dukkanaa fi ifa xiqqoo qabu bareedaa fi kan nama kakaasu ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can provide a sense of peace and tranquility, and they can be conducive to creativity and reflection.
entries.translation: Miira nageenyaa fi tasgabbii dhiyeessuu danda'u akkasumas, kalaqaa fi sirriitti waa ibsuuf mijataa ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, many artists and writers have found inspiration in the darkness.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, aartistoonni fi barreessitoonni baayyeen dukkana keessa kaka'umsa baayyee argan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vincent van Gogh, for example, was known for painting in the dark, and his work often reflects the beauty and mystery of the night.
entries.translation: Viinsenti Vaan Gooyi fakkeenyaaf, dukkana keessa fakkii kaasuun beekama, hojiinsaa baayyeensaaniis bareedinaa fi iccitii dukkanaa ibsu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Climate change has ravaged the planet, and many major cities have been abandoned.
entries.translation: Jijjiiramni qilleensaa pilaaneetii barbadeesseera, magaaloonni baayyeenis gatamaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The few remaining humans live in small, isolated communities, struggling to survive in a harsh and unforgiving world.
entries.translation: Namoonni lubbuun hafan muraasni hawaasa gargar ba'e fi xiqqoo ta'e fi addunyaa gara jabeessa mijataa hin taanee keessa jiraachuuf qabsaa'aa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In one of these communities, there is a young woman named Sneha who is training to be a long-distance runner.
entries.translation: Hawaasa kana keessaa tokko, dargaggeetti Sinehaa atilee fageenya dheeraa fiigdu ta'uuf shaakalaa jirti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She has always been a gifted athlete, and she dreams of one day competing in the Olympics.
entries.translation: Yeroo hundumaa atileetii kennaa qabdu turte, abjuu guyyaa tokko oloonpikii irratti dorgomus qabdi turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Sneha knows that the odds are stacked against her.
entries.translation: Garuu Sineehaan waan hunduu faallaa kanaa akka itti ta'e ni beekti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She is from a small, impoverished community, and she has no financial support.
entries.translation: Isheen maatii xiqqoo, hawaasa hiyyeessa irraa kan dhuftee fi deggersa faayinaansii kan hin qabne turte.

entries.english: One day, Sneha is approached by a man named Silas who represents a large sportswear company.
entries.translation: Guyyaa tokko, Sinehaan namicha Siilaas jedhamu kan kaampaanii uffata ispoortii dhiyeessu bakka bu'u tokkotu itti dhiyaate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Silas tells Sneha that he is impressed by her running ability, and he offers to sponsor her.
entries.translation: Silaas dandeettii fiigichaa Sinehaattin baayyee dinqamee akkashee ispoonsara gochuu barbaadu itti hime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sneha is hesitant at first, but she eventually agrees to sign with Silas.
entries.translation: Sineehaan jalqaba diddee turte garuu, dhumarratti Siilaasii wajjin walii farramteetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With Silas's financial backing, Sneha is able to train full-time and travel to the best competitions.
entries.translation: Gargaarsa faayinaansii Siilaasiitiin, Sineehaan sa'atii guutuu shaakaluu fi dorgommiiwwan ciccimootti imaluu dandeesseetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She quickly becomes one of the top long-distance runners in the world.
entries.translation: Isheen battalumatti atileetota ciccimoo fiigicha dheeraa addunyaa keessaa tokko taate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Sneha is not content with just being a champion.
entries.translation: Garuu Sineehaan injifachuu qofatti hin quuftu.

entries.english: Karim and Abed had been friends since they were kids.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They grew up together, went to the same schools, and even played on the same sports teams.
entries.translation: Walii wajjin guddatan, mana barumsaa tokkotti baratan akkasumas garee ispoortii wal fakkaataa keessa taphatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had a bond that was like no other.
entries.translation: Hidhata nami kamuu hin qabne qabaatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They could talk about anything, and they always knew that they could count on each other.
entries.translation: Waa'ee waan hundumaayyuu haasa'uu hin danda'u turan, akkasumas akka wal abdatanis hin beeku turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Karim was diagnosed with cancer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was devastated, but he knew that he had Abed to lean on.
entries.translation: Baayyee rifatee ture, garuu namni itti boqotu Abeed akka jiru beeka ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Abed was there for him every step of the way, through the surgeries, the chemotherapy, and the radiation.
entries.translation: Tarkaanfii hundumaa keessatti Abeed aantummaa isaa itti agarsiisera, baqaqsanii waldhaanuu, keemootiraappii fi raadiyeeshinii dabalatee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He never left Karim's side, and he always gave him hope.
entries.translation: Cina Kaariimii tii dhibamee hin beeku, yeroo hundas abdii kennaaf ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Karim eventually beat cancer, and he and Abed were closer than ever.
entries.translation: Karim dhumarra kaanserii injifate, innii fi Abeedis isa duraa caalaa walitti siqatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had both faced a life-changing experience, and they had come out of it stronger together.
entries.translation: Lachanuu muuxannoon jireenya jijjiiru isaan mudateera, garuu dhumarratti caalaatti isaan jabeesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that students should be actively engaged in the process of remembering what they have heard.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun barattoonni waan dhaga'an yaadachuu irratti dammaqinaan hirmaachuu qabu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They should not simply be passive listeners, but should be actively thinking about what they are hearing and trying to remember it.
entries.translation: Salphaadhumatti dhaggeeffatee si'aawoo hin taane ta'uu hin qaban, waa'ee waan dhaga'aa jiranii dammaqinaan yaaduu fi yaadachuu qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of ways to encourage conscious memory work in listening comprehension lessons.
entries.translation: Karaaleen ittiin yaadannoon dammaqaa gaafa barumsa hubannaa barbaadu dhaggeeffannu ittiin jajjabeessinu baayyetu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way is to use repetition.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be done by having students listen to the same passage multiple times, or by having them read a passage aloud multiple times.
entries.translation: Kun barattoonni keeyyata sana irra deddeebi'anii akka dubbisan gochuudhaan ta'uu danda'a, yookin keeyyata sana ol kaasanii akka irra deddeebi'anii akka dubbisan gochuudhaan ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Repetition helps to fix the information in students' memories.
entries.translation: Irra deddeebiin odeeffannoon sun yaadannoo ijoollee keessatti akka kuufamu taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to encourage conscious memory work is to have students take notes while they are listening.
entries.translation: Karaan biraan ittiin yaadannoo dammaqaa hojjechiisnu, barattoonni gaafa dhageeffatan yaadannoo akka qabatan gochuudhaani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This forces them to pay attention to what they are hearing and to think about what is important.
entries.translation: Kunis waan dhaggeeffataa jiranitti xiyyeeffannoo akka kennanii fi waa'ee waan barbaachisaa ta'e akka yaadaan isaan dirqisiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Students can also be asked to write down a summary of what they have heard.
entries.translation: Akkasumas barattoonni cuunfaa waanta dhaggeeffatanii akka barreessaniif gaafatamuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This helps them to organize the information in their minds and to remember it more effectively.
entries.translation: Kunis odeeffannoo sammuu isaanii keessa jiru akka qindeessanii fi sirnaan akka yaadatan isaan taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to repetition and note-taking, there are a number of other strategies that can be used to encourage conscious memory work in listening comprehension lessons.
entries.translation: Yaadannoo qabachuu fi irra deddeebii tti dabaleemmoo, tarsiimoon ittiin yaadannoo dammaqaa yeroo hubannoo dubbisaa hojjechiisan kan biraan ni jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These include asking students questions about what they have heard, having them discuss the passage with each other, and having them create their own graphic organizers to represent the information.
entries.translation: Kunis barattoonni gaaffii waan isaan dhaggeeffatan keessaa ba'e akka deebisan gochuu, waa'ee keeyyata sanaa waliin akka mari'atan gochuu fi odeeffannoo sana bifaa giraafii tiin akka qindeessan gochuu faa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By using a variety of strategies, teachers can help students to develop their listening comprehension skills and to become more effective learners.
entries.translation: Tarsiimoowwan garaa garaa fayyadamuun barsiisonni barattoonni dandeetti dhaggeeffachuu akka guddifatanii fi barataa fooyya'oo akka ta'an gochuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She holds it in her hands for a moment, then begins to read. "Dear Mama, I hope this letter finds you well.

entries.english: He even tried to build a ladder, but it wasn't tall enough.

entries.english: Just when Omar was about to give up, he heard a voice "I can help you," the voice said.

entries.english: Omar turned around and saw a small, furry creature.
entries.translation: Omar gala galee uumama xiqqoo fi rifeensa qabu arge.

entries.english: The creature had big eyes and a long tail "Who are you?" Omar asked.
entries.translation: Uumami sun ija guddaa fi eegee dheeraa qabdi. Omar isa booda "Eenyu ati?" jedheen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm a squirrel," the creature said. "And I can help you get the golden apple."
entries.translation: "Ani illeettiidha, akkati aappilii bifa warqee qabu argattuuf si gargaaruu nan danda'a" jedheen uumamichi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The squirrel told Omar to gather some leaves and sticks.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've always wondered what they're made of and how far away they are.
entries.translation: Ani yeroo hundumaa maalirraa akka hojjetamanii fi hamma akka fagaatan beekuf dinqameera.

entries.english: Mother: Well, the stars are actually huge balls of gas that are very far away from us.

entries.english: The closest star to us is the Sun, and it's about 93 million miles away.
entries.translation: Urjiin hunda caalaa nutti siqatu Aduu yoo ta'u, innis maayilii miliyoona 93 nurraa fagaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The other stars are much farther away, and some of them are so far away that it takes light years for their light to reach us.
entries.translation: Urjiileen warri kaan kana caalaa fagoodha, muraasi isaaniimmoo fageenya irraa kan ka'e ifti isaanii nu bira ga'uuf waggoota ifaa baayyee itti fudhata.

entries.english: Son: Wow, that's amazing! I can't even imagine how far away that is.

entries.english: Mother: It is amazing. And the stars are so important to us.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They provide us with light and heat, and they help us to grow crops.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Without the stars, we wouldn't be able to live on Earth.
entries.translation: Urjiilee malee Lafa irra jiraachuu hin dandeenyu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Son: So the stars are really important to us.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are all here to learn and grow, and we need to create a safe and respectful environment in order to do that.
entries.translation: As kan jirru barachuu fi guddachuufi, kana gochuudhaafimmoo naannoo nagaa ta'ee fi kabaja qabu uumuu qabna.

entries.english: Please be respectful of your classmates and instructors, and please use discretion when sharing personal information.
entries.translation: Maaloo barsiisaakee fi ijoollee dareekeef kabaja kenni, akkasumas gaafa odeeffannoo dhuunfaa qooduuf jettu dura hayyamasaanii gaafadhu.

entries.english: We all have different learning styles, and we all need to find what works best for us.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people learn best by listening to lectures, while others learn best by reading or doing activities.
entries.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko leektararii dhaggeeffachuudhaan sirriitti baratu, warri kaanimmoo dubbisuu fi gochaalee hojjechuudhaan baratu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no right or wrong way to learn, so find what works best for you and stick with it.
entries.translation: Barachuuf karaan sirrii fi dogoggoraa hin jiru, kanaafuu waan siif ta'u barbaadiitii itti cichi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to be organized and prepared for class.

entries.english: Make sure you have all the materials you need, and arrive on time.

entries.english: Taking notes will help you stay focused and remember what is being taught.

entries.english: You can also review your notes after class to help solidify your understanding of the material.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best ways to learn is to ask questions.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you don't understand something, don't be afraid to ask your instructor or classmates for clarification.
entries.translation: Waan tokko yoo hubachuu dadhabde, ijoollee dareekee yookin barsiisaakee gaafachuu hin sodaatin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Everyone is here to learn, and we all want to help each other succeed.
entries.translation: Namni as jiru hunduu barachuu barbaada, nuti hundis akka milkoofnuus wal gargaaruu barbaadna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to be an active participant in class.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Participate in discussions, ask questions, and share your thoughts and ideas.
entries.translation: Marii irratti hirmaadhu, gaaffii gaafadhu, yaadakees qoodi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The more you participate, the more you will learn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, don't be afraid to make mistakes.

entries.english: Everyone makes mistakes, and that's part of the learning process.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The important thing is to learn from your mistakes and move on.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you follow these tips, you will be well on your way to success in this class.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The young boy hid under the covers, terrified of the storm outside.
entries.translation: Mucaan xiqqaan qaqawweessa bakkee jiru sodaatee haguugduu jala dhokate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The thunder rumbled and the lightning flashed, and the boy could feel the electricity in the air.
entries.translation: Bakakkaan guungumee ibse, mucichis qilleensa irratti elektirikii argee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that if he got too close to anything metal, he could get electrocuted.
entries.translation: Waantota sibiila ta'anitti yoo siqate, akka elektirikiidhaan rukutamu beekee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The storm raged for hours, and the boy lay there, huddled in fear.
entries.translation: Qaqawweessi sa'atii dheeraaf guungume, mucaanis walitti sassaabamee achuma ciise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, the storm passed and the boy emerged from his hiding place.
entries.translation: Dhuma irratti, qaqawweessi darbee, mucaanis bakka dhokatee as ba'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked around at the damage the storm had caused, and he was amazed that he had survived.
entries.translation: Miidhaa bakaakkaan geessise ilaalee, lubbuun hafuu isaatti baayyee dinqame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The boy learned a valuable lesson that day: never underestimate the power of electricity.

entries.english: For example, a person who is angry at their boss may take it out on their spouse or children.
