entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because wrath is often a secondary emotion, meaning that it is triggered by another emotion, such as fear, sadness, or anxiety.
entries.translation: Kunis dheekkamsi yeroo baayyee miira lammaffaa waan ta'eefi, akkas jechuun miira kan biraa kan akka sodaa, gadda yookin dhiphinaan waan kakaafamuufi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are feeling these emotions, we may lash out in anger in order to protect ourselves or to feel a sense of control.
entries.translation: Yeroo miirri kun nutti dhagaa'amu, of eeguu fi of to'achuuf aariidhaan dheekkamuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wrath can also be a destructive emotion.
entries.translation: Dheekkamsi miira waa balleessuus ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can lead to violence, abuse, and other harmful behaviors.
entries.translation: Gara balaa, miidhaa fi amalootaa miidhaa geessisan kan birootti geessuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are angry, we may not be thinking clearly and we may make decisions that we later regret.
entries.translation: Gaafa aarru, Sirriitti yaaduu dhiisuu waan dandeenyuuf murtee booda itti gaabbinuu murteessuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We may also say or do things that hurt others, which can damage relationships and make it difficult to repair them.
entries.translation: Waantota nama miidhu dubbachuu yookin gochuu dandeenya, kunis walitti dhufeenya akka suphamuu hin dandeenyetti miidhuu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to be able to recognize and manage wrath.
entries.translation: Dheekkamsa adda baasuu fi to'achuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If we can do this, we can avoid the negative consequences of this emotion.
entries.translation: Yoo kana gochuu dandeenye, dhiibbaa ihintaa miira kanaa ittisuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things we can do to manage wrath, such as:
entries.translation: Dheekkamsa to'achuudhaaf waantota baayyee gochuu dandeenya, isaanis:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Identifying the triggers for our anger.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once we know what triggers our anger, we can start to avoid these situations or to develop coping mechanisms for dealing with them.
entries.translation: Gaafa waanta nu aarsu barre, haalota akkasii hirdhisuu fi mala ittiin haala akkasii to'annu guddifataa deemna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we feel ourselves getting angry, it is important to take a few deep breaths and to try to relax our muscles.
entries.translation: Gaafa aaruu jalqabnu, hargansuu gadi fagoo fudhachuu fi maashaa keenya tasgabbeessuu yaaluu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can also do something to distract ourselves, such as listening to music or taking a walk.
entries.translation: Akkasumas yaada keenya bittinneessuf waantota akka muuziqaa dhaggeeffachuu yookin deemuu faa gochuu dadeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Talking to a trusted friend or therapist can help us to process our anger and to find healthier ways to express it.
entries.translation: Nama amannuu fi teeraappistii tti haasa'uun aarii keenya akka to'annuu fi miira fayyaalessa ta'een akka ibsannu nu taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wrath is a powerful emotion, but it is one that we can learn to manage.
entries.translation: Dheekkamsi miira baayyee cimaadha, akkasumas waan to'achuuf dandaa'amuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By being aware of our triggers and by developing coping mechanisms, we can avoid the negative consequences of this emotion and live healthier, happier lives.
entries.translation: Waantota nu aarsan adda baafachuu fi haala ittiin to'atan qabaachuun, dhiibbaa ihintaa miira kanaa to'achuun jireenya fayyaalessaa fi gammachiisa jiraachuu ni dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It allows them to make decisions quickly and decisively, even when there is not enough time to think through all of the possible options.
entries.translation: Yeroon gahaa ta'e yoo hin jiraannellee, filannoowwan ta’uu danda’an hunda irratti murtoo saffisaa fi murteessaa ta’ee akka murteessaniif isaan dandeessisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Intuition is often developed through experience, but it can also be learned through training.
entries.translation: Yeroo bay'ee hubannoon muuxannoodhaan kan guddatu yoo ta’u, leenjii dhaanis baratamuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are many other skills that are important for chess players, such as calculation, memory, and concentration.
entries.translation: Dhugumattu, dandeettiiwwan biroo taphattoota cheeziitiif barbaachisoo ta'an kanneen akka shallaggii, yaadachuu fi xiyyeeffannaa hedduutu jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, pattern recognition and intuition are two of the most essential skills that all good chess players have.
entries.translation: Haa ta'uu malee, beekumsii paaternii fi hubannoon, dandetti taphataan cheezii qabuu keessaa isaan lama dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some examples of how pattern recognition and intuition can be used in chess:
entries.translation: Fakkeenyonni akkaataa beekumsi toora addaa fi hubannoon cheezii keessatti fayyadan tokko tokko kunooti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A player may recognize that their opponent is trying to set up a particular trap.
entries.translation: * Taphataan tokko morkataan isaa kiyyoo addaa kaa'uuf akka yaalu hubachuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By anticipating the trap, the player can avoid it and gain an advantage.
entries.translation: Kiyyoo sana tilmaamuun taphataan sun kiyyoo sana biraa darbuu fi faayidaa argachuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A player may see that their opponent is weak on one side of the board.
entries.translation: * Taphataan tokko morkataan isaa gama tokkoo gabatichaan laafaa ta'uu isaa arguu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By exploiting this weakness, the player can gain control of the game.
entries.translation: Dadhabbii kana fayyadamuun, taphatichi tapha sana to’achuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * A player may have a gut feeling that a certain move is the best one to make.
entries.translation: * Taphataan tokko sochiin murtaa'e tokko isa gaarii akka ta'e itti dhaga'amuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Even if they cannot explain why they feel this way, they may be right.
entries.translation: Akkamitti haala kanaan akka itti dhaga'aame ibsu dadhaban ille, sirri ta'uu danda'uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pattern recognition and intuition are not easy skills to develop.
entries.translation: Beekumsi paaternii fi hubannoon daandeetti salphaatti baratamuu dandaa'an miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, they are essential for anyone who wants to become a good chess player.
entries.translation: Haa ta'uu malee, nama taphataa gaarii cheezii ta'uu barbaaduuf baay'ee barbaachisoo dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With practice, these skills can be honed to a razor's edge, and a player will be able to see the game in a whole new way.
entries.translation: Shaakala gochuudhaan, ogummaawwan kun haaga qarqara miilaaciitti qaramuu dandaʼuu, taphataan tokkoos tapha kana karaa guutuu haaraa taʼeen ilaaluu dandaʼa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grandparents are a special kind of people.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are the ones who have seen it all, and they are always there to lend a listening ear and a helping hand.
entries.translation: Isaan warra waan hunda arganiidha, yeroo hunda gurra dhaggeeffatu fi harka gargaaruu liqeessuuf achi jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are the ones who make us feel safe and loved, and they are the ones who we can always count on.
entries.translation: Isaan mirra nagaa fi jaalatamuu akka nutti dhaga'amuu nama godhan dha, akkasumas isaan nama nuti itti abdachu dandeenyu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have been lucky to have two wonderful grandparents in my life.
entries.translation: Jireenya koo keessatti akaakayyuu ajaa'ibaa lama qabaachuu koottii carroomaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My grandmother is a kind and gentle soul, who always has a smile on her face.
entries.translation: Akkoon koo garraamii fi gara laaftuu yoo taatu, yeroo hunda fuula ishee irratti kolfa kan qabdudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loves to cook and bake, and she always has a treat for me when I visit.
entries.translation: Nyaata bilcheessuu fi daabboo tolchuu kan jaallattu yommu taʼu, yeroon ani ishee daawwadhu yeroo hunda kununsa naaf gooti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My grandfather is a strong and hardworking man, who always has a story to tell.
entries.translation: Akaakayyuun koo nama jabaa fi nama ciminaan hojjatu, yeroo hundas seenaa himuu kan qabu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He loves to take me fishing and camping, and he always shows me how to do things the right way.
entries.translation: Qurxummii qabuu fi kaampii na geessuu kan jaallatu siʼa taʼu, yeroo hunda akkamitti wanta tokko karaa sirrii taʼe akkan hojjedhu natti agarsiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am so grateful for my grandparents.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They have taught me so much about life, and they have made me a better person.
entries.translation: Waaʼee jireenyaa baayʼee na barsiisaniiru, akkasumas nama fooyyaʼaa taʼes na godhaniru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know that I can always count on them, and I am so lucky to have them in my life.
entries.translation: Yeroo hundumaa isaan irratti abdachuu akkan danda'u nan beeka, jireenya koo keessatti isaan qabaachuu koottis baay'ee carroomeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite memories with my grandparents is when we went camping together.
entries.translation: Yaadannoowwan mi'awwaa akaakilee koo waliin dabarsee keessaa yeroon kaampii keessa waliin jiraachuuf demnee isa tokko dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We hiked in the woods, roasted marshmallows over the campfire, and stargazed at night.
entries.translation: Bosona keessa deemnee, ibidda kaampii irratti karameellaa lallaafaa ta'e waaddine, halkan urjii ilaalla turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a magical experience, and I will never forget it.
entries.translation: Muuxannoo ajaa'ibaa ture, yoomiyyuu hin dagadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a traditional household, the eldest child is often expected to take on a leadership role, while the younger children are expected to follow their older siblings' lead.
entries.translation: Mana maatii aadaa keessatti, yeroo baay’ee daa’imni angafaa gahee geggeessummaa akka fudhatu kan eegamu yoo ta’u, ijoolleen xiqqaan ammoo hoggansa obbolaa isaanii warra gurguddoo hordofuutu irraa eegama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In recent years, there has been a trend towards reducing the size of families.
entries.translation: Waggoota dhiyoo asitti, adeemssi baay’ina maatii hir’isuun barramaa dhufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is due to a number of factors, including the rising cost of living, the increasing desire for couples to have fewer children, and the increasing availability of birth control.
entries.translation: Kunis sababa baasii jireenyaa dabaluu, kaadhimoonni ijoollee xiqqoo horachuuf feedhin isaanii dabaluu fi meeshaaleen to’annoo da’umsaa baay’achuu isaanii dabalatee sababoota heedduutin ka'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, the majority of families today have only one or two children, which means that there is less of a divide between the eldest and youngest children.
entries.translation: Kanarraa kan ka’e maatiin yeroo har’aa irra caalaan isaanii ijoollee tokko ykn lama qofa kan qaban yoo ta’u, kana jechuun ijoollee hangafaa fi xiqqaa gidduutti wal qoqqooduun xiqqaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a more egalitarian relationship between siblings, where each child feels like they are an equal member of the family.
entries.translation: Kunis obbolaa gidduutti haariiroo walqixxummaa guddaa uumuu fi, daa'imni hundis akka miseensa maatii walqixa ta’an itti dhaga’ama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, every family is different, and there is no one-size-fits-all approach to sibling relationships.
entries.translation: Dhugumatti, maatiin hundi garaagara dha, walitti dhufeenya obbolaa ilaalchisee mala tokko qofa taʼe hinjiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher, I'm really worried about my grandma.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa, waa'ee akkoo koo baay'ee yaadda'era.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's been sick with coronavirus for a few weeks, and she's not getting any better.
entries.translation: Torban muraasaaf vaayirasii koronaan dhukkubsatteetti, ittis fooyya'aa hin jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been spending a lot of time with her, and I can tell that she's really struggling.
entries.translation: Yeroo baay'ee ishee waliin dabarsaa tureera, dhuguma rakkachaa akka jirtus hubachuu nan danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so scared that she's going to die.
entries.translation: Nii duuti jedhee baay'ee sodaadheen jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher, I know that you're a doctor, and I was wondering if you could give me some advice on how to help my grandma.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa, ati dooktora ta'uu kee nan beeka, akkamitti akka akaakayyu koo gargaaruu danda'u gorsa tokko tokko naaf kennuu dandessa jedheen yaadaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What can I do to make her more comfortable?
entries.translation: Akka ishiitti foyya'u maal gochuun dandaʼa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are there any treatments that might help her get better?
entries.translation: Wal’aansi akka isheetti wayya'u gargaaruu danda’u jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also worried about my own health.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been taking precautions, but I'm still scared that I might get sick.
entries.translation: Of eeggannoo gochaa tureera, garuu ammallee dhukkubsachuun danda'a jedheen sodaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I don't want to put my grandma at risk, but I also don't want to get sick myself.
entries.translation: Akaakayyu koo balaadhaaf saaxiluu hin barbaadu, garuu ofii kootiif dhukkubsachuus hin barbaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young woman named Sarah graduated from college with a degree in business.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko, shamarreen Saaraa jedhamtu barnoota daldalaatiin digirii argattee kolleejjii irraa eebbifamte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was excited to start her career, but she quickly realized that it wasn't going to be easy.
entries.translation: Hojii ishee jalqabuuf gammachuu guddaa qabdi turte, garuu salphaa akka hin taane daftee hubatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She applied for dozens of jobs, but she only got a few interviews.
entries.translation: Hojiiwwan hedduu dhaaf iyyattee turte, garuu gaaffii fi deebii muraasa qofa argatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And of the interviews she did get, she only received one offer.
entries.translation: Gaaffii fi deebii isheen argatte keessaas, dhiyeessii tokko qofa argatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The job offer was for a low-paying position at a company that she wasn't really interested in.
entries.translation: Dhiyeessii hojiin kun dhaabbata isheen baay'ee fedhii itti hin qabne keessatti gita hojii kaffaltii xiqqaa qabuu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But she took the job because she needed to start earning money.
entries.translation: Garuu qarshii argachuu jalqabuu waan qabduuf hojii kana fudhatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah worked hard at her new job, but she was unhappy.
entries.translation: Saaraan hojii haaraa ishii irratti cimtee hojjechaa kan turte taʼus, gammachuu hin qabdu turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She didn't like the work, and she didn't like the company.
entries.translation: Hojiicha hin jaallanne, dhaabbatichas hin jaallanne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She started to think about quitting, but she was afraid that she wouldn't be able to find another job.
entries.translation: Hojii dhiisuuf yaaduu kan jalqabde taʼus, hojii biraa argachuu akka hin dandeenye sodaa qabdi turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Sarah's boss called her into his office.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko, hogganaan Saaraa gara waajjira isaatti ishee waame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He told her that he was impressed with her work, and he offered her a promotion.
entries.translation: Hojiin ishee akka dinqisiifate itti himee, guddina sadarkaas isheef dhiheesse.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The horse was galloping at full speed, its hooves thundering on the ground.
entries.translation: Fardichi saffisa guutuudhaan fiigaa ture, qoochoowwan isaa lafa irratti ni dha'aatu turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The rider, a young woman, was in complete control of the animal, her body swaying in rhythm with its movements.
entries.translation: Shamarittin yaabbattee, fardicha guutummaatti to’achaa turte, qaamni ishee qixa sochii isaa waliin raafamaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had been riding horses since she was a child, and she had an excellent understanding of their nature.
entries.translation: Ijoollummaa isheetii kaastee fardeen gulufaa kan turte yommuu taʼu, uumama isaanii ilaalchisee hubannoo gaarii qabdi turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew how to control them without using force, and she could sense their moods and emotions.
entries.translation: Humna utuu hin fayyadamin akkamitti akka isaan toʼattu kan beektu yommuu taʼu, miiraa fi wanta isaaniitti dhagahamu hubachuu dandeessi turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The horse was responding to her commands perfectly, and they were moving as one.
entries.translation: Fardichi ajaja isheetiif deebii gaarii kennaa kan ture yommuu taʼu, isaanis tokko ta'anii sochoʼaa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were a perfect team, and they were enjoying the freedom of the open plain.
entries.translation: Garee mudaa hin qabne kan turan yommuu taʼan, bilisummaa dirree banaa sanaa dhamdhamachaa turan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The world is awash in plastic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Everywhere you look, there it is: floating in the ocean, washing up on beaches, choking sea turtles and other marine life.
entries.translation: Bakka ilaaltan hundatti achi jira: galaana keessa bololi'aa, qarqara galaanaa irratti dhiqama, qocaa galaanaa fi lubbu qabeeyyii galaanaa kan biroos uukkaamsaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic pollution is a major threat to the health of our oceans, and it's only getting worse.
entries.translation: Faalamni pilaastikii fayyaa galaana keenyaaf balaa guddaa kan qabu yoo ta'u, hammaachaa dhufeeras.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Every year, millions of tons of plastic end up in our oceans.
entries.translation: Waggaa waggaa dhaan, pilaastikii toonii miliyoonaan lakkaa'amu galaana keenya keessatti yaa'e dhufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Most of it comes from land-based sources, such as rivers and streams.
entries.translation: Irra caalaan isaa maddoota lafa irratti hundaa’an kan akka lagaa fi sulula irraa dhufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once in the ocean, plastic can take hundreds of years to break down.
entries.translation: Pilaastikiin galaana keessa erga seenee booda diidiggamuuf waggoota dhibbaan lakkaa’aman fudhachuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can also be ingested by marine animals, which can cause them to become sick or even die.
entries.translation: Bineensota galaanaatiinis liqimfamuu kan danda’u yoo ta’u, kunis akka isaan dhukkubsatan yookin akka du’an illee gochuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the direct harm it causes to marine life, plastic pollution can also have a negative impact on the food chain.
entries.translation: Faalamni pilaastikii miidhaa kallattiin lubbu qabeeyyii galaanaa irratti fiduun alatti, sansalata nyaataa irrattis dhiibbaa hamaa geessisuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic can accumulate in the stomachs of fish and other marine animals, and when these animals are eaten by humans, we can end up ingesting plastic ourselves.
entries.translation: Pilaastikiin garaa qurxummii fi bineensota galaanaa biroo keessatti kuufamuu kan danda’u yoo ta’u, bineensonni kun namaan yeroo nyaataman ofuma keenyaan pilaastikii liqimsuu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The health effects of consuming plastic are not yet fully understood, but there is concern that it could lead to a variety of problems, including cancer, reproductive issues, and developmental disorders.
entries.translation: Miidhaan fayyaa pilaastikii fayyadamuun hanga ammaatti guutummaatti hin hubatamne, garuu kaansarii, dhimma walhormaataa fi jeequmsa guddinaa dabalatee rakkoolee adda addaatti geessu danda'a jedhamee yaaddoon jira. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Global warming is also having a significant impact on the oceans.
entries.translation: Ho'inni addunyaa galaana irrattis dhiibbaa guddaa geessisaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fashion and style are constantly evolving, as new trends emerge and old ones fade away.
entries.translation: Akkuma adeemsi haaraan dhufaa kan durii immoo badaa jirutti, faashinni fi akkaataan itti fayyadamnu dhabbataa dhaan jijjirramaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But one thing that never changes is the human desire to look good.
entries.translation: Garuu wanti gonkumaa hin jijjiiramne tokko fedhii dhalli namaa gaarii fakkaachuuf qabuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Whether you're dressing for a night out on the town or a day at the office, your outfit should reflect your personality and make you feel confident.
entries.translation: Halkan magaalaa keessa ba'uufis ta'e guyyaa waajjira keessa ooluf yoo uffata uffatte, uffannaan kee enyummaa kee kan calaqqisiisu fi ofitti amanamummaa akka sitti dhaga'amu kan godhu ta'uu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest trends in fashion this year is the return of long, flowing dresses.
entries.translation: Bara kana adeemsa gurguddoo faashinii keessaa inni tokko wandaboo dheeraa ta'e yaa'uu deebi'uu isaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These dresses are perfect for any occasion, and they can be dressed up or down depending on your needs.
entries.translation: Wandabonni kunnen yeroo kamiifuu kan mijatan yoo ta'an, fedhii keessan irratti hundaa'uun ol yookin gadi uffachuun ni danda'ama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're looking for a dress that will make you stand out from the crowd, a long, flowing dress is a great option.
entries.translation: Uffata namoota hedduu keessaa adda si taasisu barbaadde yoo ta'e, wandaboon dheeraa ta'e yaa'uu filannoo gaarii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another trend that is gaining popularity is sustainable fashion.
entries.translation: Adeemsi biraa jaalala argachaa jiru faashinii itti fufiinsa qabuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means choosing clothing that is made from recycled materials or from brands that have a commitment to ethical manufacturing.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun uffata meeshaalee deebi’anii fayyadaman irraa oomishame yookin maqaawwan daldalaa, oomisha naamusa qabuuf kutannoo qabaniin hojjetame filachuu jechuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sustainable fashion is not only good for the environment, but it's also good for your wallet.
entries.translation: Faashiniin itti fufiinsa qabu naannoo qofaaf gaarii kan ta'e osoo hin ta'in, kiisha keessaniifis gaarii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the world becomes more globalized, fashion trends are becoming more uniform.
entries.translation: Akkuma addunyaan foyya'aa dhuftetti, adeemsi faashinii walfakkaataa ta’aa dhufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What's popular in one country is quickly becoming popular in another.
entries.translation: Wanti biyya tokko keessatti jaalatama ta'e biyya biraa keessattis dafee jaalatamaa ta'aa dhufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that you can now find the latest fashion trends no matter where you live.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun amma bakka jiraattan hundatti faashinii dhiyeenyaa argachuu dandeessu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Capital punishment, also known as the death penalty, is the legally sanctioned killing of a person as punishment for a crime.
entries.translation: Adabbiin guddichaa, yookin adabbii du’aa jeedhamun kan beekamu, yakka raawwatameef adabbii nama ajjeesuu seera qabeessa ta'ee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the most severe form of punishment that can be imposed in the criminal justice system.
entries.translation: Innis sirna haqa yakkaa keessatti adabbii hamaa murtaa’uu danda’uu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Capital punishment is a controversial issue, with strong arguments on both sides.
entries.translation: Adabbiin du'aa gama lachuutiin falmii cimaa kan kaasiisu yaada falmisiisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people believe that it is a just punishment for certain crimes, while others believe that it is cruel and unusual punishment.
entries.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko yakkoota muraasaaf adabbii qofa ta’uu kan amanan yoo ta’u, kaan immoo adabbii gara jabeessaa fi kan hin baratamne ta’uu isaa amanu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is also debate about whether capital punishment is an effective deterrent to crime.
entries.translation: Adabbiin du’aa yakka ittisuu dhaaf bu’a qabeessa ta’uu fi dhiisuu isaa irrattis falmiin ni jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Capital punishment is legal in 27 states in the United States.
entries.translation: Biyyoota Ameerikaa keessatti kutaalee biyyattii 27 keessa adabbiin du'aa seera qabeessa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there is a growing movement to abolish the death penalty, and the number of executions has declined in recent years.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, adabbii du'aa haquuf sochiin guddachaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, waggoota dhiyoo asitti lakkoofsi namoota ajajaan ajjeefaman gadi bu'aa dhufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The death penalty is also legal in a number of other countries around the world, but its use is declining.
entries.translation: Adabbiin du'aa kun biyyoota addunyaa hedduu keessattis seera qabeessa ta'us, itti fayyadamni isaa gadi bu'aa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2016, there were 998 executions worldwide, down from 1,591 in 2015.
entries.translation: Bara 2016 tti addunyaa guutuu keessa namoonni 998 ajjeefamuun isaanii bara 2015 tti namoota 1,591 ajjefamanii kan turan irraa gadi bu'ee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most common method of execution in the United States is lethal injection.
entries.translation: Biyyoota Ameerikaa keessatti malli ajjeechaa baay’inaan itti fayyadaman qoricha nama ajjeesudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other methods of execution include the electric chair, the gas chamber, and the firing squad.
entries.translation: Maloonni ajjeechaa kan biroon teessoo elektirikii, golee gaazii fi garee dhukaasaa kan dabalatudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The death penalty is a complex issue with a long and controversial history.
entries.translation: Adabbiin du'aa dhimma walxaxaa seenaa dheeraa kan qabu fi falmisiisaa ta'ee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Two people are discussing the architecture of the building.
entries.translation: Namoonni lama ijaarsa gamoo kanaa irratti mari'achaa jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: This church is so lovely. I love the colors and the way the light plays through the stained glass windows.
entries.translation: Nama 1ffaa: Waldaan kun baay'ee jaallatamaadha. Halluuwwan isaa fi akkaataa ifni foddaa fuullee dibamee keessaa darbaarra taphatu baay'een jaalladha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: I agree. It's really peaceful and serene in here.
entries.translation: Nama 2 ffaa: Ani walii gala. Dhuguma as keessa taa'uun nagaa fi tasgabbii qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 3: I'm impressed by the architecture. The arches and columns are so graceful.
entries.translation: Nama 3 ffaa: Arkiteekcharii isaa baay'een dinqisiifadha. Arkii fi utubaawwan isaa mimmiidhagoo dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 4: And the ceiling is amazing! It's like being under a starry sky.
entries.translation: Nama 4 ffaa: Siidiin isaas ajaa'iba! Akka samii urjii jala jiruuti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 5: I'm glad we decided to come here. This is a beautiful church.
entries.translation: Nama 5 ffaa: As dhufuuf murteessuu keenyatti gammadeera. Kun waldaa bareedaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The group continues to admire the church.
entries.translation: Gareen kun waldicha dinqisiifachuu itti fufee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They talk about the different elements of the architecture, and how they contribute to the overall feeling of the space.
entries.translation: Waa’ee qaamolee adda addaa arkitekchaarichaa, akkasumas miira waliigalaa iddoo sanaaf akkamitti gumaacha akka godhan ni dubbatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also share their own personal experiences with church architecture, and how it has impacted their lives.
entries.translation: Akkasumas ijaarsa waldichaa waliin wal qabatee muuxannoo mataa dhuunfaa isaanii, fi akkamitti jireenya isaanii irratti dhiibbaa akka geessise ni dubbatuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Student: I'm so worried about the Nigerian education system.
entries.translation: Barataa: Waa'ee sirna barnootaa Naayijeeriyaa irratti sodaa guddaan qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It seems like it's in a state of decline.
entries.translation: Gara kufaatiitti waan deemaa jiru fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Nigerian education system has a lot of problems.
entries.translation: Sirni barnootaa Naayijeeriyaa rakkoo baayyee qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But I believe that it can be fixed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Well, for one thing, we need to invest more in education.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa: Gaariidha, karaan tokko, Barnootaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo kana caaluu gochuu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to make sure that teachers are well-trained and that schools have the resources they need.
entries.translation: Barsoonni leenjii ga'aa qabaachuu fi manneen barnootaa qabaanya isaan barbaachisu qabaachuu isaanii mirkaneessuu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what else can we do?
entries.translation: Garuu waanti dabalataa gochuu dandeenyu maaltu jira?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: We also need to change the way we think about education.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa: Waa'ee barnootaa akkamitti akka yaannus jijjiiruu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to move away from a focus on rote learning and towards a focus on critical thinking and problem-solving.
entries.translation: Xiyyeeffannoo keenya akkaataa barumsaa duubatti hafe irraa gara sirriitti hubachuu fi rakkoo furuutti jijjiiruu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But how do we get parents and students on board with that?
entries.translation: Garuu dhimma kana irratti akkamittiin barattoonni fi maatiin yaada wal fakkaataa akka qaban gochuu dandeenya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: That's a challenge, but I think it's possible.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa: Inni kun rakkisaadha, garuu waan dandaa'amu natti fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to start by talking to parents and students about the importance of a well-rounded education.
entries.translation: Waa'ee barnoota roga hundaan guutuu ta'ee maatii fi barattootatti haasa'uudhaan jalqabuu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to show them that it's not just about getting good grades, but also about developing the skills they need to succeed in life.
entries.translation: Waa'ee qabxii gaarii argachuuu utuu hin taane, waa'ee dandeettii jireenya keessatti isaan milkeessu argachuu akka ta'ee itti agarsiisuu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sakina Aissa was born in a small village in the mountains of Algeria.
entries.translation: Sakiinaa Ayisaan mandara xiqqoo gaarreen Aljeeriyaa keessatti dhalatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her parents were Berbers, one of the many ethnic groups that make up the country.
entries.translation: Maatiinshee warra Barabari, uummattoota baayyee biyyattiin irraa ijaaramte keessaa warra tokko.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sakina grew up in a close-knit community, where people of different ethnicities lived and worked together in peace.
entries.translation: Sakiinaan hawaasa walitti dhiyaatu keessatti guddatte, namoonni saboota garaa garaa irraa walitti dhufuun kan nagaan wajjin hojjetanii fi waliin jiraataniidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But when Sakina was 10 years old, the civil war in Algeria broke out.
entries.translation: Garuu gaafa Sakiinaan waggaa 10 taatu, lolli waliin waliinii Aljeeriyaa keessatti dho'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The conflict was between the Arab majority and the Berber minority.
entries.translation: Walitti bu'iinsichi Araboota warra guddoo fi Barbaroota warra xiqqoo gidduutti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sakina's village was caught in the middle, and she witnessed firsthand the violence and destruction that the war brought.
entries.translation: Mandarri Sakiinaa gidduu waan tureef, badii fi gaaga'ama waraanichi fide ijaan agarteetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Many people were killed, and many more were forced to flee their homes.
entries.translation: Namoonni baayyeen ajjeefamaniiru, akkasumas namoonni baayyeen qe'e isaaniirraa buqqifamaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sakina's family was among those who were displaced.
entries.translation: Maatiin Sakiinaa warra buqqifame keessaa tokkodha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They fled to a refugee camp in the desert, where they lived in squalid conditions.
entries.translation: Kaampii buqqaatotaa kan bosona keessa jirutti baqatan, achittis haala badaa keessa jiraatan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war lasted for more than a decade, and it had a devastating impact on Sakina and her family.
entries.translation: Lolichi waggoota kudhanii oliif kan ture yoo ta'u, Sakiinaa fi maatii ishee irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They lost everything they had, and they were forced to live in fear for their lives.
entries.translation: Waan qaban hundumaa dhaban, lubbuu isaaniif sodaataa jiraachuufis dirqaman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even in the midst of all the suffering, Sakina never lost hope.

entries.english: The venom from the snake is a neurotoxin, which means that it affects the nervous system.
entries.translation: Hadhaan bofaa niwurootooksinii dha, kana jechuun sirna nervii hubuu danda'a jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can cause paralysis, respiratory failure, and eventually death.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The venom works by binding to receptors on the surface of nerve cells and preventing them from working properly.

entries.english: This can cause a variety of symptoms, including muscle weakness, numbness, tingling, and difficulty breathing.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In severe cases, the venom can cause death.
entries.translation: Haala badaa ta'e irratti hadhaan kun nama ajjeesuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The evil dude in the story was probably feeling the effects of the venom as he was dying.
entries.translation: Namichi hamaan seenicha keessaa yeroo du'aa jirutti dhiibbaan hadhaa kanaa waan itti dhagaa'ame fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He may have felt weak, numb, and tingling.

entries.english: He may have also had difficulty breathing.

entries.english: As the venom continued to affect his nervous system, he would have eventually lost consciousness and died.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The venom from the snake is a powerful toxin that can cause serious harm or death.

entries.english: It is important to be aware of the risks of snakes and to take precautions to avoid being bitten.

entries.english: The question of "who am I?" is one that has been asked by philosophers and thinkers for centuries.
entries.translation: Gaaffiin "Ani eenyu?" jettu jaarrotaaf filoosooferootaa fi warra fageessanii yaadaniin gaafatameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no one answer that will satisfy everyone, as our sense of self is constantly evolving and changing.
entries.translation: Gaaffiin nama hunda garaa ga'uu danda'u hin jiru, sababa miirri eenyummaa keenyaa guddataa fi jijjiiramaa deemuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are some things that we can say about who we are.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, waa'ee ofii keenyaa waantoti jechuu dandeenyu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are all individuals, with our own unique thoughts, feelings, and experiences.
entries.translation: Nuti namoota yaada, miira fi muuxannoo mataa keenyaa qabnuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are also part of a larger community, and our sense of self is shaped by our interactions with others.
entries.translation: Akkasumas qaama hawaasa baldhaa waan taaneef, miirri dhuunfaa keenyaa walitti dhuufeenya nuti namoota biroo waliin goonuun bocamuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are all born into a particular time and place, and our experiences in this world help to define who we are.
entries.translation: Nuti yeroo fi bakka addaatti dhalanne, muuxannoon addunyaa kana irratti qabnu nuti eenyuu akka taane ibsuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what is the essential "I" that lies at the core of our being?

entries.english: Or is it something else entirely?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Perhaps the "I" is simply a collection of memories, experiences, and beliefs.
entries.translation: Tarii "Ana"''n walitti qabama yaadannoo, muuxannoo fi amantii keenyaa ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Perhaps it is a narrative that we create about ourselves, in order to make sense of the world around us.
entries.translation: Tarii addunyaa naannoo keenya jiru hubachuuf seenaa nuti waa'ee keenyarratti uumnu ta'uus danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Or perhaps the "I" is something more ephemeral, something that cannot be pinned down or defined.
entries.translation: Yookin tarii "Ana"n waan kan yeroo fi waan ibsamuu yookin gadi qabamuu hin dandeenye ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultimately, the question of "who am I?" is a mystery that we may never fully understand.
entries.translation: Dhumarratti, gaaffiin "ani eenyu?" jettu dhoksaa nuti yoomu hubachuu hin dandeenye ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the ninth day of Navratri, a young woman named Parvati was told that she would give birth to a son who would become a great king.
entries.translation: Guyyaa salgaffaa Naaviraatii irratti, Duubartiin maqaanshee Paarvaatii jedhamtu ilma mootii guddaa ta'u akka godhattu itti himame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was overjoyed, and she began to prepare for her delivery.

entries.english: On the tenth day of Navratri, Parvati went into labor.
entries.translation: Guyyaa kudhanaffaa Navraatirii irratti, Parvaatiin gara hojiitti bobbaate.

entries.english: She labored for many hours, and finally, she gave birth to a beautiful baby boy.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She named him Shiva, and she knew that he would fulfill his destiny to become a great king.
entries.translation: Maqaasaa Shiva jettee moggaafte, galmasaa mootii guddaa ta'uu akkanni galmaan ga'us beektee turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Shiva grew up to be a strong and courageous young man.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was always willing to help others, and he was known for his fairness and compassion.
entries.translation: Yeroo hunda nama gargaaruuf fedhii kan qabuu fi haqummaa isaa fi namaaf ho'uudhaan beekama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly became a popular figure among the people, and they looked to him for guidance and leadership.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Shiva was walking through the forest when he came across a group of bandits who were attacking a village.
entries.translation: Guyyaa tokko, Shiivaan bosona keessa osoo deemuu garee shiftootaa kan mandara tokko haleelaa jiranii arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Shiva quickly jumped into action, and he fought off the bandits.
entries.translation: Shiivaan atattamaan tarkaanfii fudhatee, shiftoota sana loluu jalqabe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The villagers were grateful to Shiva for saving them, and they asked him to become their king.

entries.english: Shiva agreed to become king, and he ruled the kingdom wisely and justly for many years.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a kind and compassionate ruler, and he always put the needs of his people first.

entries.english: Good manners are the habits and actions that show respect for other people.
entries.translation: Haalli gaariin amala fi gocha namootatti kabaja agarsiisuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are learned behaviors that are based on the Golden Rule, which says to treat others the way you want to be treated.
entries.translation: Amaloota barataman kan seera warqee jedhamu irratti hundaa'eedha. Seeirchis akkasi, akka itti kunuunfamuu barbaaddutti nama kunuunsi.

entries.english: Good manners are important because they make the world a more pleasant place to live.
entries.translation: Haalli gaariin baayyee barbaachisoodha, addunyaa kana bakka baayyee urgooftuu waan taasisuuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They help to create a sense of community and make people feel more comfortable and respected.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of good manners, but some of the most important ones include being polite, being respectful, being honest, being considerate of others, and being responsible.
entries.translation: Haala gaarii gosa garaa garaatu jira, garuu warra barbaachisaa keessaa muraasni, gadi of qabuu, nama kabajuu, haqummaa, namaaf yaaduu fi itti gaafatamummaa fudhachuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being polite means being courteous and respectful to others.
entries.translation: Gad of qabuu jechuun namoota biroo kabajuu fi arjaa ta'uu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes saying "please" and "thank you," holding the door open for others, and listening attentively when someone is speaking.
entries.translation: Kunis "maaloo" fi "galatoomi" jechuufaa, balbala namoota biroof banuu fi yeroo namni tokko dubbatu xiyyeeffannoon dhaggeeffachuufaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being respectful means treating others with dignity and respect, regardless of their age, race, gender, religion, or social status.
entries.translation: Namaaf kabaja qabachuu jechuun namoota biroof umriisaanii, halluu bifasaanii, saalasaanii, amantiisaanii yookin haala hawaasaa isaanii osoo hin ilaalin ulfina fi kabaja kennuu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes not making fun of others, not interrupting them when they are speaking, and listening to their opinions even if you disagree with them.
entries.translation: Kun kaninni of keessatti haammatu namoota birootti qoosuu dhiisuu, gaafa isaan haasa'an jeequu dhiisuu fi yoo itti walii galuu baattes yaada isaanii dhaggeeffachuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being honest means being truthful and sincere.
entries.translation: Amanamummaa jechuun dhugaa dubbachuu fi qulqulluu ta'uu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes not lying or cheating, and being upfront about your intentions.
entries.translation: Kunis kaninni of keessatti haammatu sobuu yookin korrojuu dhiisuu fi waa'ee karoorakee irratti dura bu'aa ta'uu faadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Being considerate of others means being thoughtful and helpful.
entries.translation: Waa'ee namoota biroo yaada keessa galchuu jechuun namaa yaaduu fi nama gargaaruu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This includes being aware of the needs of others and doing what you can to make them feel comfortable.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun waan namoonni biroo barbaadan hubachuun waanta isaan gaammachiisuuf gochuu dandeessu yoo jiraate gochuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans have colonized the solar system, but they are still searching for a way to travel faster than the speed of light.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If it can be created, it would allow humans to travel to distant stars in a matter of seconds.
entries.translation: Yoo uumamuu danda'eef, namoonni urjiilee baayyee fagoo jiran bira sekoondiilee gidduutti akka ga'uuf dandeessisa.

entries.english: The scientists are working on a prototype of the Einstein-Rosen Bridge in a secret laboratory on the moon.

entries.english: They have been working on the project for years, but they have not yet been able to create a stable wormhole.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She figures out a way to stabilize the wormhole.
