entries.english: She takes the prototype to the other scientists, and they are all amazed by her work.
entries.translation: Pirootootaayipii sana gara saayintistoota birootti geessite, isaanis hojiishee kanatti baayyee dinqaman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The scientists are now confident that they can create a stable Einstein-Rosen Bridge.
entries.translation: Saayinsistoonni sun amma Dildila Aayinistaayiniin Bocame kan tasgabba'aa ta'e akka uuman amantaa guutuu qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are excited about the possibilities that this new technology could bring.
entries.translation: Waa'ee carraa teekinooloojiin kun fidu irratti baayyee gammadaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Organ donation is the process of giving organs or tissues to someone else after death.
entries.translation: Gumaacha qaamaa jechuun gaafa du'an qaama yookin tissuu ofii nama biraaf kennuu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can save lives and improve the quality of life for people who are waiting for transplants.
entries.translation: Namoota jijjiiirraa barbaadanif qulqullina jireenyaa kan fooyyessuu fi lubbuu baraaruu danda'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different types of organs that can be donated, including kidneys, livers, hearts, lungs, and pancreases.
entries.translation: Qaamni gumaachamuu danda'u baayyeetu jira. Isaanis: kalee, tiruu, onnee, somba fi hadhooftuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tissues that can be donated include bone, skin, heart valves, and corneas.
entries.translation: Tishuun gumaachamuu danda'ummoo kalee, gogaa, veelvii onnee fi membereenii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many benefits to organ donation.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For the recipient, organ donation can mean a new lease on life.
entries.translation: Isa fudhatuuf, gumaacha qaamaa jechuun gara jireenya haaraa dhufuu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For the donor, organ donation can be a way to make a difference in the world and help to save lives.
entries.translation: Isa kennuuf, gumaacha qaamaa jechuun karaa ittiin addunyaa kana irratti dhiibbaa uumanii fi lubbuu baraaraniidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a few things to keep in mind if you are considering organ donation.
entries.translation: Yoo waa'ee gumaacha qaamaa yaadaa jirta ta'e, waantota muraasa sammuutti qabachuu qabdutu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, you must be over the age of 18 and in good health.
entries.translation: Jalqaba irratti, waggaa 18 ol kan taatee fi fayyaa gaarii irra jiraachuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, you must have a valid driver's license or state ID.
entries.translation: Lammaffaa, hayyama konkolaachisummaa sirrii yookin waraqaa eenyummaa mootummaa qabaachuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, you must sign a consent form to donate your organs.
entries.translation: Sadaffaa, hunka walii galtee qaama gumaachuuf si dandeessisu mallatteessuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are interested in learning more about organ donation, there are many resources available to you.
entries.translation: Waa'ee gumaacha qaamaa baldhinaan barachuu barbaadda yoo ta'e, waanti si gargaaran baayyeetu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can visit the website of the United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) at www.unos.org.
entries.translation: Marsiiriiii Neetiworkii Gamtaa Qaama Gumaachuuf(UNOS) www.unos.org irraa daawwachuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also contact your local organ procurement organization (OPO).
entries.translation: Qaama dhaabbata bittaa (OPO) naannokee jiru quunnamuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apartheid was a system of racial segregation that existed in South Africa from 1948 to 1994.
entries.translation: Appaartaayidiin sirna qoodiinsa bifaa Afrikaa Kibbaa keessatti bara 1948 - 1994 tti turee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was characterized by the separation of people of different races into different areas, schools, and other public facilities.
entries.translation: Ininis kan inni ittiin beekamu, namoota bakkoota akka mana barumsaa fi bakka hawaasni walitti qabamutti bifa isaaniin adda qooduu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The system was enforced by the South African government through a series of laws and regulations that discriminated against black people.
entries.translation: Sirni kun mootummaa Afrikaa Kibbaa tiin kan raawwachiifamu yoo ta'u kunis karaa seerota fi tumaalee baayyee dhaan bifa uummata gurraacha irratti loogii agarsiisuun ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apartheid was a brutal and oppressive system that denied black people their basic human rights.
entries.translation: Appaartaayidiin sirna cunqursaa fi gara jabeessa uummata gurraacha mirga namummaa bu'uuraa dhowwateedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It resulted in the deaths of many people and the displacement of millions more.
entries.translation: Kunis du'a namoota baayyee fi miliyoononni qe'ee isaanii irraa akka buqqaa'an taasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The end of apartheid came about through a combination of internal and external pressure.
entries.translation: Dhumni appaartaayidii karaa dhibbaa keessaa fi alaatiin ta'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1990, Nelson Mandela was released from prison and negotiations began between the government and the African National Congress.
entries.translation: Bara 1990 tti Niilseen Maandellaan mana hidhaatii ba'anii mariin mootummaa fi Koongireesii Biyyaalessaa Afrikaa gidduutti geggeeffamuu eegale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1994, South Africa held its first free and fair elections, and Nelson Mandela was elected president.
entries.translation: Bara 1994 tti, Afrikaan Kibbaa filannoo haqaa fi biliisaa jalqabaa geggeeffattee Niilseen Maandellaan pirezedaantii ta'anii filataman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gingerol is a powerful antioxidant that can help to reduce inflammation and improve circulation.
entries.translation: Jiinjerooliin aantioksiidaantii cimaa kan kulkula hirdhisuu fi yaa'iinsa dhiigaa fooyyessuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also thought to have anti-emetic properties, which means that it can help to prevent vomiting.
entries.translation: Akkasumas amala aanti emeetikii qaba jedhamee kan yaadamuu fi kun balaqqama namarraa ittisuu irratti gargaaruu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ginger root has been used for centuries to treat nausea and vomiting.
entries.translation: Hiddi jijimbilaa jaarrolee dhaaf ol nama xuxxuquu fi balaqqama ittisuuf fayyadamamaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a popular remedy for morning sickness, motion sickness, and nausea caused by chemotherapy.
entries.translation: Dhukkubbii ganamaaf, dhukkuba sochiif, ol xuxxuqa keemotiraappiidhaan dhufuuf furmaata beekamaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ginger root is also effective in treating nausea that is caused by pregnancy, food poisoning, and other medical conditions.
entries.translation: Hundeen jinjibilaa ol xuxxuqa ufaa'uudhaan dhufu, summaahuu nyaataa tiin dhufu, haala fayyaa birootiin dhufuu yaaluufis baayyee barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a study published in the journal "Phytotherapy Research," researchers found that ginger root was effective in reducing nausea and vomiting in patients who were undergoing chemotherapy.
entries.translation: Qorannoo joonaalii "Qo'annoo Faayitooteeraappii" irratti godhame irratti, qo'attoonni hundeen jijimbilaa ol xuxxuquu fi balaqqamuu dhukkubsattoota keemootiraappii godhaa jiran irraa ittisuuf baayyee barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study participants who took ginger root reported significantly less nausea and vomiting than the participants who took a placebo.
entries.translation: Hirmaattonni qorannoo kan hundee jijimbilaa fudhatan warra pilaaseeboo fudhatanii wajjin gaafa wal bira qabaman ol xuxxuquu fi balaqqamuu xiqqootu isaan mudate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ginger root is a safe and effective way to treat nausea.
entries.translation: Hundeen jijimbilaa nageenya kan qabuu fi karaa sirrii ittin ol xuxxuquu ittisaanii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is available in a variety of forms, including capsules, tablets, teas, and extracts.
entries.translation: Bifa garaa garaan argama. Isaanis kaappii, taabileetii, shaayii fi quncifaamee dhiyaachuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ginger root is also a common ingredient in many over-the-counter nausea medications.
entries.translation: Hundeen jijimbilaa qoricha ol xuxxuquu ittisu keessattis akka galteetti ni tajaajila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are experiencing nausea, ginger root may be a safe and effective way to relieve your symptoms.
entries.translation: Yoo ol xuxxuquun sitti dhagaa'amaa jira ta'e, hundeen jijimbilaa karaa nagaa qabeessaa fi karaa sirrii ittiin milikkina kanarraa haara galfattuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to talk to your doctor before taking ginger root if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have any other medical conditions.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, yoo ulfa taate, hin hoosifta ta'e fi haala fayyaa biroo qabda ta'ee fudhachuukeen dura doktooriikee haasofsiisuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most common myths about improvement is that it is a linear process.
entries.translation: Fooyya'insaa ilalchisee sheekkoon baay'ee beekama ta'e kessa inni tokko adeemsa jijjiiramaa sadarkaa itti fufaa yaaduu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are told that we should always be striving to improve ourselves, that we should never be satisfied with our current state.
entries.translation: Akka nutti himametti ofii keenya fooyyessuuf dhama'uu qabna, waa'ee ofii keenyaa irratti yoomuu quufuu hin qabnu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This myth is often reinforced by the stories we tell ourselves about success.
entries.translation: Sobni kun yeroo baayyee seenaa nuti ofitti himnuun baayyataa deema.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are told that the successful person is the one who never gives up, who always keeps moving forward.
entries.translation: Akka nutti himametti namni milkaa'an nama yoomuu abdii hin kutannee fi gara fuulduraa deemuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what if this myth is wrong?
entries.translation: Garuu yoo waanti kun dogoggora ta'ewoo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What if improvement is not a linear process?
entries.translation: Yoo fooyya'iinsi adeemsa qajeelaa miti ta'ewoo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What if it is more cyclical, or even chaotic?
entries.translation: Yoo waan marsaa qabu ta'ewoo, yookin rakkisaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What if there are times when we need to step back and take stock of what we have achieved, rather than always striving for more?
entries.translation: Yoo yeroon nuti duubatti deebinee waan milkeessine lakkaa'annu jiraatewoo, dabalataaf dhama'uu dhiifnee?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I believe that this is a more realistic view of improvement.
entries.translation: Akkan amanutti ilaalchi sirriin fooyya'iinsaa isa kana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are all human, and we all make mistakes.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There will be times when we fall back, when we doubt ourselves.
entries.translation: Yeroon nuti kufni ni jiraata, gaafa of shakkuu jalqabnu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But these are also opportunities for growth.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Droughts are a major cause of crop failure, and can have a devastating impact on food security and livelihoods.
entries.translation: Googiinsii sababa hundee kufaatii oomishaati, hirdhina nyaataa fi jireenya irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qabaachuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2019, a severe drought in the Horn of Africa left millions of people without food.
entries.translation: Bara 2019 keessa, googiinsi hamaan Gaanfa Afrikaa keessaa namoota miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman waan nyaatan akka dhaban taasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The drought was caused by a combination of factors, including El Niño and climate change.
entries.translation: Googiinsi kun waanta walitti dabalaman kanneen akka El Niño fi jijjiirama qilleensaa dhufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The drought killed livestock, destroyed crops, and forced people to flee their homes.
entries.translation: Hongeen kun horii fixe, oomisha balleesse akkasumas uuummati manasaa dhiisee akka godaanu taasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some areas, the drought was so severe that it caused famine.
entries.translation: Bakka tokko tokkotti, gogiinsi kun baayyee hammaachuun gara beelaatti jijjiiirame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Pacific Ocean is a major driver of global climate patterns.
entries.translation: Garbi guddaa Paasiifik humna haala qilleensa addunyaa duuba jiruudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: El Niño is a natural climate pattern that occurs every few years.
entries.translation: El Niño haala qilleensaa uumamaa kan waggoota muraasa keessatti deddeebi'ee ta'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During El Niño, the ocean surface temperature in the Pacific Ocean rises, which can cause droughts in some parts of the world and floods in others.
entries.translation: Yeroo El Niño, teempireecherri dirra garba guddaa Paasiifik ni dabala, kunimmoo kutaa tokko tokko keessatti googinsa fi kan biroo keessattimmoo lolaa fiduu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Climate change is also causing the Earth's temperature to rise, which is leading to more extreme weather events, such as droughts.
entries.translation: Jijjiiramni qilleensaa teempireecherri lafaa akka dabalu taasisa, kunis haala addaa qilleensaa kan akka gogiinsaa uuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Birds are sensitive to changes in their environment.
entries.translation: Sinbirroonni jijjiirama naannoosaanii hubachuu ni danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Droughts can cause a shortage of food and water for birds, which can lead to death or migration.
entries.translation: Googiinsi sinbirroonni bishaanii fi nyaata akka dhaban taasisuun akka du'an yookin godaanan taasisuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, a drought in the western United States in 2021 caused a decline in the population of some bird species, such as the black-throated sparrow.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, googiinsi Lixa Ameerikaatti bara 2021 keessa ture, baayinni sanyii sinbirroo gurraattii akka hirdhatu taasise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If there was one fruit that could be considered the king of fruits, it would be the mango.
entries.translation: Yoo kuduraan mootii kuduraalee jedhamee waamamu qabu jiraate, mangoo ta'uu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This delicious and nutritious fruit is enjoyed by people all over the world, and for good reason.
entries.translation: Kuduraan mi'aawaa fi humna qabu namoota addunyaa guutummaa irra jiraniin kan jaallatamu yoo ta'u sababa gaariifis jaallatama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mangoes are a good source of vitamins A, C, and E, as well as potassium and fiber.
entries.translation: Mangoon madda gaarii vitaaminii A, C, E fi akkasumas Pootaasiyeemii fi faayiberii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also low in calories and fat, making them a healthy snack or dessert option.
entries.translation: Akkasumas kaalorii fi cooma xiqqoo waan qabaniif nyaata fayya qabeessaa fi nyaata mi'aawaa gaariidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mangoes are native to India, but they are now grown in many tropical and subtropical regions around the world.
entries.translation: Mangoon Indiyaa keessatti kan jalqabe yoo ta'u, amma garuu addunyaa kana keessa iddoo tirooppikaalii fi tirooppikaalii gadii keessattis ni guddata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are hundreds of different varieties of mangoes, each with its own unique flavor and texture.

entries.english: The topic I would like to write about is artificial intelligence.
entries.translation: Mata dureen ani barreessuu barbaadu waa'ee artifiishaal intelijensii dha.

entries.english: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems.
entries.translation: Artifiishaal intelijensiin(AI) fakkeenya dandeetti dhala namaa kan maashinii keessumaammoo kompiyuuteeraan fakkeeffamuuti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI research has been highly successful in developing effective techniques for solving a wide range of problems, from game playing to medical diagnosis.
entries.translation: Qorannoon AI teekinaka rakkoo baayyee kana akka tapha taphachuu fi yaala fayyaa furuu keessatti kan milkaa'e ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are still many challenges to be overcome before AI systems can achieve human-level intelligence.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, ammayyuu sirni AI beekumsaan sadarkaa namaa irra ga'uuf qormaata baayyeetu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the biggest challenges facing AI researchers is the problem of generalization.
entries.translation: Qormaati guddaan qorattoota AI mudachaa jiru tokko rakkina cuunfaa ti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI systems are often able to learn to solve specific problems very well, but they often struggle to generalize their knowledge to new problems.
entries.translation: Sirni AI yeroo baayyee rakkoowwan addaa addaa furuu danda'eera, garuu beekumsa isaanii cuunfuu rakkoo kan biraa furuu irratti hanqina qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because AI systems are typically trained on a large dataset of examples, and they may not be able to generalize to new situations that are not represented in the training data.
entries.translation: Sababnisaammoo sirni AI baayyinaan tuuta odeeffannoo guuddaa irratti waan hundaa'aniif rakkoo tuuta odeeffannoo sana keessa hin jirre deebisuu hin dandaa'an.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another challenge facing AI researchers is the problem of robustness.
entries.translation: Rakkoon biraan qorattoota AI mudataa jirummoo rakkina ciminaa ti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI systems are often brittle, meaning that they can be easily fooled by small changes to the input data.
entries.translation: Sirni AI yeroo baayyee ni cabu, jechuun jijjiiramni xiqqoon daataa irratti yoo jiraate isaan goyyomsuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can make AI systems dangerous in safety-critical applications, such as self-driving cars.
entries.translation: Kunis sirni AI appilikeeshinii ofiin hojjetan kanneen akka konkolaataa ofiisaan deemuuf balaa hamaa qaqqabsiisuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these challenges, AI research is making great progress.
entries.translation: Qormaanni kun haa jiraataniyyuu malee, qorannoon AI jijjiirama guddaa fidaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: AI systems are becoming increasingly powerful and capable, and they are already having a major impact on our world.
entries.translation: Sirni AI dandeettii fi ciminnisaanii baayyee dabalaa jira, addunyaa keenyarrattis dhiibbaa gurguddaa fiduu jalqabanii jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.
entries.translation: Qaala'iinsa jireenyaa jechuun gatiiin waan hundumaa dabaluu fi gatiin qarshii gadi bu'uu jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is often measured as a change in the consumer price index (CPI), which tracks the prices of a basket of goods and services that are commonly purchased by households.
entries.translation: Yeroo baayyee kan inni ittiin safaramu indeksii gatii maamimlaa(CPI) kan gatii mi'a zambiilii tokkoo yeroo baayyee bitamuu shallaguudhaan safarama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inflation can be caused by a number of factors, including increases in the money supply, higher demand for goods and services, and supply shocks.
entries.translation: Qaala'iinsi jireenyaa sababoota baayyeen dhufuu danda'a, isaanis dhiyeessiin maallaqaa dabaluu, fedhiin waantota bitamuu dabaluu, dhiyeessiin hir'achuu faa dha.

entries.english: When the economy is growing rapidly, businesses may be able to raise prices without losing customers.
entries.translation: Yeroo diinagdeen saffisaan dabalu, daldaltoonni maamila utuu hin dhabin gatii dabaluu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a rise in inflation.
entries.translation: Kunis qaali'iinsi jireenyaa akka dabalu godha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there are also factors that can help to offset the inflationary effects of faster economic growth.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, diinagdee saffisaan guddataa jiru keessatti sababoota qaala'iinsa jireenya dabalan hirdhisuun ni danda'ama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if the labor market is tight, wages may rise more slowly than prices, which can help to keep inflation in check.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, gabaan hojii dhiphaadha yoo ta'e, gatiin baasii caalaa dabaluu danda'a, kunis qaala'iinsa jireenya to'achuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Overall, the relationship between economic growth and inflation is complex.
entries.translation: Walumaa galatti, walitti dhufeenyi guddina diinagdee fi qaala'iinsa jireenyaa gidduu jiru wal xaxaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no simple rule that can predict how faster economic growth will affect inflation.
entries.translation: Seerri salphaan sadarkaa guddinni diinagdee ittiin qaala'iinsa jireenyaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisu ittiin madaalan hin jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to be aware of the potential for inflation when the economy is growing rapidly.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, yeroo diinagdeen guddataa jirutti, sababoota qaala'iinsa jireenyaa saffisiisaa jiran beekuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the factors mentioned above, there are a number of other factors that can affect inflation.
entries.translation: Sababoota kanaan olitti xuqamaniin alattis, sababoonni qaala'iinsa jireenyaa dabalan baayyeetu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These include the exchange rate, interest rates, and government policies.
entries.translation: Isaanis gatii sharafa alaa, gatii dhalaa fi imaammata mootummaa fa'i.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The exchange rate can affect inflation by making imported goods more or less expensive.
entries.translation: Gatiin sharafa alaa meeshaalee biyya alaatii galan mi'eessuu fi rakasiisuun qaala'iinsa jireenyaa irratti dhiibbaa uuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if the value of the dollar falls, imported goods will become more expensive, which can lead to higher inflation.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, yoo gatiin doolaaraa kufe, meeshaaleen gara alaatti ergaman gatiinsaanii ol ka'uudhaan qaala'iinsa jireenyaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interest rates can also affect inflation.
entries.translation: Gatiin dhalaas qaala'iinsa jireenyaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When interest rates are high, businesses and consumers are less likely to borrow money, which can slow economic growth and reduce inflation.
entries.translation: Gatiin dhalaa gaafa dabalu, daldaltoonni fi maamiltoonni carraan isaan maallaqa liqeeffachuu xiqqoodha, kunis guddina diinagdee hirdhisuun qaala'iinsa jireenyaa hirdhisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Government policies can also affect inflation.
entries.translation: Imaammati mootummaas qaala'iinsa jireenyaa irratti dhiibbaa ni geessisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, government spending can increase demand for goods and services, which can lead to higher prices.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, baasiin mootummaa gatiin meeshaalee akka dabalu gochuu danda'a, kunis gatiin akka dabalu taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Government regulations can also affect the price of goods and services.
entries.translation: Dambiin mootumaas gatii meeshaalee irratti dhiibbaa geessisuu ni danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The relationship between economic growth and inflation is complex and depends on a number of factors.
entries.translation: Walitti dhufeenyi guddina diinagdee fi qaala'iinsa jireenyaa gidduu jiru wal xaxaa fi waantota baayyee irratti kan hundaa'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rationalist thought is the belief that the only way to acquire knowledge is through reason and logic.
entries.translation: Yaadi raashinaalistii akka jedhutti karaan tokkichi ittiin beekumsa argatan karaa sababaa fi logikii qofaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is based on the idea that the world is governed by natural laws that can be understood through observation and experimentation.
entries.translation: Yaada addunyaan seera uumamaatiin kan bultuu fi kunimmoo karaa qorannoo fi xiinxalaatiin hubatamuu ni danda'a jedhani amanu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rationalists believe that the only way to truly understand the world is to strip away all of our preconceived notions and biases and look at things objectively.
entries.translation: Raashinaalistoonni akka amananitti, karaan tokkittiin ittiin addunyaa kana hubatan waantota duraan nutti fe'amee fi loogii hunda ofirraa dhiisuun waantota ija wal qixaan ilaaluudha jedhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can be a difficult task, but it is one that is essential for making progress in science and philosophy.
entries.translation: Kun hojii cimaa ta'uu danda'a, garuu saayinsii fi filoosoofii keessatti jijjiirama agarsiisuuf karaa baayyee barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rationalists believe that the only way to make good decisions is to base them on facts and evidence.
entries.translation: Raashinaalistoonni akka amananitti karaan tokkichi ittiin murtii gaarii murteessinu ragaa fi haqa irratti hundaa'uu qofaani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They reject the idea that intuition or emotion can ever be a reliable guide to truth.
entries.translation: Yaada miirri qajeelcha dhugaa gara dhugaatti nama geessuudha jedhuu yoomuu hin fudhatani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This does not mean that rationalists are cold and unfeeling; they simply believe that it is important to separate our feelings from our thoughts when making decisions.
entries.translation: Kana jechuun garuu raashinaalistoonni diilallaa'oofi miira hin qaban jechuu miti; akka isaan amananitti salphaadhumatti gaafa murtii murteessan miira keenya yaada keenya irraa adda baasuu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rationalism has been a major force in the development of Western thought.
entries.translation: Raashinaaliisiimiin yaada warra Lixaa guddisuu keessatti humna cimaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has led to many important advances in science, philosophy, and technology.
entries.translation: Kunis saayinsii, filoosoofii fi teekinooloojii keessatti waantota barbaachisoo bira akka geenyuuf sababa ta'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it has also been criticized for being too narrow and rigid.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, dhippaa fi gogaa dha jedhamee qeeqamaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people argue that it ignores the importance of emotion and intuition, and that it can lead to a dehumanizing view of the world.
entries.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko akkas jedhanii falmu. Kun barbaachisummaa miiraa fi tilmaama namaa hin fudhatu, kunis ilaalcha addunyaa kanaa keessaa nama dhabamsiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite these criticisms, rationalism remains a powerful force in Western thought.
entries.translation: Qeeqonni kun haa jiraataniyyuu malee, raashinaaliisiimiin yaada warra Lixaa keessatti humna jabaa ta'ee itti fufe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important places in Nigeria include Lagos, Kano, and Port Harcourt.
entries.translation: Bakkoota baayyee barbaachisoo Naayijeeriyaa keessaa muraasni, Leegos, Kaanoo fi buufata markabaa Haarkoortii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lagos is the largest city in Nigeria and the economic capital of the country.
entries.translation: Leegos magaalaa guddittii Naayijeeriyaa fi magaalaa guddoo diinagdee isheeti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kano is the second largest city in Nigeria and an important center for Islamic culture.
entries.translation: Kaanoon Naayijeeriyaa keessatti magaalaa guddinaan lammaffaa irra jirtu fi giddu gala barbaachisaa aadaa Isilaamaa ti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Port Harcourt is a major port city and the center of the oil industry in Nigeria.
entries.translation: Buufatni markabaa Haarkoorti magaalaa buufata markabaa guddoo fi giddu gala industirii zayitii Naayijeeriyaa ti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most important historical figures in Nigeria include Usman dan Fodio, Muhammad Bello, and Nnamdi Azikiwe.
entries.translation: Namoota seenaa bebbeekamoo Naayijeeriyaa keessaa muraasni, Usmaan daan Foodiyoo, Mohaammad Beelloo fi Nnaamdii Azkiwwee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Usman dan Fodio was a religious leader who founded the Sokoto Caliphate in the 19th century.
entries.translation: Usmaan daan Foodiyoon hoogganaa amantii kan jaarraa 19ffaa keessa Kaliifota Sokootoo hundeesseedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Muhammad Bello was the son of Usman dan Fodio and the second sultan of the Sokoto Caliphate.
entries.translation: Mohaammad Beelloon ilma Usmaan dan Foodiyoo fi sulxaana lammaffaa Kaliifota Sokootoo dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nnamdi Azikiwe was a nationalist leader who played a key role in the independence of Nigeria from British rule.
entries.translation: Nnamdi Azikiwween hoogganaa sabboontotaa kan walabummaa Naayijeerii kolonii Biriiteen jalaa akka baatuuf ga'ee guddaa ba'aateedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Labour Day is a day to honour the contributions and achievements of workers.
entries.translation: Guyyaan hojjettootaa guyyaa hojii hojjettootaa fi gumaacha isaaniif beekamtiin itti kennamuufii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a time to reflect on the importance of hard work and dedication, and to appreciate the intelligence and skill of those who have made our country great.
entries.translation: Guyyaa itti barbaachisummaa cimanii hojjechuu fi cichoomina itti galateeffannuu fi guyyaa itti dandeettii fi cimina warra biyya keenya guddoo taasisan itti jajannuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such example is the story of Henry Ford.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyi seenaa kanaa tokko seenaa Heenerii Foordii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ford was a brilliant engineer and businessman who revolutionized the automobile industry.
entries.translation: Foordiin injiinera cimaa fi daldalaa industirii makiinaa warraaaqsiseedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is credited with inventing the assembly line, which made it possible to produce cars more efficiently and cheaply.
entries.translation: Sarara walitti qabamiinsaa kan uumee fi kunimmoo makiinaa bifa rakasaa fi ga'umsa qabuun akka oomishan taasiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to a boom in the auto industry and helped to create millions of jobs.
entries.translation: Kunis industirii konkolaataa kan guddisee fi hojiiwwan miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman kan uumeedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ford was also a strong advocate for workers' rights.
entries.translation: Akkasumas Foordiin nama mirga hojjettootaaf cimsee dubbatu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He believed that all workers should be paid a fair wage and have safe working conditions.
entries.translation: Hojjettoonni hundumtuu gatii sirriin akka kaffalamuu fi qabuu fi haala hojii nagaa qabeessa barbaadu jedhee amana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also established a profit-sharing plan for his employees, which made them shareholders in the company.
entries.translation: Akkasumas karoora ittiin isaaf qacaramtoonnisaa ittiin bu'aa qooddatan kan hundeessee fi kaampaanicha keessatti abbootii aksiyoonaa kan isaan taasisuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ford's intelligence and dedication helped to create a better world for workers.
entries.translation: Ciminnii fi dandeettiin Foordii hojjettootaaf addunyaa fooyya'aa umuuf gargaareera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is an inspiration to us all, and his legacy continues to inspire workers today.
entries.translation: Hunduma keenyaafiyyuu kaka'umsa inni, hojiinsaa hanga guyyaa arraattiyyuu hunda keenya kakaasuu itti fufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Assertiveness is the ability to stand up for your rights in a confident and direct way, without being aggressive or passive-aggressive.
entries.translation: Yaada ofiitti amanuu jechuun dandeettii mirgakeef ofitti amanamummaa fi kallattii dhaan utuu humna hin fayyadaminii fi hin sodaatiin dhaabbachuu jechuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you are assertive, you are able to express your thoughts and feelings clearly and respectfully, and you are able to set boundaries and say no when necessary.
entries.translation: Gaafa yaadakeetti amantu, yaadakee fi miirakee karaa ifa ta'ee fi kabaja qabuuun ibsuu ni dandeessa, akkasumas daangaa kaa'uu kan dandeessuu fi bakka barbachisaatti lakki jechuu akka dandeessu si godha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aggressiveness, on the other hand, is the tendency to be forceful or hostile in a way that is intended to intimidate or hurt others.
entries.translation: Humna fayyadamuu jechuunimmoo dandeettii humna fayyadamuu fi diina ta'uu karaa yaadamee nama aarsuu fi miidhuuf godhamuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you are aggressive, you may try to control others through intimidation or threats, and you may be quick to anger and lash out.
entries.translation: Gaafa humna fayyadamtu, namoota biroo doorsisuu fi yaaddessuudhaan to'achuuf yaalta, daftee kan aartuu fi kan rukuttuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Arrogant behavior is characterized by a feeling of superiority and a lack of respect for others.
entries.translation: Amala tuffii jechuun miira olaantummaa fi namoota biroof kabaja dhabuutiin beekama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you are arrogant, you may brag about your accomplishments, put others down, or act entitled.
entries.translation: Gaafa nama tuffattu, waa'ee milkaa'inakee ni dhaadhessita, warra kaan gadi buusta akkasumas akka maahireega qabdutti haasofta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is important to be able to distinguish between assertiveness, aggressiveness, and arrogance, as each behavior has its own set of consequences.
entries.translation: Yaada ofiitti amanuu, humna fayyadamuu fi nama tuffachuu adda baasnee ilaaluun barbaachisaadha, amaloonni hunduu dhiibbaa mataasaanii waan qabaniif.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Assertiveness is generally seen as a positive trait, while aggressiveness and arrogance are often seen as negative traits.
entries.translation: Yaada ofiitti amanuun walumaa galatti, akka amala eyyentaatti ilaalama, garuu humna fayyadamuu fi nama tuffachuun akka amala ihintaatti ilaalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Assertive people are more likely to be successful in their personal and professional lives, as they are able to stand up for themselves and get their needs met.
entries.translation: Namoonni yaada ofiitti amanan yeroo baayye jireenya dhuunfaa fi hojiisaanii keessatti milkaa'oodha, fedhii isaanii guuttachuuf waan dhaabbataniif.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aggressive people, on the other hand, are more likely to alienate others and have difficulty forming healthy relationships.
entries.translation: Namoonni humna fayyadaman gama biraatiin namoota biroo waan dhiibaniif walitti dhufeenya naga qabeessa uumuuf ni rakkatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And arrogant people are often seen as conceited and unlikable.
entries.translation: Namoonni nama tuffatan yeroo baayyee akka of tuultuutti waan lakkaa'amaniif hin jaallataman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are struggling to be assertive, there are a few things you can do to improve your assertiveness skills.
entries.translation: Nama yaadasaatti amanu ta'uuf rakkataa jirta yoo ta'e, dandeettii yaada ofiikeetti amanuukee dabaluuf waantoti godhaman muraasi jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, it is important to be aware of your own feelings and needs.
entries.translation: Jalqaba, miirakee fi waan barbaaddu beekuun gaariidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you know what you want, you can start to express yourself more clearly and directly.
entries.translation: Waan barbaaddu gaafa bartu, ofiikee ifaa fi kallattiidhaan ibsuu jalqabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also important to be respectful of others, even when you are disagreeing with them.
entries.translation: Namoota biroo kabajuunis barbaachisaadha, yoodhuma yaadasaanii wajjin walii hin galtu ta'eyyuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And finally, it is important to be confident in yourself and your abilities.

entries.english: But I was determined to make a good impression and make some new friends.

entries.english: It was much bigger than my old school, and there were so many students.

entries.english: It is the process of evaluating and judging the quality of something, and it can be a valuable tool for improving the work of art, literature, music, or other creative endeavor.
entries.translation: Adeemsa qulqullina waan tokkoo faraduu fi qoruudha, akkasumas meeshaa hojii aartii, litireecherii, muuziqaa yookin piroojektii kalaqaa ittiin fooyyessinuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, criticism can also be destructive, tearing down what others have created without offering any constructive feedback.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u malee, qeeqni nama balleessuus danda'a, yaad-deebii ijaarsaa utuu hin dhiyeessin hojii namoota biroo tuffachuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The perfect criticism is one that is both fair and helpful.
entries.translation: Qeeqni sirriin isa qulqulluu ta'ee fi bu'aa buusuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It should be based on sound reasoning and evidence, and it should offer specific suggestions for how to improve the work in question.
entries.translation: Sababa quubsaa fi ragaadhaan kan deggerame ta'uu qaba, akkasumas gaaffii irratti hojjetamaa jiru karaa ittiin fooyyessuun dandaa'amu irratti yaada kennuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The perfect critic is someone who is knowledgeable about the subject matter and who is able to articulate their thoughts clearly and concisely.
entries.translation: Qeeqaa sirriin nama waan sana sirnaan beekuu fi nama yaadasaa karaa sirrii fi ifa ta'een ibsu ta'uu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Criticism is a skill that can be learned and improved with practice.
entries.translation: Qeeqni dandeettii baratamuu danda'uu fi shaakalaan fooyya'uu danda'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are interested in becoming a better critic, there are a few things you can do.
entries.translation: Qeeqaa fooyya'aa ta'uudhaaf fedhii yoo qabaatte, waantoti gochuu qabdu muraasi jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: First, read widely and develop a strong understanding of the different forms of art and literature.
entries.translation: Jalqabarratti, haala aartii fi litireecherii garaa garaa hubachuuf baldhinaan dubbisuu fi hubannaa cimaa qabaachuu qabda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Second, learn to think critically about the work you are consuming.
entries.translation: Lammaffaa, waa'ee hojii hojjetaa jirtu bifa qeeqaatiin yaadi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ask yourself questions about the author's purpose, the audience for the work, and the techniques used by the artist.
entries.translation: Kaayyoo barreessaa, fayyadamaa hojii sanaa fi teekinika aartistiin sun fayyadame irratti gaaffii of gaafadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Third, be willing to share your opinions with others, even if they are not popular.
entries.translation: Sadaffaa, yaadakee namoota kan biroo wajjin walii qooduuf fedhii qabaadhu, namoonni sun beekamoo ta'uudhaa yoo baatanis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The best way to improve your critical skills is to practice them.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sierra Leone is a country in West Africa with a rich history.

entries.english: One of the most important events in Sierra Leone's history was the founding of Freetown in 1787.
entries.translation: Taatee baayyee barbaachisaa Seeraa Liyoon keessaa tokko, hundeeffama magaalaa walaabaa bara 1787 ti.

entries.english: Freetown was founded by the British as a colony for freed slaves from the United States.

entries.english: The colony grew rapidly, and by the 19th century, Freetown was a major center of commerce and culture.

entries.english: In 1896, Sierra Leone became a British protectorate.

entries.english: During the colonial period, Sierra Leone experienced significant economic and social development.

entries.english: However, the country also faced challenges, such as poverty, disease, and political instability.

entries.english: She had been thinking about getting a tattoo for a long time, but she couldn't decide what she wanted.

entries.english: The tattoo artist nodded. "I understand," he said.

entries.english: "It's important to find a design that you'll love for the rest of your life."

entries.english: He thought for a moment, then turned to the wall and pointed to a design of a rose.

entries.english: "What about this?" he asked. "It's a symbol of love and beauty."

entries.english: The woman looked at the design for a moment, then nodded.

entries.english: "I like it," she said. "I'll take it." The tattoo artist smiled and got to work.

entries.english: Technology has advanced at an unprecedented rate, and with it, our understanding of the universe.

entries.english: We now know that there are countless other planets out there, and that some of them may even be inhabited.
