entries.english: This has given rise to a new genre of science fiction: space opera.
entries.translation: Kunis guddina asoosama saayinsii: ispees opeeraa jedhamuu uumeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Space operas are big, sweeping adventure stories that take place in the vastness of space.
entries.translation: Opeeraawwani ispeesii seenaa gurguddoo fi bal'ina ta'anii baayi'ina hawaasaa keessatti kan raawwatamanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They often feature interstellar travel, alien civilizations, and other fantastical elements.
entries.translation: Yeroo baayyees imala urjiiwwanii, qarooma ormaa fi wantoota dinqisiisoo biroo agarsiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most popular space operas include Star Wars, Star Trek, and Battlestar Galactica.
entries.translation: Opeeraawwan ispeesii baay'ee beekamoo ta'an keessaa Istaar Waars, Istaar Tireekii fi Baatilistaar Gaalaktikaa ni caqafamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These shows have captivated audiences for decades with their thrilling stories, memorable characters, and stunning visuals.
entries.translation: Agarsiifti kunis waggoota kurnan baay'eef seenaawwan gamachiisoo, taatoowwan yadatamanii fi ilaalcha dinqisiisoo ta'aniin daawwatoota isaa booji'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Space operas are a great way to escape the everyday world and explore a new and exciting universe.
entries.translation: Opeeraawwan ispeesii addunyaa guyya guyyaa kana keessaa bahuun uumama bareedaa gammachiisaa fi haaraa ta'e barbaaduuf karaa bareedaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also be thought-provoking and inspiring, as they often deal with big questions about life, the universe, and everything.
entries.translation: Isaanis yeroo baay'ee gaaffilee gurguddo jireenyaa,uumamaa fi waa'ee hundumaa kan qaban waan ta'eef, kan qalbii namaa qabanii fi kan kakaasan ta'uu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you're a fan of science fiction, then space operas are definitely worth checking out.
entries.translation: Waa'ee taatee saayinsii kan jaalattu yoo taate, asoosama saayinsii illaalun dhugumatti bu'aa qabeessa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They're sure to provide you with hours of entertainment and leave you wanting more.
entries.translation: Bashannana sa'aatii dheeraa sii dhiheessuu fi caalatti akka feetu si taasisuuf sirritti ni hojjetu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2015, I visited Liberia with a group of students from New York University.
entries.translation: Bara 2015 tti garee baratoota Yuuniversitii Niiwu Yoorkii waliin Laaybeeriyaa daawwadheen ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were there to learn about the challenges facing women in the country, and to work with local organizations to help address them.
entries.translation: Qorumsa dubartoonni biyya sanatti isaan mudatu baruufii akkasumas dhaabbatoota naannoo sanaa waliin rakkoo kana furuuf achi ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most pressing issues we learned about was the high rate of sexual violence against women.
entries.translation: Dhimmoota baayyee yaaddeessoo ilaalle keessaa tokko miidhaa saalaa dubartoota irratti raawwatamu baay'ee ta'uu isaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, a 2013 study found that 65% of women in Liberia had experienced sexual violence at some point in their lives.
entries.translation: Dhugaa dubbachuuf, qorannon bara 2013 gaggeeffame akka agarsiisutti dubartoonni Laaybeeriyaatti jiraatan keessaa dhibbentaan 65 jireenyaa isaanii keessatti yeroo tokko midhaan saalaa isaan mudateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This violence has a devastating impact on women's physical and mental health, and it can also lead to poverty and social isolation.
entries.translation: Miidhaan saalaa kuni fayyaa qaamaa fi sammuu dubartootaa irratti dhiibbaa hamaa kan qabu yoo ta'u, hiyyummaa fi balaaleeffama hawaasummaattis geessuus ni danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the organizations we worked with was Women United Liberia, which provides support and services to survivors of sexual violence.
entries.translation: Dhaabbilee nuti waliin hojjenne keessaa tokko Woomeen Yuunaaytid Laaybeeriyaa yoo ta'u, Innis namoota miidhaan saalaa irra gaheef taajaajilaa fi deeggarsa kan kennudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We helped the organization to conduct a survey of survivors, and we also worked with them to develop a new method for providing counseling to survivors.
entries.translation: Dhaabbatichi qoraannoo namoota miidhaan saalaa irra gahe akka gaggeessu kan gargaarree fi namoota miidhaan saalaa irra gaheef mala haaraa ta'een gorsa akka keennuufis waliin hojjennerra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were proud to be able to work with Women United Liberia, and we believe that the method we developed will make a real difference in the lives of survivors of sexual violence in Liberia.
entries.translation: Dhaabbata Woomeen Yuunaytid Laaybeeriyaa waliin hojjechuu keenyati kan gammanne yoo ta'u, malli nuti qopheessine jireenya namoota miidhaan saalaa irra gahe irratti jijjiirama dhugaa akka fidus nii amanna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher, I think friends are one of the most important things in life.
entries.translation: Barsiisaa, hiriyyoonni jireenya keessatti wantoota barbaachisoo ta'an keessaa tokko natti fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They're the people who are there for us when we need them, who make us laugh, and who help us grow as people.
entries.translation: Isaan namoota yeroo nuti isaan barbaannu nuuf argaman, kan nu koofalchiisan, namummaatti akka guddannu kan nu gargaaranidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I was younger, I was kind of immature.
entries.translation: Yeroon ani xinnaa turetti, bilichina hin qabuun ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I didn't really understand the importance of friendship.
entries.translation: Barbaachisummaan hiriyyummaa naaf hin galle ture. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought it was all about having fun and doing things together.
entries.translation: Bashannanaa fi waantoota adda addaa waliin hojjechuu natti fakkaata ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But as I've gotten older, I've realized that friendship is so much more than that.
entries.translation: Garuu hammuma umiriin koo dabalaa dhufeen hiriyyummaan kana caalaa akka ta'e hubadheera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's about having someone to talk to who understands you, who you can trust, and who you can count on.
entries.translation: Nama si hubatu, kan ati amanuu danddeessu, kan ati itti abdachuu dandeessu qabaachuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friends have been there for me through thick and thin.
entries.translation: Hiriyyoonni koo yeroo gaddaa fi gammaachuukoo ana waliin turani.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They've seen me at my best and my worst, and they've always loved and supported me.
entries.translation: Isaan haala gaarii fi hamaakoo keessatti na wajjin turani, yeroo hundumaas na jaalachaa fi na deeggaraniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They've helped me through tough times, and they've made me laugh when I've needed it most.
entries.translation: Isaan yeroo rakkisaa koo keessatti na gargaaraniiru, yeroo baayyee na barbaachisuttis na kofalchiisaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know that I can always count on my friends.
entries.translation: Yeroo hundumaa hiriyyoota koo irratti abdachuu akkan danda'u nan beeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They're the people who I can be myself around, and who I know will always be there for me.
entries.translation: Isaan namoota ani isaan bira ta'uu danda'uu fi yeroo hunda akka anaaf jiran beekudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so grateful for their friendship, and I know that my life would be much poorer without them.
entries.translation: Hiriyyumaa isaanif baay'een galateefadha, osoo isaan jiraachuu baatanii jireenya koo keessatti hiyyeessa akkan ta'u nan beeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My dad was telling me about our new neighbors today.
entries.translation: Har'a abbaankoo waa'ee oollaa keenya haaraa anatti himaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They moved in a few weeks ago, and we haven't had a chance to meet them yet.
entries.translation: Torban muraasaa dura kan galan yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti carraa wal arguu hin arganne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad said that they are a family of four, with two kids around my age.
entries.translation: Abbaankoo maatiin isaanii namoota afur qaba naan jedheera, ijjoolleen lamaanis naannoo umurii kootti kan argamanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dad is a doctor, and the mom is a lawyer.
entries.translation: Abbaan isaanii doktora, akkasumas haati isaanii ogeessa seeraati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They seem like a nice family, and I'm looking forward to getting to know them better.
entries.translation: Maatii gaarii fakkaatu, caalaatti isaan beekuuf hawwii guddaadhanan eeggadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad also told me that the kids are both in the competitive academy at their school.
entries.translation: Abbaan kiyya ijoolleen lamaan isaanii barumsa akkadaamii isaanitin ciccimoo akka ta'an natti himeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The academy is a special program for students who are interested in pursuing a career in medicine or law.
entries.translation: Akkaadamichi kun barattoota barumsa fayyaa fi seeraa hordofuuf fedhii qabaniif sagantaa addaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The kids have to take a lot of extra classes and do a lot of extracurricular activities, but it's a great opportunity for them to learn and grow.
entries.translation: Ijoollen daree dabalataa heedduu fudhachuu fi hojjiiwwan barnootaan alaa baay'ee hojjechuu qabu, garuu barachuu fi guddachuu isaaniif carraa guddaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm impressed by the kids' ambition, and I'm excited to see what they accomplish in the future.
entries.translation: Hawwiin ijoollee kanaa na ajaa'ibsiiseera, gara fuulduraattis maal galmaan akka ga'an ilaaluuf fedhii guddaan qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: John was a farmer who grew corn and soybeans.
entries.translation: Joon qonnaan bulaa boqqolloo fii atara oomishu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been farming for over 30 years and was well-respected in the community.
entries.translation: Waggoota 30 oliif qonnaan bulaa kan ture yoo ta'u, hawaasa keessatti kabaja guddaa qabu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, John was approached by a group of government officials who were leading an initiative to help farmers adopt new technologies.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokkoo, qondaaltonni mootummaa jalqabbii teekinoolojii haaraa gaggeessaa turan qonnaan bultoonni akka fudhatan gargaaruuf Joonin dubbisan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The officials told John that they could help him increase his crop yields and reduce his costs if he would agree to use their new methods.
entries.translation: Qondaaltonni kuni Joon mala haaraa kan fayyadamuuf yoo walii gale, isaan oomisha midhaanii isaa akka dabaluu fi baasii isaa hir'isuuf akka isa gargaaran itti himan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: John was hesitant at first, but he eventually agreed to give it a try.
entries.translation: Joon jalqaba irratti mamus, garuu dhumarratti yaaluf walii galeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The officials provided John with a new set of equipment and training on how to use it.
entries.translation: Qondaaltonni kun meeshaalee haaraa fi leenjii akkaataa itti fayyadama isaanii Jooniif kennan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: John was surprised at how easy it was to use the new equipment and he was quickly able to see the benefits.
entries.translation: Joon meeshaa haaraa kana fayyadamuun hammam salphaa akka ta'een baay'ee dinqamee faayidaa isaaniis dafee arguu danda'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His crop yields increased significantly and his costs went down.
entries.translation: Omishini midhaanii isaa haalaan dabalee baasiin isaas gadi bu'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: John was so happy with the results that he recommended the new program to his fellow farmers.
entries.translation: Joon bu'aa argametti baayyee gammaduudhaan qonnaan bultoota isa wajjin hojjetaniif sagantaa haaraa kana gorseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The program was a success and helped many farmers improve their operations.
entries.translation: Sagantaan kun milkaa'ina kan argate yoo ta'u, qonnaan bultoonni hedduu hojii isaanii akka fooyyessaniif gargaareera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The debate about ecology, the environment, and human-caused climate change is a complex and multifaceted one.
entries.translation: Falmiin waa'ee sirna ikolojii, naannoo fi jijjiirama qilleensaa namtolchee dhimma baay'ee walxaxaa ta'eefi kallattii baay'eetin kan ilaalamudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different social issues that intersect with this debate, including poverty, inequality, and race.
entries.translation: Hiyyummaa, walqixxummaa dhabuu fi sanyumma dabalatee dhimmoonni hawaasummaa adda addaa falmii kana waliin wal qabatan heeddutu jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Poverty is a major driver of environmental degradation.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: People living in poverty often have to resort to environmentally destructive practices in order to survive.
entries.translation: Namoonni hiyyummaa keessa jiraatan yeroo baay'ee jiraachuf jecha gochaalee naannoo balleessan nii dalagu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, they may burn wood for cooking or heating, which releases harmful pollutants into the air.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, nyaata bilcheessuf yookiin ho'isuuf muka gubuu danda'u, kunis qilleensa faalamaa ta'e gara qilleensaati gadi lakkisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They may also cut down trees to produce arable farmland, leading to deforestation and the spread of deserts.
entries.translation: Lafa qonnaaf mijatu argachuuf muka muruu danda'u, kunis babal'ina cirama bosonaa fi gammojjumaa ni geessisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Income inequality is also a major factor in environmental degradation.
entries.translation: Dhabamuun walqixxummaa galiis manca’iinsa naannoo keessatti sababa guddaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The richest people in the world consume a disproportionately large share of the world's resources, while the poorest people often have to live with the consequences of environmental pollution.
entries.translation: Dureeyyiin addunyaa qabeenya addunyaa keessaa qooda baay'ee kan fayyadaman yoo ta'u, namoonni hiyyeeyyii ta'an yeroo baay'ee bu'aa faalama naannoo wajjin jiraachun carraa isaanii ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Race is another important factor in the debate about ecology, the environment, and climate change.
entries.translation: Falmiin waa'ee ikoloojii, naannoo fi jijjiirama qilleensaa irratti taasifamu keessatti sanyummaan sababa guddaa isa biraati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The live performances of classical music are a unique and special experience.
entries.translation: Agarsiifni muuziqaa kilaasikaalaa kallattii muuxannoo adda kan ta'ee fi baay'ee nama gammachiisudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The combination of the beauty of the music, the skill of the performers, and the energy of the audience creates an atmosphere that is unlike anything else.
entries.translation: Idaa'amni bareesina muuziqaa, dandeettin dhiheessitootaa akkasumas humnii daawwatootaa haala daran adda ta'e uuma.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One such event that perfectly captures the magic of live classical music is the annual return of the Boston Symphony Orchestra to Tanglewood.
entries.translation: Taateewwan babareedoo akkasii dinqii tapha muziqaa kilaasikaala kallattii qabatee, waggaa waggaan Oorkeestiraa Siimfoonii Boostanii hanga Tanglewooditti kan gaggeefamudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This summer festival, which has been running for over 100 years, brings together some of the world's greatest musicians to perform in a beautiful outdoor setting.
entries.translation: Ayyaanno gannaa kun waggoota 100 oliif kan gaggeeffamaa ture yoo ta'u, muuziqeessitoota gurguddoo addunyaa tokko tokko walitti fiduudhaan, bakka bareedaa ta'eetti akka dhiheessan kan taasisudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In a recent article, one music critic described the experience of attending a concert at Tanglewood as "being transported to another world."
entries.translation: Barreeffama dhiheenya kana baheen, qeeqaan muuziqaa tokko muuxannoo koonsartii Taanglewood irratti argamuun " gara addunyaa biraatti geejjibsiifamuu jechuudha" jechuun ibseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robots are machines that are capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically, especially one programmable by a computer.

entries.english: Robots are also being used in more and more applications, such as search and rescue, space exploration, and military combat.

entries.english: Same-sex marriage is a legal union of two people of the same sex.
entries.translation: Gaa'eelli saala wal fakkaataa gamtoomina seera qabeessa namoota saala wal fakkaataa lamaa gidduuti taasifamuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The legal recognition of same-sex marriage has been the subject of much debate in recent years.
entries.translation: Waggoota dhiyoo asitti seera qabeessummaan gaa'ela saala walfakkaataa yaadaa falmii guddaa kaasu ta'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people believe that same-sex marriage should be legal, while others believe that it should not be.
entries.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko gaa'elli saala wal-fakkaataa seera qabeessa ta'u qaba jedhanii yommuu amanan, warri kaan ammoo akkas ta'uu hinqabu jedhani amanu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of arguments for and against same-sex marriage.
entries.translation: Falmiileen lakkoofsaan heedduu ta'an waa'ee deeggarsaa fi mormii gaa'ela saala wal-fakkaataa irrati ka'an nii jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One argument in favor of same-sex marriage is that it is a matter of equality.
entries.translation: Falmiin gaa'ela saala wal-fakkaataa deeggaruun ka'u inni tokko waa'ee dhimma wal qixxummaa namoota gaa'ela saala wal-fakkaataa qabaniiti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: All people, regardless of their sexual orientation, should have the same rights and responsibilities.
entries.translation: Namni hundinuu, haalli saalaa isaa osoo hin ilaalamin, mirgaa fi itti gaafatamummaa wal qixa ta'e qabaachuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Marriage is a fundamental right, and same-sex couples should be able to enjoy this right just like heterosexual couples.
entries.translation: Gaa'elli mirga bu'uuraati, kanaafuu jalleewwan saala walfakkaataa mirga haaluma kadhimamoonni saala gara garaa fayyadamanitti fayyadamuu qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another argument in favor of same-sex marriage is that it is beneficial for children.
entries.translation: Falmiin inni kan namootni saala wal faakkaataa deggaraniitin ka'u immoo faayidaa gaa'ilichi ijjoolleedhaaf kennudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Studies have shown that children who are raised by same-sex parents are just as well-adjusted as children who are raised by heterosexual parents.
entries.translation: Qorannoowwan akka agarsiisanitti ijoolleen maatii saala wal fakkaataa qabaniin guddifaman akkuma ijoollee maatii gaa'ela saala garagaraa qabaniin guddifamanitti amala sirri ta'e qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, some studies have even shown that children who are raised by same-sex parents may be more tolerant and accepting of others.
entries.translation: Dhugaa dubbachuuf, qorannoowwan tokko tokko akka agarsiisanitti, ijoolleen maatii saala walfakkaataatin guddifaman caalumatti faara kan qabanii fi isaan biroo kan hammatanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, there are also arguments against same-sex marriage.
entries.translation: Dhugaadha, falmiileen gaa'ela saala wal fakkaataa mormuudhaan ka'anis ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people believe that marriage is a union between a man and a woman, and that same-sex couples should not be allowed to marry.
entries.translation: Namoonni tokko tokko gaa'elli tokkooma dhiiraafi dubaraati jedhanii amanu, isa irraas kan ka'e jaalleewwan saala walfakkaataa qaban iif gaa'elli eyyamamuu hin qabus jedhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a farmer was walking through his field when he saw a dark cloud approaching.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokko, qonnaan bulaan tokko maasii isaa keessa osoo deddeemaa jiruu, dumeessi gurraacha'aa ta'e akka dhufa jiru arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He knew that a storm was coming, so he ran to his barn to get his animals to safety.
entries.translation: Roobni yandoo ta'e akka dhufaa jiru waan bareef, bineeldota isaa gara mooraa isaaniitti galchuuf fiige.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He gathered up his cows, pigs, and chickens and brought them inside.
entries.translation: Saawwan, booyyeewwan, fi lukkuwwan isaas walitti qabee gara keessaa ol-galche.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the storm raged, the farmer watched from the window as the wind and rain whipped through the trees.
entries.translation: Hammuma qilleensichi jabaachaa dhufeen, qonnaan bultichi qilleensii fi bokkaan mukkootaa darbanii fi raasan karaa foddaa isaa ilaalaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was worried about his crops, but he knew that there was nothing he could do.
entries.translation: Waa'ee midhaan isaa yaadda'aa ture, haa ta'u iyyuu malee homaa gochuu akka hin dandeenyee bekeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next morning, the sun came out and the storm was over.
entries.translation: Ganama guyyaa itti aanuttis, aduun baatee turte, yandoon sunis dhaabatee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer went outside to survey the damage.
entries.translation: Qotee bulaan kunis midhaa qaqabe qorachuuf gara alaatti gadi bahe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His crops were ruined, but he saw something else that made him smile.
entries.translation: Midhaan isaas manca'ee ture, haa ta'u iyyuu malee wanta isa kofalchiisu tokko arge.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the middle of the field, there was a beautiful rainbow.
entries.translation: Maasii isaa gidduutti, sabbatni araaraa bareedaan ni mul'ata ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer knew that the rainbow was a sign of hope.
entries.translation: Qonnaan bulaan kun sabbanni araaraa mallattoo abdi akka ta'e ni beeke.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It reminded him that even though there are storms in life, there is always a silver lining.
entries.translation: Jireenya keessatti bubbeen hamaa jiraatu illee, yeroo hunda wanti abdii gaarii kennu akka jiraatu isa yaadachiise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The railway station is a place where people come and go.
entries.translation: Bufatni baaburaa bakka namoonni dhufaniifi deemanii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are always people rushing to catch their trains, and others waiting for their loved ones to arrive.
entries.translation: Yeroo hunda namonni baaburicha dhaqqabuuf asiif achi kaatan, isaan kaan immoo namni isaan jaalatan hanga dhufutti nii eeggatu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a place of constant activity, and there is always something to see.
entries.translation: Iddoo sochiiin dhaabbataa ta'e itti argamu yoo ta'u, akkasumas yeroo hunda wanti ilaalamu nii jiraata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the things that you might see at a railway station is a meme.
entries.translation: Wantoota buufata baaburaa keesssatti argu dandeessu keessaa inni tokkoo maxxansa qoosaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Memes are images or videos that are copied and shared online, often with slight variations.
entries.translation: Maxxansa qoosaa jechuun suuraalee yookiin viidiyoowwan garaagarumma xinnootiin toora marsariitii irraatti kan qoodamanidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be funny, serious, or anything in between.
entries.translation: Isaanis kan nama kofalchiisan, dhimmoota cimoo yookiin wanta gidduu lamaan kanaa kan ta'anidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At a railway station, you might see memes about traveling, waiting for trains, or meeting new people.
entries.translation: Buufata baaburaatti, qoosaawwan waa'ee imalaa, namoota baabura eeggatanii yookiin immoo waa'ee nama haaraan wal baruu arguu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another thing that you might see at a railway station is a store.
entries.translation: Wanti biraan kan buufata baaburaa keessatti arguu dandessu mana daldalaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are usually a variety of stores at a railway station, including convenience stores, newsstands, and bookstores.
entries.translation: Yeroo baay'ee suuqota gurguddoo, buufata gaazexaa akkasumas manneen kitaabaa dabalatee manneen daldalaa gosa garagaraa ta'an buufata baaburaa keessatti nii argamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These stores sell a variety of items, such as food, drinks, newspapers, magazines, and books.
entries.translation: Manneen daldalaa kunneen nyaataa, dhugaatii, gaazeexaa, barruulee fi kitaabota dabalatee mi'a gosa garagaraa nii gurguru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The railway station is a place where people come together, and it is a place where anything can happen.
entries.translation: Buufatnii baaburichaa bakka itti namonni walitti sassaabamanii dha, akkasumas bakka wantii fedhee itti uumamuu danda'uu dhas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You might see a meme, you might buy a snack, or you might even meet your future spouse.
entries.translation: Maxxansa qoosaa arguu dandessa, nyaata salphaa bituus ni dandeessa, yookiin immoo jaalalee kee yeroo fuulduraa illee argachuu dandessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sports call to us from our youth, urging us to join in the fun and excitement.
entries.translation: Ispoortiin yeroo dargagummaa keenya irraa kaasee, bashannanaa fi gamachuu keessatti akka hirmaannu nu jajabeessa, nu waamas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They promote physical fitness and teamwork, and teach us how to work together as a pack.
entries.translation: Isaanis jabeenya qaamaa fi hojii garee nii jajjabeessun, akkaataa akka tuutaa tookkootti waliin hojjechuu dandeenyu nu barsiisu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sports also help us to develop our bodies and minds, and to learn how to deal with both victory and defeat.
entries.translation: Ispoortiin qaamaaf sammuu keenya akka guddisnuuf nu gargaara, akkasuumas injifannoo fi moo'amuu waliin akkaataa ittiin waligalluu dandeenyus nu barsiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we play sports, we are not only competing against others, but also against ourselves.
entries.translation: Yeroo ispoortii taphannu, namoota biroo waliin qofa osoo hin taane, ofii keenya waliinis dorgomaa jirra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are pushing ourselves to be our best, and we are learning what we are capable of.
entries.translation: Hunda caalaa ofii keenya isa filatamaa ta'uudhaaf of dhiibaa jirra, akkasumas maal hojjechuu akka dandeenyus baraa jirra.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sports are a great way to stay healthy and active, and they can also be a lot of fun.
entries.translation: Ispoortiin fayyaa fi si'aawaa ta'uuf mala baay'ee gaarii ta'eedha, akkasumas bakka ittti bashanana argannuu ta'uu danda'uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So lace up your shoes and get out there!
entries.translation: Kanaaf kophee kee hidhadhutii gara achiitti bahi!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a young man, I was always fascinated by the stories that my grandmother used to tell me.
entries.translation: Ijoolluummaa kootti, oduu durii akkoon kiyya natti himtuun yeroo hunda baay'ee na gammada ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had a wonderful gift for storytelling, and her tales always seemed to transport me to another world.
entries.translation: Isheeniis seenaa himuudhaan kennaa ajaa'ibaa qabdi turtee, akasumas oduun durii ishee yeroo hunda gara adunyaa biraatti na geessa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of my favorite stories was about a man named Srinivasa, who was a great scholar and philosopher.
entries.translation: Seenaa ani baay'ee jaaladhuu keessaa inni tokkoo seenaa nama Sirnivaasaa jeedhamuu yoo ta'u, innis haayyuu fi nama falaasamaa turee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Srinivasa was so wise that he could answer any question that was put to him.
entries.translation: Sirnivaasiin baay'ee ogeessa waan tureef gaaffiilee isaaf dhiyaatan kamiyyuu ni deebisa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The purpose of life is to give it away" The king was so impressed with Srinivasa's answer that he gave him a large reward.
entries.translation: Kaayyoon jireenyaa ammo kennuu dha" Mootichis deebii Sirnivaasaatiin baay'ee dinqisiifamee badhaasa guddaa isaaf kenne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But Srinivasa refused the reward, saying that he had already been rewarded enough by the knowledge that he had helped someone else.
entries.translation: Garuu Sirnivaasaan duurumaan iyyuu beekumsa ittin nama gargaaruu akka badhaafamee ibsuun badhaasa sana fudhachuu diideera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This story taught me that the most important thing in life is not to seek material possessions, but to find your gift and share it with others.
entries.translation: Seenaan kun jireenya keessatti wanti hunda caalaa barbaachisaa ta'e qabeenya argachuuf dhamahuu osoo hin taane, kennaa koo argachuu fi namoota birootif qooduu akka ta'e na barsiiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's an opportunity to help those in need and make a difference in the world.
entries.translation: Kunis namoota rakkkatan gargaaruunifi aduunyaa irratti jijjirrama fiduuf carraa isa tokko dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But sometimes, charity can have unexpected consequences.
entries.translation: Garuu yeroo tokko tokko, arjummaan rakkoo hin eegamnee fiduu danda'aa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most common unintended consequences of charity is that it can create a dependency on the giver.
entries.translation: Bu'aan hin eegamnee tola oltummaa irraa dhufuu inni tokkoo nama kennu irratti hirkattummaa umuu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When people are given help without having to work for it, they can start to expect that help to continue.
entries.translation: Namoonni yeroo homaa hin hojjatiin gargaaraman, gargaarsiichi akka itti fuufuf eeggachuu jalqabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a lack of motivation and a sense of entitlement.
entries.translation: Kunis haanqina kaka'umsa fi miira mirga qabaachuutti geessuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another unintended consequence of charity is that it can create a divide between the giver and the receiver.
entries.translation: Rakkinni tola ooltummaa hin yaadamne irraa dhufuu inni kan biraa immoo kennaa fi fudhataa jedhamuun qoqoodamuu isaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The giver may feel superior to the receiver, while the receiver may feel inferior or ashamed.
entries.translation: Namni kennu isa fudhatu irra akka caalu itti dhagaahamuu danda'a, namni fudhatu immoo gad aantummaan yookiin mirri qaanii itti dhagaahamuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can make it difficult for both parties to build a relationship based on mutual respect.
entries.translation: Kunis qaamoolee lamaan gidduutti haariroo wal kabajuu irratti hundaa'ee ijaaruuf ulfaata gochuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, charity can sometimes do more harm than good.
entries.translation: Dhumarrattis, tola arjummaan yeroo tokko tokko faayidaa caala midhaan isaa baay'ee ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the help that is given is not appropriate or if it is not given in a way that is respectful, it can actually make the situation worse.
entries.translation: Gargaarsii keennamaa jiruu haala sirrii hin taaneen yookin haala nama kabajuun yoo kennamu baate, dhugumatti haala sana haammeessu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, giving food to a homeless person without also providing them with shelter or job training may only enable their homelessness.
entries.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, nama mana hin qabneef iddoo dahoo yookin leenjii hojii osoo hin kennin nyaata dhiyeessuun dhabiinsa manaa hammeessuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, these are just a few of the unintended consequences of charity.
entries.translation: Eeyyeni, kunneenis rakkina toola ooltummaa hin eegamnee irraa dhufan keessaa isaan muraasadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many other ways that charity can backfire.
entries.translation: Karaaleen biroo hedduun hojii toola ooltummaa duubatti deebisan jirachuu danda'uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Did you see that new logo for the water scarcity awareness campaign?
entries.translation: A: Asxaa haaraa duula hubannoo uumuu hanqina bishaanii kanaaf oolu sana argatanittu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I like how they used the shape of a water droplet to form the word "scarcity."
entries.translation: Akkaataa isaan boca cooba bishaanii jecha "hanqina" jeettuu ibsuuf itti fayyadaman jaaladheera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Yeah, it's a really clever design. And it's definitely a relevant issue.
entries.translation: A: Eeyyen, diizaayiniin isaa baay'ee bareedaa ta'ee dha. Akkasumas dhimmichis dhimma baay'ee barbaachisaa ta'ee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I know, right? Water scarcity is a major problem in many parts of the world.
entries.translation: B: Nan beeka, mitiree? Hanqinni bishaanii kuutaale adunyaa heeddutti rakkoo guddaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Yeah, it's something that we all need to be aware of and working to address.
entries.translation: A: Eeyyee, dhimma hundi keenya hubachuufi furuuf hojjachuu qabnu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I agree. We can all do our part to conserve water and use it wisely.
entries.translation: B: Nan walii gala. Bishaan kunuunsuufi oguummaa dhaan fayyadamuuf gahee keenya bahaachu dandeenya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Yeah, even small changes can make a big difference.
entries.translation: A: Eeyye, jijjirramoonnii xixiqqoon waan guddaa tokko umuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: I'm glad that people are starting to talk about this issue more.
entries.translation: B: Namoonni dhimma kanarratti haalaan haasa'uu jalqabuu isanitti gammadeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's something that we need to address sooner rather than later.
entries.translation: Dhimma boodarra ilaaluu qabnu osoo hin taane kan dafnee ilaaluu qabnudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I agree. We need to act now before it's too late.
entries.translation: A: Walii nan gala. Amma osoo hin barfatiin eegaluu qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once upon a time, there was a man named Ahmed who was married to a woman named Fatima.
entries.translation: Dur Dur, namni maqaan isaa Ahimad jedhamu dubartii maqaan ishee Faaximaa jedhamtu kan fuudhee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had been married for many years, but they were not happy together.
entries.translation: Waggoota hedduu gaa'elaan jiraachaa tuuranillee, gamachuu garuu waliin hin qaban ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ahmed was a very strict man, and he always wanted things to be done his way.
entries.translation: Ahimad nama baay'ee seera cimsuu ture, innis yeroo hunda wanti tokko karaa inni barbaaduun akka hojjatamuu feedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima was a kind and gentle woman, but she found it difficult to live with Ahmed's constant demands.
entries.translation: Faaximaan immo dubara gara laaftuu fi tasgabbooftuu turte, garuu feedhii dhaabbataa Ahimadii waliin jirachuun itti ulfaate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ahmed and Fatima decided to get a divorce.
entries.translation: Gaaf tokkos, Ahimad fi Faaximaan wal hiikuuf murteessan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They went to see a divorce consultant, who helped them to understand the relevant laws and regulations.
entries.translation: Isaanis ogeessa gorsaa gaa'elaa, isa seeraafi dambii barbaachisuu hubachuu isaanii irratti isaan gargaare bira deeman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The consultant also helped them to reach an agreement on how to divide their assets and share custody of their children.
entries.translation: Goorsaan kuniis qabeenya isaani akkamitti akka qooddatan fi kunuunsa ijollee isaanii irratti waligaltee irra akka ga'an isaan gargaare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The divorce was finalized, and Ahmed and Fatima went their separate ways.
entries.translation: Wal hiikumsi isaanis xumuramee, Ahimad fi Faaximaaniis karaa isaanii adda adda ta'een deeman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ahmed was relieved to be free from the marriage, but Fatima was sad to see her family break up.
entries.translation: Ahimad gaa'eela sana irra hiikaan adda ba'uun isaa miira boqonna isaaf laateera, Faaximman garuu maatiin ishee addan bahuu isaatiin gadditeeti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She knew that it would be difficult for her to raise her children on her own, but she was determined to make the best of it.
entries.translation: Ijoollee ishee kophaa ishee taatee guddisuun akka itti ulfaatuu ni beekti turte, garuu akka gaaritti itti fayyadamuuf murteessiteetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima found a job and started to rebuild her life.
entries.translation: Faaximaan hojii argatte achiis jireenya ishee ijaaruu jalqabde.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She enrolled her children in school and made sure that they had everything they needed.
entries.translation: Ijoolle ishee mana barumsaatti galmeessistee achiis waan isaan barbaachisuu akka guutameef mirkannessite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She also started to see a therapist, who helped her to deal with the emotional pain of the divorce.
entries.translation: Akkasumas ogeessa fayyaa bira deemuu kan jalqabde yoo ta'u, kunis dhukkubbii miira wal hiikuu sanaan ishee mudatu akka moo'attu ishee gargaareera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dictators are often seen as ruthless and bloodthirsty rulers who have no regard for human life.
entries.translation: Abbootiin irree yeroo baay'ee akka bulchitoota lubbuu namaatiif ilaalcha siirri hin taanee, akkasumas gara laafina kan hin qabneettiifii dhiigaa dheebotanitti ilaalamu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While there is some truth to this stereotype, it is important to remember that not all dictators are the same.
entries.translation: Yaadni kun dhugaan tokko tokko qabaatus, abbootiin irree hundi isaanii walfakkaatoo akka hin taane yaadachuunis barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some have been responsible for great atrocities, while others have actually improved the lives of their people.
entries.translation: Isaan tokko tokko gocha hammeenyaa gurguddaaf itti gaafatamtoota kan turan yoo ta’u, kaan immoo qabatamaadhaan jireenya ummata isaanii fooyyessanii jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most famous dictators in history is Adolf Hitler.
entries.translation: Seenaa keessatti abbootii irree beekamoo ta’an keessaa tokko kan ta'e Adoolf Hiitlari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hitler was the leader of Nazi Germany from 1933 to 1945.
entries.translation: Hiitlaris bara 1933 A.L.A hanga 1945 A.L.Atti hogganaa Naazii Jarmanii ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Under his rule, Germany invaded several countries and committed genocide against the Jews and other minority groups.
entries.translation: Bulchiinsa isaa jalattis, Jarmaniin biyyoota hedduu weeraruudhaan Yihudootaa fi gareewwan xixiqqaa biroo irratti duguuggaa sanyii raawwattetti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hitler is responsible for the deaths of millions of people, and he is considered one of the most evil men in history.
entries.translation: Hiitlar du'a namoota miliyoonaan lakkaa'amaniif itti gaafatamummaa kan qabu yoo ta'u, seenaa keessatti namoota hamoo ta'an keessaa isa angafaa ta'ee fudhatama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another famous dictator is Joseph Stalin.
entries.translation: Abbaan irree beekamaan kan biraa Jooseef Istaaliin jedhama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stalin was the leader of the Soviet Union from 1924 to 1953.
entries.translation: Istaaliinis bara 1924 A.L.Atii hanga 1953 A.L.Atti hogganaa Gamtaa Sooviyeetii ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Under his rule, the Soviet Union became a superpower, but it also experienced a great deal of repression and violence.
entries.translation: Bulchiinsa isaa jalattis, Gamtaan Sooviyeet humna guddaa qabaachuuttis dhuftee turte, haa ta'u iyyuu malee ukkaamsii fi jeequmsi guddaanis isaan mudate ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Millions of people were killed or imprisoned under Stalin's regime.
entries.translation: Sirna bulchiinsa Istaaliin jalatti namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman ajjeefamaniiru yookin immoo hidhamaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While Hitler and Stalin are two of the most infamous dictators in history, there have been many others who have committed atrocities.
entries.translation: Hiitlar fi Istaalin seenaa keessatti abbootii irree maqaa badaa qaban keessaa kan caqafaman yoo ta’u, bulchitoonni biroo hedduun gocha hammeenyaa raawwatan ni jiru. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm always congested and I can't seem to shake the cough.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Yeroo hunda dhiphacha waanan jiruuf qufaa kana ballessuu waanan danda'u natti hin fakkaatu. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It sounds like you might have a fungal infection.
entries.translation: Doktara: Infekshinii fangasii kan qabdu fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fungi are a type of microorganism that can cause a variety of diseases in humans.
entries.translation: Fangasiin gosa maayikiroo-orgaanizimii dhukkuboota adda addaa nama irratti fiduu danda'uudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can live in the environment, on our skin, and even in our bodies.
entries.translation: Isaanis naannoo keenya keessa, gogaa keenya irrattis, qaama keenya keessa illee jiraachuu nii danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: What kind of fungi could be causing my symptoms?
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Fangasii isa akkamiitu mallattoolee dhukkubaa kanaa natti fidaa jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: There are many different types of fungi that can cause infections in humans.
entries.translation: Doktara: Fangasoonni gosa adda addaa hedduun nama irratti dhukkuba fiduu danda'an nii jiru. ​
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most common include Aspergillus, Candida, and Cryptococcus.
entries.translation: Kanneen baay’inaan mul’atan keessaa muraasni Aspeergilas, kaandida, fi kiryptococcus dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fungi can enter the body through the nose or mouth and travel to the upper respiratory tract.
entries.translation: Fangasoonni kun karaa funyaanii yookiin afaaniin qaama keessa seenuudhaan gara ujummoo sirna hargansuu gubbaatti gahuu danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: How are these fungi treated?
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Fangasoonni kun akkamitti yaalamuu danda'u?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Fungal infections are treated with antifungal medications.
entries.translation: Doktara: Infeekshiniin fangasii qoricha farra fangasiitiin yaalama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of medication and the length of treatment will depend on the type of fungus causing the infection.
entries.translation: Gosti qorichaafi dheerinni wal’aansaa infeekshinchichaa gosa fangasii dhukkuba kana fide irratti hundaa’udhaan murtaa'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm glad to hear that there's a treatment for this. I'm tired of feeling so sick.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Wal'aanisi dhukkuba kanaa akka jiru dhagahuu kootti gammadeera. Akkasitti dhukkubsachuun kun baay'ee na nuffisiiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The declaration of Zambia's independence from Britain on October 24, 1964, was a momentous occasion in the country's history.
entries.translation: Zaambiyaan Waxabajjii 24, 1964 A.L.Atti Biriteen irraa walabummaa ishee labsuun seenaa biyyattii keessatti yeroo baay'ee murteessaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It marked the end of colonial rule and the beginning of a new era of self-determination.
entries.translation: Xumura bulchiinsa garbummaa fi jalqaba bara haaraa ofiin murteessuu kan agarsiisedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The road to independence was not easy, however.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u iyyuu malee, daandiin walabummaa salphaa hin turre.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambians had to fight for their freedom, and they faced many challenges along the way.
entries.translation: Lammiileen Zaambiyaa bilisummaa isaaniif falmuu qabu turan, karaa irrattis qormaanni hedduun isaan mudate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important figures in Zambia's independence struggle was Kenneth Kaunda.
entries.translation: Qabsoo walabummaa Zaambiyaa keessatti namoota barbaachisoo ta'an keessaa tokko Kennet Kaawundaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kaunda was a charismatic leader who mobilized the Zambian people to fight for their rights.
entries.translation: Kaawundaan hogganaa ayyaana guddaa qabuu yoo ta'u, ummatni Zaambiyaas mirga isaaf falmatuuf kan kakaasaa turedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was also a skilled diplomat who was able to negotiate a peaceful settlement with the British government.
entries.translation: Itti dabaluunis inni dippilomaata ogummaa qabuu fi mootummaa Ingilizii waliin waa'ee nagaa mari'achuu nama danda'e ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1964, Kaunda became the first president of Zambia.
entries.translation: Bara 1964 A.L.Atti Kaawundaan pirezidaantii Zaambiyaa isa jalqabaa ta'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ruled the country for 27 years, during which time he oversaw Zambia's transition from a colony to a modern independent nation.
entries.translation: Innis waggoota 27 aaf biyyattii kan bulche yoo ta'u, yeroo sanattis Zaambiyaan garbummaa irraa gara walabummaa ammayyaatti yeroo ceetu to'atera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kaunda was a strong advocate for pan-Africanism and played a leading role in the Organization of African Unity (OAU).
entries.translation: Kaawundaan leellisaa cimaa paan-Africanizimii kan ture yoo ta’u, Dhaabbata Tokkummaa Afrikaa (OAU) keessatti gahee adda-duree taphateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also helped to establish the Non-Aligned Movement, a group of countries that are not aligned with either the United States or the Soviet Union.
entries.translation: Akkasumas garee biyyoota hirmaannaa Ameerikaas ta’e kan Gamtaa Sooviyeet waliin hin hiriirre hundeessuuf gargaareera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia's independence was a major victory for the Zambian people.
entries.translation: Walabummaan Zaambiyaa ummata Zaambiyaaf injifannoo guddaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a dark and stormy night.
entries.translation: Halkanichi dukkanaa'aa fi bubbee cimaa kan qabu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The wind howled and the rain beat against the windowpanes.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Inside, a young woman sat by the fire, her face pale and her eyes filled with sadness.
entries.translation: Keessattis, dubarri tokko ibidda bira teessee, fuulli ishee diimatee fi ijji ishees gaddaan kan guutame ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had just lost her husband, and she didn't know how she would go on without him.
entries.translation: Abbaa warraa ishee reefu jalaa boqotee waan turees, isa malee akkamitti akka jiraattu hin beekne turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, a knock came at the door.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The woman opened it to find a stranger standing there.
entries.translation: Dubartiin sunis bantee nama haaraa tokko alatti dhaabatee argite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was tall and handsome, with kind eyes and a warm smile. "I'm sorry for your loss," he said. "I know how you're feeling.
entries.translation: Namichis dheeraa fi bareedaa, ija gara laafessaa fi kolfa hawwataa kan qabu. "Dhaba keef baay'ee gaddeera," jedhe. "Miirri akkamii akka sitti dhaga'amaa jiru nan beeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I lost my wife a few years ago." The woman invited the stranger in, and they talked for hours.
entries.translation: Waggoota muraasaan dura anis haadha manaa koo dhabeeera." Dubartittiinis namicha sana keessatti affeertee sa'aatii dheeraaf haasa'an.

entries.english: He told her about his life, and she told him about hers.
entries.translation: Inni waa'ee jireenya isaa isheetti hime, isheenis akkuma isaa waa'ee jireenya ishee itti himte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They laughed and cried together, and by the time the stranger left, the woman felt much better.
entries.translation: Isaanis waliin kolfaa fi bo'aa turan, yeroo namichi sun deemuttis dubartiin sun miirri gaariin isheetti dhagahame.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She realized that she wasn't alone in her grief.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were other people who understood what she was going through.
entries.translation: Namoonni biroo waan isheen keessa jirtu kan hubatanis ni jiru ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And even though her husband was gone, she still had a lot to be grateful for.
entries.translation: Abbaan manaashee lubbuudhaan kan hin jirre taʼus, waan itti galateeffattuu baayʼee qabdi turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had her health, her family, and her friends.
entries.translation: Fayyaa ishee, maatii ishee fi hiriyyoota ishee qabdi turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And she knew that she would get through this.
entries.translation: Kana keessa akka isheen darbitus nii beekte.

entries.english: The kids these days are so different from when we were young.

entries.english: They're more into technology and social media, and they don't seem to have as much of a sense of humor as we did.
entries.translation: Isaan caalaatti teeknooloojii fi miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti kan xiyyeefatan yoo ta'u, akka yeroo keenyas miira qoosaa waan qaban hin fakkaatu.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It won't always be easy, but it's important.
entries.translation: Yeroo hunda salphaa ta'uu dhiisuu danda'a, haa ta'uyyuu malee barbaachisaa dha.
