entries.english: Volcanic eruptions are a powerful and destructive force of nature.
entries.translation: Dhohinsi volkaanoo humna uumamaa cimaa ta'eefi humna balleessaa kan qabudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can cause widespread devastation, loss of life, and environmental upheaval.
entries.translation: Isaanis gaaga’ama bal’aa, darbuu lubbu namaa, fi jeequmsa naannoo fiduu ni danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While volcanic eruptions are often associated with danger, they can also be a source of beauty and wonder.
entries.translation: Dhohinsi volkaanoo yeroo baay’ee balaa sodaachisaa faana kan walqabatu ta’us, madda bareedinaa fi dinqiis ta’uu ni danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sight of a erupting volcano is a awe-inspiring sight, and the resulting lava flows can create stunning landscapes.
entries.translation: Yeroo volkaanoo dhoʼu arguun kan nama dinqisiisu yoo taʼu, dhangalaʼaan laavaa isarraa dhufus taa'umsa lafa dinqisiisaa ta'e uumuu dandaʼa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Volcanic eruptions are caused by the build-up of pressure beneath the Earth's surface.
entries.translation: Dhohinsi volkaanoo kan uumamu, idaa'ama dhiibbaan lafa jalatiini.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When this pressure becomes too great, the magma is forced up through the crust and erupts onto the surface.
entries.translation: Dhiibbaan kun garmalee yeroo guddatu, maagmaan humna guddaa ta'een kara gidduu lafaa kessaan ol ba’uudhaan gara gubbaatti ol dho’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The size and intensity of a volcanic eruption can vary greatly.
entries.translation: Guddinni fi ciminni dho’iinsa volkaanoo garaagarummaa baay’ee qabaachuu ni danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some eruptions are relatively small and localized, while others can be massive and have a devastating impact on entire regions.
entries.translation: Dhohinsi tokko tokko xixinnoo ta'anii iddo xiqqaatti kan argaman yoo ta’u, isaan kaan immoo hammaan guddatanii naannoo guutuu irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisuu danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most destructive volcanic eruptions can cause widespread ashfall, mudflows, and tsunamis.
entries.translation: Dhohinsi volkaanoo inni baay'ee barbadeessaa ta'e, bookka daaraa, dhangala'aa dhoqqee fi sunaamii fiduu dandaʼa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can also trigger earthquakes and landslides.
entries.translation: Akkasumas kirkira fi sigigaachuu lafaas kakaasuu ni danda’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the worst cases, volcanic eruptions can claim thousands of lives and cause billions of dollars in damage.
entries.translation: Yoo baay'ee hammaataa ta’ees, dho’iinsi volkaanoo lubbuu namoota kumaatamaan lakkaa’aman galaafachuuniifi miidhaa doolaara biliyoonaan lakkaa’amu geessisuu ni danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite the risks, volcanic eruptions are an important part of the Earth's geological processes.
entries.translation: Balaan jiraachuu malus, dhohinsi volkaanoo adeemsa ji'ooloojii lafaa keessatti qaama barbaachisaa ta'e dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They help to recycle the Earth's crust and create new landforms.
entries.translation: Isaanis gidduun lafaa akka irra deebiidhaan itti fayyadamuu fi bifa lafaa haaraa ta'e uumuuf gargaaru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also provide a home for a variety of plants and animals.
entries.translation: Biqiltootaa fi bineensota adda addaatiifis mana ni ta’u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The young engineer, Erica, was excited to start her new job at the automotive recruitment center.
entries.translation: Dargaggeen injinaraa Eeriikaa jedhamtu kun, wiirtuu qacarrii konkolaataa keessatti hojii haaraa jalqabuu isheetiin gammachuun guddaa ta'e itti dhagahameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She had always been fascinated by cars, and she was eager to learn more about the industry.
entries.translation: Yeroo hundumaa wanta konkolaataatiin kan hawwattamtu siʼa taatu, waaʼee indastirichaa caalaatti baruuf fedhii guddaa qabdi ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On her first day, Erica was greeted by her manager, who gave her a tour of the center.
entries.translation: Guyyaa jalqabaa Eerikaan hogganaa ishee wajjin kan walbarte yoo taʼu, innis giddugalicha ishee daawwachiiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Erica was amazed by the size of the facility, which was filled with rows of cars.
entries.translation: Eerikaan balʼina dhaabbatichaa isa konkolaattota tarreedhaan hiriiraniin guutamee ture baayʼee ajaa'ibsiifatte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She learned that the center was responsible for recruiting new employees for all of the major automakers in the area.
entries.translation: Giddugalichi oomishtoota konkolaataa gurguddoo naannoo sana jiran hundaaf hojjettoota haaraa qacaruudhaaf itti gaafatamummaa akka qabu baratte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Erica was assigned to a team that was working on recruiting engineers for a new electric vehicle project.
entries.translation: Eerikaan garee isaan pirojektii konkolaataa elektirikii haaraa hojjechuuf injinaroota qacaruudhaan hojjechaa turan keessatti ramadamte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was quickly up to speed on the project, and she was soon meeting with potential candidates.
entries.translation: Pirojekticha irrattis saffisa bareedaa kan qabdu waan ta'eef, utuu baayʼee hin turin namoota kaadhimamtootaa ta'an waliinis wal arguu jalqabdeeti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the candidates that Erica met was a young man named David.
entries.translation: Kaadhimamaa Eerikaan wal argite keessaa tokko dargaggeessa Deevid jedhamu ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: David had a degree in engineering from a top university, and he had a lot of experience working on electric vehicles.
entries.translation: Deevid yunivarsiitii olaanaa ta'e irraa digirii barnoota injinariingiitin kan argate yeroo taʼu, konkolaattota elektirikii hojjechuu irrattis muuxannoo guddaa qaba ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Erica was impressed by David's knowledge and skills, and she was confident that he would be a valuable asset to the team.
entries.translation: Eerikaan beekumsaa fi dandeettiin Deeviid qabu kan dinqisiifatte yoo taʼu, garee kanaafis gatii guddaa kan qabu akka taʼu ofitti amanamummaa ni qabdi turte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Erica eventually convinced David to join the project, and he was a huge success.
entries.translation: Eerikaan adeemsa keessa Deevid hojii kanarratti akka hirmaatu amansiistee, innis milkaaʼina guddaa argamiseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He helped the team to develop a new electric vehicle that was both efficient and affordable.
entries.translation: Innis konkolaataa elektirikii haaraa gahumsa qabanii fi gatii madaalawaa ta'een akka hojjetan isaan gargaareera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zimbabwe is a country in southern Africa.
entries.translation: Zimbaaween biyya kibba Afrikaa keessatti argamtudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is bordered by South Africa to the south, Botswana to the west, Mozambique to the east, and Zambia to the north.
entries.translation: Kibbaan Afrikaa Kibbaatin, karaa dhihaa Bootswaanaadhaan, bahaan immoo Moozaambiikiin, akkasumas karaa kaabaatiin immoo Zaambiyaa waliin daangeffamti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The capital and largest city is Harare.
entries.translation: Magaalaan guddooniinii bal'oon magaalaa Hararee dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zimbabwe has a long and complex history.
entries.translation: Zimbaaween seenaa dheeraa fi walxaxaa ta'e qabdi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The area was first inhabited by Bantu peoples in the 11th century.
entries.translation: Jalqabarratti naannoon kun ummattoota Baantuutiin jaarraa 11 ffaa keessa kan kessa kan dhuunfatame ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, the Ndebele people migrated to the area from South Africa.
entries.translation: Jaarraa 19 ffaa keessa ummanni Indibele Afrikaa Kibbaa irraa gara naannoo sanaatti godaane.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 1880s, the British colonized Zimbabwe and named it Southern Rhodesia.
entries.translation: Bara 1880 moota keessatti, Ingilizoonnis Zimbaawee koloneeffachuudhaan maqaa Roodeeshiyaa Kibbaa jedhu moggaasaniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1965, Southern Rhodesia declared independence from Britain as a white-minority-ruled state.
entries.translation: Bara 1965 tti Roodeshiyaan Kibbaa Biriteen irraa walabummaa ishee, akka mootummaa warra adii xiqqaa qabduutti labsite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The country was renamed Rhodesia in 1970.
entries.translation: Biyyattiinis bara 1970 A.L.Atti Roodeeshiyaa jedhamtee moggaafamte.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1979, a civil war broke out between the Rhodesian government and the Zimbabwe African National Liberation Army (ZANLA).
entries.translation: Bara 1979 A.L.Atti Roodeshiyaa fi Waraana Bilisummaa Biyyoolessaa Afrikaa Zimbaawee (ZANLA) gidduttii waraanni biyya keessaa ka’ee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war ended in 1980, when Rhodesia was granted independence as Zimbabwe.
entries.translation: Waraanni kun bara 1980 tti Roodeshiyaan akka Zimbaabuweetti walabummaa ishee yeroo argattutti xumurameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robert Mugabe became the first president of Zimbabwe.
entries.translation: Roobert Mugaabeenis pirezidaantii Zimbaabuwee isa jalqabaa ta'uudhaan muudaman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He was a controversial figure who was accused of human rights abuses and corruption.
entries.translation: Innis nama falmisiisaa dhiittaa mirga namoomaa fi malaammaltummaan himatamaa turedha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any pending transactions that you would like to complete, please do so before closing your account.

entries.english: Once your account is closed, we will not be able to process any further transactions.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please note that we may also be required to cancel pending transactions by law.
entries.translation: Hubadhaa, seeraanis kaffaltiin eegamaa jiru haquuniis kan nu irraa eegamu ta’uu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, if we are notified by a law enforcement agency that a pending transaction is related to illegal activity, we will be required to cancel the transaction.
entries.translation: Fakkenyaaf, kaffaltiin raawwatamaa jiru gochaa seeraan alaatiin kan walqabatu ta'uus isaa dhaabbata seera kabajchiisaniin kan nutti himame ta'ee, kaffaltii sana haquudhaaf nii dirqamna.

entries.english: If you have any questions about our account closure policy, please do not hesitate to contact us.
entries.translation: Waa'ee imaammata cufiinsa herregaa keenya irratti gaaffii kamiyyuu yoo qabaattan nu qunnamuudhaaf duubatti hin jedhinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will be happy to answer any questions you may have.

entries.english: In addition to canceling any pending transactions, we will also close your account and remove any of your personal information from our records.

entries.english: Answer: While your neighbor's symptoms do overlap with Yellow Fever, it's crucial to understand that self-diagnosing is dangerous, especially with a serious illness like Yellow Fever.

entries.english: Yellow fever is caused by the yellow fever virus, which is spread through the bite of an infected Aedes aegypti mosquito.

entries.english: These mosquitoes also transmit diseases like Zika and Dengue.

entries.english: Essentially, the only cause of Yellow Fever is infection with the yellow fever virus transmitted by the bite of an infected mosquito.
