entries.translation: Ollaankee xiyyeeffannoo fayyaa ogeessaa akka barbaadu yaadachiisuun murteessaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms could be from a number of other illnesses, some serious, and delaying proper diagnosis and treatment can have serious consequences.
entries.translation: Mallattooleen isaa kan dhukkuboota biroo ta'uu danda'a, kan baay'ee cimoo ta'an, qorannoo fi wal'aansa seera qabeessa harkifachiisuun wanta cimaa fidee dhufu ni qabaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills, headache and thinks she has Malaria and asks, Malaria is more common with people coming from Mozambique.
entries.translation: Gaaffii: Hirriyyaan dubaraa daree koo komii ho'a qaamaa, dhaamocha, dhukkubbii mataa qabdi akkasumas Busaa akka qabdu yaaddi akkasumas kana gaafatti, dhibeen busaa namoota Moozaambik irraa dhufaniif waan baramaadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So are you from there and how do you know you got it?
entries.translation: Kanaaf achii dhuftee akkasumas akkamitti akka si qabe barte?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: "I understand you're not feeling well and are worried about malaria.
entries.translation: Deebii: "Miirri gaariin akka sitti hin dhagahamnee akkasumas waa'ee dhibee busaa akka yaaddofte nan hubadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's definitely important to take symptoms like fever, chills, and headache seriously.
entries.translation: Mallattoolee kan akka ho'a qaanaa, dhaamocha, fi dhukkubbii mataa cimaa fudhachuun murteessaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, I can't diagnose you, and self-diagnosing can be risky.
entries.translation: Haa ta'u garuu, si qorachuu hin danda'u, ofiin of qorachuun balaa qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lots of illnesses share those symptoms.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for your question about where I'm from and my health, I’d prefer not to share personal details.
entries.translation: Gaaffii odeeffannoo dhuunfaa koo eessaa akkan dhufee fi fayyaa koo kan na gaafatteef, qooduu hin barbaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The most important thing right now is for you to see a doctor to figure out what's going on and get the right treatment.
entries.translation: Siif ammatti wanti baay'ee murteessaan maaltu adeemaa akka jiruu fi wal'aansa sirrii argachuuf doktara dubbisuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can run tests to determine if it’s malaria or something else and give you the best advice.
entries.translation: Busaa yookiin waan biraa murteessuuf qorannoo gaggeessuu dana'u akkasumas gorsa gaarii siif kennu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can be harmful, so please make an appointment as soon as possible."
entries.translation: Kunuunsa fayyaa seera qabeessa harkifachiisuun balaa qabaachuu danda'a, kanaaf hanga danda'ametti dafii beellama qabadhu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your classmate that it's crucial she doesn't self-treat and sees a doctor immediately for diagnosis and treatment.
entries.translation: Deebii: Ofiin of yaaluu akka hin qabnee fi hatattamaan doktara dubbisuun qorannoo fi wal'aansa gochuu akka qabdu hiriyyaa daree keetti himi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria can be serious, even fatal, if not treated promptly.
entries.translation: Yoo hatattamaan yaalamuu baate busaan hamaa ta'uu dana'a ajjeesuus danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suspecting malaria isn't the same as having a confirmed diagnosis.
entries.translation: Busaa shakkuun qorannoon mirkaneessuu waliin tokko miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once she has seen a doctor and if she is diagnosed with malaria and completes her prescribed medication, these are some precautions she can take to prevent recurrence:
entries.translation: Erga doktara dubbistee fi busaaf qoratamteen booda akkasumas qoricha ajajaneef xumurteen booda irra deebi'ee akka akka hin uumamne ittisuuf qophiiwwan dursaa kunooti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Continue preventative medication as prescribed: Her doctor may prescribe medication to be taken regularly during and after travel to malaria-endemic areas.
entries.translation: Qoricha ittisaa akka ajajametti itti fufi: Doktarri ishee naannoowwan busaa qabanitti yeroo imaltuu fi imala booda idileedhaan kan fudhatamu qoricha ajajuu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s crucial to adhere to the prescribed regimen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sleep under insecticide-treated mosquito nets (ITNs): Ensure the net is properly tucked in and has no holes.
entries.translation: Agoobara farra ilbiifaan cuuphame jala rafi (ITN): Agoobarichi sirriitti cuqqaalamuu fi qaawwi akka hin jiraanne mirakaneessi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wear long-sleeved clothing and long pants, especially during dawn and dusk: Mosquitoes are most active during these times.
entries.translation: Uffataa fi kofoo dheeraa uffadhaa, keessumaa ganamaa fi galgala: Yeroo kana bookeewwan baay'ee si'atoo dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use insect repellents containing DEET (diethyltoluamide), picaridin, or IR3535: Follow the instructions on the product label.
entries.translation: Ittisa ilbiisaa DEET (diitiltooluwaamidee), pikaaridiin, yookiin IR3535 qabu fayyadami: Qajeelfama golgaa oomishichaa irra jiru hordofi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider using mosquito coils or insecticide-treated vaporizers indoors.
entries.translation: Shiboo bookee fi hurkisiistuu farra ilbiisaa mana keessatti fayyadamuu yaali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eliminate mosquito breeding grounds around her home: This includes removing standing water from flower pots, buckets, and other containers.
entries.translation: Nannoo mana ishee bakka hormaata bookee haa dhabamsiistu: Kunis bishaan dhaabbatu huubboo habaaboo keessaa, guuboo fi kuusaa biroo balleessuu hammata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be aware of potential relapse symptoms and seek immediate medical attention if they occur: Even after treatment, malaria parasites can sometimes persist in the liver and cause a relapse.
entries.translation: Mallattoolee deebi'anii ka'uu danda'an hubachuu fi yoo uumaman hatattamaan xiyyeeffannoo fayyaa argachuu: Wal'aansa booda illee, baattoon busaa yeroo tokko tokko tiruu keessa turuun deebi'ee ka'uu uumuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, the most important first step is to encourage her to seek immediate medical attention.
entries.translation: Irra deebiin, tarkaanfiin jalqabaa akka isheen xiyyeeffannoo fayyaa hatattamaa argattu jajjabeessuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: What precautions should I take to prevent the spread of typhoid fever to others, particularly my household members or close contacts?
entries.translation: Gaaffii: Qophii dursaa taayifooyidiin namoota birootti akka hin babal'anne ittisuuf ani gochuu danda'u maal fa'i, addatti miseensota maatii koo fi namoota natti dhihoo jiraniif?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Typhoid fever is a serious bacterial infection that can spread easily to others through contaminated food and water or close contact.
entries.translation: Ho'i qaamaa taayifooyidii dhukkuba baakteeriyaa cimaa kana karaa nyaata fi bishaan faalamee namoota dhiyootti darbuu danda'u dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here's a breakdown of the precautions:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Handwashing: This is the single most important measure.
entries.translation: Harka dhiqachuu: Kun tarkaanfii baay'ee murteessaa isa qofaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thorough handwashing with soap and water, especially after using the toilet and before handling food, removes bacteria and prevents transmission.
entries.translation: Saamunaa fi bishaaniin harka dhiqachuun keessumaa erga mana fincaanii fayyadamanii booda fi nyaata qabuun dura baakteeriyaa dhabamsiisa akkasumas daddarbuu ittisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Disinfecting Contaminated Surfaces: Typhoid bacteria can survive on surfaces.
entries.translation: Dirrawwan Faalaman Farra Itti Dibuu: Baakteeriyaan taayifooyidii dirrawwan irra jiraachuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regularly disinfecting frequently touched surfaces like countertops, doorknobs, and bathroom fixtures with a household disinfectant helps prevent spread.
entries.translation: Dirrawwan irra deddeebiin tuqaman kan akka kaawonterii irra, qabannoo balbalaa, fi meeshaalee mana fincaanii idileedhaan farra itti dibuun tatamsa'uu ittisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Food Handling Precautions: Individuals with typhoid fever should not prepare or serve food for others while they are ill and for a period after recovery as determined by a healthcare professional.
entries.translation: Qophii Dursaa Qabinsa Nyaataa: Namni taayifooyidiin qabame yeroo dhukkubsachaa jiru fi hanga turtii damdamachuu ogeessa fayyaan murtaa'eetti namoota biroof nyaata hojjechuu fi dhiyeessuu hin qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid Sharing Personal Items: Sharing personal items like towels, utensils, and drinking glasses can spread the bacteria.
entries.translation: Wantoota Dhuunfaa Waliif Qooduu Dhiisuu: Wantoota dhuunfaa kan akka fooxaa, meeshaalee itti nyaatan, fuullee ittiin dhugan baakteeriyaa tatamsaasuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Each individual should use their own dedicated items.
entries.translation: Namni hunduu meeshaa kan ofii qofa fayyadamuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccination: Typhoid vaccines are available and can provide substantial protection against the disease.
entries.translation: Talaallii: Talaalliiwwan taayifooyidii ni jiru akkasumas eegumsa dhukkubichaa kennuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccination is recommended for travelers to areas where typhoid is common and for individuals with close contact with a typhoid carrier.
entries.translation: Talaalliin namoota gara taayifooyidiin baramaa itti ta'etti imalanii fi namoota baattoo taayifooyidii ta'an waliin qunnamtii qabaniif ni gorfama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Prompt Treatment: Getting prompt medical treatment with appropriate antibiotics helps shorten the duration of illness and reduces the risk of complications and spread to others.
entries.translation: Wal'aansa Hatattamaa: Wal'aansa fayyaa hatattamaa fi antiibaayootikii sirrii argachuun turtii dhukkubbii fi carraa walxaxxaa ta'uu fi namoota birootti darbuu ni hir'isa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's also crucial to complete the full course of antibiotics even if symptoms improve.
entries.translation: Mallattooleen yoo fooyya'anis antiibaayotikii guutummaatti xumuruun murteessaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: "It sounds pretty rough dealing with what you think is malaria multiple times.
entries.translation: Deebii: "Yeroo hedduu dhibee busaa jettee yaaddu waliin wallaansoo qabuun ulfaataa fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's definitely worth getting checked out by a doctor each time to confirm the diagnosis and get the right treatment, because recurring fevers can be a sign of other things too.
entries.translation: Wal'aansa mirkaneeffachuuf akkasumas yaala sirrii ta'e argachuuf yeroo kamittuu doktaraan ilaalamuun barbaachisaa dha, sababni isaas ho'i qaamaa mallattoo kanneen biroo ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating can sometimes mask the real problem.
entries.translation: Yaali ofiin taasifamu yeroo baay'ee rakkoo isa sirrii dhoksuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for prevention, there are a few things you can do, especially if you're in an area where malaria is common.
entries.translation: Addatti bakka dhibeen busaa itti baratamaa ta'e kan jiraattu yoo ta'e, ittisaaf akka ta'utti wantoota muraasa ati gochuu dandeessu ni jiraata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using mosquito nets, especially ones treated with insecticide, is really important.
entries.translation: Agoobara bookee busaa fayyadamuu, addatti kan farra ilbiisotaa qabu fayyadamuun baay'ee barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, wearing long sleeves and pants, particularly during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active, can help.
entries.translation: Dabalataan, uffata harka dheeraa fi kofoo uffachuun keessattuu ganamaa fi galgala yeroo bookeen busaa jirtutti ni fayyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also insect repellents containing DEET or picaridin that are effective.
entries.translation: Akkasumas farri ilbiisotaa bu'a qabeessa ta'an kan DEET ykn picardin qabu ni jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can assess your individual risk and make sure you're aware of any potential side effects."
entries.translation: Dhuunfaatti balaa maalii fiduu akka danda'u qorachuu danda'u akkasumas rakkoo cinaa inni fiduu danda'u akka ati beektu si taasisu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor he needs to see a doctor immediately to get a proper diagnosis and treatment.
entries.translation: Deebii: Yaalaa sirrii fi wal'aansa doktaraa hatattamaan argachuu akka qabu namicha ollaa keetti himi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rift Valley Fever can be serious, and self-treating is dangerous.
entries.translation: Dhukkubni Gandii baay'ee hamaa ta'uu danda'a akkasumas yaalli ofiin taasisamu balaafamaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While waiting for medical attention, he should take the following precautions to minimize the risk of spreading the disease (if it is indeed RVF):
entries.translation: Osoo yaala fayyaa eeggatuu, dhukkubni (beekamaadha Dhukkuba Gandii) kun akka hin daddarbinee ittisuuf of eeggannoo armaan gadii gochuu qaba:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention: This is paramount.
entries.translation: Bookeen isa ciniintu eeggachuu: Hunda caalaatti barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should use mosquito repellent containing DEET, picaridin, or IR3535 liberally.
entries.translation: Kanneen bookee ofirraa ari'aniif DEET, picaridin, ykn IR3535 qaban fayyadamuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should wear long sleeves, long pants, and socks whenever possible, especially during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active.
entries.translation: Yoo kan danda'amu ta'e keessattuu ganamaa fi galgala yeroo bookeen jirtutti uffata harka dheeraa, kofoo dheeraa akkasumas kaalsii godhachuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito netting around his bed would also be helpful.
entries.translation: Naannoo siree isaatti agoobara bookee fayyadamuunis ni fayyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eliminate standing water around his home where mosquitoes breed (e.g., flower pots, buckets, discarded tires).
entries.translation: Bishaan ciisaa naannoo manaa jiru kan bookeen irratti wal horuu dandeessu dhabamsiisuu (fakkeenyaaf qodaa habaaboo keessa dhaaban, qodaa bishaanii, goommaa itti fayadamame)
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Animal contact precautions: Avoid contact with any animals, especially livestock, that appear sick or are dead.
entries.translation: Of eeggannoo quunnamtii bineeldaa: Bineelda waliin wal quunnamuu dhiisuu, keessattu beeyladoota dhukkubsatan ykn du'an waliin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he must handle animals (e.g., he's a farmer), he should wear protective clothing, including gloves and a mask.
entries.translation: Yoo beeyladoota kana waliin kan hojjetu ta'e (fakkeenyaaf qotee bulaa yoo ta'e), uffata nama irraa ittisan kan akka guwaantii fi haguuggii afaanii fi funyaanii godhachuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should not slaughter any animals himself and should report any suspicious animal deaths to the local veterinary authorities.
entries.translation: Bineelda kamuu ofiin qaluu hin qabu akkasumas du'a bineeldaa shakke kamiyyuu gara abbootii taayitaa fayyaa beeyilada naannootti gabaasa gochuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Raw milk should not be consumed – it must be pasteurized.
entries.translation: Annaan osoo hin danfisin fayyadamuu dhiisuu - ho'ifamuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hygiene: Frequent handwashing with soap and water is crucial, especially after handling animals or animal products.
entries.translation: Qulqullina eeggachuu: Yeroo hundaa saamunaa fi bishaaniin harka dhiqachuu, keessattuu erga bineelda ykn oomisha bineeldaa waliin hojjetanii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid touching his eyes, nose, and mouth with unwashed hands.
entries.translation: Osoo harka hin dhiqatin ija, funyaanii fi afaan isaa tuquu dhiisuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should also practice good hygiene when coughing or sneezing, covering his mouth and nose with a tissue or his elbow.
entries.translation: Yeroo qufa'u ykn haxxifatu afaanii fi funyaan isaa erbee ykn ciqilee isaan haguuggachuun shaakala gaarii dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should avoid sharing personal items like towels, eating utensils, and drinking glasses.
entries.translation: Meeshaa dhuunfaa kanneen akka fooxaa, fal'aana nyaataa fi qodaa ittin dhugan nama biroof qooduu dhiisuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Isolation (to a reasonable extent): While complete isolation might not be necessary at this stage (before a diagnosis), he should limit close contact with others as much as possible until he sees a doctor.
entries.translation: Adda of baasuu (hanga barbaachisu): Sadarkaa kana irratti (osoo hin yaalamin) guutummaatti adda of baasuun hin barbaachisuu ta'a, osoo doktaraan hin ilaalamin hanga danda'ame namatti siquu irraa of qusachuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is particularly important for pregnant women, who are at higher risk of severe complications from RVF.
entries.translation: Addatti dubartii ulfaaf baay'ee murteessaa dha, kunis haalli isaanii dhukkuba Gandii kanaan walqabatee wal xaxaa ta'uu waan danda'uuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emphasize to your neighbor again that these are precautionary measures and do not replace the need to see a doctor immediately.
entries.translation: Tarkaanfiiwwan of eeggannoo kunneen nama ollaa keef irra deebi'uun ibsiifi haa ta'u malee hatattamaan doktaraan ilaalamuu bakka hin bu'uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A blood test is needed to confirm the diagnosis and appropriate treatment will be necessary.
entries.translation: Dhibee adda baasuuf qorannoon dhiigaa ni barbaachisa akkasumas yaalli sirriin barbaachisaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, if he suspects he has RVF, he needs to inform local health authorities so they can monitor the situation and take appropriate public health measures.
entries.translation: Akkasumas, dhukkuba Gandii qaba jedhee yoo shakke, abbaa taayitaa fayyaa naannoof odeeffannoo kennuu qaba kunis akka isaan haala isaa to'atanii fi tarkaanfii fayyaa hawaasaa fudhatan isaan taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While malaria is a possibility, especially with travel to a malaria-endemic region, several other illnesses can cause fever, chills, and headache.
entries.translation: Carraan dhibee busaa ta'uu jiraatus, keessattu naannoo dhibeen busaa keessatti babal'atetti garuu dhibeen biroo mallattoo ho'a qaamaa, dhaamocha fi dhukkubbii mataa qabaachuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Depending on where she traveled, some of the possibilities include:
entries.translation: Bakka isheen imalte irratti hundaa'uun dhibeewwan biroon kanneen akka:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other mosquito-borne illnesses: Dengue fever, Zika virus, Chikungunya virus, and West Nile virus all share similar symptoms with malaria.
entries.translation: Dhukkuboota biroo bookeen daddarbani: Dhukkubi Dengue, vaayirasii Zika, vaayirasii Chikungunya, fi vaayirasii Naayil Dhihaa dhibee busaa waliin mallattoolee wal fakkaataa qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Viral infections: Influenza, common cold, COVID-19, and other viral infections can cause these symptoms.
entries.translation: Dhukkuboota vaayirasii: Infiluweenzaa, qufaa, COVID-19 fi dhukkuboonni vaayirasii biroon mallattoolee kunneen agarsiisuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bacterial infections: Typhoid fever, urinary tract infections, and bacterial pneumonia can also present with fever, chills, and headache.
entries.translation: Dhukkuboota beekiteeriyaa: Dhibeen taayifooyidii, dhibeen ujummoo fincaanii fi nimooniyaan baakiteeriyaa mallattoolee ho'a qaamaa, dhaamocha fi dhukkubbii mataa ni qabaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tick-borne illnesses: Lyme disease, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, and other tick-borne illnesses can cause these symptoms, though headache is less prominent in some.
entries.translation: Dhukkuboota ilbiisa irraa dhufan: Dhukkuba silmii, Ho'a qaamaa tulluu dhagaa, fi dhukkuboonni ilbiisa irraa dhufan kanneen biroon mallattoolee kana fiduu danda'u, garuu mataa dhukkubbiin hedduu baramaa miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat stroke/heat exhaustion: If she was in a hot climate and exerted herself, this could be a cause.
entries.translation: Dhayicha ho'aa/ho'a garmalee: Yoo haala qilleensaa ho'aa keessa turte fi kan of dadhabsiiste ta'e, kun sababa ta'uu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other less common infections: Depending on the region of travel, things like leptospirosis or brucellosis could be considered, although these are less common.
entries.translation: Dhukkuboota baramoo hin taane kanneen biroo: Naannoo imalaa irratti hundaa'uun, wantoonni kanneen akka leptoospiroosis yookiin biruseloosis yaada keessa galuu danda'u, baramoo ta'uu baatanis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's crucial that she tell her doctor exactly where she traveled and what she did there (e.g., hiking, swimming in fresh water, eating street food).
entries.translation: Eessatti akka imaltee fi achitti maal akka goote (fakkeenyaaf bohaartii imala miillaa, bishaan daakuu, nyaata daandii irraa nyaachuu) doktara isheetti himuun baay'ee murteessaa dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This information will help the doctor narrow down the possibilities and order the appropriate tests.
entries.translation: Odeeffannoon kun doktarichi carraawwan jiran muraasa godhee akka ilaaluu fi qorannoowwan barbaachisoo ajajuuf kan gargaaru dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important she doesn't self-treat and seeks professional medical advice.
entries.translation: Of yaaluu dhiistee gorsa ogeessa fayyaa barbaaduun ni barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your friend to see a doctor immediately to get tested and treated if he does have malaria.
entries.translation: Deebii: Yoo dhibee busaa qabaate hatattamaan doktara bira adeemuun qoratamuu fi yaala argachuu akka qabu hiriyyaa keetti himi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's not something to mess around with.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As for his question about prevention, here's what you can tell him:
entries.translation: Gaaffii waa'ee ittisa isaa irratti gaafateef, wantoota ati itti himuu dandeessu:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria prevention is multi-pronged and depends heavily on where he's travelling, as different regions have different mosquito species and resistance patterns.
entries.translation: Ittisi dhibee busaa karaalee hedduu ta'uu danda'a keessumaa bakka itti imale irratti hundaa'a sababi isaa gosi sanyii busaa fi dandamannan bakkaa bakkatti garaa gari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should consult a travel health specialist or his doctor for personalized recommendations, but generally speaking, here are the key precautions:
entries.translation: Gorsoota dhuunfaaf ogeessa fayyaa imalaa yookiin doktara dhuunfaa isaa gorsa gaafachuu qaba, garuu dimshaashatti qophiiwwan dursaa ijoon kunooti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Qoricha farra dhibee busaa: Kun baay'ee murteessaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are several different types, and the best one for him will depend on his destination, medical history, and other factors.
entries.translation: Gosootni adda addaa ni jiru, isaaf filatamaan garuu bakka inni deemu, seenaa fayyaa, fi sababoota biroo irratti hundaa'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A doctor needs to prescribe this, and it's often taken before, during, and after the trip.
entries.translation: Doktarri kana ajajuu barbaachisa, imala dura, yeroo imalaa, fi imala booda fudhatama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito bite prevention: This is the cornerstone of malaria prevention and includes:
entries.translation: Ittisa ciniinnaa bookee: Kun ittisa dhibee busaa ijoo dha kan inni of keessatti haammatus:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Insect repellent: Use repellents containing DEET (20-50%), picaridin (20%), or IR3535 (20-30%).
entries.translation: Ittisa ilbiisaa: Ittisa DEET (20-50%), pikaariidin (20%), yookiin IR3535 (20-30%) of keessaa qabu fayyadamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Apply to exposed skin and clothing, following product instructions.
entries.translation: Qajeelfama fayyadamaa hordofuun gogaa fi uffata saaxilamaa ta'etti dibaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Long-sleeved clothing and pants: Wear loose, light-colored clothing that covers most of your body, especially during dawn and dusk when mosquitoes are most active.
entries.translation: Uffataa fi kofoo dheeraa: Uffata bal'aa, halluu ifaa hin taane qabu kan qaama keessa danuu haguugu uffadhaa, keessumaa galgalaa fi ganama yeroo bookeen baay'ee si'atoo ta'an.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Treat clothing with permethrin insecticide for added protection (don't apply directly to skin).
entries.translation: Eegumsa dabalataaf uffatatti farra ilbiisaa permiitiriin itti godhaa (kallattiidhaan gogaa irratti hin godhiinaa).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito nets: Sleep under insecticide-treated mosquito nets, ensuring they are properly tucked in and have no holes.
entries.translation: Agoobara bookee: Agoobara bookee farri ilbiisotaa itti godhame jala rafaa, sirriitti cuqqaalamuu fi qaawwi jiraachuu dhiisuu isaa mirkaneessaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito-proof accommodation: Stay in places with screened windows and doors, or use air conditioning to keep mosquitoes out.
entries.translation: Bakka aara galfi bookee hin seensisne: Bakka foddaawwanii fi balbala cufamaa keessa turaa yookiin bookeen akka baatuuf mijeessaa qilleensaa (air conditioning) fayyadamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consider mosquito coils or vaporizers if needed.
entries.translation: Yoo barbaachise shiboowwan bookee yookiin hurkisiistuu fayyadamuu yaalaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Environmental control: While this is more of a public health measure, being aware helps.
entries.translation: To'annoo naannoo: Kun irra caalaa tarkaanfii fayyaa hawaasaa ta'us beekuun ni gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Minimizing standing water around accommodations can reduce breeding grounds for mosquitoes.
entries.translation: Naannoo aara galfiitti bishaan ciisee jiru hir'isuun bakka wal hormaata bookee xiqqeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be aware of symptoms: Even with precautions, there's a small risk of contracting malaria.
entries.translation: Mallattoolee beekaa: Qophiin dursaa godhamus carraan dhibee busaan qabamuu xiqqaan jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Knowing the symptoms (fever, chills, sweats, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, nausea, vomiting) is crucial.
entries.translation: Mallattoolee (ho'a qaamaa, dhaamocha, dafqa, mataa dhukkubbii, dhukkubbii maashaa, dadhabbii, jibbisiisuu, ol deebisuu) beekuun murteessaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If he develops any of these during or after travel to a malaria-endemic area, he should seek medical attention immediately.
entries.translation: Yoo yeroo gara naannoo busaa qabuutti imale yookiin erga imalee booda mallattoolee kana qabaate hatattamaan xiyyeeffannoo ogeessa fayya barbaaduu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Early diagnosis and treatment are essential.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, emphasize to your friend that seeing a doctor right away is the most important step right now for his health.
entries.translation: Irra deebiin hiriyyaan kee hatattamaan doktara dubbisuun fayyaa isaaf tarkaanfii murteessaa akka ta'e hubachiisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These prevention tips are for future trips.
entries.translation: Gorsoonni ittisaa kun imala gara fuulduraafi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that since he suspects dengue fever, it's crucial he see a doctor immediately for proper diagnosis and management.
entries.translation: Deebii: Ollaa keetiin erga ho'a qaamaa dengue shakkee qorannoo fi to'annoo seera qabeessaaf hatattamaan doktara dubbisuun murteessaa akka ta'e itti himi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dengue can be dangerous, and complications can arise quickly.
entries.translation: Dengue balaafamaa ta'uu danda'a, hamminni isaas saffisaan eegaluu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Ofiin yaala ofii taasisuun balaa qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While waiting for his appointment, he should:
entries.translation: Osooma beellama isaa eeguu, kanneen kana gochuu qaba:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rest: This helps the body fight the infection.
entries.translation: Boqochuu: Kun qaamni akka dhukkuba morkatu gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to avoid strenuous activities.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hydrate: Drink plenty of fluids, like water, electrolyte solutions, or broths, to prevent dehydration, which is a common dengue complication.
entries.translation: Dhangala'aa fudhachuu: Balaa dengue beekamaa kan ta'e goginsa ittisuuf dhangala'aawwan muraasa kan akka bishaan, dhangala'oowwan elektiroolaayitii, yookiin shoorbaa dhugaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain Relief: He can take over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen (Tylenol) to manage fever and pain.
entries.translation: Furmaata dhukkubbii: Ho'a qaamaa fi dhukkubbii to'achuuf dhukkubbii kan furan kanneen akka asetaminoofen (Taayilenool) fudhachuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Absolutely avoid ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), aspirin, and naproxen (Aleve) as these can increase the risk of bleeding, a serious dengue complication.
entries.translation: Balaa dengue isa hamaa kan ta'e carraa dhiiguu waan guddisaniif gonkuma ibupiroofinii (Adviil, Mootriin), aspiriinii, fi naapirooksiin (Aleevee) fayyadamuu dhiisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If any of these occur, he should seek immediate medical attention, potentially going to the emergency room.
entries.translation: Kanneen kana keessaa tokko yoo uumame, xiyyeeffannoo fayyaa hatattamaa barbaaduu qaba, carraan kutaa balaa tasaa seenuus ni jiraata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mosquito Control: Even though he's already likely infected, he should prevent further mosquito bites to avoid spreading dengue to others.
entries.translation: To'annoo bookee: Qabamee kan jiru ta'us dengue gara nama biraatti tatamsa'uu ittisuuf ciniinnaa bookee dabalataa ittisuu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means using mosquito repellent, wearing long sleeves and pants, and sleeping under a mosquito net.
entries.translation: Kana jechuunis ittisa bookee fayyadamuu, uffataa fi kofoo dheeraa uffachuu, agoobara bookee jala ciisuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Emphasize again that he needs to see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Saffisa danda'ameen doktara qunnamuu akka qabu irra deebiin cimsii hubachiisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This advice is not a substitute for professional medical care.
entries.translation: Gorsi kun kunuunsa fayyaa ogummaa bakka hin bu'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: It's important to preface this by saying I am not a medical professional.
entries.translation: Deebii: Jalqaba irratti ogeessa fayyaa akka ani hin taane ibsuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your friend needs to see a doctor, not ask the internet, especially since she believes she has multiple diseases.
entries.translation: Hiriyyaan kee doktara qunnamuu qabdi, keessumaa dhukkuboota danuu akka qabdu waan amanteef intarneeta gaafachuu hin qabdu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-diagnosing zoonotic diseases is particularly dangerous as some can be serious if left untreated.
entries.translation: Dhukkuboota zuunootik ofiin qorachuun yoo osoo hin wal'aanamiin hafe balaa cimaa qabaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I can give some general information, but it should not be taken as medical advice.
entries.translation: Odeeffannoo waliigalaa muraasa siif kennuu nan danda'a, haa ta'u maleep akka gorsa fayyaatti fudhatamuu hin qabu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To answer her question properly, she needs to provide more information to a doctor.
entries.translation: Gaaffii ishee seera qabeessaan deebisuuf, odeeffannoo dabalataa doktaraaf dhiyeessuu qabdi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, some common zoonotic diseases and associated risk factors include:
entries.translation: Haa ta'uutii, dhukkumoonni zuunotik fi sababoonni balaa isaan wal qabatan beekamoon muraasni kanneen armaan gadiiti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Common Zoonotic Diseases & Associated Risk Factors:
entries.translation: Dhukkuboota Zuunotik fi Sababoota Balaa Isaan Walqatan Beekamoo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include spending time in wooded or grassy areas, having pets that go outdoors, and not performing regular tick checks.
entries.translation: Sababoonni balaa nannooo mukkeen baay'atan yookiin marga keessa yeroo dabarsuu, beelada manaa baatu qabaachuu, mirkaneessa ilbiisaa idilee gaggeessuu dhiisuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rocky Mountain spotted fever: Also tick-borne.
entries.translation: Ho'a qaamaa Dhagaa Tulluu: Kunis ilbiisaan dhufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Similar risk factors to Lyme disease.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Toxoplasmosis: Caused by a parasite often found in cat feces and undercooked meat.
entries.translation: Toksoopilaasmoosis: Yeroo baay'ee bobbaa hadurree keessatti argamu fi foon hin bilchaanne irraa dhufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pregnant women and individuals with weakened immune systems are at higher risk.
entries.translation: Dubartiin ulfaa fi namni sirni damdamannaan isaa dadhabaa ta'e balaa guddaa irra jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gardening and handling cat litter are risk factors.
entries.translation: Ooyiruu keessa hojjechuu fi balfi adurree sababoota balaati.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rabies: Transmitted through the bite of an infected animal (e.g., bats, raccoons, skunks).
entries.translation: Dhukkuba saree maraatuu: Karaa ciniinnaa bineelda dhukkubichaan qabameen (fkn. simbira halkanii, raakoonii sikuunii) darba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include contact with wildlife, especially if the animal is behaving strangely.
entries.translation: Sababoonni balaa bineensotaan wal qunnamuu hammata, keessumaa yoo bineeldichi amala keessummaa ta'e qabaate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Salmonella and Campylobacter: Bacterial infections often acquired through contact with contaminated food (especially poultry, eggs, and unpasteurized milk), reptiles, or contaminated water.
entries.translation: Salmooneellaa fi Kaampiilobaakteer: Dhukkuba baakteeriyaa karaa nyaata faalameen (keessumaa lukkuu, killee, fi aannan hin danfine), reppitaayiloota, fi bishaan faalame dhufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ringworm: A fungal infection that can be transmitted from animals (especially cats and dogs) to humans through direct contact.
entries.translation: Baarollee: Dhukkuba fangasii beelada irraa (keessumaa adurree fi saree) gara namaatti karaa tuttuqqii kallattii daddarba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Psittacosis (Parrot Fever): A bacterial infection spread by birds, particularly parrots, parakeets, and pigeons.
entries.translation: Sitaakoosis (Ho'a Qaamaa Paarootii): Dhukkuba baakteeriyaa simbirrootaan keessumaa paarootii, parakiitii, fi pigeewoon tatamsa'udha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include handling infected birds or inhaling dust from their droppings.
entries.translation: Sababoonni balaa simbirroota hubaman qabuu fi dhukkee kosii isaanii qilleensaan fudhachuu dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Leptospirosis: A bacterial infection spread through contact with the urine of infected animals (e.g., rodents, livestock).
entries.translation: Leeptospiroosisii: Dhukkuba baakteeriyaa karaa fincaan bineelda dhukkubsatee tuquun darbudha (fkn. hantuuta, lubbuu qabeeyyii).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Risk factors include exposure to contaminated water or soil.
entries.translation: Sababoonni balaa saaxilamummaa bishaanii fi biyyee faalamee dabalata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: General preventative measures for zoonotic diseases often include:
entries.translation: Tarkaanfiiwwan ittisaa dimshaashaa dhukkuboota zuunotik kanneen kana hammata:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Regular handwashing: Especially after handling animals, their food, or waste.
entries.translation: Yeroo yerootti harka dhiqachuu: Keessumaa bineeldota, nyaata isaanii, yookiin kosii isaanii erga tuqxanii booda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Safe food handling: Cook meat thoroughly, wash fruits and vegetables, and avoid unpasteurized dairy products.
entries.translation: Qabinsa nyaataa nagaa qabu: Foon bilcheessaa, kuduraaf muduraa miicaa, bu'aalee aannanii paaschoralaayizdii hin taane hin fayyadamiinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tick checks: After spending time outdoors, thoroughly check yourself, your children, and your pets for ticks.
entries.translation: Mirkaneessa ilbiisaa: Erga alatti yeroo dabarsitanii booda, ofii keessan, daa'ima keessan, fi beelata keessan ilbiisa akka qaban ilaalaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Of eeggannoo fi seera qabeessaan dhabamsiisaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Vaccinations: Vaccinate your pets against rabies and other diseases.
entries.translation: Talaalliiwwan: Beeladoota keessan talaalliiwwan farra dhukkuba saree maraatuu fi kanneen biroo kennaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are also human vaccines for some zoonotic diseases (e.g., rabies).
entries.translation: Talaalliiwwan dhukkuboota zuunotik namootaas jira (fkn. kan saree maraatuu).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pest control: Control rodent and insect populations in and around your home.
entries.translation: To'annoo ilbiisaa: Nannoo mana keessanii hoomaa hantuutaa fi ilbiisotaa to'adhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Avoid contact with wildlife: Do not handle or feed wild animals.
entries.translation: Bineensota waliin wal qunnamuu dhiisaa: Bineensota hin qabiinaa yookiin hin sooriinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be cautious around unfamiliar animals, especially those exhibiting unusual behavior.
entries.translation: Bineeldota baratamoo hin taane cinatti qalbiin socho'aa, keessumaa warreen amala idilee hin taane agarsiisan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Protective clothing: Wear long sleeves, pants, and closed-toe shoes in areas where ticks or other disease-carrying insects may be present.
entries.translation: Uffannaa ittisaa: Bakkeewwan ilbiisonni dhukkuba baatan jiraachuu danda'anitti uffata harka dheeraa, kofoo, fi kophee miilla haguugu uffadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Ittisa ilbiisaa DEET of keessaa qabu fayyadamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Again, this is not medical advice.
entries.translation: Irra deebiin, kun gorsa fayyaa miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your friend needs to consult a doctor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her concerns about having multiple zoonotic illnesses warrant professional medical evaluation.
entries.translation: Yaaddoon ishee waa'ee dhukkubbii zuunotik danuu qabaachuu sakatta'insa fayyaa akeeka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's possible her symptoms have a different underlying cause altogether.
entries.translation: Mallattooleen ishee walii wajjin sababa adda addaa qabaachuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Encourage her to seek medical attention as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Hanga danda'ametti wal'aansa fayyaa adda argattu jajjabeessiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Question: My female classmate complains of fever, chills and thinks she has Malaria and asks, What is the best way to treat malaria?
entries.translation: Gaaffii: Hiriyyaan daree koo komii ho'a qaamaa, dhaamocha fi busaan akka ishee qabate yaaddi akkasumas kana gaafatti, Malli gaarii itti busaan wal'aanamu maali?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: She needs to see a doctor immediately.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Malaria is a serious illness and requires a proper diagnosis and prescription medication.
entries.translation: Busaan dhukkuba hamaadha qorannoo seera qabeessaa fi ajaja qorichaa barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Self-treating can be dangerous and delay effective treatment, leading to complications.
entries.translation: Ofiin of wal'aanuun balaafamaa ta'uu mala akkasumas wal'aansa bu'aa qabeessa harkifataa taasisa, wal xaxaas taasisa
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her to go to a doctor or clinic as soon as possible to get tested and receive the appropriate care.
entries.translation: Qoratamuu fi kunuunsa barbaachisu argachuuf saffisa danda'ameen gara doktara yookiin kilinikaa akka deemtu isheetti himi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that he absolutely should not attempt to self-treat suspected onchocerciasis with over-the-counter supplements.
entries.translation: Deebii: Ollaan kee onkosershiyaasis shakkame wanta fudhatamuunn ofiin of wal'aanuu akka hin yaalle itti himaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are no over-the-counter supplements that prevent or treat river blindness.
entries.translation: Wanti jaaminsa lagaa ittisuu fi wal'aanuuf gargaaru hin jiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms (severe itching, blindness) are serious and warrant immediate medical attention from a qualified doctor.
entries.translation: Mallattooleen isaa (hooksisa cimaa, jaamummaa) waan ulfaataa fi doktara seera qabeessa irraa xiyyeeffannoo fayyaa akeekudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to be properly diagnosed and, if he does have onchocerciasis, receive the appropriate prescription medication.
entries.translation: Seera qabeessaan qoratamuu isa barbaachisa, yoo onkosershiyaasis qabaate, qoricha seera qabeessa ajajame fudhata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can lead to permanent vision loss and other serious complications.
entries.translation: Kunuunsa fayyaa harkifachiisuun dhaabbiidhaan agartuu dhabuu fi wanta walxaxaa biraatti geessuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: No, schistosomiasis is not a genetic disease and cannot be passed directly from parents to their children through genes.
entries.translation: Deebii: Lakki, istoosoomiyaasis dhukkuba qaccee miti akkasumas karaa qaccee maatii irraa gara daa'imaniitti hin darbu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a parasitic infection caused by flatworms called schistosomes.
entries.translation: Dhukkuba baattoo kan raammoo battee istoosoomes jedhamuun dhufudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You get it by coming into contact with contaminated freshwater where the parasite larvae live.
entries.translation: Bishaan faalamee fi baattoo laarvaan irra jiraatu tuquun si qabata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These larvae penetrate the skin and develop inside the body.
entries.translation: Laarvaan kun gogaa keessa darbuun qaama keessatti kan guddatu dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, while family members might be at higher risk if they share the same contaminated water source, it's due to shared environmental exposure, not inheritance.
entries.translation: Kanaaf, maatiin balaa cimaa irra kan ta'an yoo bishaan faalamaa waliin qooddatan, sababa saaxilamummaa wal fakkaataa qabaatan malee dhalootaan kan darbu miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should definitely see a doctor to get diagnosed and treated properly, as untreated schistosomiasis can lead to serious long-term health issues.
entries.translation: Qorannoo gaggeessuu fi seeraan wal'aanamuuf doktara qunnamuu qaba, istoosomiyaasis hin wal'aanamne rakkoo fayyaa yeroo dheeraa waan fiduuf.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Hi there. How can I help you today?"
entries.translation: Ogeessa qorichaa: "Akkam jirta? Har'a maal si gargaaru?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teenager: "Hey, I need a refill for my eye drops. It's for pink eye."
entries.translation: Dargaggeettii: "Akkam jirta, qoricha ija kiyyaa deebisee guuttachuu barbaadeen ture. Ija diimateefan barbaade."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Okay, no problem. Can I get your name and date of birth, please?"
entries.translation: Ogeessa qorichaa: "Tole, rakkoon hin jiru. Maqaa kee fi guyyaa dhalootaa kee natti himuu dandeessaa?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teenager: "It's Latifa Ziyat, and my birthday is August 15th, 2006."
entries.translation: Dargaggeettii: "Laxiifaa Ziyaat jedhama, guyyaan dhalootaa kiyya ammoo Hagayya 15, 2006 dha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Alright, let me check your file. Ah, I see the prescription here. It looks like you have one refill remaining. Is that correct?"
entries.translation: Ogeessa qorichaa: "Tole, faayila keen ilaala. Eeyyee, ajaja qorichaa asitti argeera. Akka asii natti mul'atutti marsaan tokko si hafa natti fakkaata. Sirriidhaa?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teenager: "Yeah, I think so. My doctor said I might need another bottle if it didn't clear up."
entries.translation: Dargaggeettii: "Eeyyee, akkas natti fakkaata. Dooktarri koo yoo si dhiisuu baate qaruuraa biraa si barbaachisuu danda'a naan jedheera."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Okay, great. I'll get that filled for you right away. It should just take a few minutes. Would you like to wait here or come back later?"
entries.translation: Ogeessa qorichaa: "Tole, gaariidha. Ammuma siifan qopheessa. Daqiiqaa muraasa qofa fudhata. Asumatti eegdamoo booda deebitee dhufta?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Sure thing. I'll call your name when it's ready."
entries.translation: Ogeessa qorichaa: "Rakkoon hin jiru. Yeroo qophaa'u maqaa kee nan waama."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pharmacist: "Here you go. Just make sure to use the drops exactly as prescribed, okay? And if you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to ask."
entries.translation: Ogeessa qorichaa: "Kunooti. Qoricha kana sirriitti akkuma ajajametti fayyadami, tole? Yoo gaaffii ykn yaaddoo qabaatte, gaafachuu hin sodaatin."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Good afternoon, thank you for calling TeleHealth Services. My name is Jennifer. How can I assist you today?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Akkam ooltan, Tajaajila Fayyaa Bilbilaaf bilbiluu keessaniif galatoomaa. Maqaan koo Janiifar jedhama. Maalin isin gargaara?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teenager: Hi Jennifer, I'm not feeling so great. I've been really tired and weak lately, and I'm not sure what to do.
entries.translation: Dargaggeessa: Akkam Janiifar, miirri gaariin natti dhaga'amaa hin jiru. Dhiheenya kana baay'ee dadhabbiin natti dhaga'am akkasumas humna na dhowwa, maal akkan godhus hin beeku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: I'm sorry to hear that you're not feeling well. Can you tell me a little more about your symptoms? When did you start feeling this way?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Waa'ee dhukkubsachuu kee dhaga'uu kootiif nan gadda. Waa'ee mallattoo keetii xiqqoo natti himuu dandeessaa? Yoom sitti dhaga'amuu jalqabe?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teenager: It's been a few days now. I just feel like I have no energy, even after a good night's sleep. And doing simple things like walking up the stairs feels like a huge effort.
entries.translation: Dargaggeessa: Amma guyyoota muraasa ta'eera. Erga hirriba gaarii rafee boodayyuu humna waan hin qabne natti fakkaata. Wantoota salphaa kan akka sadarkaa bahuun hojii guddaa natti ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: I see. Have you been experiencing any other symptoms, like fever, chills, or body aches?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Naaf gale. Mallattoolee biroo kan akka hoo’a qaamaa, qorraa, ykn dhukkubbii qaamaa qabdaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teenager: No, nothing like that. Just this overwhelming fatigue and weakness.
entries.translation: Dargaggeessa: Lakki, wanti akkasii hin jiru. Dadhabbii humnaa ol ta’e qofadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Okay. Have you made any changes to your diet or exercise routine recently?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Tole. Dhiheenya kana jijjiirama nyaataa ykn sochii qaamaa irratti gootee jirtaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teenager: Not really. I've been eating pretty much the same as always, and I haven't been exercising much lately because I've been so tired.
entries.translation: Dargaggeessa: Baay'ee miti. Akkuma yeroo kaanii nyaachaan jira, dhiheenya kana dadhabbii waan qabuuf sochii qaamaa hin hojjenne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teenager: Yes, please. That would be great.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Okay, one moment please while I connect you.
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Tole, hangan wal si quunnamsiisutti xiqqoo na eegi.

entries.english: 1. Order lumbar spine and right knee X-rays.
entries.translation: 1. Raajii lafee dugdaa gadii fi jilba mirgaa ajajuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Prescribe physical therapy for back and knee strengthening and flexibility exercises.
entries.translation: 2. Wal'aansa qaamaa (physical therapy) dugdaa fi jilba jabeessuu fi sochiif ajajuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. Discuss smoking cessation strategies and prescribe nicotine replacement therapy if interested.
entries.translation: 3. Tarsiimoo sigaaraa dhiisuu mari'achuu fi yoo fedhii qabaatan wal'aansa bakka bu'iinsa nikootinii ajajuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Provide dietary counseling and encourage healthier food choices on the road.
entries.translation: 4. Gorsa nyaataa kennuu fi filannoo nyaata fayya qabeessa ta'e karaa irra jiru jajjabeessuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 6. Follow up in 4 weeks to review X-ray results and monitor blood pressure.
entries.translation: 6. Torban 4 booda bu'aa raajii ilaaluu fi dhiibbaa dhiigaa hordofuuf deebi'anii dhufuu.

entries.english: Mrs. Vasseur peered over her glasses, her expression weary. "What kind of rash, Mr. Chitepo?" she asked, her voice devoid of any real interest.
entries.translation: Adde Vaaseri fuullee ijaa ishee irraan ilaalte, fuulli ishee dadhabbii kan agarsiisu ture. "Fincaan gubaa akkamii, Obbo Chiitepoo?" jettee gaafatte, sagalee ishee irraa fedhii akka hin qabne irraa beekama ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Chitepo hesitated, his face flushing crimson. He leaned in closer, lowering his voice to a whisper. "It's... um... diaper rash."
entries.translation: Obbo Chiitepoo ni shakke, fuulli isaa diimate. Itti siqee, sagalee isaa gara hasaasaatti gadi qabee. "Kun... um... fincaan gubaa uffata daa'immaniiti."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Chitepo nodded vigorously, his embarrassment deepening. "Yes, ma'am. It's... quite painful. I can barely walk."
entries.translation: Obbo Chiitepoo mataa oliif gadi sochoose, qaaniin isaa dabalaa dhufe. "Eeyyee, aadde. Kun... baay'ee nama dhukkubsa. Ani deemuu illee hin danda'u."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Vasseur sighed, shaking her head slightly. "Alright, Mr. Chitepo. Have a seat. The nurse practitioner will be with you shortly."
entries.translation: Adde Vaaseri hafuura baafatte, mataa ishee xiqqoo raaste. "Tole, Obbo Chiitepoo. Teessuma irra taa'aa. Ogeessi kilinikaa yeroo gabaabaa keessatti isin ilaala."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Neurologist:** Hello Mr. and Mrs. Bianchi. I've reviewed your daughter's recent seizure activity and I'd like to discuss starting a new medication.
entries.translation: **Ogeessa narvii:** Maatii Biyaanchii Akkam Jirtu. Sochii dhibee gaggabdoo intala keessanii isa dhiyoo ilaaleera, qoricha haaraa eegalchiisuu irrattis mari'achuun barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Mrs. Bianchi:** Is that really necessary? We're worried about how it might affect her learning and behavior.
entries.translation: **Aadde Biyaanchii:** Dhugumaan barbaachisaadhaa? Akkaataa barumsa ishee fi amala ishee irratti dhiibbaa geessisuu danda'u irratti yaaddoo qabna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Mr. Ncube:** So, what are the possible side effects we should be aware of?
entries.translation: **Obbo Enkuubee:** Egaa, miidhaan cinaa nu beekuu qabnu maal fa'i?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Mrs. Bianchi:** Will she be able to keep up in school?
entries.translation: **Aadde Biyaanchii:** Barnoota ishee itti fufuu ni dandeessii?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Mr. Ncube:** Is there anything we can do to help minimize these side effects?
entries.translation: **Obbo Enkuubee:** Miidhaa cinaa kana hir'isuuf wanti gochuu dandeenyu jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Mrs. Bianchi:** Thank you for explaining everything so clearly. We appreciate your guidance.
entries.translation: **Aadde Biyaanchii:** Waan hunda ifatti waan nuuf ibsitaniif galatoomaa. Qajeelfama keessan ni dinqisiifanna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Neurologist:** You're very welcome. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any further questions or concerns. We're in this together.
entries.translation: **Ogeessa narvii:** Rakkoo hin qabu. Yoo gaaffii yookiin yaaddoo dabalataa qabaattan nu qunnamuu irraa duubatti hin jedhinaa. Waliin taanee furmaata barbaanna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Welcome to your cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) session.
entries.translation: Baga nagaan gara tajaajila yaala sammuu (CBT) keessaniitti dhuftan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here's what we can do today:
