entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns. We're here to help you get the support you need.
entries.translation: Gaaffii ykn yaaddoo yoo qabaattan na beeksisaa. Deeggarsa isin barbaaddan akka argattan isin gargaaruuf ani qophiidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good afternoon, Mrs. Dlamini. I understand you're here for kidney function tests. What brings you in specifically for this today?
entries.translation: Dooktara: Akkam ooltan Aadde Dilaamiiniin. Ani akkan hubadhetti har'a asitti kan argamtan qorannaa kaleefidha. Addatti maaltu akka har'a asitti argamtan isin taasise?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Okay, that sounds simple enough. Are there any other tests?
entries.translation: Dhukkubsattuu: Tole, salphaa fakkaata. Qorannoowwan biroo jiruu laata?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: GFR? Is that a separate test?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: What if the tests show something is wrong?
entries.translation: Dhukkubsattuu: Yoo qorannoon rakkoo qabaachuu koo agarsiise hoo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: No, I think that covers it. Thank you for explaining everything so clearly.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsattuu: Lakki, waan hunda kan haguuge natti fakkaata. Waan hunda ifatti waan naaf ibsitaniif galatoomaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're welcome, Mrs. Dlamini. The nurse will be in shortly to draw your blood and collect the urine sample. Take care.
entries.translation: Dooktara: Rakkoo hin qabu Aadde Dilaamiinii. Narsiin dhiiga fudhachuufi fincaan fuudhuuf dhiyeenyatti ni dhufa. Nagaan turaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some instructions you can give your patient:
entries.translation: Qajeelfamni dhukkubsataa keetiif kennuu dandeessu tokko tokko kanneen armaan gadiiti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Start a daily routine and stick to it as much as possible. This can help provide structure and reduce confusion.
entries.translation: Yeroo hundumaa hojii guyyaa guyyaa keessanii eegalaa itti fufiinsaanis raawwadhaa. Kun caasaa hojii kennuu fi burjaaja’uu hir’isuuf gargaaruu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use a calendar or planner to keep track of appointments and important dates. Write everything down, even small tasks.
entries.translation: Beellamaa fi guyyoota barbaachisoo ta’an hordofuuf kaaleendarii ykn karoorsituu fayyadamaa. Waan hunda barreessaa, hojiiwwan xixiqqoo ta’an illee jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Break down large tasks into smaller, more manageable steps. This can make them feel less overwhelming.
entries.translation: Hojiiwwan gurguddoo gara tarkaanfiiwwan xixiqqoo fi salphaatti to’atamuu danda’anitti qoqqoodaa. Kunis akka humna keessanii ol hin taane isin gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Engage in regular mental exercises, like puzzles, crosswords, or reading. Keeping your brain active is important.
entries.translation: Shaakala sammuu idilee kanneen akka paazilii, jechoota qaxxaamuraa ykn dubbisuu irratti hirmaadhaa. Sammuu keessan si'eessuun barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Get plenty of rest and try to maintain a regular sleep schedule. Fatigue can worsen memory problems.
entries.translation: Boqonnaa gahaa fudhadhaa akkasumas sagantaa hirribaa idilee qabaachuuf yaalaa. Dadhabbiin rakkoolee yaadachuu hammeessuu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Continue taking your prescribed medications as directed. If you have any questions or concerns about your medications, please don't hesitate to ask.
entries.translation: Qoricha ajajame akka qajeelfameetti fudhachuu itti fufaa. Waa'ee qoricha keessanii gaaffii ykn yaaddoo yoo qabaattan, gaafachuu irraa duubatti hin jedhinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eat a healthy diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Proper nutrition is essential for brain health.
entries.translation: Nyaata fayya qabeessa kanneen akka kuduraa, muduraa fi midhaan dheedhii badhaadhe sooradhaa. Nyaanni sirrii fayyaa sammuutiif barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water throughout the day.
entries.translation: Guyyaa guutuu bishaan gahaa dhuguudhaan dhangala'aan qaama keessanii akka gadi hin buune eegaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reach out to friends and family for support. Social interaction is important for overall well-being.
entries.translation: Deeggarsa argachuuf maatii fi hiriyoota keessan qunnamaa. Walitti dhufeenyi hawaasummaa nageenya waliigalaatiif barbaachisaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you experience any sudden changes in your memory or cognitive function, or if you have any concerns, please contact us immediately or go to the nearest emergency room.
entries.translation: Yoo yaadannoo ykn dandeettii sammuu keessan irratti jijjiirama tasaa argitan, ykn yaaddoo kamiyyuu yoo qabaattan, battaluma sanatti nu qunnamaa ykn gara kutaa hatattamaa isinitti dhihoo jiru dhaqaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We'll schedule a follow-up appointment in two weeks to check on your progress. In the meantime, please don't hesitate to call if you have any questions.
entries.translation: Torban lama keessatti fooyya'iinsa keessan ilaaluuf beellama hordoffii ni qabanna. Hammasitti gaaffii yoo qabaattan bilbiluu irraa duubatti hin jedhinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   You'll need to fast (not eat or drink anything) for at least 6 hours before the procedure. Your doctor will give you specific instructions based on your individual needs.
entries.translation: * Yoo xiqqaate sa'aatii 6f soomuu qabda (waan tokko illee nyaachuu yookaan dhuguu hin qabdu). Ogeessi fayyaa keetii qajeelfama addaa fedhii dhuunfaa keetii irratti hundaa'e siif kenna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Let your doctor know about any medications you're taking, including over-the-counter drugs and supplements. You may need to stop taking some of them temporarily.
entries.translation: * Qoricha fudhachaa jirtu kamiyyuu, qoricha ajaja ogeessaa malee gurguramu dabalatee, ogeessa fayyaa kee beeksisi. Isaan keessaa tokko tokko yeroof addaan kutuu si barbaachisuu mala.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Arrange for someone to drive you home after the procedure, as you'll likely be sedated.
entries.translation: * Erga yaaliin baqaqsanii yaaluu raawwatamee booda akka si geejjibsiisuuf nama qopheeffadhu, sababiin isaas tarii qorichaan si raffisuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   You'll be given medication to help you relax and possibly fall asleep.
entries.translation: * Qorichi akka boqottuufi tarii akka raftu si gargaaru siif kennama.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   The doctor will insert a thin, flexible tube (endoscope) through your mouth and down your throat into your stomach.
entries.translation: * Ogeessi fayyaa ujummoo qalloo fi salphaatti dacha'u (endoscope) afaan keetiin gara qoonqoo keetti gadi buusuun gara garaacha keetti seensisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Using X-ray guidance, the stent will be placed in the narrowed area of your stomach to help keep it open.
entries.translation: * Qajeelfama raajii fayyadamuun, istentichi iddoo dhiphaa garaacha keetii keessa kaa'uun akka banamu gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   You'll stay in the recovery area for a short time until the sedation wears off.
entries.translation: * Hanga qorichi rafuu siif kenname dhiibbaan isaa badutti yeroo gabaabaaf bakka hagaggamaa turta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   You may experience some mild discomfort or a sore throat, which should improve within a few days.
entries.translation: * Dhukkubbiin xiqqoo yookaan madaan qoonqoo si quunnamuu danda'a, kunis guyyoota muraasa keessatti fooyya'uu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Follow your doctor's instructions regarding diet and activity. You'll likely start with a liquid diet and gradually progress to solid foods.
entries.translation: * Waa'ee nyaataa fi sochii qaamaa ilaalchisee qajeelfama ogeessa fayyaa keetii hordofi. Tarii nyaata dhangala'aa ta'een jalqabdee suuta suutaan gara nyaata jabaataatti darbuu dandeessa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   If you have severe pain, vomiting, fever, or difficulty swallowing.
entries.translation: * Yoo dhukkubbii cimaa, haqqisaa, hoo'a qaamaa yookaan liqimsuu dadhabuun si mudate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   If you notice any blood in your stool or vomit.
entries.translation: * Yoo dhiiga sagaraa yookaan haqqisa kee keessatti argite.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good afternoon, what brings you to the emergency department today?
entries.translation: Dookter: Akkam ooltan, maaltu har’a gara kutaa balaa hatattamaa isin fide?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I've been having chronic back pain for months now, and it's getting worse.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Ji'ootaaf dhukkubbiin dugdaa kroonikii narra tureera, ittuma hammaachaas dhufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand. Can you describe the pain for me?
entries.translation: Dookter: Naaf galeera. Dhukkubbichaa naaf ibsuu dandeessuu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's a dull ache in my lower back that radiates down my legs sometimes. It's been making it hard to sleep and work.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Dhukkubbii dugda koo jalaa kan yeroo tokko tokko miila kootti gadi darbuudha. Rafuu fi hojjechuun natti ulfaataa dhufeera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay, let's examine you and discuss your medical history to see what might be causing this.
entries.translation: Dookter: Tole, maaltu akka kana fiduu danda'u ilaaluuf isin qorree seenaa yaalaa keessan haa mari'annu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Good afternoon, I'm Dr. Aung. What brings you in today?"
entries.translation: Doktara: "Akkam ooltan, Ani Doktar Awungi jedhama. Har'a maaltu isin fide?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tarek Mahmoud: "I can't believe this is happening! I'm allergic to something I ate, but I have no idea what it is. My throat feels tight, and I'm starting to get hives all over."
entries.translation: Taarik Mahamuud: "Waan ta'aa jiru amanuu hin dandeenye! Waanin nyaadhe tokkoofin alarjii qaba, garuu maal akka ta'e hin beeku. Qoonqoon koo dhiphachaa jira, akkasumas dhagna koo guutuu irratti finniisa baasaa jira."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Okay, try to stay calm. Can you tell me what you ate for your last meal?"
entries.translation: Doktara: "Tole, tasgabbaa'uuf yaalaa. Nyaata keessan isa dhumaa irratti maal akka nyaattan natti himuu dandeessuu?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tarek Mahmoud: "I just had a sandwich from that new deli down the street. It had turkey, cheese, lettuce, and some kind of sauce on it. I've never had a reaction like this before!"
entries.translation: Taarik Mahamuud: "Mana nyaataa haaraa daandii gubbaa jiru irraa saandwiichii tokkoon nyaadhe. Lukkuu, chiizii, salaaxaa, fi sosii akaakuu tokko qaba ture. Kanaan dura gonkumaa alarjii akkasii qabaadhee hin beeku!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Do you know what kind of sauce it was?"
entries.translation: Doktara: "Sosii gosa akkamii akka ta'e beektuu?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tarek Mahmoud: "No, I don't remember. It was some kind of creamy sauce, maybe mayo based? But I eat mayo all the time with no problems."
entries.translation: Taarik Mahamuud: "Lakki, hin yaadadhu. Sosii kirimii fakkaatu ture, tarii kan meeyoo irraa hojjetame ta'innaa? Garuu ani yeroo hunda rakkoo malee meeyoo nan nyaadha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Allergies can be unpredictable like that. But don't worry, we'll get to the bottom of this and get you feeling better soon."
entries.translation: Doktara: "Alarjiin akkuma kana tilmaamuuf ulfaataa ta'uu danda'a. Garuu hin dhiphatinaa, waan kana hundee isaa bira geenyee dafnee isin fayyisna."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Meditation is like a tune-up for your mind. It helps you:
entries.translation: Mediteeshiniin akka sammuu kee qopheessuuti. Kunis kan si gargaaru:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stay Cool Under Pressure: Learn to manage stress and frustration in the moment, even in heavy traffic.
entries.translation: Dhiibbaa Damdamachuuf: Dhiphinaa fi aarii yeruma sana keessatti, sochii tiraafikaa cimaa keessatti illee to’achuu baradhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Improve Focus: Sharpen your concentration and awareness, making you a safer and more alert driver.
entries.translation: Xiyyeeffannoo Fooyyessuu: Xiyyeeffannoo fi hubannoo kee qaraa, konkolaachisaa of eeggannoo qabuu fi dammaqina qabu si taasisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Boost Well-being: Reduce anxiety, improve sleep, and feel generally calmer and happier.
entries.translation: Nagaa Dabaluu: Yaaddoo hir’isuu, hirriba fooyyessuu, fi waliigalaan tasgabbaa’aa fi gammadaa ta’uu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: How to Meditate (Even on Your Break):
entries.translation: Akkamitti Akka Mediteeshiniin Hojjetamu (Yeroo Boqonnaa Keetii Illee Yoo Ta'e):
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Find a Quiet Spot: Even a few minutes in your parked bus or a quiet corner can work.
entries.translation: Bakka Callisaa Barbaadi: Daqiiqaa muraasaaf illee yoo ta'e bakka baasiin kee dhaabbatetti yookaan bakka jeequmsi hin jirretti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Get Comfortable: Sit upright, close your eyes, and relax your shoulders.
entries.translation: Bakka Mijataa Taa'i: Ol jedhii taa’i, ija kee cufi, fi gateettii kee laaffisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Focus on Your Breath: Notice your breath going in and out. Don't try to change it, just observe.
entries.translation: Hafuura Kee Irratti Xiyyeeffadhu: Hafuurri kee ol galuu fi gadi ba’uu isaa hubadhu. Jijjiiruuf hin yaalin, callisiituma hordofi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When Your Mind Wanders (And It Will!): Gently bring your attention back to your breath. It's okay if your mind wanders, just gently guide it back.
entries.translation: Yeroo Sammuun Kee Jooru (Ni Joora!): Suuta jedhii xiyyeeffannoo kee gara hafuura keetti deebisi. Sammuun kee yoo joores rakkoo hin qabu, suuta jedhii deebisii qajeelchi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Start Small: Even 5 minutes a day can make a difference.
entries.translation: Xiqqoodhaan Eegali: Guyyaatti daqiiqaan 5 illee jijjiirama fiduu danda’a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Red Light Reset: Use red lights as a cue to take a few deep breaths and relax your grip on the wheel.
entries.translation: Deebisanii Sirreessuu Ibsaa Diimaa: Ibsaa diimaa akka mallattoo hafuura dheeraa fudhachuu fi qabannoo gommaa konkolaataa kee laaffisuutti fayyadami.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mindful Moments: Notice the sights and sounds around you without judgment.
entries.translation: Yeroowwan Yaada Qulqulluu: Wanta argituu fi dhageessu naannoo kee jiru osoo itti hin murteessin hubadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kindness Check: If a passenger is difficult, take a breath and remind yourself everyone has bad days.
entries.translation: Sakatta’insa Gaarummaa: Imaltoon yoo rakkisaa ta’e, hafuura fudhadhuutii namni kamuu guyyaa badaa akka qabaachuu danda'u of yaadachiisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember: Meditation is a practice, not a perfect performance. Be patient with yourself and enjoy the journey to a calmer mind!
entries.translation: Yaadadhu: Mediteeshiniin shaakaladha, raawwii guutuu miti. Ofii keetiif obsa qabaadhuu fi deemsa gara sammuu tasgabbaa’aatti godhamutti gammadi!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are Mr. Wong's TIA symptoms, Dr. Jeon:
entries.translation: Dr. Jeon, mallattooleen TIA Obbo Wong kunooti:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Alright, Mr. Varma, just breathe normally for me. I'm just going to check your blood pressure. Your doctor mentioned your potassium was a little high last time.
entries.translation: Narsii: Tole, Obbo Vaarmaa, akkuma yeroo kaanii hafuura baafachuun galchi. Dhiibbaa dhiiga kee qofaan safara. Dooktariin kee yeroo darbe pootaasiyeemiin kee xiqqoo ol ka'ee akka ture dubbatee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Varma: Yeah, Dr. Tekle said something about that. I've been trying to cut back on bananas, but honestly, I haven't been perfect.
entries.translation: Obbo Vaarmaa: Eeyyee, Dooktar Takleen waa'ee sanaa natti himee ture. Muuzii nyaachuu hir'isuuf yaalaa turus, dhugaa dubbachuuf garuu sirriitti hin milkoofne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Well, let's see where things stand today. It's good you're aware of it. Sometimes it just takes small adjustments.
entries.translation: Narsii: Tole, mee haalli isaa har'a maal akka fakkaatu haa ilaallu. Beekuu kee qofti gaariidha. Yeroo tokko tokko sirreeffama xiqqoo qofa barbaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Varma: I hope so. I really don't want to have to take any more medication.
entries.translation: Obbo Vaarmaa: Akkasan abdadha. Qoricha dabalataa fudhachuu hin barbaadu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Understandable. Dr. Tekle will go over your results with you shortly and discuss any next steps. For now, your blood pressure looks good, 124 over 82.
entries.translation: Narsii: Naaf gala. Dooktar Takleen bu'aa qorannoo keetii dhiheenyatti sitti himuudhaan tarkaanfiiwwan itti aanan irratti sii wajjin mari'ata. Ammaaf, dhiibbaan dhiiga keetii gaarii fakkaata, 124/82 dha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Varma: Oh, good. One less thing to worry about.
entries.translation: Obbo Vaarmaa: Ohoo, gaariidha. Wanti yaaddessu tokko hir'ateera jechuudha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Exactly. Just relax for a few minutes, and the doctor will be right in.
entries.translation: Narsii: Sirriidha. Daqiiqaa muraasaaf boqadhu, dooktarichi amma ni dhufa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Lim: Hey there, Somphou! It's good to hear your voice. How have you been? Still tearing it up on the soccer field?
entries.translation: Dr. Liim: Akkam jirta, Somphou! Sagalee kee dhaga'uun gaariidha. Akkam turte? Ammayyuu dirree kubbaa miilaa irratti taphachaa jirtaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Somphou: Hey Dr. Lim! Yeah, I'm doing okay. Still playing soccer, but I actually hurt my knee pretty bad at practice last week.
entries.translation: Somphou: Haay Dr. Liim! Eeyyee, nagaa kooti. Ammayyuu kubbaa taphachaan jira, garuu torban darbe shaakala irratti jilbi koo baay'ee miidhameera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Lim: Oh no, that's not good to hear. What happened?
entries.translation: Dr. Liim: Ooh, kun oduu gaarii miti. Maaltu uumame?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Somphou: I went for a tackle and my knee just twisted weird. It swelled up pretty quick and it's been really painful to walk on.
entries.translation: Somphou: Kubbaa irraa buusuuf yeroon yaalu jilbi koo na jallate. Battalumatti dhiita'e deemuufis baay'ee natti ulfaate.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Lim: Ouch, that sounds painful. Have you been icing it and resting?
entries.translation: Dr. Liim: Dhuguma, baay'ee kan nama dhukkubu fakkaata. Cabbii itti gootee boqonnaa fudhachaa jirtaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Somphou: Yeah, I've been doing that. But it's not really getting much better. My coach thinks I might have torn something and suggested I get a CT scan.
entries.translation: Somphou: Eeyyee, akkasuma godhaan ture. Garuu foyya'iinsa hin argisiisne. Leenjisaan koo wanti cite waan jiru fakkaata jedhee CT iskaan akkan ka'u natti hime.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Somphou: Oh, okay. I didn't know that. My coach just said CT scan, so I figured that's what I needed.
entries.translation: Somphou: Oo, tole. Isa hin beekun ture. Leenjisaan koo CT iskaan waan jedheef, kan na barbaachisu isa natti fakkaatee ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Somphou: That sounds good, Dr. Lim. Thanks for explaining things.
entries.translation: Somphou: Kun gaariidha, Dr. Liim. Waan naaf ibsiteef galatoomi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Lim: Of course! Let's get you back on the field as soon as possible. Call the office and set up a time to come see me.
entries.translation: Dr. Liim: Tole! Hanga danda'ametti dafnee gara dirreetti si deebisna. Bilbilaan beellama qabsiisiitii na waliin wal haa arginu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Somphou: Will do. Thanks again, Dr. Lim!
entries.translation: Somphou: Akkasuman godha. Ammas galatoomi, Dr. Liim!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Lim: You got it, Somphou. Talk soon!
entries.translation: Dr. Liim: Rakkoo hin qabu, Somphou. Wal-argina!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Have you ever experienced any dizziness or fainting spells?" Dr. Vane asked, his eyes fixed on the clipboard.
entries.translation: "Kanaan dura joojnoon ykn of wallaaluun si mudatee beekaa?" Dooktar Veen gaafate, iji isaa gabatee qabataa irratti xiyyeeffateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No," Solene replied, his voice barely a whisper.
entries.translation: "Lakki," Sooleeneen deebise, sagaleen isaa gumgummii qofa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Any history of heart problems or high blood pressure?"
entries.translation: "Seenaan rakkoo onnee ykn dhiibbaa dhiigaa ol'aanaa jiraa?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, Dr. Vane put down his pen and looked at Solene directly for the first time. "Everything seems to be in order, Mr. Balogun," he said, his voice still flat. "You've passed the physical."
entries.translation: Dhumarratti, Dooktar Veen biirii isaa kaa'ee yeroo jalqabaatiif kallattiin Sooleenee ilaale. "Wanti hundi sirrii fakkaata, Obbo Baalugun," jedhe, sagaleen isaa ammayyuu laafaa ture. "Qorannoo qaamaa darbiteetta."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Solene let out a sigh of relief, the tension draining from his body. "Thank you, Doctor," he said, standing up.
entries.translation: Sooleeneen hafuura baafate, dhiphinni qaama isaa keessaa ba'e. "Galatoomi, Dooktar," jedhe, ol ka'ee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Gil finally walked in, his face a mask of professional calm. "Good morning, Mrs. Wattana. Good morning, Mr. Putra," he greeted us, shaking our hands. "How are you feeling today, Maria?"
entries.translation: Dhumarrattis Dr. Giil dhufe, fuulli isaa tasgabbii ogummaa argisiisa. “Akkam bultan, Aadde Waataanaa. Akkam bultan, Obbo Puutraa,” jedhee nagaa nu gaafate harka nu fuudhe. “Maariyaa har’a akkam sitti dhagahamaa jira?”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "A little nervous, to be honest, Doctor," I admitted, my voice trembling slightly.
entries.translation: “Dhugaa dubbachuuf xiqqoo na sodaachiseera, Doktar,” jedheen itti hime, sagaleen koo xiqqoo hollachaa ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Maria, do you have any questions?" Dr. Gil asked, bringing me back to the present.
entries.translation: “Maariyaa, gaaffii qabdaa?” jedhee Dr. Gil na gaafatee, yaada koo keessaa na deebise.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Just one," I said, my voice stronger now. "Will I be able to eat my favorite foods again?"
entries.translation: “Tokko qofa,” jedheen, sagaleen koo amma cimeera. “Nyaatan jaalladhu deebi’ee nyaachuu nan danda’aa?”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Gil smiled. "Eventually, yes. But we'll start you off on a liquid diet and gradually introduce solid foods as you heal. It might take some time, but you'll get there."
entries.translation: Dr. Giil ni seeqe. “Yeroo booda, eeyyee. Garuu nyaata dhangala’aa irraa si jalqabsiisna, suuta suutaan nyaata jabaataa siif kennina akkuma fayyiteen. Yeroo fudhachuu danda’a, garuu achi ni geessa.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jing Sun: Doctor, I need a note for work. I've been missing days because of my mediation practice.
entries.translation: Jing Sun: Doktar, hojii irraa hafuu koof waraqaa ragaa na barbaachisa. Shaakala mediteeshinii kiyyaaf jecha guyyoota muraasa hojii irraa hafeen ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Dawit Girma: Meditation? You mean you've been missing work to meditate?
entries.translation: Dr. Daawit Girmaa: Mediteeshinii? Jechuun kee mediteeshiniif jecha hojii irraa hafaa turte jechuudhaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jing Sun: Yes, exactly. It's very important for my mental health. I've been feeling extremely stressed lately, and meditation is the only thing that helps.
entries.translation: Jing Sun: Eeyyee, sirriidha. Fayyaa sammuu kiyyaaf baayyee barbaachisaadha. Dhiyeenya kana dhiphinni sammuu natti baay'atee ture, yeroo akkasii mediteeshinii qofatu na gargaara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Dawit Girma: I understand that meditation can be helpful for stress, but missing work for it is not a valid medical reason.
entries.translation: Dr. Daawit Girmaa: Mediteeshiniin dhiphinaaf akka gargaaru naaf gala, garuu sababa kanaan hojii irraa hafuun sababa yaalii quubsaa miti.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jing Sun: But doctor, look at me! I'm shivering. My anxiety is through the roof. I can't function properly at work when I'm like this.
entries.translation: Jing Sun: Garuu dooktar, mee na ilaali! Hollachaan jira. Yaaddoon koo daangaa darbeera. Yeroon akkana ta'u hojii koo sirriitti hojjechuu hin danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Dawit Girma: I can write you a note recommending that you take some time off for stress management, but I cannot explicitly state that it is for meditation. Would that be acceptable?
entries.translation: Dr. Daawit Girmaa: Waraqaa dhiphina to'achuuf boqonnaa akka fudhattu gorsu siif barreessuu nan danda'a, garuu mediteeshiniif jecha akka ta'e ifatti barreessuu hin danda'u. Kun siif ta'aa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jing Sun: Yes, that would be perfect. Thank you, doctor. I really appreciate your understanding.
entries.translation: Jing Sun: Eeyyee, sun baayyee gaariidha. Galatoomi dooktar. Na hubachuu keetiif baayyeen si galateeffadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Dawit Girma: You're welcome, Jing. Just remember to take care of yourself and seek professional help if your anxiety persists.
entries.translation: Dr. Daawit Girmaa: Rakkoo hin qabu Jing. Of eeggachuu hin dagatin, yoo yaaddoon kee itti fufe gargaarsa ogeessaa gaafadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Elena Rodriguez: Good evening. I'm Dr. Gomis. What seems to be the trouble today?
entries.translation: Dr. Eleenaa Roodrigez: Akkam bulte. Ani Dr. Goomis. Rakkoon har'aa maali?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Agatha Thorne: It's my hands and feet, Doctor. They feel... strange. Like pins and needles, or sometimes they just go completely numb. It started a few days ago and hasn't gone away.
entries.translation: Aadde Agaataa Toorn: Harkaa fi miila kooti, Doktar. Miirri isaa... adda. Akka waan lilmoo fi piiniin waraannamanii, yookiin yeroo tokko tokko guutummaatti hadoodu. Guyyoota muraasa dura kan jalqabe yoo ta'u, hin badne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Gomis: I see. Can you tell me more about when this started? Did anything specific happen around that time?
entries.translation: Dr. Goomis: Eeyyee. Yoom akka jalqabe caalaatti natti himuu dandeessaa? Wanti addaa yeroo sana raawwatame jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Thorne: Not that I recall. I was just knitting, like I always do, and suddenly my fingers started tingling. Then it spread to my toes.
entries.translation: Aadde Toorn: Kanin yaadadhu hin jiru. Akka yeroo hunda godhutti uffata hodhaan ture, tasa qubbi koo ol na waraanuu jalqabe. Sana booda quba miila koo irra ga'e.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Gomis: Have you experienced any other symptoms? Dizziness, weakness, trouble with balance?
entries.translation: Dr. Goomis: Mallattoolee biraa argiteettaa? Lafti namaan naannawuu, dadhabina, madaallii eeguu dadhabuu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Thorne: Maybe a little unsteady on my feet sometimes, but I attributed that to my age. And my hands feel weaker, harder to grip things.
entries.translation: Aadde Toorn: Tarii yeroo tokko tokko miila kootiin hin dhaabbadhu, garuu kun umurii kootiin wal qabata jedheen yaada. Akkasumas harki koo dadhabaa, waa qabachuufis rakkisaa ta'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Gomis: Okay. Do you have any history of diabetes or other medical conditions?
entries.translation: Dr. Goomis: Tole. Seenaa dhukkuba sukkaaraa yookiin haala fayyaa kan biroo qabdaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Thorne: Yes, I've been managing type 2 diabetes for years now.
entries.translation: Aadde Toorn: Eeyyee, waggootaaf dhukkuba sukkaaraa gosa 2ffaa to'achaan ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Gomis: And how have your blood sugar levels been lately?
entries.translation: Dr. Goomis: Yeroo dhiyoo asitti sadarkaan sukkaara dhiiga keetii akkam ture?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Thorne: A bit up and down, to be honest. I haven't been as strict with my diet as I should be.
entries.translation: Aadde Toorn: Dhugaa dubbachuuf, xiqqoo ol ka'aa fi gadi bu'aa ture. Akka ta'uu qabutti nyaata koo hin to'anne.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Thorne: Oh dear. Is it serious?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Thorne: Thank you, Doctor. I appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Aadde Toorn: Galatoomi, Doktar. Gargaarsa keessaniif isinan galateeffadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Gomis: You're welcome, Mrs. Thorne. We'll get to the bottom of this. Just relax and let us take care of you.
entries.translation: Dr. Goomis: Rakkoo hin qabu, Aadde Toorn. Hundee isaa bira ni geenya. Hin yaadda'inaa, isin kunuunsina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Understanding Your Journey Back to Wellness
entries.translation: Adeemsa Gara Fayyaatti Deebi'uu Keessan Hubachuu
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, you are the expert on your own experience. Your voice matters. Please feel free to share any thoughts, questions, or doubts you may have. We are here to support you every step of the way.
entries.translation: Yaadadhaa, muuxannoo keessan irratti ogeessa ta'uu keessan. Sagaleen keessan iddoo qaba. Mee yaada, gaaffii ykn shakkii qabdan kamiyyuu bilisaan qoodaa. Nuti tarkaanfii hunda keessatti isin deeggaruuf qophiidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let's work together to find a way forward that feels right for you.
entries.translation: Mee karaa gara fuulduraa sirrii ta'e argachuuf waliin haa hojjennu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, here I am. Scared, overweight, facing a spinal cord tumor. But I'm also Marco Santini. And I'm not giving up without a fight. Not today. Not ever.
entries.translation: Kanaaf, kunooti ani asin jira. Sodaadheera, ulfaatinni koo dabaleera, xannacha dugugguruu dugdaa wajjin wal'aansoo qabaan jira. Garuu ani Maarkoo Saantiiniidha. Osoo hin qabsaa'in harka hin kennu. Har'a miti. Yoomiyyuu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Hello, this is Urgent Care Telehealth. My name is Ingrid. How can I help you today?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Akkam jirta, kun Kunuunsa Hatattamaa Telehealthti. Maqaan koo Ingiriid jedhama. Har'a akkamittan si gargaaruu danda'a?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: Hi Ingrid, my husband burned his hand while cooking. It's really red and blistering.
entries.translation: Bilbilaa: Haay Ingiriid, abbaan manaa koo wayita nyaata bilcheessu harkisaa gubate. Baay'ee diimateera akkasumas bishaan kuuseera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Okay, I understand. Can you tell me your name and your husband's name please?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Tole, naaf galeera. Maaloo maqaa kee fi kan abbaa manaa kee natti himuu dandeessaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: My name is Priya Patel and my husband is Rohan.
entries.translation: Bilbilaa: Maqaan koo Piriyyaa Paateel jedhama kan abbaa manaa koo immoo Roohaaniidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Thank you, Priya. Is Rohan in a lot of pain right now?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Galatoomi Piriyyaa. Roohaan amma dhukkubbii cimaa irra jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: Yes, he says it's really burning. He's right here next to me, pacing back and forth. He's really worried it might get infected.
entries.translation: Bilbilaa: Eeyyee, baay'ee na gubaa jira jedha. Asuma cinaa koo jira, oliif gadi deddeebi'aa jira. Inni dhukkubichi ni infeekshinii ta'a jedhee baay'ee yaadda'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: I understand your concern, Priya. Burns can be painful and scary. Let me ask you a few questions to assess the severity of the burn. How large is the burn area?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Yaaddoon kee naaf galeera Piriyyaa. Gubaan dhukkubbii qabaachuu fi kan nama sodaachisu ta'uu danda'a. Ulfina gubichaa madaaluuf gaaffilee muraasa sin gaafadha. Bal'inni bakka gubatee hangam ta'a?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: It's about the size of a quarter on the back of his hand.
entries.translation: Bilbilaa:  Ruubii duuba harka isaa ni ta'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Okay. And you mentioned blistering. Are the blisters open or closed?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Tole. Bishaan kuusuu isaa natti himteetta. Bakki bishaan kuuse duudaa moo urataadha?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: They are closed right now, but they look like they might pop.
entries.translation: Bilbilaa: Ammaaf duudaadha, garuu waan dhoohuuf jedhu fakkaata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Is the skin around the burn white or charred?
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Gogaan naannoo gubaa sanaa addaateera moo gurraacha'eera?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: No, it's just very red.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: Yes, please. That would be great. Rohan is really anxious about this.
entries.translation: Bilbilaa: Eeyyee, maaloo. Kun baay'ee gaariidha. Roohaan waa'ee kanaa baay'ee dhiphateera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: Of course. I can connect you with Dr. Elena Rodriguez right away. Please hold for just a moment while I transfer you.
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Eeyyee. Battalumatti Dr. Eleenaa Roodriigeez wajjin wal isin qunnamsiisuu nan danda'a. Yeroon garasitti isin dabarsutti maaloo daqiiqaa muraasa eegaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Caller: Thank you so much, Ingrid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Operator: You're welcome, Priya. Just a moment.
entries.translation: Ogeessa: Rakkoo hin qabu Piriyyaa. Daqiiqaa muraasa qofa eegaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ilunga: Yeah, yeah, just tell me what's going on. Is it my heart? Am I gonna die?
entries.translation: Obbo Ilungaa: Eeyyee, eeyyee, maal akka ta'e natti himi. Onnee koodhaa? Nan du'aa laata?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ilunga: Slightly elevated? What does that mean? Is it a heart attack or not? Just give it to me straight!
entries.translation: Obbo Ilungaa: Xiqqoo ol ka'eera? Maal jechuudha? Dhukkuba onnee moo miti? Ifatti natti himi!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ilunga: More tests? I've been poked and prodded enough already! Can't you just give me some pills and let me go home?
entries.translation: Obbo Ilungaa: Qorannoo dabalataa? Kanaan dura baay'ee waraannadheera! Qoricha muraasa naaf kennitanii gara manaa deemuu hin danda'uu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ilunga: Fine, fine. Just make it quick. I've got things to do, places to be.
entries.translation: Obbo Ilungaa: Tole, tole. Ariifachiisi qofa. Waanan hojjedhuu fi bakkan deemun qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medical Student: We'll do our best to expedite things, Mr. Ilunga. In the meantime, try to relax and take some deep breaths. Stress can sometimes worsen chest pain.
entries.translation: Barataa Yaalii: Hanga dandeenye ni ariifachiisna, Obbo Ilungaa. Hammasitti, tasgabbaa'uu fi hafuura dheeraa fudhachuu yaalaa. Dhiphinni yeroo tokko tokko dhukkubbii laphee hammeessuu danda'a.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Ilunga: Relax? You try relaxing when you think your heart's about to explode! But okay, okay. I'll try. Just get that doctor in here soon.
entries.translation: Obbo Ilungaa: Tasgabbaa'uu? Onneen keessan dho'uuf akka jiru yeroo yaaddan tasgabbaa'uuf yaalaa! Garuu tole, tole. Nan yaala. Dooktaricha dafee akka dhufu taasisi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Hello, this is the after-hours nurse line. My name is Rutendo. How can I help you?
entries.translation: Narsii: Haloo, kun sarara bilbilaa narsii sa'aatii hojiin alaati. Maqaan koo Rutendoodha. Maal isin gargaaru?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tourist: Hi Rutendo, this is John. I'm visiting from out of town and I have a question about power of attorney for healthcare.
entries.translation: Tuuristi: Hayyee Rutendoo, an Jooni. Ani magaalaa alaatii dhufeen daawwachaa jira, waa'ee aangoo bakka bu'ummaa eegumsa fayyaarratti gaaffiin qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Okay, John. What seems to be the concern?
entries.translation: Narsii: Tole, Joon. Dhimmi isaa maalidha?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tourist: Well, my wife is in the hospital and I need to make some decisions about her care, but I don't have power of attorney. Can I get it set up over the phone?
entries.translation: Tuuristi: Tole, haati warraa koo hospitaala jirti, waa'ee kunuunsa ishee murtoo tokko tokko murteessuu nan barbaada, garuu aangoo bakka bu'ummaa hin qabu. Bilbilaan sirreeffachuu nan danda'aa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tourist: Oh, I see. Is there anything else I can do in the meantime?
entries.translation: Tuuristi: Oo, naaf gale. Hanga sanatti wantin gochuu danda'u jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: You can speak with the hospital social worker or case manager. They may be able to provide you with information and resources regarding healthcare decision-making and legal options.
entries.translation: Narsii: Hojjetaa hawaasummaa hospitaalaa ykn gaggeessaa dhimmaa wajjin dubbachuu dandeessu. Isaan waa'ee murtoo eegumsa fayyaa fi filannoo seeraa irratti odeeffannoo fi qabeenya isiniif kennuu danda'u.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tourist: Okay, thank you for the information, Rutendo.
entries.translation: Tuuristi: Tole, odeeffannoo kanaaf galatoomi, Rutendoo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: You're welcome, John. Is there anything else I can help you with tonight?
entries.translation: Narsii: Homaa miti, Joon. Har'a galgala wanti biraa isin gargaaru jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tourist: No, that's all for now. Thank you.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: You're welcome. Take care. Goodbye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Kojo Adesanya. I see you're here about an insect bite. How have you been feeling since you noticed it?
entries.translation: Dooktara: Akkam jirtu Obbo Kojoo Addesaanyaa. Sababa ilbiisni isin ciniineef akka dhuftan argeera. Erga isin ciniinee kaasee maaltu isinitti dhaga'amaa jira?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Honestly, Doc, I'm a bit confused. I don't remember getting bitten, but it's been itching like crazy. And it looks weird, all red and swollen.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Dhugaa dubbachuuf Dooktar, xiqqoo na burjaajesse. Yoom akka na ciniine hin yaadadhu garuu, akka malee na hooksisa. Bifa isaas yoo ilaaltu diimateera, dhiita'eeras.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand that can be concerning, Mr. Adesanya. It's not uncommon to not feel the bite initially. Let's take a closer look. Can you show me where it is?
entries.translation: Dooktara: Yaaddessuu akka danda'u naaf gala Obbo Addesaanyaa. Jalqaba irratti ciniinnichi nama dhukkubuu dhabuun waanuma barameedha. Mee itti siqnee haa ilaallu. Eessa akka ta'e natti agarsiisuu dandeessaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Sure, it's right here on my arm. See how it's kind of raised?
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Eeyyee, harka koo irra asiidha. Akkamitti akka dhiita'e argitaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Yes, I see that. It does look a bit inflamed. Have you noticed any other symptoms, like fever or chills?
entries.translation: Dooktara: Eeyyee, nan arga. Xiqqoo waan dhiita'e fakkaata. Mallattoo biraa kan akka hoo'a qaamaa yookiin qorri isin qabuu isin irratti mul'ateeraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: No, just the itching and the redness. And maybe a little bit of throbbing pain.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Lakki, hookisoo fi diimachuusa qofa. Tarii xiqqoo dhukkubbii gara keessaan natti dhaga'amu qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Thanks, Doc. I appreciate you taking the time to listen. I was starting to worry it was something more serious.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Galatoomi Dooktar. Yeroo kee aarsaa gootee waan na dhageesseef galatoomi. Waan cimaa natti fakkaatee yaadda'aan ture.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Of course, Mr. Adesanya. We're here to help. And please, if you have any other questions or concerns, don't hesitate to ask.
entries.translation: Dooktara: Rakkoo hin qabu Obbo Addesaanyaa. Isin gargaaruuf as jirra. Ammas yoo gaaffii yookiin yaaddoo qabaattan, gaafachuu irraa duubatti hin jedhinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please tell me more about what you're experiencing. Are you feeling nauseous or vomiting? Do you have any other symptoms like dizziness, headache, or stomach pain?
entries.translation: Mee waan sitti dhaga’amaa jiru naaf ibsi. Ol ol si jechaa jira moo si balaqqamsiisaa jira? Mallattoowwan biroo kan akka mataa naanna’uu, mataa bowwuu, yookiin dhukkubbii garaa qabdaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Also, have you eaten anything unusual recently or been around anyone who's sick?
entries.translation: Akkasumas dhiheenya kana waan addaa nyaatteettaa yookiin nama dhukkubsataa wajjin turteettaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While we talk, I'll check your vital signs like your temperature, blood pressure, and heart rate. This will give us a better idea of your overall health.
entries.translation: Yeroo haasofnu, mallattoowwan ijoo kanneen akka ho’iinsa qaamaa, dhiibbaa dhiigaa, fi dhahannaa onnee kee nan ilaala. Kun waa’ee fayyaa kee walii galaa hubannoo fooyya’aa nuuf kenna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Try to relax and take deep breaths. We'll get to the bottom of this together.
entries.translation: Tasgabbaa’uuf yaali, akkasumas hafuura dheeraa baafadhu. Waliin taanee furmaata ni arganna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember, you are an active partner in your healthcare journey. Don't hesitate to ask questions, voice your concerns, and share your experiences. We're here to listen and support you every step of the way.
entries.translation: Adeemsa kunuunsa fayyaa keetii keessatti ati hirmaattuu ta'uu kee yaadadhu. Gaaffii gaafachuu, yaada kee ibsuu fi muuxannoo kee qooduu irraa duubatti hin jedhin. Nuti si dhaggeeffachuufi deeggaruuf qophiidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let's work together to get to the bottom of this and find a treatment plan that works for you. We're confident that with open communication and collaboration, we can help you feel better soon.
entries.translation: Rakkoo kana furuufi karoora yaalii siif hojjetu argachuuf waliin haa hojjennu. Qunnamtii ifa ta'ee fi walta'iinsaan, dafnee akka si gargaarru ni amanna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Take Sumatriptan 50mg orally as soon as you feel a headache coming on. You can repeat the dose once after 2 hours if needed, but do not exceed 200mg in 24 hours.
entries.translation: * Yeroo mataa bowwuun sitti dhagahamu Sumatriptan 50mg liqimsi. Yoo barbaachisaa ta'e sa'aatii 2 booda irra deebi'uun fudhachuu dandeessa, garuu sa'aatii 24 keessatti 200mg ol hin fudhatiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Continue taking Naproxen 500mg twice daily with food for pain relief.
entries.translation: * Dhukkubbii hir'isuuf Naproxen 500mg guyyaatti si'a lama nyaata wajjin fudhachuu itti fufi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Maintain a regular sleep schedule, aiming for 7-8 hours of sleep per night.
entries.translation: * Sagantaa hirribaa idilee qabaadhu, halkan tokkotti sa'aatii 7-8 rafuu yaali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Stay hydrated by drinking at least 8 glasses of water daily.
entries.translation: * Guyyaatti yoo xiqqaate bishaan burcuqqoo 8 dhuguun dhangala'aa qaama keetii eeggadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Identify and avoid any potential headache triggers, such as certain foods, stress, or bright lights.
entries.translation: * Waan mataa bowwuu fiduu danda'u adda baasuu fi irraa fagaachuu, kanneen akka nyaatawwan murtaa'oo, dhiphina, yookaan ifa garmalee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Practice relaxation techniques like deep breathing or meditation to manage stress.
entries.translation: * Dhiphina to'achuuf tooftaa boqonnaa kan akka hafuura dheeraa baafachuu yookaan mediteeshinii shaakalaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Keep a headache diary to track the frequency, severity, and duration of your headaches, as well as any potential triggers.
entries.translation: * Irra deddeebi'uu, cimaa ta'uu fi turuu mataa bowwuu keetii, akkasumas wantoota fidan hordofuuf yaadannoo mataa bowwuu qabadhu.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Monitor your blood pressure regularly and record the readings.
entries.translation: * Dhiibbaa dhiigaa keessan yeroo yeroon hordofaa, bu'aasaas galmeessaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Schedule a follow-up appointment in 4 weeks to discuss your progress and adjust the treatment plan if necessary.
entries.translation: * Fooyya'iinsa keessan mari'achuu fi yoo barbaachisaa ta'e karoora wal'aansaa sirreessuuf torban 4 booda beellama hordoffii qabadhaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * Contact our office immediately if you experience any severe or unusual symptoms, such as vision changes, weakness, or difficulty speaking.
entries.translation: * Mallattoolee cimaa yookaan addaa, kanneen akka jijjiirama agartuu, dadhabbii, yookaan dubbachuuf rakkachuu yoo argitan hatattamaan waajjira keenya qunnamaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns.
entries.translation: Yoo gaaffii yookaan yaaddoo qabaattan nu qunnamuu irraa duubatti hin jedhinaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hi Robert! Good to see you again, though not under the best circumstances I imagine. How's the family?
entries.translation: Doktora: Haay Roobert! Yeroo gaarii akka hin taaneen tilmaama ta'us ammas si arguun koo gaariidha. Maatiin akkam?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robert: Hi Dr. Matthews, they're doing alright, thanks. Just a little worried about me, naturally.
entries.translation: Roobert: Haloo Dr. Maatiwuus, isaan nagaadha, galatoomi. Waa'ee koo xiqqoo yaadda'aniiru.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Understandably so. I'm glad you came in, though. We want to get this sorted as quickly and safely as possible. So, tell me, how have you been feeling lately? Any new symptoms or changes?
entries.translation: Doktora: Hubatamadha. Ta'us garuu dhufuu keef gammadeera. Kana saffisaa fi nageenyaan sirreessuu barbaanna. Mee natti himi, dhiyeenya kana maaltu sitti dhaga'amaa jira? Mallattoon haaraan yookiin jijjiiramni jiraa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robert: Well, the back pain has been pretty constant, and I've noticed some numbness in my legs recently. It's making it hard to walk properly.
entries.translation: Roobert: Dhukkubbiin dugdaa irra deddeebi'ee natti dhaga'ama, dhiyeenya kana immoo miila koo irra dadhabbiin natti dhaga'amaa jira. Sirriitti akka hin deemne na godhaa jira.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robert: Just the usual, I guess. Risks, recovery time... will I be able to walk again?
entries.translation: Roobert: Waan barame qofa natti fakkaata. Balaawwan, yeroo bayyanachuu... sana booda deemuu nan danda'aa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Robert: That's good to hear. Thanks, Dr. Matthews. It means a lot having you here.
entries.translation: Roobert: Kana dhaga'uun gaariidha. Galatoomi, Dr. Maatiwuus. As jiraachuun keessan waan guddaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Of course, Robert. You've been my patient for years, you're practically family! Now, try to get some rest before the surgery. We'll be checking in on you regularly.
entries.translation: Doktora: Dhugaadha, Roobert. Waggootaaf dhukkubsataa koo turte, ati akka maatiiti! Amma, baqaqsanii yaaluu dura boqonnaa fudhachuu yaali. Yeroo yeroon si ilaalla.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reason for Visit: Scheduled Vaccinations for mRI-guided Biopsy
entries.translation: Sababa daawwannaa: Tallaallii Biopsy mRI-guided'f beellamame
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Abernathy: "What kind of tests, Doctor?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Saputra: "Is there anything we can do in the meantime? Anything to help her feel better?"
entries.translation: Obbo Saaputraa: "Hanga sanatti wanti nuti gochuu dandeenyu jiraa? Wanti miira gaarii akka isheetti dhaga'amu gargaaru?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mrs. Abernathy: "Thank you, Doctor. I appreciate your thoroughness."
entries.translation: Aadde Abernathy: "Galatoomi Doktor. Qorannoo gadi fageenyaan gochuu kee nan dinqisiifadha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Saputra: "Yes, thank you. We just want her back to her old self."
entries.translation: Obbo Saaputraa: "Eeyyee, galatoomi. Nuti kan barbaannu isheen fayyite akka duriitti akka deebitu qofa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "We'll do everything we can to make that happen. Now, let's get those tests scheduled and we'll meet again soon to discuss the results."
entries.translation: Dooktara: "Kana gochuuf wanta dandeenyu hunda ni goona. Amma qorannoo sanaaf beellama qabanna, sana booda bu'aa isaa irratti mari'achuuf dhiheenyatti wal argina."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Good morning, Mr. Said. How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Narsii: Akkam bulte, Obbo Saa'id. Har'a miira akkamiitu sitti dhagahamaa jira?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Oh, I'm fine. Just ready to get out of here.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Oh, fayyaa kooti. Asii bahuudhaaf qophaa'eera.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: That's understandable. We just need to schedule your follow-up appointment for the pulmonary function test before you leave. When would be a good time for you?
entries.translation: Narsii: Kun waanuma jirudha. Oso ati hin deemin dura qorannoo dandeettii sombaaf beellama hordoffii qabsiisuu qabna. Yeroo kamtu siif mijaata?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I... I'm not sure. My schedule is pretty open right now.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Ani... Ani hin beeku. Sagantaan koo yeroo ammaa banaadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: No problem at all. We can work around whatever time is best for you. Are mornings or afternoons usually better?
entries.translation: Narsii: Rakkoo hin qabu. Yeroo kamiyyuu siif mijatutti hojjechuu dandeenya. Ganama moo galgala siif wayya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Um, afternoons I guess. But, honestly, I'm not sure if I can make it. Things are a bit... tight right now.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Eeyyee, galgala wayya natti fakkaata. Garuu, dhugaa dubbachuuf, dhufuu danda'uu fi dhiisuu koo hin beeku. Wanti hunduu... yeroo ammaa xiqqoo dhiphataadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: I understand, Mr. Said. Sometimes unexpected things come up. Is there anything specific you're worried about? Maybe transportation or costs?
entries.translation: Narsii: Sin hubadha, Obbo Saa'id. Yeroo tokko tokko wantoonni hin eegamne ni uumamu. Wanti addatti si yaaddesse jiraa? Tarii geejjibaa ykn baasii?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Well, yeah. I lost my job recently, and insurance ran out. I don't know how I'm going to pay for another test, let alone get here without a car.
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Eeyyee, sirriidha. Hojii koo dhiheenyan dhabe, inshuraansiin koos dhumateera. Konkolaataa malee as ga'uun hafee qorannoo biraatiif akkamittiin akkan kaffalu hin beeku.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Really? They can help with that?
entries.translation: Dhukkubsataa: Dhugaadhaa? Isaan kana irratti nama gargaaruu danda'uu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: Absolutely. We want to make sure you get the care you need without added stress. Let's get that set up for you, okay?
entries.translation: Narsii: Eeyyee. Nuti tajaajila si barbaachisu dhiphina dabalataa malee akka argattu mirkaneessuu barbaanna. Kana siif haa mijeessinuu?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: That would be great. Thank you so much.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse: You're very welcome, Mr. Said. We're here to support you every step of the way.
entries.translation: Narsii: Rakkoo hin qabu, Obbo Saa'id. Nuti adeemsa hunda keessatti si deggeruuf qophiidha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Good morning, Mr. Win. It's good to see you again. How have things been since our last visit?"
entries.translation: Doktora: "Akkam bultan, Obbo Wiin. Ammas walarguun keenya gaariidha. Erga wal arginee booda maaltu jira?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Win: "Well, honestly, Doctor, it's been a bit stressful lately. I'm having some trouble making ends meet, and I'm worried about being able to afford my blood pressure medication this month."
entries.translation: Obbo Wiin: "Dhugaadha, Doktor, dhiheenya kana xiqqoo na dhiphiseera. Waan barbaachisu guuttachuuf rakkoo keessan jira, akkasumas baasii qoricha dhiibbaa dhiigaa koo kan ji'a kanaa danda'uu koo irratti yaaddoon qaba."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Win: "I haven't, actually. I wasn't sure if that was something I could do."
entries.translation: Obbo Wiin: "Ani hin ilaalle, dhugaadha. Waanan gochuu danda'u ta'uu isaa hin beeknen ture."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Win: "That would be incredibly helpful, Doctor. I didn't realize there were so many options."
entries.translation: Obbo Wiin: "Kun baay'ee kan gargaaruudha, Doktor. Filannoon hedduun akka jiran hin hubannen ture."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Win: "Thank you, Doctor. I really appreciate your help and understanding."
entries.translation: Obbo Wiin: "Galatoomaa, Doktor. Gargaarsaa fi hubannoo keessaniif guddaan isin galateeffadha."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "You're very welcome, Mr. Win. We're in this together. Now, let's take a look at your blood pressure and see how you're doing otherwise."
entries.translation: Doktora: "Galatoomaa, Obbo Wiin. Isin waliin jirra. Amma, dhiibbaa dhiigaa keessan haa ilaallu, akkasumas haala keessan kan biraa haa ilaallu."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Gara Dr. Bintou Cisse, ogeessa dhibee sombaa
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_om, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please feel free to contact me if you require any further information.
