entries.english: Ashenda is a unique religious and traditional festival celebrated every year in Tigray and Amhara Regional States between 16 to 21 August.
entries.translation: Ashendaan ayyaana addaa amantii fi aadaaa waggaa waggaan Mootummoota Naannoo Tigiraayii fi Amaaraa keessatti Hagayya 16 fi 21 gidduutti kabajamudha.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ashenda is a Tigrinya word meaning ‘’tall green grass that estimates around 80–90 centimeters minimum height.
entries.translation: Ashendaan jecha afaan Tigiriffaa hiikni isaa "marga magariisa dheeraa kan dheerinni isaa tilmaamaan yoo xiqqaate naannoo seentimeetira 80-90 tahuudha"
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In the tradition of this religious festival, blades of grass are strewn on the floors of homes and shops as a kind of welcome mat.
entries.translation: Aadaa ayyaana amantii kanaa keessatti, baalli margaa manneenii fi suuqiiwwan keessatti akka minxaafii simannaatti ni facaafama.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Unmarried girls and young women skillfully wove the grass into a bunch and wear them at their back while dancing on the occasion.
entries.translation: Durboonni hin heerumnee fi dubartoonni ijoolleen ogummaan margicha gurmuun dhahanii yeroo isaan qophicha irratti sirban duubaan isaan uwwisu.

entries.english: Abune Paulos, who died on August 16 at the age of 76 after an illness, was the patriarch of Ethiopia’s Orthodox Church since 1992, when he was elected to the highest order of the denomination.
entries.translation: Abuune Phaawuloos, kan gaafa Hagayya 16 umrii waggaa 76'tti dhukkubsatanii du'an, bara 1992 yeroo bakka olaanaa mana amantichaatti filataman irraa kaasuun patiriyaarkii Bataskaana Ortoodoksii Itoopiyaa turan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: His Holiness, Abune Paulos was also president of the World Council of Churches.

entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed called on Muslims to remember and practice the teachings of Prophet Muhammad while celebrating his birth.
entries.translation: Muummichi Ministeera Abiyyi Ahimed wayita ayyaana dhaloota isaa kabajanitti barsiisa Raajii Muhaammad akka yaadatanii fi hojiirra oolchan gaafatan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In a message he extended in connection to the celebration of the birth of the Prophet, Abiy called on Muslims to practice what the Prophet has taught while celebrating the festival known as Mawlid.
entries.translation: Ergaa kabaja ayyaana dhaloota Raajichaa irratti kennaniin, Abiyyi Musliimotni yeroo ayyaanicha isa Mawlid jedhamu kabajanitti wanta Raajichi barsiisaa ture akka hojiirraa oolchan gaafatan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Mawlid, the birth of the Prophet, is mainly celebrated with prayer, reading the Quran, singing spiritual songs that honor the Prophet, and offering food clothes to the poor.
entries.translation: Mawlid, dhalootni Raajichaa, irra jireessaan kadhataan, Quraana dubbisuun, faaruu hafuuraa isa Raajicha kabaju faarfachuun, akkasumas hiyyeessotaaf nyaataa fi uffata kennuun kabajama.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Abiy noted that the Prophet taught that the world need four pillars to survive – teaching of the wise, justice of the elderly, prayer of the good and courage.
entries.translation: Abiyyi barsiisa Raajichi isa addunyaan ooluuf utubaa afur - barsiisa beekaa, murtii/haqa jaarsaa, kadhata isa gaarii fi jabina ittiin rakkoo darban akka barbaaddu yaadachiise.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Religious fathers serving at Lailbela Rock-hewn churches appreciated the visit of French President Emanuel Macron and requested speedy renovation of the historical site.
entries.translation: Abbootiin amantii bataskaanota Rook-hewaan Laallibalaatti tajaajilan daawwannaa Pirasdaantii Faransaay Imaanu'eel Maakiroon jajuun bakkeen seena qabeessichi akka ariitiin haareffamu gaafatan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: After visiting the Lalibel Rock-hewn churches on Tuesday, President Macron had pledged to give technical and financial support for the renovation of the churches.
entries.translation: Pirasdaant Maakiroon, gaafa Kibxataa bataskaanota Rook-hewaan Laallibalaa erga daawwatanii booda, bataskaanota sana haaressuuf deggersa teekinikaa fi faayinaansii akka kennan waadaa galan.

entries.english: Some religious fathers who attended the welcoming ceremony for the president told ENA that urgent restoration is needed for the churches which are severely damaged.
entries.translation: Abbootiin amantaa tokko tokko kanneen sagantaa simannaa pirasdaantichaaf qophaa'e hirmaatan bataskaanota akka malee miidhamaniif haara'umsi atattamaa akka barbaachisu ENA'tti himan.

entries.english: The newly established Japan-Korea-Ethiopia Friendship Association held a concert in Tokyo, Japan, with the view to strengthening the people-to-people relationship among the countries.

entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to a statement from the Ethiopian Embassy in Tokyo, he also called on members of the association to visit Ethiopia and explore the vast tourism and investment potentials of the country.
entries.translation: Akka ibsa Imbasii Itoopiyaa Tookiyoo keessaatti, inni miseensotni waldichaa akka Itoopiyaa daawwatanii fi dandeettii tuurizimii fi inveestimentii biyyattii akka ilaalan waamicha godhe.

entries.english: French National Order of Arts and Letters was bestowed upon the celebrated Ethiopian musician, Mulatu Astatke, today for his distinguished contributions.

entries.english: French Culture Minister, Franck Riester said during the award giving ceremony that Mulatu has uplifted music to another level by combining Ethiopian and another melodies.

entries.english: “His innovative contribution to music, particularly jazz, has earned him a global prestige,” he added.

entries.english: Six delegates representing Ethiopia have finalized preparations to partake in the Cannes film festival including model and actress, Gelila Bekele as well as Film producer Mehret Mandefro.

entries.english: Upon returning from Cannes, Tourism Ethiopia will establish a local working group to study the potential of the film industry market as a site for international co-production beyond job creation, she pointed out.

entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The working group will also produce a case study report that lay out the business for targeting the film industry as a job creation sector, she indicated.

entries.english: This is the second installment of African Film Week, the first launched in 2016 with the African Union Culture Department.

entries.english: The Film Week hopes to bring African countries closer by showcasing each other’s works, forming a shared experience and creating opportunities for storytellers.

entries.english: Leul Shoaferaw, local filmmaker and founder of Eerie Productions Inc., states the week is a tremendous platform to introduce the best of African films to the Ethiopian audience and filmmakers.

entries.english: At this concert Lij Michael will be featured with Michael Belayneh.
entries.translation: Konsertii kana irratti Lij Mikaa'el, Mikaa'el Belaayinee wajjin dhiayaata.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Organized by Yorka event organizer this concert is entitled “Addis Concert”.
entries.translation: Qindeessituu taatee Yorkaan kan qindaa'e konsertiin kun "Addis Konsert" jedhamee mogga'e.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: This concert focused on having a mini festival in introducing the best album, best singles and also best DJs in the country.
entries.translation: Konsertiin kun festivaala xiqqaa biyyattii keessatti albemii baayyee gaarii tahe, qeenxeewwan bareedoo fi DJ wwan baayyee gaarii tahan beeksisu qabaachuu irratti xiyyeeffate.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: They chose Lij Michael as their debut concert since his album entitled “Zare Yihun Nege” was well accepted among fans.
entries.translation: Isaan albemiin isaa "Zaaree Yihun Nagee" jedhamu hordoftoota biratti akka gaariitti waan fudhatameef Lij Mikaa'eliin akka ijoo konsertii isaaniitti filatan
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Especially his single “Zemenay Marye” was able to capture audience ears easily.
entries.translation: Keessumaa qeenxeen isaa "Zemenaay Maariyyee" salphumatti dhageettii hordoftootaa argachuu danda'eera.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Mihret Dawit’s clay works exhibition was presented on April 21 at Asni Gallery.
entries.translation: Agarsiisni hojii suphee Mihret Daawwit gaafa Ebla 21 Gaalerii Asniitti dhiyaateera.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The versatile artist who is highly drawn about three dimensional forms has been initially experimenting with materials such as gypsum and cement to create sculptures.
entries.translation: Artistiin versataayilii kan waa'ee bocawwan daayimeenshinii sadiin hedduminaan kaasu duratti bocawwan uumuuf meeshaalee akka jiipsamii fi simmintoon shaakalaa tureera.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Later she moved on to recycled paper, cardboards and bottles.
entries.translation: Boodarra isheen gara waraqaa, kaartoonii fi burcuqqoolee deebiftee haaressuutti deemte.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Situated at the Gullele Botanic Gardens, the festival features a wide range of activities for first-time campers, festival goers or seasoned outdoor enthusiasts.
entries.translation: Gaardenii Bootanikii Gulalleetti kan geggeeffame, festivaalichi hojiilee adda addaa baayyee kan dunkaana keessa buufatan jalqabaa, festivaala kan deemanii fi namoota bakkee deemuu jaallataniif dhiyeesse.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: This monthly Paugmé Shir-shir event usually involves two days spent venturing off into the surrounding hillsides for various outdoor adventures and one night spent camping under the stars.
entries.translation: Qophiin Shirr-shirriin Paagumee ji'a kanaa bashannana adda addaaf tulluuwwan naannoo jiran jala guyyaa lamaaf deemaa akkasumas guyyaa tokko urjiiwwan jala dunkaana keessa bulama.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: March 2018 was a big year for circus in Ethiopia as the second edition of the African Circus Arts Festival came to town.
entries.translation: Bitootessi 2018 akkuma qophii lammaffaan Feestivaala Aartii Sarkasii Afirikaa gara magaalatti dhufeen sarkasii Itoopiyaa keessaaf waggaa guddaa ture.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Thousands gathered to attend the spectacle.
entries.translation: Agarsiisicha hordofuuf namoonni kumaan lakka'aman walitti qabamanii turan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: 11 circus troupes from across the continent joined the festival to showcase their works.
entries.translation: Gareen sarkasii 11 guutuummaa ardichaa irraa hojii isaanii agarsiisuuf festivaalicha irratti hirmaataniiru.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Inside the largest circus tent to ever be erected in the country, the lights dimmed to welcome the South African troupe Zip Zap.
entries.translation: Dunkaana sarkasii guddicha biyyattii keessatti dhaabachuuf deemu keessatti, ibsaan garee weellistoota Afrikaa Kibbaa Zip Zaap simatu dimimmisaa'e.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Ethiopian Muslims all over the country are celebrating the Al Maulid Al nabawi or Prophet Mohammed’s Birthday with various religious events.
entries.translation: Musliimonni Itoopiyaa guutummaa biyyaattii keessa jiraatan ayyaana Al Mawulid Al nabaawi yookaan Guyyaa dhaloota Raajii Mohaammed qophiilee amantii garagaraan kabajani.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: In the capital, Addis Ababa, the Muslim Community celebrated Al Maulid Al Nabawi at the Grand Mosque with prayers and spiritual events commemorating the birth of Prophet Mohammed.
entries.translation: Magaala guddoo,Addis Ababaa keessatti, Hawaasni Musliimaa Al Mawulid Al Nabawi Masjiida Guddaa keessatti kadhannaa fi qophiilee hafuuraatiin dhaloota Raajii Mohaammed yaadachuun kabajan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Jimma, Hawassa and Dessie towns have also witnessed colorful celebration of the Eid al-Adha festival with both outdoor and indoor religious events.
entries.translation: Magaalonni Jimmaa, Hawaasaa fi Dasseenis kabaja feestivaala Iid al-Adha qophiilee amantii mana keessaa fi alaa lamaaniin bifa hawwataan kabajamuu ragaa bahu.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Eid al-Adha is the feast of obedience and sacrifice that remembers the willingness of Prophet Ibrahim to sacrifice his son Ibrahim based on a call from God (Allah).
entries.translation: Iid al-Adha dhangaa abboomamuu fi wareegamuu isa Raajiin Ibiraahim ilma isaa Ibraahimiin waamicha Waaqaa (Allaa) irratti hundaa'uun wareeguuf fedhii agarsiise yaadachuufi.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: The Ethiopian Orthodox Church Religious leaders and the clergy held prayers and masses at the Holy Trinity Church in the capital Addis Ababa commemorating the Holy Maundy.
entries.translation: Abbootiin amantii fi luboonni Bataskaana Ortoodoksii Itoopiyaa kadhannaa geggeessuun amantoonni Bataskaana Qulqulluu Sillaasee Addis Ababaa keessatti Qulqulluuu Jala Bultii Gannaa yaadatan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Religious fathers and some clergy, while observing the holly day, made supplication to God to save the world from the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic.
entries.translation: Abbootiin amantii fi luboonni muraasi, guyyaa ayyaanaa yeroo hordofan, addunyaa kana weerara vaayirasii koronaa (COVID-19) jalaa akka oolchuuf kadhata gara Waaqaatti godhan.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: According to Tourism Ministry, the celebration begins on September 22 to entertain assorted events including visiting Ethiopia’s rich cultural, historical, and natural attractions.
entries.translation: Akka Ministirii Tuurizimiitti, kabaji aayyaanichaa gaafa Fulbaana 22 bakkeewwan hawwatoo Itoopiyaa aadaa, seenaa fi uumamamaan badhaadhan daawwachuu dabalatee qophiilee walitti qindeeffaman dhiyeessuun jalqabama.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: Various sport competitions, exhibitions and symposiums are also scheduled events of the festival.
entries.translation: Dorgommiileen ispoortii adda addaa, agarsiisonni fi simpooziyemiiwwanis qophiilee festivaalicha irratti karoorfamaniidha.
entries.context: Lesan AI HornMT Parallel News Benchmark (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/asmelashteka/HornMT)

entries.english: For God so loved the world (John 3:16 — 1889 Southern / Bararetta Orma-Borana Specimen #153)
entries.translation: Manif ak suni Wain ha fed'e inama lafa, ak in fed'e, ak in Ilm isa tokocha kofa d'alete base, akum suni, namn d'ud'umt ka is d'uguomfetu ak im bane, ammo ha d'argetu fayum ta in dumne.
